verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify cloud connection is established (positive case)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify cloud connection is NOT established (negative case)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify ES data IS uploaded to AWS (positive case)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default unit selection on screen open
verificationPatterns.example: Meters scale is chosen by default; radio buttons offer 'Meters' (or Feet if customer setting changed) and 'A3'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Screen chrome verification
verificationPatterns.example: Title reads 'Printing Counters', radio group labeled 'Display usage in:', Close button present

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ordered list layout — fixed-order group first, then alphabetical
verificationPatterns.example: CMYKOVG inks listed first in left-hand column top-to-bottom; remaining inks in alphabetical order starting from middle column

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter display for missing data
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate no data for a random ink; counter must display '---'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter display for installed-but-unused ink
verificationPatterns.example: Install new ink on press without printing; counter must display '0'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ink name bound to correct color icon
verificationPatterns.example: Each ink entry shows a color drop icon matching the ink's actual color

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter increment after print job
verificationPatterns.example: Start DFE job with random color separations; verify all affected counters changed accordingly

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button illumination encodes system state (lit = ready, blinking = pending/transitioning, off = unavailable)
verificationPatterns.example: UW SWF physical button is blinking / RW SWF physical button is blinking [during ILP transition to Milling]

verificationPatterns.pattern: Buzzer sounds on actionable button press; absence of buzzer indicates cooldown or invalid state
verificationPatterns.example: Buzzer is sounded if 30 seconds were passed from previous SWF button press

verificationPatterns.pattern: Action deferred until precondition signal reaches target value; verify action does NOT execute before precondition
verificationPatterns.example: SWF is performed only when ILP reaches Milling

verificationPatterns.pattern: Deferred action does NOT auto-trigger once precondition is met; requires explicit re-press
verificationPatterns.example: SWF is not performed (web is not moving) [after ILP reaches Milling and dryer at temperature]

verificationPatterns.pattern: Hold-to-run: action continues while button held, stops on release
verificationPatterns.example: SWF continues all the time the button is pressed / SWF is stopped successfully [on release]

verificationPatterns.pattern: Subsystem state preserved across SWF start and stop
verificationPatterns.example: ILP remains in Milling [after SWF and after SWF stop]

verificationPatterns.pattern: Subsequent identical operation does not cause state regression in dependent subsystem
verificationPatterns.example: ILP remains in Milling (does not change states) [on second SWF press]

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify precondition signal value via OPCUA path before asserting dependent behavior
verificationPatterns.example: Wait till OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ExportedData.ILP.Status.MillingStatus = True and dryer has reached production temperature

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button illumination matches press state
verificationPatterns.example: UW SWF physical button is not lit (OFF state); UW SWF physical button is lit (Standby state)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button action blocked in OFF state
verificationPatterns.example: When UW SWF physical button is pressed, SWF is not performed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Held-button blink feedback during operation
verificationPatterns.example: UW SWF physical button is blinking; RW SWF physical button is blinking

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dry mode suppresses ILP transition and dryer activation
verificationPatterns.example: ILP does not transition to Milling state, dryer is not activated

verificationPatterns.pattern: SWF executes immediately without waiting for ILP
verificationPatterns.example: SWF is performed ASAP, not waiting for ILP

verificationPatterns.pattern: Buzzer sounds on SWF button press
verificationPatterns.example: Buzzer is sounded

verificationPatterns.pattern: Priority classification — first-published error becomes failure
verificationPatterns.example: The first error that publish from the PLC subsystem will be classified as failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Secondary error downgrades to error severity
verificationPatterns.example: second as error

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cross-subsystem simultaneous error handling
verificationPatterns.example: one in the same time but from other subsystem *CS flow + BKT temp

verificationPatterns.pattern: Baseline parameter verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify ???.swfButtonAccleration = 0.5, ???.UwRwMaxAccleration = 1, ???.ilpPrintTimeout = 2000

verificationPatterns.pattern: Record scope measurement before parameter change
verificationPatterns.example: Perform web feed via physical button and record web speed using scope

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter change reflected in hardware state
verificationPatterns.example: After setting swfButtonAccleration=0.25, UwRwMaxAccleration=0.5 — UW and RW SWF physical buttons are lit

verificationPatterns.pattern: Proportional behavior verification after parameter halving
verificationPatterns.example: Web speed should be half the speed that was before after halving swfButtonAccleration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Symmetry check across paired buttons
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat web feed for the other physical button to confirm same behavior

verificationPatterns.pattern: Restore original values after test
verificationPatterns.example: Return swfButtonAccleration=0.5 and UwRwMaxAccleration=1 after test completes

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-transition on single failure
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate failure → press state moves to Standby; failure from subsystem displayed on UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Time-windowed failure escalation (4-second window)
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate second failure within 4 seconds of first → press state moves to OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cumulative failure display on UI
verificationPatterns.example: Failure from relevant subsystem displayed in addition to the first failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Direct Standby→OFF transition on single failure
verificationPatterns.example: Press already in Standby; simulate failure → press state moves to OFF; failure displayed alongside prior failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition on single failure during pre-print
verificationPatterns.example: On pre print simulate press failure → press move to ready state/Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure message displayed from subsystem
verificationPatterns.example: Failure from relevant subsystem displayed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Escalated state transition on second failure within time window
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate another failure in time range of 4 seconds from the first error → Press state move to OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multiple failure messages accumulate
verificationPatterns.example: Failure displayed from relevant subsystem in addition to the first failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Time-bounded failure window triggers algorithm change
verificationPatterns.example: Second failure within 4 seconds of first → escalation to OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simulate signal-driven failure and verify press state transition
verificationPatterns.example: Set OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.BKT.HW_Inputs.Stir.StirIRTempSens=108 → verify press moves to Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inject failure within 2-second cache window and verify state degrades further
verificationPatterns.example: Within 2s of first failure simulate another error → verify Press State is Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inject third failure within 1–3s window and verify OFF state plus UI failure count
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate failure in same 1–3s range → press state is OFF; 3 failures displayed on UI with relevant details

verificationPatterns.pattern: After recovering to Print, inject failure and verify OFF state recurrence with failure details
verificationPatterns.example: Set OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.HW_Inputs.Dryer.TemperatureSensor=0 → Press is at OFF state with relevant failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inject failure outside the accumulation window (>3s) and verify no failure shown on UI
verificationPatterns.example: After 4s from last failure set OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.HW_Inputs.RW.DancerPos=20 → no failure displayed on UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure causes press state change to ready with correct UI event display
verificationPatterns.example: ready state change with relevant failure event message. Relevant subsystem displayed.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure severity propagated as-is from BL to ES and all history reports
verificationPatterns.example: ES and all history reports shall receive the severity as it was classified by BL.

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC_FAILURE_STATE_CHANGE suppressed from UI but still written to CSV history
verificationPatterns.example: No _PLC_FAILURE_STATE_CHANGE displayed on UI (still shall be written to .cvs history)

verificationPatterns.pattern: All expected parameters present on failure event
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all parameters exist on event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Second failure injected within 2s cache window produces separate UI event entry (total count verified)
verificationPatterns.example: In cache of 2s prior 2s delay, simulate another failure... total 2 failure display on events

verificationPatterns.pattern: Non-failure errors (e.g. near-panic thresholds) continue displaying on UI after a failure-triggered state change
verificationPatterns.example: Errors from relevant subsystem keep displaying after failure occurred.

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI event display on fault injection
verificationPatterns.example: UI screen displays the event CB_FEEDBACK_FAILURE with the correct CB ID

verificationPatterns.pattern: CB trips off on feedback failure
verificationPatterns.example: CB tripped OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat pattern across all EC zones
verificationPatterns.example: Do 1-3 for UW EC, PWS EC, PE Feed EC, PE Exit EC, UC EC, RW EC

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault injected mid-print via E-stop during active job
verificationPatterns.example: Start print regular job and during print press the E-stop button CB_FEEDBACK_FAILURE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wire reconnect as teardown/recovery step
verificationPatterns.example: Reconnect the wire

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI malfunction event on sensor fault
verificationPatterns.example: UI display an event about 24V

verificationPatterns.pattern: Scope verification of safety output disabled on sensor fault
verificationPatterns.example: BDV lamps are disabled by scope (PE area, ref 3.2.4.2)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Recovery by reconnecting faulty cable
verificationPatterns.example: Reconnect the cable (step 3)

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI error event displayed for sensor fault during get ready activation
verificationPatterns.example: During get ready activation UI screen display error event about the sensor

verificationPatterns.pattern: BDV lamps disabled state confirmed by oscilloscope measurement
verificationPatterns.example: Verify by scope that BDV lamps are disabled 3.2.4.2. PE area

verificationPatterns.pattern: Restore hardware state after fault injection
verificationPatterns.example: Reconnect the cable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event assertion on sensor fault during Get Ready sequence
verificationPatterns.example: Perform Get Ready → verify event PRESSURE_PANIC_LOW

verificationPatterns.pattern: Scope-based hardware output verification on safety fault
verificationPatterns.example: Verify by scope that BDV lamps are disabled (PE area) when sensor is disconnected

verificationPatterns.pattern: Restore precondition after fault injection
verificationPatterns.example: Reconnect the cable after verification steps complete

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault injection via physical disconnection → observe expected start failure signal
verificationPatterns.example: Start Get Ready → press fails on PRESSURE_PANIC_LOW

verificationPatterns.pattern: Scope-based electrical verification of safety output under fault condition
verificationPatterns.example: Verify by scope that BDV lamps are disabled (SWR 3.2.4.2)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Restore physical condition after fault injection to close test
verificationPatterns.example: Reconnect air pipe to pressure sensor

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal assertion on cable disconnect
verificationPatterns.example: Disconnect interlock cable while closed → expect xy_ZONE_OPENED_UNEXPECTEDLY + Zone name

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI event verification on fault
verificationPatterns.example: Event displayed on UI with relevant details (highlighted in step 1 expected result)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal assertion with pole-status parameter on wire break
verificationPatterns.example: Disconnect Wire A or B → expect xy_ZONE_OPENED_UNEXPECTEDLY with parameter of poles status

verificationPatterns.pattern: State restoration after reconnect
verificationPatterns.example: Reconnect interlock cable / wire → verify door/lock state returns to expected (noted as open question in case)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cable disconnect triggers safety event with pole parameter
verificationPatterns.example: disconnect the E stop entire cable → UI displays EMS_WAS_ACTIVATED (with parameter of pole status)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Reconnect restores press to OFF state
verificationPatterns.example: Reconnect the E stop cable → press state move to OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Single pole wire disconnect triggers same safety event
verificationPatterns.example: Disconnect pole A \ B wire from the E stop connector → UI displays EMS_WAS_ACTIVATED (with parameter of pole status)

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI indication on interlock open
verificationPatterns.example: interlock is open. indication in UI displayed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Motors and contactors disabled within deactivation delay after interlock opens (scope measurement required)
verificationPatterns.example: All relevant contactors and motors disabled. verify by scope - TBD

verificationPatterns.pattern: Relevant enable contactors state checked after interlock opens
verificationPatterns.example: relevant enable contactors enabled?

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press returns to OFF state with all relevant enables active after door closes
verificationPatterns.example: Door closed and press back to OFF state with all relevant enabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat steps 1-4 for each interlock door in the system
verificationPatterns.example: 1-4 for: UW dancer door, PWS rear door, ILP dancer door, Priming door, Drying door, PWS front exit door, PE rear feed door, PE rear middle door, PE rear exit door, PE front door, RW roll door

verificationPatterns.pattern: Interlock door state check after stop
verificationPatterns.example: After E stop pressed and press stop - Make sure all interlocked doors are closed and unlocked (Service state)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Safety power enable button state check
verificationPatterns.example: Check the power enable button behind the press — expected: Safety Power enable button is still ON

verificationPatterns.pattern: E-stop release transitions press to OFF state
verificationPatterns.example: Release the E-stop button — expected: Press move to OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Scope tool verification of drive safety-enable and no unwanted axes movement
verificationPatterns.example: Using the Scope tool, make sure all drives are safety-enabled and there are no unwanted axes movements

verificationPatterns.pattern: Deactivation timing check — actuator response within spec
verificationPatterns.example: Motors and contactors have stopped and disabled in less than specified deactivation delay according to Safety for Kedem S6 logic requirements

verificationPatterns.pattern: Negative safety check — protected components must NOT trip
verificationPatterns.example: CBs should not be tripped to OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: HV power-off verification for multiple subsystems
verificationPatterns.example: CRU HV and BID HV are OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Visual inspection of mechanical safety element state
verificationPatterns.example: Check by visual inspection that Main air supply valve has shut OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-area coverage — repeat test per E-stop zone
Press E-Stop → EMS activated with button identity, press transitions to power-disable state
verificationPatterns.example: Press UW E-STOP (1) → EMS_WAS_ACTIVATED with Estop button name; press state changed to power disable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Release E-Stop → press returns to OFF state
verificationPatterns.example: Release the E stop button → Press state back to OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat press/release cycle for every E-Stop button in enumerated list
verificationPatterns.example: repeat 2-3 steps for: PWS UW SIDE E-STOP (2), PWS Rear E-STOP (3), PWS Front feed E-STOP (4), PWS FRONT Exit E-STOP (5), PWS BUTT SPLICER UW E-STOP (6), PE Rear E-Stop (7), PE Front Exit E-Stop (12), UC Rear E-Stop (8), IC Front Feed E-stop, IC Front Exit E-stop (9), IC E-STOP, RW E-STOP (10), UC ILF E-STOP (14), UC Turret (automatic) RW E-STOP (15)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Hardware-inaccessible buttons may be emulated in software
verificationPatterns.example: PWS BUTT SPLICER UW E-STOP (6) (or emulate the button); UC ILF E-STOP (14) (or emulate the button); UC Turret (automatic) RW E-STOP (15) (or emulate the button)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Trigger-based report issuance — verify report emitted for all outcome states
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the press issues the report once ImO wash has passed, failed, or not performed due to pre conditions that were not filled (all 3 statuses)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Local telemetry delivery — verify data reaches Elasticsearch
verificationPatterns.example: Statistics report shall deliver data locally to elastic search

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter table assertion — verify report payload matches expected parameters table
verificationPatterns.example: Expected: See below parameters table

verificationPatterns.pattern: OP data status = completed successfully after auto-wash finishes
verificationPatterns.example: Wash is completed successfully. Verify OP data with status completed successfully.

verificationPatterns.pattern: OP data status = failed with reason ID when wash errors during execution
verificationPatterns.example: Separator sensor fails to turn back on; error issued. Verify OP data status changed to failed with proper reason ID.

verificationPatterns.pattern: OP data status = stopped with reason ID when wash is aborted mid-execution
verificationPatterns.example: User lowers press to off during wash; wash is aborted and counting is not initialized by App. Verify PLC OP data status with proper ID reason and status stopped.

verificationPatterns.pattern: OP data status = skipped when IMO wash flag is true but wash did not run
verificationPatterns.example: Wash didn't run even the IMO wash flag is true. Verify the PLC OP data expose status skipped.

verificationPatterns.pattern: OP data status = idle when wizard is not required to run
verificationPatterns.example: Verify if no necessity to run the wizard the OP data is Idle.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blocked operation — confirm action did not execute when blocking condition is active
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the IMO auth wash didn't execute after clicking std while water tank is low

verificationPatterns.pattern: Feature flag preserved — confirm flag unchanged after blocked operation
verificationPatterns.example: Verify ImOWashFeatureFlag still true after failed wash attempt

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter unchanged — confirm history/counter did not increment after blocked operation
verificationPatterns.example: ImoAutoWashHistory counter didn't count another wash

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state transition completes independently — confirm press reaches target state despite blocked sub-operation
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the press reached standby even though wash was not executed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event generated — confirm specific error code emitted on blocking condition
verificationPatterns.example: IMO_REC_WATER_TANK_LEVEL_LOW error message generated

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error appears exactly once at standby and does not alter press state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify for all relevant errors that appear only one time at std and not change press state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Events fire based on subsystem state definition, not only as part of the triggering operation flow
verificationPatterns.example: Events are functional based on sub systems state definition and not only as part of the above operation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fallback guidance available — if wizard unavailable, user can follow warning event 'what to do'
verificationPatterns.example: If wizard is not available in case of one of the below warning events, user can follow warning event 'what to do'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blocking-condition gate: wash operation suppressed when tank-level signal is low
verificationPatterns.example: WasteWaterLevelLow.status = True → click STD → verify OP did not execute

verificationPatterns.pattern: Flag persistence: feature flag stays true after blocked wash attempt
verificationPatterns.example: ImOWashFeatureFlag still true after STD click with low tank

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter non-increment: auto wash history counter must not advance on blocked attempt
verificationPatterns.example: ImoAutoWashHistory counter didn't count another wash

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state progression: press still reaches standby despite blocked wash
verificationPatterns.example: The press reached to std

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event generation: specific error event emitted matching the blocking condition
verificationPatterns.example: IMO_REC_WATER_TANK_LEVEL_LOW generated (water tank); IMO_REC_SEPARATOR_LEVEL_LOW generated (separator)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Feature flag gate check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify ImOWashFeatureFlag is change to True — shall exist in pex

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC executes subsystem OP during press mech init
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that PLC executes wash as part of press mech init

verificationPatterns.pattern: All subsystems reach target state BEFORE OP executes
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all subsystems reached standby BEFORE the OP is executed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state transition blocked until OP completes
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press reached to std only after the IMO auto wash OP executed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Resume after power cycle
verificationPatterns.example: Turn the power on and verify the download proceeds

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log-based version confirmation
verificationPatterns.example: Go to logs and verify new version was installed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-update functional smoke
verificationPatterns.example: Move the press to Ready and print user job

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert feature unavailability with specific press message when hardware not detected
verificationPatterns.example: Any print functions shall not be available with press message: PressNotAvailableDongleNotDetected

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert error event generation and user notification when hardware fault detected with SN present
verificationPatterns.example: Press SW shall generate error event and notify user

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert production continuity — no behavioral change — when fault is non-blocking
verificationPatterns.example: Press production will continue w/o any changes

verificationPatterns.pattern: SN persisted on press as local parameter
verificationPatterns.example: SN number is stored on the press.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dongle ID rotation with same SN is not a mismatch
verificationPatterns.example: Dongle ID changes with new USB dongle but with same SN is not considered as mismatch if SN is match.

verificationPatterns.pattern: No dongle → DONGLE_NOT_DETECTED event generated
verificationPatterns.example: Following event shall be generated: _DONGLE_NOT_DETECTED_

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press responds immediately to dongle absence
verificationPatterns.example: Press shall immediately response to the issue - Press behavior detailed below.

verificationPatterns.pattern: SN mismatch → PC_DONGLE_MISMATCH event generated
verificationPatterns.example: In case dongle detected but S/N on dongle not match the S/N App SW shall generate next event: PC_DONGLE_MISMATCH

verificationPatterns.pattern: Popup error visible to operator on mismatch event
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the popped event error raised.

verificationPatterns.pattern: AppSW regenerates event and popup after SW restart when issue persists
verificationPatterns.example: In case one of above issues persist, AppSW shall regenerate the event- Verify restart SW and popud errors.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event assertion — exact event name
verificationPatterns.example: Press shall generate error event: "PC_DONGLE_MISMATCH"

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event parameter value assertion — empty/missing SN represented as sentinel string
verificationPatterns.example: Press S/N under this case shall be represented as parameter with value; "Not_Exist" (empty) (ES write as part of the event data)

verificationPatterns.pattern: ES write assertion — verify sentinel string persisted to ES
verificationPatterns.example: To the Es shall be write as "Not_Exist"

verificationPatterns.pattern: File artifact assertion — verify DB file created and contains expected SN
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the secure.db.exe file created and the SN is in this file - You can see this with SQL lote S:\-Press-bin-Securedata-secure.db

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state reachability assertion — verify press cycles through all operational states
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the press reached to OFF, Standby, get ready, Ready\DynamicReady

verificationPatterns.pattern: Feature lockout assertion — verify print functions blocked when precondition unmet
verificationPatterns.example: If press side SN not exist — Press shall be not functional. Any print functions shall not be available

verificationPatterns.pattern: User-facing message assertion — exact press message string when dongle absent
verificationPatterns.example: If dongle not detected "PressNotAvailableDongleNotDetected"

verificationPatterns.pattern: Interrupt during async operation then verify resume
verificationPatterns.example: While auto-download in progress shut down power, then turn power on and verify download proceeds

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log-based version verification post-install
verificationPatterns.example: Go to logs and verify new version was installed

verificationPatterns.pattern: End-to-end readiness check after recovery
verificationPatterns.example: Move press to Ready and print user job

verificationPatterns.pattern: Flag persists across SW upgrade
verificationPatterns.example: DryBIDRequired=False/True before upgrade → same value after upgrade completes

verificationPatterns.pattern: Flag false → stays false after SW open
verificationPatterns.example: DryBIDRequired=False before SW reset → Flag = false after SW opened

verificationPatterns.pattern: Flag true → stays true after SW open
verificationPatterns.example: DryBIDRequired=True before SW reset → Flag = True after SW opened

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-entry triggers correct BID variant
verificationPatterns.example: mech-init from OFF → BID valve open + drain BID performed; failure-driven OFF → drain BID only (no dry BID)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Automatic dry BID fires during Get Ready
verificationPatterns.example: Start Get Ready → dry BID performs automatically before ready state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-print dry BID + state promotion to dynamic ready
verificationPatterns.example: Print 10 copies → at post-print, automatic dry BID performed, press state changes to dynamic ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: State demotion from dynamic ready to ready re-triggers dry BID
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate error (e.g. bad reading from EH X) lowering state to ready → dry BID performed on state entry

verificationPatterns.pattern: Nominal OFF transition during print triggers dry BID
verificationPatterns.example: Change press state to OFF during print → dry BID performed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure-driven OFF triggers drain BID only, not dry BID
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate failure during print/GR that forces OFF → only drain BID performed

verificationPatterns.pattern: DryBIDRequired=False flag suppresses re-execution and clears wizard icon
verificationPatterns.example: Dry BID not finished successfully from wizard + {_}DryBIDRequired{_}=False → after GR/ready, dry BID marked done and wizard menu icon not displayed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Run-all triggers sequence only on non-bypassed units
verificationPatterns.example: All BID's start dry BID sequence. BID's that bypassed not start dry BID sequence.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter reflects number of units started
verificationPatterns.example: Counter under the screen header display the number of BID's started.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Control unavailability shown with reason
verificationPatterns.example: Stop not available with relevant availability reason.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard completion marked with pass/fail color per unit
verificationPatterns.example: Wizard finished with pass \ fail and marked with relevant color above BID's.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Exit-service-state checkbox on close transitions service state to OFF
verificationPatterns.example: Click on 'exit Service state on Close.' check box and click 'close'. After wizard menu closed, service state move to OFF state.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure signal causes unit to display failure icon and label
verificationPatterns.example: After failure the BID that failed mark with icon and text 'drying needed' (Icon displayed).

verificationPatterns.pattern: Read OPC-UA HV signal and assert voltage at print state
verificationPatterns.example: During print start, CleanerVoltSet_v.Value == 280V

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inject NULL state and assert squeegee voltage drops to null level
verificationPatterns.example: During NULL, SqueegeeVoltSet_v.Value == 220V; rule: V_Squeegee = V_Developer + 5

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass VJOS from both PLC and App, then verify print mode and voltages apply across all print areas including seam
verificationPatterns.example: Print voltages and mode applied during print and on seam

verificationPatterns.pattern: HV moves to VJOS voltages during non-printing area
verificationPatterns.example: HV shall move to VJOS voltages at none printing area

verificationPatterns.pattern: HV returns to slot voltages at fixed stabilization distance before slot start
verificationPatterns.example: return to slot voltages, BidVjosToPrintStabilizationDist microns before slot start

verificationPatterns.pattern: Hardware removal blocks wizard availability with named reason
verificationPatterns.example: Pull random INK tank out → dry BID unavailable with relevant availability reason (INK_TANK_NOT_IN_PLACE)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Invalid/out-of-range sensor reading blocks wizard Play button
verificationPatterns.example: INK level invalid or INK level too low/high → Wizard Play button not available (INK_LEVEL_INVALID / INK_LEVEL_TOO_LOW)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mid-wizard fault shows failure, leaves subsystem in safe state, lets background sequence finish

verificationPatterns.pattern: Process activation during mode transition
verificationPatterns.example: During Get Ready process, verify blade wetting activates for all stations before press reaches standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mode arrival confirmation
verificationPatterns.example: Press is in standby mode after Get Ready completes

verificationPatterns.pattern: Precondition state assertion
verificationPatterns.example: Press is in standby mode before initiating Get Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Process activation during transition
verificationPatterns.example: During get ready process verify that blade wetting process activated

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter-driven timing control
verificationPatterns.example: Timeout duration configurable via BladeWetRequiredTimePeriod to shorten test execution

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual trigger coverage
verificationPatterns.example: Same wetting activation verified via two independent triggers: elapsed time and station deactivation/reactivation

verificationPatterns.pattern: CS blade wetting request is true during Get Ready
verificationPatterns.example: CS blade wetting is true gInterface.Station[index].Ctrl.In.Par.Local.CS_BladeWettingReq

verificationPatterns.pattern: CS engage sensor is active during wetting sequence
verificationPatterns.example: CS Engage gIos.Station[index].CS.Input.EngageSens.Value

verificationPatterns.pattern: CS at-wetting status is set during Get Ready
verificationPatterns.example: CS at wetting gInterface.Station[index].Comp.CS.Main.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtWetting

verificationPatterns.pattern: Asid blade wetting angle increments by 25 degrees on each CS re-insertion + GR cycle
verificationPatterns.example: The last Asid Blade Wetting Angle is 25 degrees more than in previous step gInterface.Station[index].Ctrl.In.Par.Save.LastAsidBladeWettingAngle

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blade wetting process does NOT activate during Get Ready when CS was not removed
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that during get ready, the blade wetting process did not activated

verificationPatterns.pattern: Maintenance availability blocked until blocking condition cleared
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that ILP maintenance availability is False till ILP wash performed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Maintenance availability blocked by charge/discharge state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify PE Maintenance availability is False till ASID discharging

verificationPatterns.pattern: Maintenance availability blocked by temperature threshold
verificationPatterns.example: Verify PWS maintenance availability is False till Dryer temp < 50

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket tension above threshold after mode entry
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Comp.Tension.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.Tension.BktTenAct > 100

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket tension drops to near-zero after mode switch
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Comp.Tension.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.Tension.BktTenAct ~ 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: BR position at service position during active service mode
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that BRs are at service position

verificationPatterns.pattern: PE front door unlocked during active service mode
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that PE front door unlocked

verificationPatterns.pattern: PE front door interlock signal low (unlocked) during service
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockLockCmdStatus.PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state returns to OFF after EndService
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: All component states reset to NA after EndService
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that all components States changed to NA

verificationPatterns.pattern: PE front door interlock signal high (locked) after EndService
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockLockCmdStatus.PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify service mode parameter equals chosen mode value
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Manager.ExportedData.Sys.Status.AtServiceMode[0-54] = Seq

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify machine state returns to OFF after end-service operation
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify indexed service mode parameters reset to NA after service ends
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Manager.ExportedData.Sys.Status.AtServiceMode[0-54] = NA

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify press is in OFF state as precondition
verificationPatterns.example: Press is in OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify indexed subsystem status array matches set service mode value
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Manager.ExportedData.Sys.Status.AtServiceMode[0-54] = EA

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify end-service operation is available before calling it
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.EndService.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify machine state returns to OFF after ending service
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify indexed subsystem status array resets to NA after end service
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Manager.ExportedData.Sys.Status.AtServiceMode[0-54] = NA

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service unavailable in non-Off states
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.Service.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = False (at Standby and Ready)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service available in Off state
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.Service.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = True (at Off)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Subsystem service mode flag array transitions to Service state
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Manager.ExportedData.Sys.Status.AtServiceMode[0-54] changed to Service state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state returns to Off after EndService
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-component status check after service start — from Stdby/Ready initial state
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.Web.Comp.DRYER.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtStandBy, NS4|String|gInterface.Web.Comp.RW.Out.Status.AtReady = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-component AtOFF status check after service start — from OFF initial state
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.Web.Comp.DRYER.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOFF = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Distinguish AtStandBy vs AtReady per component — not all components use same terminal state signal
verificationPatterns.example: DRYER/ILP/WHS use AtStandBy; RW/SPM/UW use AtReady

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-dependent signal value: verify signal holds Stdby/Ready value when entered from Stdby/Ready, different value when entered from OFF
verificationPatterns.example: BlowersAtLowSpeed=True from Stdby/Ready vs BlowersAtOffSpeed=True from OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Monitor active/inactive based on source state: boolean monitor signal is True from Stdby/Ready, False from OFF
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.CWS.Ctrl.Out.Status.Monitor_Active=True (Stdby/Ready), False (OFF)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Subsystem ready status preserved: AtReady signal True when source state is Stdby/Ready
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.ImoSystem.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtReady=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Subsystem OFF status set: AtOFF signal True when source state is OFF
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.Reservoir.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOFF=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-invariant signal: some signals hold same value regardless of source state
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.InkCommon.InkWaterCtrlTutko.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtStdBy=True in both Stdby/Ready and OFF entry paths

verificationPatterns.pattern: Start sub-mode operation → verify status flag goes True
verificationPatterns.example: Call CWS.Sys.EA.Start → NS4|String|gInterface.CWS.Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.CWS_Main.Ea = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: End service operation → verify status flag returns False
verificationPatterns.example: Call EndService.Start → NS4|String|gInterface.CWS.Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.CWS_Main.Ea = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Each mode (EA, SEQ) toggled independently via its own Start operation and cleared by EndService
verificationPatterns.example: Call CWS.Sys.SEQ.Start → CWS_Main.Seq = True; EndService.Start → CWS_Main.Seq = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: CSV-driven property comparison: load expected values from a data table file, compare each property of the entity to the corresponding row
verificationPatterns.example: Data from table is matching the DB. (source: standardWhiteParameters.csv)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Exhaustive property sweep: verify ALL properties of an ink entity in a single case rather than one property per case
verificationPatterns.example: Choose standard White and compare each property to the requirements.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter-to-requirement alignment check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify parameters are aligned to SW requirements.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state assertion
verificationPatterns.example: Press state is OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tube-in-place check across all stations via sensor signal
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[index].HW.Inputs.INK[index].Rdu.Tube.In.Place.Sens.Value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Revolver save-state cleared before test (WorkSideA false, SaveEnable true)
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[index].Comp.arrBid[index].Ink.Rdu.Comp.Revolver.Ctrl.In.Par.Save.WorkSideA = false

verificationPatterns.pattern: Extractor-up check across all stations via sensor signal
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[index].HW_Inputs.INK[index].Rdu.Ext_Piston_Up_Sens.Value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mutual-exclusion check: neighbor revolvers not rotating simultaneously
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that neighbor revolvers of rotating revolver not rotating in the same time — ginterface.Station[1].Comp.arrBid[1].Ink.Rdu.Comp.Revolver.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtRotation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Safety event raised with specific error code
verificationPatterns.example: Verify event raised: MOTOR_HOMING_FAILED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press transitions to safe/Off state on motor fault
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press fell to OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Torque fault identifies correct motor ID
verificationPatterns.example: Verify error raised: TORQUE_FAILURE with correct motor ID

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event payload contains actual vs expected values
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in event actual/expected torque appeared

verificationPatterns.pattern: Set HW input signal to fault value, then verify UI indication appears
verificationPatterns.example: Change STIR_TRAY_IN_PLACE_SNS to 0 while in Print state → verify indication in UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Set HW input signal to warning/alert value, then verify UI indication appears
verificationPatterns.example: Change STIR_TRAY_ALMST_FULL_SNS to 1 while in Print state → verify indication in UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Set HW input sensor to active state, then verify UI indication appears
verificationPatterns.example: Change STIR_TRAY_FULL_SNS_LIGHT_ON to 1 while in Print state → verify indication in UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault code assertion — verify specific error code is raised after injecting hardware input failure
verificationPatterns.example: Verify error raised - STICKY_ROLLER_THERMAL_SAFETY_CUTOFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition assertion — verify press falls to expected safe/fault state after safety event
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press fell to TBD state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Lamp/indicator suppression — verify safety-related lamp does NOT illuminate during fault condition
verificationPatterns.example: Verify STIR lamp is not turning ON

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-at-trigger: end print from normal running state → verify AtStandBy without clean cycle
verificationPatterns.example: wait for TempCtrlActive=True, end print → AtStandBy=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-at-trigger: end print during pre-clean state → verify end-clean command issued, then AtStandBy
verificationPatterns.example: AtPreClean=True, click end print → verify end clean command + AtStandBy=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-at-trigger: end print during clean state → verify engage phase, blanket rotations complete, then AtStandBy
verificationPatterns.example: AtClean=True, click end print → AtEngage=True → StirCleanColdBlanketRotations complete → AtStandBy=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Terminal state assertion: all paths must end with AtStandBy=True
verificationPatterns.example: OCB_saPLC.OCB.gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtStandBy = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Rotation count verification: blanket rotates for named parameter value before transitioning
verificationPatterns.example: Verify bkt rotates for StirCleanColdBlanketRotations after end print command

verificationPatterns.pattern: DB entity value check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in PEX::SubstrateEntity the tensions are correct

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC OPC-UA signal propagation check — verify SW value pushed to PLC web component signals after substrate install
verificationPatterns.example: Verify tensions moved to PLC web component: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.Ctrl.UnwinderTension.Value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Monitor ON/OFF state check after signal override
verificationPatterns.example: Tank level monitor is OFF, Heating control is OFF, Pump is OFF, Pressure Monitor is OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event with actual/expected values issued on fault condition
verificationPatterns.example: Error event 'LEVEL_PANIC_LOW' with actual/expected values issued

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout-based state transition during MechInit
verificationPatterns.example: LPH fall to OFF state after 'LPHTankTempMITimeoutMs' (60000ms)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout error event issued after heating fails to complete
verificationPatterns.example: Error '_LPH_COOLING_TANK_TEMP_HEATING_TIMED_OUT_' issued

verificationPatterns.pattern: Nominal MechInit verifies all monitors and outputs active, reaching Standby
verificationPatterns.example: Tank level monitor ON, Heating control ON, Pump ON, Pressure monitor ON — LPH Cooling reach Standby state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass monitoring signal, inject out-of-range value, verify state unchanged
verificationPatterns.example: Bypass 'LPH main line pressure monitoring', change Main Line pressure to above LPHMainLinePressureValidHigh and below LPHTankLevelValidLow, verify LPH Cooling remains in Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Test both high and low out-of-range extremes under bypass
verificationPatterns.example: Change value to above ValidHigh AND below ValidLow/PanicLow thresholds within same step

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timed multi-action verification: all shutdown actions complete within deadline
verificationPatterns.example: Issue EMStop command and verify the following actions happened within 2.8 seconds: Turn off LPH power supplies, Close heater control, Close water pump, Temperature control turned off, All monitors turned off, LPH cooling changed to power off state (last)

verificationPatterns.pattern: State persistence under concurrent command: verify state unchanged when secondary command issued in restricted mode
verificationPatterns.example: Perform MechInit while in EmergencyStop and verify LPH cooling remains in Power Disabled state

verificationPatterns.pattern: State recovery after fault release: verify return to expected idle state
verificationPatterns.example: Release Emergency stop and verify LPH cooling returns to OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ordered shutdown sequencing: last action in shutdown sequence explicitly verified
verificationPatterns.example: LPH cooling changed to power off state (Should be last)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Apply bypass → verify signal drops to 0
verificationPatterns.example: Bypass LPH power supply → value changes to 0 on OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.LPHCooling.HW_Outputs.LPH_1_Enable_Voltage.Value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Remove bypass → verify signal restores to 1
verificationPatterns.example: Remove LPH power supply bypass → value changes to 1 on OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.LPHCooling.HW_Outputs.LPH_1_Enable_Voltage.Value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Actuator starts under valid preconditions
verificationPatterns.example: Waste pump starts to work when barrel not full and UC_CT_Low is Up

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error raised and press state unchanged on invalid-range signal value
verificationPatterns.example: Set Pressure > or < Invalid threshold → error PRESSURE_INVALID raised, press state no change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error raised and press state unchanged on panic-range signal value
verificationPatterns.example: Set Pressure > or < Panic threshold → error PRESSURE_Panic_High/Low raised, press state no change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Output activates on trigger-signal falling edge after state transition
verificationPatterns.example: Waste pump starts work when CT Low goes Down (0) after state changes to SB

verificationPatterns.pattern: Output sustains for press-type-specific timed duration
verificationPatterns.example: Waste pump continues to work during UcWasteAddDrain time (UC) / PeWasteAddDrain time (PE)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Same test repeated per press variant using variant-specific signals
verificationPatterns.example: Step 1 uses UC_CT_Low; Step 2 uses PE_CT_Low — same pump output observed for both

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition on threshold violation
verificationPatterns.example: Verify CS changed to Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event raised with current/expected values on threshold breach
verificationPatterns.example: Verify an event raised about - CS_IMO_LOW_FLOW with current/expected values

verificationPatterns.pattern: No state change and no event when precondition state does not apply
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press stayed at Ready state and no event

verificationPatterns.pattern: FlowBypass active across specific state transitions
verificationPatterns.example: Bypass is working from StandbytoWetting, StandbyToFreeWetting, FreeWettingToWetting

verificationPatterns.pattern: AT_OFF status check — manager + all sub-components
verificationPatterns.example: Verify CS manager and all components below status At OFF is TRUE.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ordered shutdown sequence — Wetting state
verificationPatterns.example: Close CS inlet valve → Disengage CS → Close inlet valve → CS rotation to OFF (Motors deenergized) → Stop CS-IMO flow monitoring → Stop CS aSid temp ctrl

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ordered shutdown sequence — Free Wetting state (no Disengage CS step)
verificationPatterns.example: Close CS inlet valve → Close inlet valve → CS rotation to OFF (Motors deenergized) → Stop CS-IMO flow monitoring → Stop CS aSid temp ctrl

verificationPatterns.pattern: Source-state-dependent sequence delta — compare Wetting vs Free Wetting shutdown steps to confirm 'Disengage CS' is only present in Wetting path
verificationPatterns.example: Wetting includes 'Disengage CS' between Close CS inlet valve and Close inlet valve; Free Wetting does not.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Flow monitor stop on standby entry
verificationPatterns.example: Stop CS-IMO flow monitoring

verificationPatterns.pattern: Squeeze sequence: IMO valve closed, CS engaged, AtSqueeze=True
verificationPatterns.example: Squeeze Sequence: Closed IMO valve, CS engaged, AtSqueeze=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Squeeze Free sequence: IMO valve closed, CS disengaged, AtSqueeze=True
verificationPatterns.example: Squeeze Free Sequence: Closed IMO valve, CS disengaged, AtSqueeze=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: CS rotation shutdown sequence: stop → backward rotation → stop
verificationPatterns.example: Stop CS rotation, CS BackwardRotation, Stop CS rotation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Final state assertion: CS manager reaches Standby
verificationPatterns.example: Verify states at Standby / Verify CS manager At Standby state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ordered activation sequence verification
verificationPatterns.example: 1. Activate CS drive 2. Open IMO line valve 3. Verify ImoFlow>MinFlowForTempControl 4. IMO Flow monitor started 5. State changed to Wetting only after sequence finished

verificationPatterns.pattern: CS disengagement on state transition
verificationPatterns.example: When moving from Wetting to FreeWetting status, verify CS is disengaged

verificationPatterns.pattern: Low-flow fault event triggered after stabilization timeout
verificationPatterns.example: Set CS IMO flow below CsImoMinFlow (Force), send GotoWet CMD, verify CS_IMO_LOW_FLOW event triggered after MaxFlowStabPeriod time with current/expected values

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter-driven duration scaling
verificationPatterns.example: Increase WettingCycles value and verify CSWetting duration increases proportionally

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ordered state-machine sequence check
verificationPatterns.example: 1. Activate CS drive → 2. Open IMO line valve → 3. Wait flow stabilization time → 4. Verify ImoFlow>MinFlowForTempControl → 5. IMO Flow monitor started → 6. Engage CS & Activate ImoTempControl → 7. State changed to AtFreeWetting only after sequence complete

verificationPatterns.pattern: Below-threshold fault event trigger with timeout gate
verificationPatterns.example: Force CS IMO flow below CsImoMinFlow, send GotoWet CMD, verify CS_IMO_LOW_FLOW event fires with current/expected values after MaxFlowStabPeriod elapses

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter-driven timing scaling check
verificationPatterns.example: Increase CsRotSetSpeed and verify CsWettingDelay duration increases proportionally

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-signal AtOFF gate check — assert all sub-component AtOFF flags simultaneously before proceeding
verificationPatterns.example: CS Status: AtOFF = True / CS Engage Status: AtOFF = True / CS SRoller Status: AtOFF = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Command propagation check — verify the manager sends the lifecycle command (Mechinit) down to every registered sub-component
verificationPatterns.example: Verify CS Manager sends Mechinit command to all components.

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-transition completion check — after sub-components finish the phase, verify the manager-level status flag flips
verificationPatterns.example: CS rotation finished MI, the CS manager AtStandby status changed to TRUE.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Gradual ramp-up to target voltage on state transition
verificationPatterns.example: Verify pump voltage is increasing gradually to 5v: OCB_saPLC.OCB.gIos.CVC.Output.CVC_WATER_PUMP_CTRL.Value = 5

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simulate input sensor via SimValue to drive PID toward saturation limit, then verify gradual ramp-down to 0V
verificationPatterns.example: Change CVC_EXIT_OUTLET_TEMP.pIOs_OPC^.SimValue to PID_SetValue + PID_MaxOut; verify OCB_saPLC.OCB.gIos.CVC.Output.CVC_WATER_PUMP_CTRL.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Below-low threshold triggers PRESSURE_INVALID event
verificationPatterns.example: Change CVC_EXIT_ECO_AIR_PRESSURE.Value to below CVCFeedEchoAirPressureValidLow.Value → verify event PRESSURE_INVALID appeared

verificationPatterns.pattern: Above-panic threshold triggers PRESSURE_PANIC_HIGH event
verificationPatterns.example: Change CVC_EXIT_ECO_AIR_PRESSURE.Value to above CVCFeedEchoAirPressurePanicHigh.Value → verify event PRESSURE_PANIC_HIGH appeared

verificationPatterns.pattern: Above-valid-high threshold triggers PRESSURE_INVALID event
verificationPatterns.example: Change CVC_EXIT_ECO_AIR_PRESSURE.Value to above CVCFeedEchoAirPressureValidHigh.Value → verify event PRESSURE_INVALID appeared

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event sensorID matches sensor under test
verificationPatterns.example: Verify sensorID is correct (CVC exit echo)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event contains actual measured value
verificationPatterns.example: Verify actual temperature (pressure) is correct in event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event contains the breached limit value
verificationPatterns.example: Verify temperature limit / panic limit is correct in event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary breach triggers named event
verificationPatterns.example: Verify event appeared - TEMP_INVALID

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event contains correct sensor identity
verificationPatterns.example: Verify sensorID is correct (CVC exit inlet)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Below valid-low threshold triggers TEMP_INVALID event
verificationPatterns.example: Change CVC_FEED_ECO_AIR_PRESSURE.Value to below CVCFeedEchoAirPressureValidLow.Value → event TEMP_INVALID appears

verificationPatterns.pattern: Above panic-high threshold triggers TEMP_PANIC_HIGH event
verificationPatterns.example: Change CVC_FEED_ECO_AIR_PRESSURE.Value to above CVCFeedEchoAirPressurePanicHigh.Value → event TEMP_PANIC_HIGH appears

verificationPatterns.pattern: Above valid-high threshold triggers TEMP_INVALID event
verificationPatterns.example: Change CVC_FEED_ECO_AIR_PRESSURE.Value to above CVCFeedEchoAirPressureValidHigh.Value → event TEMP_INVALID appears

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event contains correct sensorID
verificationPatterns.example: Verify sensorID in event matches CVC feed echo sensor

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event contains actual sensor value
verificationPatterns.example: Verify actual temperature (pressure) value reported in event matches injected value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Out-of-range sensor triggers named event
verificationPatterns.example: Verify event appeared - TEMP_INVALID

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event contains correct sensorID identifying the specific sensor
verificationPatterns.example: Verify sensorID is correct (CVC feed inlet)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event echoes actual measured value
verificationPatterns.example: Verify actual temperature is correct in event.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event echoes the violated limit value
verificationPatterns.example: Verify temperature limit is correct in event.

verificationPatterns.pattern: SW requirements table exhaustive parameter check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all parameters according to SW requirements - Parameters Table - PP table (2.2)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold-crossing event check: confirm correct event code fires when signal crosses limit
verificationPatterns.example: Verify event appeared - LEVEL_INVALID / LEVEL_PANIC_LOW

verificationPatterns.pattern: SensorID field validation in event payload
verificationPatterns.example: Verify SensorID is correct in event (CVC Tank)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Actual value echo: event reports the same value that was injected
verificationPatterns.example: Verify actual liquid level is correct.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Limit value echo: event reports the threshold that was breached
verificationPatterns.example: Verify limit value is correct.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Safety response: PLC transitions to OFF on threshold breach
verificationPatterns.example: Verify PLC fell to OFF.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Long-press triggers Select Mode
verificationPatterns.example: Enter to 'Select Mode' by long-press on a station → 'Select Mode' triggered

verificationPatterns.pattern: Toolbar appears on Select Mode entry
verificationPatterns.example: Verify toolbar is displayed when Select Mode is active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tap to multi-select stations while in Select Mode
verificationPatterns.example: Select several ink stations by tapping on them while on 'Select Mode'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tapping already-selected station deselects it
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that selection removed if tapping on the already selected station

verificationPatterns.pattern: X icon in toolbar clears all selections
verificationPatterns.example: Press on the 'X' icon at the toolbar and verify all the selections removed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unavailable actions are disabled in Multi-Selection mode
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that actions that cannot be done on 'Multi-Selection' mode are disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Deselecting all stations exits Select Mode
verificationPatterns.example: Deselect all stations and verify that 'Select Mode' is closed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Toolbar counter matches selected station count
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that the counter at the toolbar display the right number of the selected stations

verificationPatterns.pattern: Revolver rotation animation matches design prototype
verificationPatterns.example: Verify revolver rotation animation is according to the prototype link; force via RevolverAtRotation = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Set signal to enum value, verify UI renders matching visual state
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation.ExportedData.Ink.Sys.Status.TubeSolidLevel = Full → station UI looks like screenshot-11

verificationPatterns.pattern: Enumerate all discrete enum states and assert each has distinct UI representation
verificationPatterns.example: Three steps cover Full, AlmostEmpty, Empty — one step per enum value with dedicated screenshot reference

verificationPatterns.pattern: Screenshot-based visual assertion paired with signal-state precondition
verificationPatterns.example: TubeSolidLevel = AlmostEmpty → screenshot-13; TubeSolidLevel = Empty → screenshot-12

verificationPatterns.pattern: Count verification — assert UI element count matches expected quantity
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the Ink Cabinet menu displays 12 inks

verificationPatterns.pattern: Configuration table verification — assert each column's configuration code (Q/S/D) and ink color (W/Y/M/C/O/V/G/K) match a reference table indexed by ink number
verificationPatterns.example: INK: 12..1 | Configuration: Q S S S S S S D D D D Q | Ink Color: W Y M C O V G K C M Y W

verificationPatterns.pattern: Empty/placeholder state verification — assert a timer or field shows the null/placeholder value when feature is not yet active
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Tube Unloading timer is empty (‒‒:‒‒)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Absence-of-icon check for process indication
verificationPatterns.example: Verify no icon showing any process running

verificationPatterns.pattern: Incremental sim-value change triggers UI refresh at configured step percentage
verificationPatterns.example: Change PrimerTankLevel.SimValue; verify primer level updated in UI every X% (step defined by PEX::PWSConfigEntity::PrimerLevelStep)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold crossing changes status icon
verificationPatterns.example: Set PrimerTankLevel.SimValue to panic-low threshold (TBD); verify ILP tank primer icon changes accordingly

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal-driven UI state toggle

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify specific step duration in milliseconds after command

verificationPatterns.pattern: Composite LUT spot-check at fixed input percentages

Repeat per-color verification for all channels

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state assertion

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simulate hardware input via SimControlFlag and verify signal reflects change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timed post-event assertion — signal must reach expected state only AFTER a fixed delay

verificationPatterns.pattern: Immediate side-effect assertions after emergency trigger

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC state verification after safety event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Release safety input and verify signal clears

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press operates across all states with ILP subsystems disabled (Dry mode)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press operates with corona active under Dry mode

verificationPatterns.pattern: Level-out-of-valid-range stops circulation and raises INVALID error

verificationPatterns.pattern: Level exceeds panicHigh stops circulation and raises OVERFLOW error

verificationPatterns.pattern: Level drops below panicLow stops circulation and raises EMPTY error

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass flag suppresses tank-level fault and allows continued operation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Same three-threshold pattern (invalid/overflow/empty) applies to each tank type

verificationPatterns.pattern: ILP circulation stops on tank-absent fault

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multiple simultaneous tank-absent errors are all raised when multiple tanks missing
verificationPatterns.example: error is raised "ILP_CLEANER_TANK_NOT_IN_PLACE" AND error is raised "ILP_WASTE_TANK_NOT_IN_PLACE"

verificationPatterns.pattern: System continues to work properly after bypass is set

verificationPatterns.pattern: ILP transitions to Primer Mode after SWF Wet start

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify wash sequence from off state
verificationPatterns.example: Start wash from off — Expected: Works according to defined sequence

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blower set and temperature verified against current state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Corona turns off on fault

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stop print sequence — verify dryer transitions to postprint mode

verificationPatterns.pattern: Corona state tracking across transitions

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify MI starts then fails after timeout when done signal not asserted

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dryer temp control activation with ready set point

verificationPatterns.pattern: Corona state in SB

verificationPatterns.pattern: Corona Off when Press is in Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: All-clear state check: all actors enabled → ILP returns to Off with subsystems off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Exception raised on invalid configuration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unknown struct property not initialized
verificationPatterns.example: Add unknown property to imported param struct → start press SW → verify new param value did not initialize

verificationPatterns.pattern: CRC correctness check after print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Job completion confirmation
verificationPatterns.example: job printed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Continuous printing verification for multi-job queues

verificationPatterns.pattern: Value persists across SW restart

verificationPatterns.pattern: Restore to default resets value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timed activation after multi-signal turn-on

verificationPatterns.pattern: Deactivation follows upstream signal off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default values import/save verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all default values imported/save locally correctly

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault event raised on threshold breach

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print continues after protective action

verificationPatterns.pattern: Output signal zeroed on overcurrent protection

verificationPatterns.pattern: Limit-reached event raised when voltage sum hits ceiling

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wait for print session end before concluding test

verificationPatterns.pattern: Value saved after convergence condition met

verificationPatterns.pattern: Saved value used as initial setpoint on next session entry

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter persists across SW and PLC restart

verificationPatterns.pattern: Feature inactive → output zeroed, PID disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault injection while bypassed → event raised, output zeroed, print continues

verificationPatterns.pattern: Time-bounded response assertion (within N seconds)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state gate check before action

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration entry motion coordinates
verificationPatterns.example: X move to = 40000 / Z move to = -100

verificationPatterns.pattern: SPM status transitions to calibration during sequence

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration pass flag assertion

verificationPatterns.pattern: Return-to-ready motion coordinates after calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Deactivate-and-report on invalid range breach
