verificationPatterns.pattern: Deactivate-and-report on panic-high breach
verificationPatterns.example: IMO pressure out of panic high range → Deactivate EFS + Report EFS_PRESSURE_PANIC_HIGH EVENT

verificationPatterns.pattern: Deactivate-and-report on panic-low breach
verificationPatterns.example: IMO pressure out of panic low range → Deactivate EFS + Report EFS_PRESSURE_PANIC_LOW EVENT

verificationPatterns.pattern: Report-only (no deactivation) on operating-window breach
verificationPatterns.example: IMO pressure out of operating window → Report EFS_PRESSURE_LOW or EFS_PRESSURE_HIGH EVENT (EFS stays active)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Trigger-then-auto-stop: verify system activates on threshold breach and deactivates via timer when condition clears
verificationPatterns.example: Verify EFS start working and stop when dirtiness back to normal (timer)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-instance coverage: verify behavior applies to all parallel instances of a component
verificationPatterns.example: Both drums 1&2 suppose to work

verificationPatterns.pattern: Out-of-valid-range triggers deactivation + event
verificationPatterns.example: Vavg out of valid range → Deactivate EFS, Report EFS_VOLTAGE_INVALIDEVENT

verificationPatterns.pattern: Out-of-panic-range triggers deactivation + directional event
verificationPatterns.example: Vavg out of panic range → Deactivate EFS, Report EFS_VOLTAGE_TOO_HIGH or EFS_VOLTAGE_TOO_LOW depending on deviation direction

verificationPatterns.pattern: Current panic range mirrors voltage panic range behavior
verificationPatterns.example: Cavg out of panic range → Same as voltage monitoring

verificationPatterns.pattern: Motor rotation loss triggers state-dependent fallback + subsystem stop + user event
verificationPatterns.example: Drum rotation sensor does not change → In PRINTING: stop printing, fall to READY; In GR: stop GR, fall to STB; filter pump and EFS stop; issue event to user

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fast activation skips time delay
verificationPatterns.example: EFS fast activation is performed when sudden stop occurred previously; time delay from EFS pump activation to drum rotation is skipped

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fast deactivation mirrors nominal sequence minus delay
verificationPatterns.example: Fast EFS deactivation includes same sequence as nominal sequence w/o time delay before drum rotation stop

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify EFS stopped on both drums after each deactivation trigger
verificationPatterns.example: Step 3: Verify EFS stopped (Both drums) — repeated after filter pump cmd, after trash bin monitor stop, after HV monitoring stop

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify HV voltage and current zero after timed wait
verificationPatterns.example: Step 10: Verify HV voltage and current are zeroed for both drums (after waiting EfsHvStopDelay)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Apply ordered stop sequence: monitoring off → setpoint → delay → verify → next delay → motor stop
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 6–13: Stop HV monitoring → set EfsHvVoltage_OffSetPoint → wait EfsHvStopDelay → verify zero → wait EfsMotorStopCmdDelay → stop motor rotation monitoring → stop motor and HV

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat full drum stop sequence for second drum and verify both stopped
verificationPatterns.example: Step 14: Repeat steps for second drum as well, and verify both drum stops when needed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ordered acknowledge sequence verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the following acknowledge sequence: 1. Cold GR measurement done 2. T1 engage done 3. Cold GR speed calibration done 4. aSID at temp status 5. T1 disengage done 6. At free wetting 7. Hot GR speed measurement done 8. T1 disengage done 9. Hot GR speed calibration done

verificationPatterns.pattern: Persisted calibration value verification on re-run
verificationPatterns.example: Run again Get Ready, Verify that ASID initiate velocity use the last calculated value.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence blocks on temperature precondition
verificationPatterns.example: Override Asid temp below setpoint → verify sequence waits for temp at working window

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence blocks on hardware completion status
verificationPatterns.example: Force T1 disengage status before Get Ready → verify sequence waits for T1 completion

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence blocks on second subsystem temperature precondition
verificationPatterns.example: Override ITM temp below setpoint → verify sequence waits for temp at working window

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout event fires when blocking condition unresolved
verificationPatterns.example: Override CS at FreeWet status during Hot Get Ready → verify timeout event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press stop sequence triggered on timeout
verificationPatterns.example: CS at FreeWet during Get Ready → verify press stop sequence

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error and log verification after fault condition
verificationPatterns.example: verify error and log

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout event fires on temperature condition
verificationPatterns.example: Verify timeout event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press stop sequence executes after fault condition
verificationPatterns.example: verify press stop sequence

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error recorded in log on fault
verificationPatterns.example: verify error and log

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stop latency bounded after EMS trigger
verificationPatterns.example: ASID should stop within 2.3 sec after EMS press during Get Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter change → derived value change
verificationPatterns.example: Change Master_to_Gear_ratio parameter and verify Asid velocity changed accordingly

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold breach triggers event + log + motion stop
verificationPatterns.example: Override ASID torque above TorqueThreshold → Verify event + log + stop GR

verificationPatterns.pattern: Below/above boundary sweep on override
verificationPatterns.example: Override torque below/above the threshold value to confirm boundary behavior

verificationPatterns.pattern: Axis failure injection via simulation
verificationPatterns.example: Cause leg_error failure — note: simulation method TBD

verificationPatterns.pattern: Control mode check after GR
verificationPatterns.example: verify GR at ASID component act accordingly

verificationPatterns.pattern: Velocity control active during Auto Bias print
verificationPatterns.example: Verify asid is under velocity control and not speed control

verificationPatterns.pattern: Position control active during regular print
verificationPatterns.example: Verify asid is under position control and not speed control

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter-velocity match: confirm actual rotation speed equals the value stored in a named speed parameter
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Asid rotates at the velocity appear at parameter process speed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sync-follow: confirm component velocity tracks a master motor across multiple speed setpoints
verificationPatterns.example: try few ITM velocities and verify Asid velocity changes accordingly

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sync-stop: confirm component stops when master motor stops
verificationPatterns.example: while ITM stop verify asid also stopped

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inching-speed match: confirm rotation speed equals the inching speed parameter value
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Asid rotates at the velocity appear at parameter inching speed

verificationPatterns.pattern: MI pass: run MI sequence and confirm it completes without failure
verificationPatterns.example: verify asid passed MI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault-log presence: disconnect a sensor/encoder, run MI, confirm log contains a diagnostic clue
verificationPatterns.example: disconnect encoder->run MI; verify the log show clue about encoder

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-session homing verification
verificationPatterns.example: verify at the end Asid perform homing

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cross-mode coverage: repeat same check across all mode combinations
verificationPatterns.example: get ready at velocity control / get ready at speed calibration / print at velocity control / print at speed calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Average-over-active-subset check
verificationPatterns.example: Final average aSid velocity = sum of station velocities / numOfWorkingStations; result must be logical and comparable to all-stations-ON speed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sanity/plausibility check against known baseline
verificationPatterns.example: Calculated speed is similar to the speed when all stations are ON

verificationPatterns.pattern: Check event fires on failed precondition
verificationPatterns.example: Try to perform MI — Verify event CR not in place

verificationPatterns.pattern: Check event fires mid-print on sensor loss
verificationPatterns.example: During print Override In Place IO to False — Verify event CR not in place

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify HV turns off on sensor loss during print
verificationPatterns.example: During print Override In Place IO to False — Verify HV turn off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Param table import verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify param table imported correctly

verificationPatterns.pattern: IO sensor state tracks engage/disengage sequence
verificationPatterns.example: MI sequence Disengage→Engage→Disengage: IOSensor should be On→Off→On

verificationPatterns.pattern: Piston reaches commanded position and reports status to manager
verificationPatterns.example: Engage CMD: Verify PISTON reached position and status sent to manager

verificationPatterns.pattern: LED reflects current engage/disengage state
verificationPatterns.example: At Engage: LED on; At DisEngage: LED on

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout event + log on blocked state transition
verificationPatterns.example: Send Engage CMD, Override IoSensor ON → Verify Timeout event+Log (include station number)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Station number present in timeout log
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Timeout event+Log (include station number)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout triggered from multiple source states (Engage, Disengage, Off/MI)
verificationPatterns.example: Step 1: from idle; Step 2: from Engage; Step 3: from Off via MI

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-conflict sequence order verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify first disengage and then the regular sequence

verificationPatterns.pattern: Imported parameter existence and default value check
verificationPatterns.example: verify all imported parameters existed and their default values are correct

verificationPatterns.pattern: Position reset on re-initialization
verificationPatterns.example: SRoller/BRoller motor actual position should start from 0 every MI attempt

verificationPatterns.pattern: LPH stops tracking and arrBr disengages
verificationPatterns.example: LPH AtTracking = false, arrBr AtDisengage = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Both Bid stations reach AtPostPrint and AtDisengage
verificationPatterns.example: Bid[1], Bid[2] AtPostPrint = True, AtDisengage = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Charging subsystem returns to standby
verificationPatterns.example: Charging = AtStdby

verificationPatterns.pattern: CS subsystem returns to standby
verificationPatterns.example: CS = AtStdBy

verificationPatterns.pattern: Asid reaches ready state
verificationPatterns.example: Asid AtReadyState = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Station Manager signals ready after post-print sequence
verificationPatterns.example: Station Mgr AtReady = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Same post-print end-state is expected regardless of which active phase end-print is triggered from
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 1 and 2 share identical expected results across Pre Print Phase 1 and Print state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify all subsystems reach expected status after mode command
verificationPatterns.example: After MI: all subsystem AtMI = True, then all subsystems AtStandby = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify Station-level status reflects current operational mode
verificationPatterns.example: After GR command: Station status = AtGetReady; after Print command: Station status = AtPrint

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify subsystem collective state before verifying station-level state
verificationPatterns.example: Check all subsystem AtMI=True before checking AtStandby=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequential mode progression: MI → GR → Print with status check at each transition
verificationPatterns.example: Perform MI → verify → Perform GR → verify → Perform Print → verify

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence-vs-spec conformance check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Mechinit sequence is according to SW requirements

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-station status check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify for all 6 stations: Bid[1], BID[2] are at preprint status

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequential signal polling with wait rounds
verificationPatterns.example: Wait for 2 Asid rounds, and verify CR AtCharging = True; Wait 1 Asid round, and set T1SafeEngage flag to true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boolean signal true-state gating — verify each signal reaches True before proceeding
verificationPatterns.example: Asid AtProcessSpeed = True, then CsAtWetting = True, then CR AtCharging = True, then CR atPrint = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sync command flag verification
verificationPatterns.example: BID Mgr print sync command = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: External flag injection mid-sequence
verificationPatterns.example: Set T1SafeEngage flag to true after waiting 1 Asid round

verificationPatterns.pattern: Subsystem ready-state convergence check
verificationPatterns.example: LPH AtRunOutCalib = True, LPH AtTracking = True, Station Manager AtPrint = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Only installed units enabled — uninstalled units stay OFF
verificationPatterns.example: When LPH in Standby state, verify enable signals set to '1' for only installed LPH units

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition OFF→Standby triggers enable signal change
verificationPatterns.example: When LPH in OFF state, verify enable signals set to '0' for all installed LPH units; when Standby, set to '1'

verificationPatterns.pattern: BID phase command sequence: verify Phase1_3 before Phase4, and Phase4 issued to A before B
verificationPatterns.example: Bid A,B got GetReady_Phase1_3 command → Bid A got GetReady_Phase4 → Bid B got GetReady_Phase4

verificationPatterns.pattern: ASID status step-through: assert each named status in order before advancing
verificationPatterns.example: ColdGRAdjustTorque → AtColdGRMeasureTorque → AtHotGRMeasureTorque → AtHotGRAdjustTorque

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cross-component status correlation: assert CS and ASID statuses together at the same moment
verificationPatterns.example: CS status is AtWetting, Asid status is AtColdGRAdjustTorque; CS status is AtFreeWetting, Asid status is AtHotGRMeasureTorque

verificationPatterns.pattern: CR and LPH milestone checks during GR: verify CR and LPH statuses at defined points in the sequence
verificationPatterns.example: CR status is AtCalibrate → CS status is AtWetting → CR status is AtCharging → LPH status is AtEngage

verificationPatterns.pattern: Aggregate completion gate: station transitions to AtPostGetReady only after all BID Phase4 and LPH engage complete
verificationPatterns.example: After BIDs A,B finished phase 4, and LPH is engaged, Station status is AtPostGetReady

verificationPatterns.pattern: PostGR IO voltage check: assert all four BID HV monitor signals equal their respective DefaultDry constants
verificationPatterns.example: BidHv.ElectrodeVoltageMon_v.Value = DefaultElectodeDryVoltage; DeveloperMon_v.Value = DefaultDeveloperDryVoltage; SqueegeeVoltageMon_v.Value = DefaultSqueegeeDryVoltage; CleanerVoltageMon_v.Value = DefaultCleanerDryVoltage

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-sequence CS/charging idle state: verify AtStandby + T1Disengaged before declaring ready
verificationPatterns.example: Verify CS/charging status is AtStandby, T1Disengaged

verificationPatterns.pattern: Final station readiness gate: station status transitions to AtReady only after CS/charging idle confirmed
verificationPatterns.example: After the above, verify station status is AtReady

verificationPatterns.pattern: Temperature threshold triggers full valve open/close
verificationPatterns.example: Override CWS temperature to 24°C → verify CWS valve opened (90); override to 20°C → verify CWS valve closed (0)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error window boundary: value at edge does not change valve state
verificationPatterns.example: Set error window to 0.2, set CWS temperature to setpoint − 0.2 → verify CWS valve value did not change

verificationPatterns.pattern: PID gain affects rate of valve response
verificationPatterns.example: Set PID 1/2 gain to 50, sweep temperature 20→24 → verify valve reaches 0/90 faster than baseline

verificationPatterns.pattern: Valve rotation speed limits slew rate; verify target reached within derived time bound
verificationPatterns.example: Set valve rotation per second to 10, sweep temperature 20→24 → verify proportional valve reaches 0/90 within 9 seconds

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold-triggered binary valve state
verificationPatterns.example: Override line flow to 35.7°C → verify main valve opened (90); override to 36.3°C → verify main valve closed (0)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Hysteresis band — no-change zone
verificationPatterns.example: Override line flow to 35.8/36.2°C → verify main valve value did not change

verificationPatterns.pattern: PID gain effect on response speed
verificationPatterns.example: Change PID gain to 50, set flow to 34/37°C → verify main valve changes faster to desired value (0/90)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Valve rotation rate limits travel time
verificationPatterns.example: Set valve rotation per second to 10, set flow to 34/37°C → verify main valve reaches 0/90 within 9 seconds

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify actuator activates on cold start condition
verificationPatterns.example: Verify heater is ON after Mechinit with tank temp below threshold

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify timeout event fires after configured duration elapses
verificationPatterns.example: Verify event LPH_COOLING_TANK_TEMP_HEATING_TIMED_OUT appears after heating timeout reached

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify press state degrades to OFF on unresolved condition
verificationPatterns.example: Verify LPH/press state fell to OFF after heating timed out

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify state indication flags match current state
verificationPatterns.example: AtOff indication is ON (in OFF state); AtColdStart indication is ON (in cold start); AtOff indication is OFF (once transitioned out of OFF)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify actuator output (heater ON/OFF) matches expected state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify heater is OFF in OFF state; Heater activated indication is ON during cold start; Verify heater is OFF in Standby/Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify actuator output (pump ON/OFF) matches expected state
verificationPatterns.example: Pump is OFF in OFF state; Pump activated indication is ON from cold start onward; Pump is OFF after clicking OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify all monitors active/inactive at state boundaries
verificationPatterns.example: All monitoring are on in cold start/standby/ready/print; All monitors are OFF after clicking OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify temperature control activation per state
verificationPatterns.example: Temperature control activated during cold start; Temperature CTRL active indication is ON in Ready and Print; not required in Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify state transition triggered by threshold crossing
verificationPatterns.example: Change tank temperature to 19°C → stays in cold start; change to 20°C → transitions to Standby (setpoint reached)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify timeout-triggered fallback to OFF
verificationPatterns.example: After 30 seconds without reaching setpoint during cold start, PLC falls back to OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify full forward state-machine walk via UI actions
verificationPatterns.example: Mechinit → cold start/standby; GR → GetReady → Ready; Print → Print state; End Print → Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify full reverse state-machine walk via UI actions
verificationPatterns.example: Ready/GR → Standby (click Standby); Standby → OFF (click OFF)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Flow set point decreases as installed LPH count drops
verificationPatterns.example: LPH_Installed[6]=false → flow set point 30; LPH_Installed[4]=false → 24; LPH_Installed[2]=false → 18

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mechinit with matching actual flow triggers correct valve states
verificationPatterns.example: Actual flow set to 18, Mechinit → CWS Proportional valve closed (90 degrees), valves 2,4,6 closed (false), rest open (true)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timed state transition after trigger command
verificationPatterns.example: Verify LPH cooling system changed to OFF state within 2.3 seconds.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Out-of-range input raises named failure
verificationPatterns.example: Set AK_Upper_Blower_Pressure_Sens.SimValue=1200 → expect BLANKET_AK_PRESSURE_INVALID

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic-range input raises panic-level failure
verificationPatterns.example: Set AK_Upper_Blower_Pressure_Sens.SimValue=200 → expect BLANKET_AK_PRESSURE_PANIC_HIGH

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass flag suppresses monitoring failure
verificationPatterns.example: Set Bypass_Monitor_Pressure=True, then SimValue=200 → verify no failure raised

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor outside working window raises no event when not AK-related
verificationPatterns.example: Set BktTemp_EH8_MelexisSens.SimValue=140 → verify no failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Return to known state between fault injections
verificationPatterns.example: Press go to standby after each failure-inducing step before next injection

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify imported data integrity
verificationPatterns.example: Verify parameters imported correctly

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify DB-to-PLC param propagation
verificationPatterns.example: Verify upon param change at DB, PLC control params change accordingly

verificationPatterns.pattern: Hardware disconnect triggers COMM_FAILURE event + log with device number
verificationPatterns.example: Disconnect Melexis sensor → verify BLANKET_IR_MLX_COMM_FAILURE event + log with specific sensor number

verificationPatterns.pattern: Frozen/stuck sensor value triggers FREEZE event + log with device number
verificationPatterns.example: Set Melexis value to specific value → verify BLANKET_IR_MLX_FREEZE event + log with specific sensor number

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dimmer disconnect triggers COMM_FAILURE event + log with device number
verificationPatterns.example: Disconnect dimmer → verify BLANKET_DIMMER_COMM_FAILURE event + log with specific dimmer number

verificationPatterns.pattern: Phase-completion gate on temp within Set point ± working range
verificationPatterns.example: verify GR finish (Blanket heating status change) when Blanket temp reach Set point±working range (Enter low and high)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pre-Print phase completion triggered by temp entering working range
verificationPatterns.example: verify Pre-print finish when Blanket temp reach Set point±working range (Enter low and high)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Active-phase status remains valid while temp stays within working window
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Print is under status at working window

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition on overheat — confirm system falls to Standby
verificationPatterns.example: Override Blanket Temp above the Exit High- fall to Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log and event verification after fault trigger
verificationPatterns.example: verify log and event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cooling recovery cases for each overheat threshold
verificationPatterns.example: Verify cooling cases for 1-3

verificationPatterns.pattern: Matrix repetition across press states — repeat full threshold set per state
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat 1-4 for Pre-print. Repeat 1-4 for Print.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Change input set point → verify downstream power output updates accordingly
verificationPatterns.example: Change Blanket set points during heating operation → verify EH power change accordingly

verificationPatterns.pattern: Transition operational mode (get-ready → print) → verify set point value follows mode change
verificationPatterns.example: Change Blanket set points from get ready values to Print values → verify EH S.P. changed accordingly

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify configurable ratio signal governs relative power distribution between paired hardware units
verificationPatterns.example: Verify upper EH can get working ratio between them (each pair) MultiHootLampsPowerRatio

verificationPatterns.pattern: Phase-specific timeout failure on signal below threshold
verificationPatterns.example: During Get Ready Override Blanket Temp below enter low → verify timeout failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat same override check across all active press phases
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 1–3 repeat identical override+verify pattern for Get Ready, Pre-print, Print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timed deactivation after upstream system off
verificationPatterns.example: Turn off blanket heating; verify AK deactivates exactly AkDeactivateTimeDelay after EH turns off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-unit setpoint assignment
verificationPatterns.example: Set different setpoint to each AK individually; verify each AK receives its own assigned setpoint

verificationPatterns.pattern: Real-time parameter change during active job
verificationPatterns.example: Change AK setpoint during print; verify output voltage changes accordingly without stopping job

verificationPatterns.pattern: Safety interlock blocks activation and logs cause
verificationPatterns.example: Attempt to activate AK with hood open; verify AK does not activate and log contains the hood number

verificationPatterns.pattern: Out-of-range value triggers event and log entry
verificationPatterns.example: verify event+log

verificationPatterns.pattern: Subsystem state transition depends on previous state
verificationPatterns.example: drying subsystem (and press) will go to standby/ready according to previous state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blower measurement presence check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify each blower has current/torque monitoring, RPM monitoring, and internal errors reporting.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Overheat simulation → heating stop + event/log
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate AK blower overheat → blanket heating stops, event and log entry appear.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Out-of-valid-range value → named failure raised + subsystem goes OFF + logs
verificationPatterns.example: Set pressure out of valid range → failure BLANKET_AK_PRESSURE_INVALID raised, drying system goes to OFF, logs present.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Out-of-panic-range value → named panic failure raised
verificationPatterns.example: Set pressure out of panic range → failure BLANKET_AK_PRESSURE_PANIC_HIGH or BLANKET_AK_PRESSURE_PANIC_LOW raised.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass ON suppresses out-of-range failure
verificationPatterns.example: Set pressure outside valid range with bypass ON → verify no failure appears.

verificationPatterns.pattern: All-preconditions-met activates feature
verificationPatterns.example: Blanket at process speed + suction pressure in panic range + upper hood closed → blanket heating is active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Single precondition failure triggers timeout event + log
verificationPatterns.example: Blanket not reached process speed → verify timeout event + log

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault event/log must include the specific component identifier
verificationPatterns.example: Upper hood not closed → verify event+log, verify they include hood's number; pressure sensor outside panic range → verify event+log, verify they include sensor's number

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ordered sequence verification — assert each action fires in exact order before proceeding
verificationPatterns.example: 1. Activate CS drive → 2. Open IMO line valve → 3. wait flow stabilization time → 4. verify ImoFlow>MinFlowForTempControl → 5. Engage CS & Activate ImoTempControl → 6. state changed to AtFreeWetting

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold gate check — verify analog signal exceeds minimum threshold before next step executes
verificationPatterns.example: verify ImoFlow>MinFlowForTempControl before Engage CS & Activate ImoTempControl

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition only after full sequence — final state must not change until all prior steps complete
verificationPatterns.example: Verify only when sequence finished - state changed to AtFreeWetting

verificationPatterns.pattern: Actuator activation verification — confirm hardware actuator activated as discrete step
verificationPatterns.example: Activate CS drive; Open IMO line valve

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stabilization wait — allow time-based settling before measuring flow/signal
verificationPatterns.example: wait flow stabilization time

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event fired on fault condition
verificationPatterns.example: Verify event - CS_NOT_IN_PLACE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state drops to OFF on fault
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press fell to OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault triggers in both direct input change and IO override
verificationPatterns.example: Step 1: direct input change; Step 2: IO override during active press state

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-agnostic OFF arrival check: CS Manager and all components below report At OFF = TRUE
verificationPatterns.example: Verify CS manager and all components below status At OFF is TRUE.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ordered shutdown sequence verification when coming from GR-wetting
verificationPatterns.example: Verify sequence: Close IMO valve → Disengage CS → Stop CS rotation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ordered shutdown sequence verification when coming from GR-free-wetting (shorter sequence, no CS disengage)
verificationPatterns.example: Verify sequence: Close IMO valve → Stop CS rotation

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-dependent sequence comparison: verify sequence steps differ based on entry state (GR-wetting includes Disengage CS; GR-free-wetting does not)
verificationPatterns.example: GR-wetting: Close IMO valve, Disengage CS, Stop CS rotation. GR-free-wetting: Close IMO valve, Stop CS rotation.

verificationPatterns.pattern: State precondition check — verify all subsystem status flags before action
verificationPatterns.example: Verify CS manager and all components below status At OFF is TRUE.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Broadcast command verification — confirm manager propagates command to all child components
verificationPatterns.example: Verify CS Manager sends Mechinit command to all components.

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition check — verify status flag flips after sequence completes
verificationPatterns.example: Verify after CS engage, CS rotation finished MI, the CS manager AtStandby status changed to TRUE.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter table assertion — verify Name, Units, Default Value, and Local/Imported flag for each row
verificationPatterns.example: CsWrSetSpeed | RPM | 160 | Imported

verificationPatterns.pattern: Source classification check — confirm each parameter is marked either 'Local' or 'Imported' per specification
verificationPatterns.example: CsRollerTorqueAvg | msec | 50 | Local  vs  CsWrSetSpeed | RPM | 160 | Imported

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-type parameter coverage — assert params spanning RPM, msec, NM, and Bool units in single table sweep
verificationPatterns.example: BrMotorActive | Bool | True | Imported

verificationPatterns.pattern: State regression on out-of-bound signal
verificationPatterns.example: Verify CS changed to Standby when flow set below CsImoMinFlow or above CsImoMaxFlow in GR/Print

verificationPatterns.pattern: No-op verification in non-active state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press stays at Ready state and no event raised when flow set above/below min/max in Ready state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ordered sequence verification
verificationPatterns.example: 1. Activate CS drive  2. Open IMO line valve — verify steps occur in this exact order

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-transition disengagement check

verificationPatterns.pattern: State verification via StepMessage at standby/init
verificationPatterns.example: At standby and init verify status accordingly (through StepMessage)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Retry-exhaustion triggers intermediate active state with pump active
verificationPatterns.example: PRE_CONDITIONS_CHECK -> too many retries → Verify status AtCondActive and Conductivity pump is active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Setpoint satisfaction transitions component to Running
verificationPatterns.example: Set Conduct to SetPoint (or in the working range) → Verify status Running

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault injection via manager CMD closes all valves and disables thermal control
verificationPatterns.example: Send fault CMD from Ink manager → Verify status fault, all valves are close (no heating or cooling)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify availability state table per control type
verificationPatterns.example: For temperature control verify availability state table

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat availability state table check across all control domains
verificationPatterns.example: Steps cover temperature, level, conductivity, density controls in sequence

verificationPatterns.pattern: Set voltage above threshold during active print and verify current monitoring response
verificationPatterns.example: During Print set CR voltage to above ChargingThreshold

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat threshold-crossing check for each charging channel (CR, ASID)
verificationPatterns.example: During Print set ASID voltage to above ChargingThreshold

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal value = 0 implies pump Off
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[2].HW_Outputs.INK[1].Conductivity.cdDirectPump.Value=0 → verify pump is Off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal value = 1 implies pump On + active status flag set
verificationPatterns.example: cdDirectPump.Value=1 → Verify Ink.Cond.Out.Status.AtCondActive + Cond pump is On

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cross-state pump-off assertion (no override needed in Standby)
verificationPatterns.example: During standby verify pump is off: cdDirectPump.Value=0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Set signal above threshold during active state and observe response
verificationPatterns.example: During Print set CR voltage to above ChargingThreshold

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat threshold-exceed test for second voltage source in same state
verificationPatterns.example: During Print set ASID voltage to above ChargingThreshold

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence-order assertion: verify HV components turn on in prescribed order
verificationPatterns.example: Set CR VDC → set aSID VDC → (conditionally) activate BR current control → set CR VDC to print default → wait ChargingStabTime → set CR VAC; Expected: HV turn on at the correct sequence

verificationPatterns.pattern: Conditional step gating on hardware variant (CrType)
verificationPatterns.example: If CrType=Hydrin is installed, activate balancing roller current control (activation); If CrType=Hydrin, turn off BR current control (deactivation)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stabilization wait between voltage change and next action
verificationPatterns.example: Wait ChargingStabTime msec after setting CR VDC before enabling CR VAC; Wait DiscahrgingStabTime seconds after setting CR VDC to AsidBiasVoltage before turning off aSID VDC

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mirror/reverse deactivation sequence mirrors activation order
verificationPatterns.example: Activation sets VAC last; deactivation turns off VAC first. Activation sets aSID VDC first; deactivation turns off aSID VDC last.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Block HV on ASID speed fault
verificationPatterns.example: run ASID&CR charging CMD while asid not at speed → verify HV doesn't turn on; expect event CRG_ASID_NOT_IN_FULL_SPEED in log

verificationPatterns.pattern: Block HV on electrometer out of range
verificationPatterns.example: set electrometer reading to above valid → TBD if necessary, may be tested under another feature

verificationPatterns.pattern: Block HV sequence on CR DisEngage sensor active
verificationPatterns.example: override CR DisEngage IoSensor '1' to simulate disengage → verify HV sequence doesn't continue

verificationPatterns.pattern: Deactivation sequence executes as in sanity
verificationPatterns.example: deactivation sequnce (as in sanity)

verificationPatterns.pattern: ASID rotation occurs twice
verificationPatterns.example: 2 asid rotation

verificationPatterns.pattern: PTE turns off
verificationPatterns.example: PTE off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence step ordering — verify each sub-step of a sequence fires in defined order
verificationPatterns.example: 1. deactivation sequence (as in sanity) 2. 2 asid rotation 3. PTE off 4. disengage CR

verificationPatterns.pattern: IoSensor override to block sequence progression — override sensor to failure state, verify system halts before target state
verificationPatterns.example: override CR DisEngage IoSensor '0' to simulate engage → verify charge manager didn't reached Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Open safety question — step flags an unverified protection (HV stayed On), marking a gap in test coverage
verificationPatterns.example: **is there protection to HV stayed On?

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert ordered sequence-state signals after sequence start
verificationPatterns.example: Expected: 1. ASID at process speed  2. CR engage  3. PTE on

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify event+log after disabling a prerequisite flag
verificationPatterns.example: Turn off ASID at process speed flag → Verify event+log

verificationPatterns.pattern: Override IoSensor to simulate hardware disengage, then verify event+log
verificationPatterns.example: override CR DisEngage IoSensor '1' to simulate disengage → Verify event+log

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-station concurrency repeat
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat test when several station request add imo

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press-to-Off failure on critical dirty level with specific event
verificationPatterns.example: Press failed to Off, Event 'IMO_RSV_DIRTY_TANK_IS_EMPTY' (advise user for leak detection, check HW and manually add IMO)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Level-too-low event raised on Empty level in active states
verificationPatterns.example: Event IMO_RSV_dirty_TANK_LEVEL_TOO_LOW fired for Ready, GR, and Print states when dirty level is Empty

verificationPatterns.pattern: US Waste pump activates on ExtraHigh and runs until level drops to target
verificationPatterns.example: US Waste pump start to works till level goes back to Normal (non-print) / High (print)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press-to-Off failure on PanicHigh dirty level
verificationPatterns.example: Press failed to Off when dirty level > panicHigh during Print mode

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-dependent ExtraHigh exit threshold differs between non-print and print states
verificationPatterns.example: Non-print exit ExtraHigh threshold = 62; print exit ExtraHigh threshold = 45

verificationPatterns.pattern: Output activation with delay — verify signal goes active after a delay, then inactive after a delay
verificationPatterns.example: Verify FS return pump activated with delay (TBD) / Verify FS return pump deactivated with delay (TBD)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pressure panic boundary — inject high and low panic values, verify subsystem enters standby and correct named error events are raised
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the IMO subsystem will go to standby and error events will be raised: IMO_FILTER_RETUTN_PUMP_PRESSURE_PANIC_HIGH, IMO_FILTER_RETURN_PUMP_PRESSURE_PANIC_LOW accordingly

verificationPatterns.pattern: No false alarms — same fault injection when subsystem output is inactive must produce no errors or warning LEDs
verificationPatterns.example: Set pressure panic high/low value when IMO return pump not activated. Verify no errors and warning leds

verificationPatterns.pattern: Low-level triggers supply sequence
verificationPatterns.example: Ink request adds IMO to tank. Open correct IMO-IC valve. Wait time delay (TBD). Activate Res. pump.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Setpoint reached terminates supply sequence
verificationPatterns.example: Deactivate Res. Pump. Wait delay. Close correct IMO-IC valve.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat test under different machine mode for coverage
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat test in print mode.

verificationPatterns.pattern: FP activates when dirtiness exceeds start threshold
verificationPatterns.example: Set dirtiness level >0.01% [NVS] (100) → Verify FP started to work

verificationPatterns.pattern: FP runs continuously until dirtiness drops below stop threshold
verificationPatterns.example: FP continue to work until dirtiness level reaches to <0.001 [NVS] (10)

verificationPatterns.pattern: FP stops when dirtiness falls below stop threshold
verificationPatterns.example: Set dirtiness level 0.00009% [NVS] (9) → Verify FP stopped to work

verificationPatterns.pattern: FP re-activates when dirtiness rises above start threshold again
verificationPatterns.example: Set dirtiness level >0.01% [NVS] → Verify FP started to work

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press fails to Off with error event after timeout if dirtiness stays above threshold
verificationPatterns.example: Dirtiness level stays >0.01% [NVS]. After timeout 5min (TBD) → Error event 'Reservoir dirtiness level is too high'. Press failed to Off.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mid-cycle dirtiness drop still results in press failure if timeout elapses
verificationPatterns.example: Set dirtiness >0.01% then >0.007% [NVS] → After 5min press failed to Off. 'Reservoir dirtiness level is too high'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat full test across all press states
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat test for all states

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump sequencing: verify dependent pump starts after trigger pump activates
verificationPatterns.example: Stop CS pump (stop GR or Print) → FS pump should start

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump sequencing: verify dependent pump stops after upstream pump stops with delay
verificationPatterns.example: FS pump should stop (TBD) min after CS Return pump stops

verificationPatterns.pattern: Nominal pressure: verify no errors or warning LEDs when pressure is in valid range
verificationPatterns.example: Start filter pump and set correct pressure value → Verify no errors and warning leds

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic threshold breach: verify subsystem enters standby and raises correct error events
verificationPatterns.example: Set pressure panic high/low value → IMO subsystem goes to standby; events IMO_FILTER_PUMP_PRESSURE_PANIC_HIGH / IMO_FILTER_PUMP_PRESSURE_PANIC_LOW raised accordingly

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic threshold suppression: verify no fault when pump is inactive during threshold breach
verificationPatterns.example: Set pressure panic high/low value when FS pump not activated → Verify no errors and warning leds

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic threshold → press state change + specific error event
verificationPatterns.example: Set level = Panic low → Press changes state to off; error event 'IMO_RTN_BFR_LVL_PANIC_LOW' raised

verificationPatterns.pattern: All-states sweep: repeat same condition across every press state
verificationPatterns.example: 'Repeat for all states' used in steps 1 and 2 to confirm behavior is state-independent

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout/convergence failure → pump fault event
verificationPatterns.example: Buffer value > pump 'on' trigger but value not changed before Converge Time expires → IMO return pump starts, then press fails to off with event 'IMO_RTN_PUMP_CTRL_FAILURE'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Delayed correction within active pump cycle → pump runs to 'off' trigger or PID
verificationPatterns.example: Level > pump 'on' trigger, CS pump activated, then after 5 sec new correct value > pump 'on' trigger set → pump works until level drops to pump 'off' trigger or per PID

verificationPatterns.pattern: Valid range — no errors
verificationPatterns.example: Set correct value between Valid low and Valid high → verify no error and no warning LEDs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Invalid value — named error raised + press fails to Off
verificationPatterns.example: Set incorrect value → verify error IMO_RSV_CLEAN_TEMP_INVALID raised, press failed to Off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic value — named panic error raised + press fails to Off
verificationPatterns.example: Set panic value → verify error IMO_RSV_CLEAN_TEMP_PANIC_HIGH raised, press failed to Off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Empty level blocks any press-state advance and forces Off with named event
verificationPatterns.example: Press in Off state. Set clean level is Empty. Start MI. Expected: Press failed to Off with event: Clean is empty.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Low level triggers filter pump and warning, then failure if level does not recover within convergence timeout
verificationPatterns.example: Press in Ready state. Set clean level is Low. Expected: Filter pump starts to work until clean level back to high. Warning message 'Clean reservoir level is low, please check'. In case IMO clean tank level stays too low for CleanLevelConvergenceTime, a failure will be raised IMO_RSV_CLEAN_TANK_LEVEL_TOO_LOW. Press failed to Off.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Active-print states (GR/Print) raise a distinct event on Empty and mirror Ready behavior on Low
verificationPatterns.example: Set clean level is empty during the state. Expected: Event MO_RSV_CLEAN_TANK_LEVEL_TOO_LOW and press failed to Off.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Advise user action on empty detection (leak check, HW check, manual IMO add)
verificationPatterns.example: Advise user for leak detection, check HW and manually add IMO.

verificationPatterns.pattern: No-event guard in Off state
verificationPatterns.example: State Off. Open reservoir cover. Expected: No events

verificationPatterns.pattern: Safety-cover event fires in all active states (SB, Ready, GR, Print)
verificationPatterns.example: For SB and Ready, GR and Print: Open reservoir cover. Expected: Event IMO_RSV_COVER_OPENED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Subsystem stops on cover open
verificationPatterns.example: IMO subsystem will stop

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state transitions to Off on safety fault
verificationPatterns.example: Press failed to Off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Broadcast state-change command and verify all subsystems react
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all subsystem get GR command from PLC manager and changed state to SB

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify command source is PLC manager
verificationPatterns.example: Stop GR from PLC manager

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify target state reached on all subsystems after command
verificationPatterns.example: all subsystem ... changed state to SB

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC manager stops GR on all subsystems on timeout
verificationPatterns.example: PLC manager should stop GR all subsystems.

verificationPatterns.pattern: All components (PLC manager + subsystems) transition to SB state
verificationPatterns.example: PLC manager and all subsystems should change state to SB.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence gate — wait for upstream condition before next phase
verificationPatterns.example: CS starts Post GR only after T1 disengage

verificationPatterns.pattern: Broadcast verification — confirm station manager sends command to all subsystems
verificationPatterns.example: Verify station manager send Post GR to all subsystems

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault injection on subsystem during active GR triggers global state-change broadcast
verificationPatterns.example: During GR simulate fault from station subsystem. Verify PLC manager get fault from problematic subsystem and send change state to all subsystems. Repeat for Blanket subsystem.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-GR disengage timeout causes Station manager to issue stop-GR command
verificationPatterns.example: Start GR and cause T1 not finished disengage in Post GR. Verify PLC manager - Station manager send stop GR after timeout.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tabular default-value check: for each parameter assert name, default value, and Local/Imported scope match spec
verificationPatterns.example: CwsBypassValveFullOpenPosition = 90, Imported

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boolean parameter default check: assert bool parameters default to TRUE or FALSE as specified
verificationPatterns.example: DeactivateChillerOnOffState = TRUE, IsChillerInstalled = FALSE, CwsTempMonitorBypass = FALSE, CwsPressureMonitorBypass = FALSE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Absolute-value temperature bound check: assert temp thresholds carry ABSOLUTE VALUE qualifier and correct numeric default
verificationPatterns.example: CwsTempValidHigh = 80 ABSOLUTE VALUE, CwsTempPanicLow = 0 ABSOLUTE VALUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Delay/timing parameter default check: assert integer delay defaults match spec
verificationPatterns.example: CwsChillerOffDelay = 900, CwsTempMonitorStartDelay = 10, CwsPressureMonitorStartDelay = 5

verificationPatterns.pattern: Scope assertion: verify all listed parameters are marked Imported, not Local
verificationPatterns.example: All 18 parameters listed as Imported

verificationPatterns.pattern: Delayed monitoring window — state must not change while delay active
verificationPatterns.example: increase CwsTempMonitorStartDelay, create high/low temperature outside ranges — verify state does not change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Moving average on temperature input — change not applied immediately
verificationPatterns.example: change water temperature — verify change is not done immediately and moving average is implemented

verificationPatterns.pattern: Temperature settable from press UI as well as software
verificationPatterns.example: verify change can be done also on press

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic range breach after mech init → state off + error event only
verificationPatterns.example: perform mech init, set temperature above/below panic ranges — verify state changes to off, error event issued, other events not issued

verificationPatterns.pattern: Valid range breach after get ready → state off + error event only
verificationPatterns.example: perform get ready, set temperature above/below valid ranges — verify state changes to off, error event issued, other events not issued

verificationPatterns.pattern: Working range breach during print → print continues (no state change)
verificationPatterns.example: perform print, set temperature above/below working ranges — verify print continues

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass mode suppresses all state changes and events
verificationPatterns.example: bypass temperature monitoring and repeat tests 3;4;5 — state does not change and no event is issued

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default flag value check
verificationPatterns.example: verify flag of isChillerInstalled is set to default — Value should be false

verificationPatterns.pattern: IO signal asserted when feature flag enabled + mech init
verificationPatterns.example: set isChillerInstalled to TRUE and perform mech init — verify ON IO signal is sent to chiller

verificationPatterns.pattern: IO signal persists through full state cycle
verificationPatterns.example: perform transition get ready->print->ready->standby->off — verify chiller ON signal remains ON

verificationPatterns.pattern: IO signal NOT asserted when feature flag disabled
verificationPatterns.example: set isChillerInstalled to False and perform mech init — verify chiller IO is not turned ON

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timed IO deactivation: signal turns off after configurable delay
verificationPatterns.example: set DeactivateChillerOnOffState to TRUE, set CwsChillerOffDelay to 10, perform go-to-off — verify chiller IO turns off after 10 seconds

verificationPatterns.pattern: Valve position on state entry
verificationPatterns.example: After mech init + get ready: verify bypass valve moves from 32767 to 10922

verificationPatterns.pattern: Valve position persistence across state transition
verificationPatterns.example: After moving back to standby: verify bypass valve still reads 10922

verificationPatterns.pattern: Valve position on system off
verificationPatterns.example: After go to off: verify bypass valve moves to 32767

verificationPatterns.pattern: Valve response to supply valve commanded closed (0)
verificationPatterns.example: Set CVC HX water supply valve to 0: verify bypass valve moves to 10922

verificationPatterns.pattern: Valve response to supply valve unset/released
verificationPatterns.example: Unset CVC HX water supply: verify bypass valve moves to 32767

verificationPatterns.pattern: Start-delay suppression: state must not change while monitor delay is active
verificationPatterns.example: increase CwsPreFilterPressureMonitorStartDelay.Value to 99, perform mech init and create high pressure(outside ranges) — verify state does not change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Moving-average lag: pressure change must not take immediate effect
verificationPatterns.example: change water inline pressure — verify change is not done immediately and moving average is implemented; verify change can be done press as well

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic-range violation during mech init: state → off, exactly one error event, no other events
verificationPatterns.example: perform mech init, set inline pre filter pressure above panic ranges — verify state changes to off, verify error event is issued, verify other events are not issued

verificationPatterns.pattern: Valid-range violation during print: state → off, exactly one error event, no other events
verificationPatterns.example: perform print, set inline pre filter pressure above valid range — verify state changes to off, verify error event is issued, verify other events are not issued

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass mode: all pressure violations produce no state change and no events
verificationPatterns.example: bypass pressure monitoring and repeat tests 3;4 — state does not change and no event is issued

verificationPatterns.pattern: Off-state silence: invalid pressure while already off must not issue any event
verificationPatterns.example: set at off state invalid pressure — verify no event is issued

verificationPatterns.pattern: Silent CLI execution
verificationPatterns.example: LogSaver.UI.exe /silent="S:\Press\Legacy\Indigo\Config\eTools\Indigo.Infra.LogSaver.Collection.Preset.Silent"

verificationPatterns.pattern: Archive created at default path with timestamp-based filename
verificationPatterns.example: S:\logSaverArchive\silentRun_TodayDate()_CurrentPCTime().zip exists

verificationPatterns.pattern: Expected top-level folder exists inside archive
verificationPatterns.example: info folder exists inside zip

verificationPatterns.pattern: Expected files exist inside a specific archive subfolder
verificationPatterns.example: ScreenCapture.png and Readme.txt exist in info folder

verificationPatterns.pattern: Expected log files exist under indigologs\loggerfiles
verificationPatterns.example: PC.log, EngineGroupA, EngineGroupB exist under indigologs\loggerfiles

verificationPatterns.pattern: Expected configuration files exist under Configuration folder
verificationPatterns.example: PressConfig.json and PressDB.db exist in Configuration folder

verificationPatterns.pattern: Expected event files exist under Events folder
verificationPatterns.example: Events.csv exists in Events folder

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cleanup after test by deleting generated archive folder
verificationPatterns.example: Delete folder from S:\LogSaverArchive after verification

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cloud connectivity precondition check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Press connected to the cloud — Expected: Press connected to PressQA stack

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service health precondition check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify IOTJobsService is running on the system — Expected: IOT service running on the system

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state precondition check before operation
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press is in standby or ready state — Expected: Press is in Standby/Ready states

verificationPatterns.pattern: Web tool UI interaction and parameter configuration
verificationPatterns.example: Set snapshot time frame to custom; Set start date to yesterday and end date to now(); Select press from presses list

verificationPatterns.pattern: IOT transfer verification via desktop client
verificationPatterns.example: Open S:\Indigo\Indigo.Infra.Iot.PressIotJobsClient.Tester.exe and verify logs transferred by IOT

verificationPatterns.pattern: Web console parameter completeness check
verificationPatterns.example: Open web console and verify all selected parameters sent successfully — Expected: Press S/N, job name, time are present

verificationPatterns.pattern: Conditional verification based on press serial number
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all logs exist in LRS folder for specific machine — exists only if press serial started with 5 only

verificationPatterns.pattern: Local archive path existence check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify logs saved locally under s:/press/logsaverarchive

verificationPatterns.pattern: Enumerated log type completeness check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify ScreenCapture, EngineLogs (GroupA + B), PLC logs, PressEventsDB are saved in both LRS and Local

verificationPatterns.pattern: Negative test: operation blocked during active machine state
verificationPatterns.example: Collect logs during print — Expected: logs cannot be collected due to current machine state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cleanup verification: artifact deletion from all locations
verificationPatterns.example: Delete created folder under S: and from LRS — Expected: Both deleted

verificationPatterns.pattern: Process termination stops output — no artifact produced
verificationPatterns.example: Close LogSaverUI process mid-run; verify S:\LogSaverTemp contains no .zip file

verificationPatterns.pattern: Destination folder state check after abort
verificationPatterns.example: Temp folder is empty after process closed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cleanup step as implicit pass gate
verificationPatterns.example: Delete S:\LogSaverTemp; expected: folder deleted (confirms no locked file left behind)

verificationPatterns.pattern: No state change during monitoring start delay
verificationPatterns.example: verify state does not change / no events are issued

verificationPatterns.pattern: Restore parameter to default and assert default values
verificationPatterns.example: delay should be 6000 / upper limit should be 15000

verificationPatterns.pattern: Moving average: value change is not applied immediately
verificationPatterns.example: verify change is not done immediately and moving average is implemented

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic-low threshold triggers event with named parameters
verificationPatterns.example: below panic low event CWS_FLOW_PANIC_LOW is issued; parameters are SensorID, ActualValue, LimitValue

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic-high threshold triggers event and state change to service
verificationPatterns.example: above panic high, press state goes to service; CWS_FLOW_PANIC_HIGH is issued

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass flag suppresses state change and event
verificationPatterns.example: state does not change and no event is issued when CwsFlowMonitorBypass active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wait for named event enqueue from specific ink station with FlowID
verificationPatterns.example: Enqueue event INK_FAILED_TO_ADD_CD from INK_2_Stn_1, FlowID 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Return system to Standby after fault event confirmed
verificationPatterns.example: Press go to Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert failure event enqueued with source and FlowID
verificationPatterns.example: Enqueue event INK_FAILED_TO_ADD_IMO from INK_2_Stn_1, FlowID

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert system recovers to Standby after failure
verificationPatterns.example: Press go to Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Valve sequencing check — assert dependent valve closes after controlling valve
verificationPatterns.example: verify CWS valve closes after CVC valve (ready state)

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-hold check — assert valve stays in expected position after state transition
verificationPatterns.example: verify CWS valve remains closed after moving back to standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Off-state release check — assert bypass valve opens when machine goes to off
verificationPatterns.example: go to off → bypass valve is opened

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal-driven open check — deassert upstream signal, wait fixed delay, assert bypass valve opens
verificationPatterns.example: unset CVC HX water supply to 0, wait 1 second → bypass valve opens after about [delay]

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert boolean signal TRUE after trigger
verificationPatterns.example: verify Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.CWS.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtPowerDisable is at state TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert boolean signal FALSE after trigger release
verificationPatterns.example: verify Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.CWS.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtPowerDisable is at state FALSE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert complementary state signal TRUE after trigger release
verificationPatterns.example: verify Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.CWS.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff is at state TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default flag check
verificationPatterns.example: verify flag of isChillerInstalled is set to default — expected false

verificationPatterns.pattern: IO signal activation after config enable + mech init
verificationPatterns.example: set IsChillerInstalled=TRUE, perform mech init, verify ON signal sent to OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.CWS.HW_Outputs.CWS_Chiller.Value

verificationPatterns.pattern: IO signal persistence across state transitions
verificationPatterns.example: transition ready->print->ready->standby->off, verify CWS_Chiller.Value remains ON

verificationPatterns.pattern: IO signal absent when config disabled after mech init
verificationPatterns.example: set IsChillerInstalled=FALSE, perform mech init, verify chiller IO is not turned ON

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timed shutdown via delay parameter
verificationPatterns.example: go to off, verify CWS stays in 'going to off' state for CwsChillerOffDelay (10) seconds, then chiller IO turns off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Immediate shutdown on panic condition
verificationPatterns.example: override pressure above panic high, press goes to off, verify chiller turns off immediately

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timed shutdown — verify subsystem output signals reach off-state within specified deadline
verificationPatterns.example: CVC goes to off in 2.3 sec: HX valve closed AND pump value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Valve closes on emergency — boolean output signal goes True
verificationPatterns.example: Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gIos.CVC.Output.CVC_HX_WTR_SPLY_VLV.Value = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump shuts off on emergency — integer output signal reaches 0
verificationPatterns.example: Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gIos.CVC.Output.CVC_Pump.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Power-disable state confirmation — status flag asserts after emergency sequence
verificationPatterns.example: Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.CVC.Out.Status.AtPowerDisable = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-state coverage — same EMS trigger verified across all machine states
verificationPatterns.example: Steps repeated from OFF / Standby / Service / Mechinit / GR / Ready / Print

verificationPatterns.pattern: CS circulation pumps de-energise on EMS
verificationPatterns.example: CsInletPump.Value = 0 AND ImoReturnPump.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Reservoir pumps (filter + waste) de-energise on EMS
verificationPatterns.example: FilterPump.Value = 0, UC_WastePump.Value = 0, PE_WastePump.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Recycling controller reaches AtOff on EMS
verificationPatterns.example: ImoSystem.Comp.RecyclingCtrl.Out.Status.AtOff = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: IMO system reports AtPowerDisable on EMS
verificationPatterns.example: ImoSystem.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtPowerDisable = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Subsystem reaches AtOFF within time bound
