verificationPatterns.example: Steps 1-2 = circulation, Steps 3-4 = supply, Steps 5-6 = drain

verificationPatterns.pattern: Command-triggered sequence matches SWR
verificationPatterns.example: Set GoToInkSupply CMD → verify correct sequence per SWR section 2.2.6

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mid-sequence stop triggers recovery/drain sequence
verificationPatterns.example: Stop GoToInkSupply after bypass valve opens → verify Drain sequence is performed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Derived value = min(inputs) - constant
verificationPatterns.example: Verify set point = lowest ASID set point minus const

verificationPatterns.pattern: Change input → verify derived value updates accordingly
verificationPatterns.example: Change one ASID set point to lower value, verify IMO set point changed accordingly

verificationPatterns.pattern: Command triggers correct state sequence per SWR
verificationPatterns.example: Set Drain sequence CMD → verify correct sequence per section 2.2.6

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error during sequence halts it
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate air pressure error during drain → verify Drain sequence is Stop

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unrelated failure does not interrupt sequence
verificationPatterns.example: Raise failure not related to Ink tank/BID during Drain → verify Drain continues as normal

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold underflow triggers fault signal
verificationPatterns.example: Set air pressure below MinSupplyPressure + set InkSupply CMD → verify INK_AIR_PRESSURE_TOO_LOW_FOR_SUPPLY

verificationPatterns.pattern: Distinct threshold per operation mode triggers distinct fault signal
verificationPatterns.example: Set air pressure below MinDrainPressure + set InkSupply CMD → verify INK_AIR_PRESSURE_TOO_LOW_FOR_DRAIN

verificationPatterns.pattern: Interrupt-and-start: new command issued mid-sequence starts its own sequence
verificationPatterns.example: Run GoToInkSupply while DrainToStandby has not been completed yet → Verify GoToInkSupply sequence starts

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bidirectional interrupt: works regardless of which sequence is in-flight
verificationPatterns.example: Run DrainToStandby while GoToInkSupply has not been completed yet → Verify DrainToStandby sequence starts

verificationPatterns.pattern: DrainToOff interrupt: off-path command also preempts active sequence
verificationPatterns.example: Run DrainToOff while GoToInkSupply has not been completed yet → Verify DrainToOff sequence starts

verificationPatterns.pattern: Last-state preservation — pump retains its pre-command state
verificationPatterns.example: Set DrainToStandby once Ink pump is On and once ink pump is Off → Keep InkPump at last state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Forced pump shutdown — drain command turns pump off regardless of prior state
verificationPatterns.example: Set DrainToOff → Turn off ink pump

verificationPatterns.pattern: Drain sequence execution — correct drain sequence runs after state change
verificationPatterns.example: Each drain command expected result includes 'Drain sequence'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-precondition sweep — same command verified under both pump-on and pump-off preconditions
verificationPatterns.example: DrainToStandby tested with pump On and pump Off; DrainToCirculation tested with pump On and pump Off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Check component states after each CMD transition
verificationPatterns.example: After InkCirculation: BID valve closed, InkTank pump on, BID return pump off; after InkSupply: BID valve opened, InkTank pump on, BID return pump on

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify Drain sequence triggers on stop commands
verificationPatterns.example: Run Stop [off] CMD after InkSupply → Verify Drain sequence started, verify ink pump tank is off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify Drain sequence triggers on PostPrint CMD
verificationPatterns.example: Run Post print CMD after Print → Verify Drain sequence started, verify ink pump tank is still on/off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Binary state assertion per component per CMD
verificationPatterns.example: BID valve: opened/closed; InkTank pump: on/off; BID return pump: on/off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence conformance check against SWR section
verificationPatterns.example: Verify correct sequence — expected: section 2.2.6

verificationPatterns.pattern: Flag set on condition entry
verificationPatterns.example: IsBIDDrainFlag should be true when InkTankPump activated and BID valve opened

verificationPatterns.pattern: Flag reset on condition exit
verificationPatterns.example: After drain is finished the flag goes to False

verificationPatterns.pattern: State persistence across restart
verificationPatterns.example: After restart the flag is at false

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stop event emitted when sensor goes False during active operation
verificationPatterns.example: During InkCirculation set in place sensor False → Verify event: INK_CIRCULATION_STOPPED_TANK_NOT_IN_PLACE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation blocked (nothing happens) when sensor is False before start attempt
verificationPatterns.example: Set in place sensor to false, try to run INK CIRCULATION → Verify nothing happens / in future shouldn't be available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pair each ink operation with both a mid-run interrupt test and a pre-start blocked test
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 1+2 for InkCirculation, Steps 3+4 for InkSupply, Steps 5+6 for InkDrain

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence correctness against SWR
verificationPatterns.example: Verify correct sequence per section 2.2.6

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify nominal sequence against SWR section
verificationPatterns.example: Set Drain sequence CMD → verify correct sequence per section 2.2.6

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inject subsystem-specific error → verify sequence halts
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate air pressure error during drain → verify Drain sequence is Stop

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inject unrelated failure → verify sequence continues unaffected
verificationPatterns.example: During Drain raise failure not related to Ink tank/BID → verify Drain continues as normal

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print-continue check: non-critical RDU event must not stop print
verificationPatterns.example: Verify print continue

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event enqueue check: confirm named event is enqueued from the expected station source
verificationPatterns.example: Enqueue event INK_RDU_BACKSTROKE_FAILURE from INK_1_Stn_2

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event parameter check: for events with flow/pressure data, verify FlowID and RealParam values in enqueued event
verificationPatterns.example: Enqueue event INK_RDU_PRIME_FAILURE from INK_1_Stn_2, FlowID 0, RealParam1 RduPumpInletPressure 100.000

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition check: after fault in GetReady, verify press reaches expected state (Ready or Standby depending on severity)
verificationPatterns.example: Verify standard post print to Ready / Verify press go to Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cross-state repeatability: repeat same fault injections across Print and GetReady states to confirm consistent event and state behavior
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat stage 1-3 for GetReady

verificationPatterns.pattern: All RDU actuators off after stop
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all RDU action stopped, pump are off, valves off, etc.

verificationPatterns.pattern: No leaks after interrupted sequence
verificationPatterns.example: Verify SolidAdd sequence doesn't cause any leaks.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pressure returns to unprime state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify pressure is at unprime.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Set point hold during phase transition
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Density & Level values at set point after Get Ready sequence completes

verificationPatterns.pattern: Set point maintenance under load
verificationPatterns.example: Verify RDU stays on set points during print-phase Level changes caused by ink flow to bid

verificationPatterns.pattern: Status check at phase boundary
verificationPatterns.example: Focus on Pressure and RDU statuses at end of Get Ready and during Print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Happy-path sequence completion check with log and signal status
verificationPatterns.example: verify completion log and ink.density.status

verificationPatterns.pattern: Override a hardware status to an invalid state, run operation, verify failure propagates to ink manager after timeout with descriptive logs
verificationPatterns.example: Override Slider status to Close → Run ink load → Verify failure sent to ink manager after timeout with relevant logs description

verificationPatterns.pattern: Override a different hardware status to disengaged state, run operation, verify same failure-with-timeout pattern
verificationPatterns.example: Override Tube engage status to disengage → Run ink load → Verify failure sent to ink manager after timeout with relevant logs description

verificationPatterns.pattern: Return system to standby between override sub-cases
verificationPatterns.example: Go back to standby (before next override step)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tube-empty gate: when AlmostEmpty sensor is On, system halts regardless of pressure
verificationPatterns.example: Expected: Tube Empty - wait for tube replacement

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print-continue under low pressure: with AlmostEmpty Off and pressure < PrimingPressure, Run At Print state continues normally
verificationPatterns.example: Run At Print: Print continue

verificationPatterns.pattern: Get-Ready-to-Standby fallback: low inlet pressure during Get Ready transitions system to Standby (failure path)
verificationPatterns.example: Run at Get Ready: fail to Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event assertion on prime failure: verify named fault event is raised after low-pressure prime failure
verificationPatterns.example: Event should be raised: INK_RDU_PRIME_FAILURE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Override-then-run failure injection
verificationPatterns.example: Override Tube engage status to engage, run unload ink, verify failure sent to ink manager after timeout with relevant logs description

verificationPatterns.pattern: Standby reset between negative cases
verificationPatterns.example: Go to standby, override Slider status to Open, run unload ink, verify failure sent to ink manager after timeout

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout-triggered failure propagation to ink manager
verificationPatterns.example: Verify failure sent to ink manager after timeout with relevant logs description

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log inspection after failure
verificationPatterns.example: verify completion log and density status; verify relevant logs description on timeout failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-condition incomplete: operation not finished when only one of two required parameters (density, level) is at setpoint
verificationPatterns.example: Density at setpoint + level below LevelEnterLow → SolidAdd not finished; RDU tries to add both level and solids

verificationPatterns.pattern: Impossible-condition notification: user alert triggered when calculation shows target unachievable
verificationPatterns.example: Level at setpoint + density below EnterLow → SolidAdd not finished + 'empty ink tank' notification appears

verificationPatterns.pattern: Above-setpoint density with low level: process continues rather than halting
verificationPatterns.example: Density above setpoint + level below EnterLow → process continues to build

verificationPatterns.pattern: Too-many-retries fault → press standby transition
verificationPatterns.example: INK_RDU_TOO_MANY_PULSES_ADDED fires after excessive retries → verify press goes to standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: DB persistence check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify events exists in DB SQLite - events.db

verificationPatterns.pattern: File persistence check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify event exists in CSV file under logs directory

verificationPatterns.pattern: Schema column existence check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify columns existence: Status, Subsystem, Component, Functionality, SW layer, Event_ID, UI description, What to Do

verificationPatterns.pattern: Content correctness check against reference sheet
verificationPatterns.example: Verify columns content according to events; reference CSV used as expected values source

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify entity exists in both press and DB
verificationPatterns.example: Verify events on press and DB — Events exists in DB and Press

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify entity visible in UI tool after DB persistence
verificationPatterns.example: Open events viewer tool, verify events existence — Events exists

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify UI content matches DB record
verificationPatterns.example: Verify event content exists same as exists in DB — Content exists

verificationPatterns.pattern: DB max-capacity enforcement with oldest-event eviction
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate 15001 events → verify exactly 15000 remain and the oldest event is deleted from SQLite DB

verificationPatterns.pattern: SW startup triggers capacity verification (log check)
verificationPatterns.example: Restart/startup SW → verify in logs that max capacity verification was performed

verificationPatterns.pattern: DB delete reflected in UI grid
verificationPatterns.example: Delete all events from SQLite DB → verify Events grid in Kedem UI is empty

verificationPatterns.pattern: Time-advance triggers scheduled capacity verification (log check)
verificationPatterns.example: Set PC time to current + 30 min → verify in logs that capacity verification ran and found 0 events

verificationPatterns.pattern: Network capacity check for data movement
verificationPatterns.example: Capacity should rise in order to indicate movement of data via data network card

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-side Gcorn viewer validation (DFE + press)
verificationPatterns.example: Both DFE and press side viewers show separations

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC/ELC trace multi-signal verification with slot placement rules
verificationPatterns.example: Verify graph shows slots are placed correctly, with no overlap on each other and over stitch; verify start and end of frame correlates to planned slot position; verify HV occur at the correct position

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calculated vs. actual printed-line count check
verificationPatterns.example: Number of printed lines matches calculated number

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeatability verification by re-running identical job
verificationPatterns.example: Perform print again of 10 copies, each of 1 meter, 1 copy per blanket rotation; verify printing again is possible more than once

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition verification (off → ready)
verificationPatterns.example: UI and PLC at ready state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print job execution verification on PLC and UI
verificationPatterns.example: PLC and UI show print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-print state return verification
verificationPatterns.example: states return to ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button disabled until target state reached
verificationPatterns.example: verify print button is not enabled until ready state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button becomes unavailable after triggering action that changes state
verificationPatterns.example: verify state changes to state print and button becomes unavailable

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition confirmation after user action
verificationPatterns.example: verify state changes to state print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Above-valid-high boundary: signal set above ValidHigh limit produces no reaction when monitor is canceled
verificationPatterns.example: Set OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.CVC.HW_Inputs.CVC_FEED_ECO_AIR_PRESSURE.Value = gInterface.CVC.Ctrl.In.Param.Import.MonitorLimits.EcoAirPressureFeed.ValidHigh + 10 → No state change, no error in UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Below-valid-low boundary: signal set below ValidLow limit produces no reaction when monitor is canceled
verificationPatterns.example: Set OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.CVC.HW_Inputs.CVC_FEED_ECO_AIR_PRESSURE.Value = gInterface.CVC.Ctrl.In.Param.Import.MonitorLimits.EcoAirPressureFeed.ValidLow - 10 → No state change, no error in UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: State exhaustion: repeat both boundary checks for every press state to confirm monitor suppression is state-agnostic
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat steps 1-4 for MechInit, Standby, Get Ready, Ready, Pre-Print, Print, Post-Print → No state change, no error in UI in each state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal pair coverage: apply identical boundary tests to both the feed and exit sensor signals
verificationPatterns.example: CVC_FEED_ECO_AIR_PRESSURE tested in steps 1-2; CVC_EXIT_ECO_AIR_PRESSURE tested in steps 3-4 with corresponding ValidHigh/ValidLow limits

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inject value above PanicHigh threshold and assert no reaction
verificationPatterns.example: Set sensor value = PanicHigh + 10 → No state change, no error in UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inject value below PanicLow threshold and assert no reaction
verificationPatterns.example: Set sensor value = PanicLow - 10 → No state change, no error in UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat same panic-boundary checks across all relevant press states
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 1-4 repeated for Pre-Print, Print, Post-Print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Scope-vs-reference-table distance verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify scope results are matching the distances. Use the excel table for verification.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Column presence check

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boolean field value check after fault injection

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert machine state equals expected numeric state code

verificationPatterns.pattern: Trigger state transition and assert new machine state code
verificationPatterns.example: Press go to STANDBY → OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = 6 (STBY)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert subsystem component reaches Off status after state transition
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Comp.Drying.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event presence with parameter check
verificationPatterns.example: error event IR_SENSOR_COMM_FAILURE appears; event parameter: eh temperature sensor 10

verificationPatterns.pattern: Component forced to OFF on fault
verificationPatterns.example: BLANKET DRYING COMPONENT IN OFF (gInterface.BKT.Comp.Drying.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state response depends on press state at fault time
verificationPatterns.example: Dynamic ready/Pre-print/Print → state = Ready; Get Ready → move to STBY; STBY and below → no state change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-state sweep — repeat fault injection across all press states
verificationPatterns.example: repeat step #1 in READY / PRE PRINT / POST PRINT / DYNAMIC READY / STBY / OFF / INITIALIZE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-hood sweep — repeat full test for each sensor location
verificationPatterns.example: REPEAT STEPS 1 AND 2 FOR HOOD 1 AND HOOD 5 SENSORS

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event fields match expected fault signature
verificationPatterns.example: error event THERMISTOR_INVALID / SensorID: air knife thermistor / Actual Resistance: -1 (from AK_Blower_Thermistor_Temperature.Simulation.Value) / Limit Resistance: AkBlowerValidLow

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault reproduces across all machine states
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat step in READY / PRE PRINT / POST PRINT / DYNAMIC READY / STBY / OFF / INITIALIZE and verify THERMISTOR_INVALID event fires each time

verificationPatterns.pattern: Prerequisite component state is verified before each check
verificationPatterns.example: BLANKET DRYING COMPONENT IN OFF (gInterface.BKT.Comp.Drying.Comp.Hood[10].Comp.Heater[1].Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state precondition is validated per state under test
verificationPatterns.example: For Dynamic Ready / Pre-Print / Print: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = Ready; for Get Ready: State = stby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pop-up notification appears on press after cloud job received
verificationPatterns.example: Ensure pop up message appear to user

verificationPatterns.pattern: Elastic index search confirms SWInstaller index is present and discoverable
verificationPatterns.example: Go to elastic → Create new Data View → Search for index SWInstaller and find proper index

verificationPatterns.pattern: SWInstaller report reason field matches triggering event string exactly

verificationPatterns.pattern: SWInstaller report umbrella version matches the deployed version

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify indexed subsystem default values match a fixed expected table

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert UNDEFINED_INK for unassigned/reserved slots within an indexed range

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cross-check same ink order visible in every wizard UI (not just one surface)

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI reflection of ink change
verificationPatterns.example: verify: inks changed in UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press Explorer entity state check

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-SW-upgrade state persistence check
verificationPatterns.example: after SW upgrade passed colors remained same as in step #2 and not changed back to default configuration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Guard condition: warning suppressed while prerequisite actuator is OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timed warning activation: warning appears after fixed delay once actuator turns ON

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic threshold triggers error message, stops subsystem, and drops press to OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Configuration-dependent behavior: same stimulus produces different outcomes per build/feature flag

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass active suppresses warning — wait fixed dwell then assert no UI warning
verificationPatterns.example: Wait 3 seconds, there is no warning since imaging oil filter pressure is bypassed.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass deactivated restores warning — UI monitor shows orange + event fires
verificationPatterns.example: After 3 seconds when pump is ON, warning appear in the UI monitor of the mechanical filters and they are turn to Orange color; Event appear: PRESSURE_TOO_HIGH

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass state readable as boolean signal after toggle

verificationPatterns.pattern: Metadata parameter default + min/max verification

verificationPatterns.pattern: Below-minimum boundary rejection: value just outside lower bound triggers red error with range tooltip

verificationPatterns.pattern: Lower bound acceptance: value exactly at minimum clears error
verificationPatterns.example: C0 = 0.4 → red error disappeared

verificationPatterns.pattern: Above-maximum boundary rejection: value just outside upper bound triggers red error with range tooltip
verificationPatterns.example: C0 = 0.61 → red error, tooltip = 'Allowed Range 0.4-0.6'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Upper bound acceptance: value exactly at maximum clears error
verificationPatterns.example: C0 = 0.6 → red error disappeared

verificationPatterns.pattern: No error events during active print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-job verification after press returns to Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: ES Dashboard data presence check after run
verificationPatterns.example: In ES we have data about this run (Dashboard - CSC result)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default boolean flag check in PEX

verificationPatterns.pattern: OPC UA tree node existence check

verificationPatterns.pattern: OPC UA report node existence check

verificationPatterns.pattern: Live value update verification during print
verificationPatterns.example: During active print, verify WebRlScalingFactor and ImageLenScalingFactor values change; verify onStripeId and scalingFactorsRefId values change

verificationPatterns.pattern: ISF and RLSF correctness check per print mode
verificationPatterns.example: ISF and RLSF works correct. Check data in ES.

verificationPatterns.pattern: CSC-selective algorithm activation: ISF/RLSF only fires for jobs where CSC is enabled
verificationPatterns.example: ISF and RLSF works only for jobs were CSC is enable. Check data in ES.

verificationPatterns.pattern: ES data validation after each print scenario
verificationPatterns.example: Check data in ES.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Validate calculated parameter stays within panic-high delta bound

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify noise detection and RPM selection result is surfaced to user

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify retry on invalid RPM measurement
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate invalid RPM measurement; expected: SW starts RPM measurement again

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify max-iteration failure event fires after 3 consecutive failures

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify station is locked out for print after calibration failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify calibration timeout causes station failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal-state assertion: verify a status/sequencer signal reaches an expected string value before proceeding
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.arrInk[1].Main.Out.Status.Seq.InkFlowCalib.AtInkFlowCalib → 'Delta BID calculation finished'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary formula check: simulate a calculated value and assert it stays within a panic-high threshold derived from RPM set-points
verificationPatterns.example: InkFlowValue < (SetInkRPMis3300 - inkPumpCalibrationRPM) * (inkFlowPanicHigh - inkFlowSetPoint) / (SetInkRPMis3300 - SetInkRPMis2700)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Noise-detection gate: after RPM measurement, verify SW classifies the sample as clean/noisy and records the selected RPM
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.arrInk[1].Main.Out.Exported.Calib.InkFlow.CalibratedRpm → 'calibration finished for INK flow - result shall be shown to user'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Retry-on-invalid: simulate an invalid RPM measure and assert SW restarts the measurement cycle
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate RPM measure invalid → CalibratedRpm signal shows 'SW start measure RPM again'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Max-iteration failure event: trigger the failure condition N times (3) and assert the correct failure event fires with its description
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate INK_FLOW_RPM_MEASURE_FAILURE 3 times → event INK_FLOW_CALIBRATION_MAX_ALLOWED_ITERATIONS_FAILURE raised; description: 'Ink flow calibration failed to pass the calibration in range of allowed iterations'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Station lockout after calibration failure: exit the wizard and verify the INK station is marked unavailable for print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout assertion: let calibration exceed InfFlowCalibrationTimeoutSec and verify the station fails
verificationPatterns.example: Wizard runs > 10 minutes (InkFlowCalibTimeOut) → selected station shall fail

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold-based level measurement trigger
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate INK level < 0.1L → measure recorded, InkAtReadyLevel asserted

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timed stabilization delay verification

verificationPatterns.pattern: AppSW persists user-facing calibration inputs and metadata to statistics storage
verificationPatterns.example: AppSW will save for statistics the following: LPH S/N, User selection - stations to calibrate, calibration set position - Default / LastCalibrated, User inputs - best focus rear & front, Iteration number

verificationPatterns.pattern: AppSW persists LPH hardware state and result fields to statistics storage
verificationPatterns.example: LPH duty cycle wizard set point, LPH sensor exists, LPH calibration result

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC exports mechanical calibration output values after calibration completes
verificationPatterns.example: PLC will export calibration results - engage position rear & front, proximity sensors rear & front

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify wizard default selection state on open
verificationPatterns.example: All active stations are selected; 'LastCalibrated' is selected for all stations

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify per-station UI element presence
verificationPatterns.example: Each station contains: station number, color indication (drop), 'Focus on page' switch + label (default 'yes'), Rear number input + label, Front number input + label, Next button (arrow); last station replaces Next with Validate

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify 'Focus on page' switch disables inputs when toggled off
verificationPatterns.example: If switched to 'no', disables both Rear and Front input fields

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify current-station indicator updates as jobs appear
verificationPatterns.example: Once the first job appears in the inspection area, its station is indicated as the 'current' station

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify pass/fail visual indication per station after Validate
verificationPatterns.example: Stations 1,2,3,6 (Front 400 / Rear 600) receive a visual Passed indication; stations 4,5 (Front 90 / Rear 910) receive a visual Failed indication

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify action buttons enable/disable state after Validate
verificationPatterns.example: Save becomes enabled, Recalibrate becomes enabled, Validate becomes disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify footer note appears after validation with mixed results
verificationPatterns.example: A note appears in the footer: 'Note that only passed stations will be saved'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify passed stations are disabled (but retain indication) during Recalibrate flow
verificationPatterns.example: Stations 1,2,3,6 (passed) are disabled with their 'Passed' indication still displayed after clicking Recalibrate

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify invalid-value input produces correct UI indication
verificationPatterns.example: Values such as >1000, +-, 500.11 trigger a correct error/warning indication in the wizard window

verificationPatterns.pattern: DC value matches Pex source
verificationPatterns.example: Verify DC correct value; Verify LPHs got new DC values as in Pex

verificationPatterns.pattern: DC resets to default after wizard close
verificationPatterns.example: Verify DC values back to default after close wizard

verificationPatterns.pattern: Partial station subset produces same result
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat test only with station 1,3,5 — Same result

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cancel mid-step still applies then resets DC
verificationPatterns.example: Click to cancel whole Measuring and entering value step; Verify LPHs got new DC values as in Pex; Verify DC values back to default after close wizard

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault during print + cancel shows correct wizard info and resets DC
verificationPatterns.example: Cause fault during print then click cancel; Verify correct information appears in window of wizard; Verify DC values back to default after close wizard

verificationPatterns.pattern: Changed Pex DC propagates correctly through wizard
verificationPatterns.example: Change DC in Pex, start calibration from wizard, finish wizard; Verify LPHs got new DC values as in Pex

verificationPatterns.pattern: Highest GlossTargetOD wins bid selection
verificationPatterns.example: Verify job send to Bid with the highest GlossTargetOD color

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tie-breaking rule: Bid-B wins on equal OD
verificationPatterns.example: Define on station 3 two Bids are active with same OD — Print will be with Bid-B

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify all selected stations printed
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all 6 stations printed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify only selected stations appear in wizard
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in Wizard displayed only station 2,3,6

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify selected stations passed calibration after inserting value and clicking Validate
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all stations passed calibration / Verify stations passed calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify wizard closes after Save
verificationPatterns.example: Wizard closed

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI reflects signal change from multiple input sources
verificationPatterns.example: Change roll orientation via PLC or PEX or wizard → Verify roll orientation displayed correct

verificationPatterns.pattern: Visual strip representation of substrate on roll
verificationPatterns.example: The substrate is represented by strips on the uw/rw

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bounded strip count: min/max range enforcement
verificationPatterns.example: Maximum number of strips is 10, and the minimum is 1 strip

verificationPatterns.pattern: Max digit count enforcement
verificationPatterns.example: Maximum length = 5 digits

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-unit support check (metric/imperial)
verificationPatterns.example: Support meter/feet units

verificationPatterns.pattern: Periodic update interval with rounding
verificationPatterns.example: Value updated every 10 meters (32 feet), displayed rounded to nearest 10 meters/feet

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unwinder displays current value only
verificationPatterns.example: Unwinder: only the current value is displayed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Rewinder displays current value plus total potential
verificationPatterns.example: Rewinder: the current value and the total potential meters are displayed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service op triggers ink station state change to OFF
verificationPatterns.example: Send Service operation to some BID → Verify the relevant ink station lowered to OFF state.

verificationPatterns.pattern: EA op executes successfully on commanded ink
verificationPatterns.example: Send some EA operation to all inks → Verify operation done successfully on the commanded ink.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Command propagation to ink station
verificationPatterns.example: Send ink preparation command to ink station 2; verify ink station 2 received the ink preparation command

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass operation on ink level
verificationPatterns.example: Do bypass on ink level of ink station 3; verify bypass done on ink station 3

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration result persistence on ink station
verificationPatterns.example: Send level calibration operation to ink station 4; verify level calibration result saved to ink station 4

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cascading deactivation of associated ink when BID station deactivated via PEX
verificationPatterns.example: Deactivate BID station 6 using PEX; verify ink associated to BID station 6 deactivated as well

verificationPatterns.pattern: OPC UA signal value check per ink index after parameter write
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Ink[1].ImportedData.Density.PanicLow.Value = 10

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ink-to-BID index mapping verification via HW configuration table signals
verificationPatterns.example: IEngine:MEStationEntity.BID.BID[0].Value.Config.InkIndex.Value and gInterface.Station[index].Comp.arrBid[index].Main.In.Par.Import.InkIndex

verificationPatterns.pattern: Command propagation check: send preparation command, verify ink stations acknowledge receipt
verificationPatterns.example: Send ink preparation command to ink stations; verify ink stations got ink preparation command

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify ink-to-BID mapping via InkIndex signals on both IEngine and gInterface layers
verificationPatterns.example: IEngine:MEStationEntity.BID.BID[0].Value.Config.InkIndex.Value matches gInterface.Station[index].Comp.arrBid[index].Main.In.Par.Import.InkIndex per HW configuration table

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify BID Developer voltage reaches expected set-point after printing starts
verificationPatterns.example: OCB_saPLC.OCB.gIos.Station[X].BID_Hv[Y].Output.DeveloperVoltSet_v.Value= 500

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify press prints without error after state change
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press printing without any error after transitioning to Ready state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Precondition gate — simulation flag must be off before recording can be verified
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in Umkultum that Simulate Elastic is off. When Elastic is simulated IOs and parameters changes are not recorded.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dashboard filter edit via wildcard to scope IO subset
verificationPatterns.example: Change the wildcard portion, the name in the parentheses, to a part of IO name. For example for all CWS IOs use wildcard = 'CWS'.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Time-range scoped graph verification of IO state changes
verificationPatterns.example: Select the desired time range, refresh the results. In the graph area all the changes in IO state in a selected time range would be displayed.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Table-level filtering when multiple IOs match the wildcard
verificationPatterns.example: Filter single or more IOs in a case of multiple results in the 'IOs table' area of the dashboard.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Elastic simulation gate check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in Umkultum that Simulate Elastic is off — when simulated, IO and parameter changes are not recorded

verificationPatterns.pattern: Kibana data presence check
verificationPatterns.example: Kibana -> Discover -> Filters, search for plc-analog-data or plc-digital-data to confirm data is stored for policies

verificationPatterns.pattern: JSON config syntax validation
verificationPatterns.example: Verify JSON file syntax is correct; error message must display line number and failure type

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard completion check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify wizard passed.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-calibration print validation
verificationPatterns.example: Verify job is printing without any error.

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition after calibration
verificationPatterns.example: Once the press in Standby state, go to Ready state and print some job

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI control availability per press state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify ASID speed calibration wizard play button is disabled in Off/GR/Ready/Print/PostPrint/PrePrint state

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI control enabled only in privileged states
verificationPatterns.example: Verify ASID speed calibration wizard play button is Enabled in Service/Standby state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service state entry on wizard launch
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.MgmtCtrl.Out.Status.AtService = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default UI checkbox state verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify checkbox marked by default - 'Exit Service state upon close'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard failure triggers recalibrate affordance
verificationPatterns.example: Verify wizard failed; Verify recalibrate button appeared

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter persistence after successful recalibration
verificationPatterns.example: Verify results are saved in: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.In.Par.Save.ProcessSpeed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter NOT persisted when closing without recalibration
verificationPatterns.example: Verify results are not saved in: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.In.Par.Save.ProcessSpeed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service-to-Standby state restoration on Close
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press state is Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Negative path repeat — same wizard flow, skip recovery step
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat the test; this time instead of step 3 go to step 4

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter table conformance check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify parameters in PLC are according to SW requirements - 'Parameters Table – Summary' (table 2.15)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operational state precondition assertion
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press at Service operational state

verificationPatterns.pattern: LPH reaches operational after standby transition
verificationPatterns.example: move to standby → verify LPHs go to operational

verificationPatterns.pattern: LPH operational state survives GR cycle
verificationPatterns.example: perform GR and go back to standby → verify LPHs remain at operational

verificationPatterns.pattern: DB parameter change + mech init propagates to hardware
verificationPatterns.example: change off-state duty cycle in DB, perform mech init → verify duty cycle changed in practice in LPHs

verificationPatterns.pattern: NVRAM DB not overwritten on restart when data already exists
verificationPatterns.example: perform restart → verify NVRAM DB are not overwritten on restart in case data already exists

verificationPatterns.pattern: NVRAM read failure blocks LPH operational + raises event
verificationPatterns.example: cause failure on reading nvram data → verify LPH does not go to operational and event is given

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter change (zmod) applied only at spread boundary, not slice boundary
verificationPatterns.example: print wizard that changes zmod between spreads → verify zmod only changed between spreads and not between slices

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default-value compliance check against SWR
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all STIR peeling default parameters are according SW requirements, chapter 2.20.1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Named-parameter enumeration — list every parameter under test explicitly
verificationPatterns.example: Parameters that needs verification: StirPeelSpeed, StirPeelingTempSetPoint, StirPeelingTime

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert signal equals expected boolean during calibration
verificationPatterns.example: OCB_saPLC.OCB.gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtPeeling = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Run cleaner for minimum rotation count then re-verify peeling inhibition
verificationPatterns.example: Run cleaner with at least 13 bkt rotations; verify STIR peeling is not entering during calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error severity differs by press state: OFF state yields 'error', any other state yields 'failure'
verificationPatterns.example: In OFF: ASID_IR_MLX_COMM_FAILURE from ASID_DRUM_TEMP_SNS error is published. In Print: ASID_IR_MLX_COMM_FAILURE from ASID_DRUM_TEMP_SNS failure is published.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press falls to OFF on communication failure during active state
verificationPatterns.example: Set IOsSimulationMode = FALSE while in Print state → Press falls to OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press remains in OFF when communication failure occurs while already in OFF
verificationPatterns.example: Set IOsSimulationMode = FALSE while in OFF state → Press remains in OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Published message includes subsystem ID
verificationPatterns.example: ASID_IR_MLX_COMM_FAILURE published including subsystem ID - Asid_Station_1

verificationPatterns.pattern: MI (Maintenance Information) available after fault
verificationPatterns.example: MI available (verified in all steps)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat test across all press states to ensure consistent behavior
verificationPatterns.example: Step 4: Repeat for all other press states — expect press falls to OFF and failure published each time

verificationPatterns.pattern: Main enable signals remain TRUE regardless of which ME station is bypassed
verificationPatterns.example: LPH_Main_Enable_Exit = TRUE, LPH_Main_Enable_Feed = TRUE (both steps 2 and 4)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Only the LPH voltage signal matching the disabled ME station number goes FALSE; all others stay TRUE
verificationPatterns.example: ME 1 disabled → LPH_1_Enable_Voltage = FALSE, LPH_2..6_Enable_Voltage = TRUE; ME 4 disabled → LPH_4_Enable_Voltage = FALSE, others TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: One disabled station at a time — re-enable before disabling a different station to isolate each bypass effect
verificationPatterns.example: Step 3: Enable ME 1, then disable ME 4 before re-entering Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal stays false throughout timeout window
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Stations.Station1.Comp.AsiD.Comps.AsidTemp.Out.Status.AtTemperature = false during 720 seconds

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout event published with full metadata (subsystem ID, sensor ID, current temp, timeout value)
verificationPatterns.example: TEMP_CONTROL_TIMEOUT event published including subsystem ID (Asid_Stn_1), sensor ID (ASID_DRUM_TEMP_SNS), current temperature (30degC), timeout value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press transitions to correct fallback state on fault
verificationPatterns.example: Press returns to Standby state (from Get Ready); Press returns to Ready (from Pre-Print)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Correct process available after recovery from fault state
verificationPatterns.example: Get Ready available after Standby; Print available after Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat fault scenario from alternate entry state to verify state-specific recovery
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat for Pre-Print process, from Ready (not Dynamic Ready)

verificationPatterns.pattern: MechInit engage/disengage sequence order
verificationPatterns.example: Verify disengage -> Engage -> Wait duration time -> Verify engage -> Disengage -> Wait duration time -> Verify disengage

verificationPatterns.pattern: Disengage-before-engage on active stations only
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that disengage command is sent before each engage command for all active stations. Verify that no commands were sent to inactive stations.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Disengage on machine state transitions to off/standby states
verificationPatterns.example: Verify disengage of Charging roller in transition to: Standby, Standby - service, OFF machine states.

verificationPatterns.pattern: HMI-triggered engage also issues disengage-first
verificationPatterns.example: Activate Charging roller engage directly via HMI. Verify that disengage command is sent before each engage command for all active stations.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Soft engage does not add measurable delay to machine processes
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that the additional disengage does not bring a new delay to machine processes.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Physical softness verification (no aSiD damage)
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that engage indeed soft and not damage the aSiD? Jig?

verificationPatterns.pattern: Correct behavior during Print-Null-Print transition
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that the feature works correctly during Print-Null-Print transition.

verificationPatterns.pattern: CR disengage triggered on fault condition
verificationPatterns.example: Verify CR disengage during failure, for example VOLTAGE_NOT_REACHED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Behavior coverage across various slot sizes
verificationPatterns.example: Print jobs with various slot sizes.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-action dialog title reflects source entity name
verificationPatterns.example: Title of the popup is '<Substrate name> - properties'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Transient field highlight on newly created/editable field (3-second highlight then off)
verificationPatterns.example: The field 'Name' is highlighted for 3 seconds and then the highlight turns off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Duplicate prefixes copy name with 'Copy of'
verificationPatterns.example: 'Copy of' added at the beginning of the duplicated substrate

verificationPatterns.pattern: Toolbar action disabled on multi-selection when operation is single-item only
verificationPatterns.example: Select multiple substrates → Verify that Duplicate button is disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Edit mode entry: toolbar Edit button opens substrate properties in edit mode
verificationPatterns.example: Select Substrate and click on Edit button on the tool bar → Substrate properties of the selected substrate opened in edit mode

verificationPatterns.pattern: Save button disabled on edit open: verify save is not enabled until a change is made
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that save button is disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: In-use resource lock: resource active during operation is not editable; tooltip explains reason
verificationPatterns.example: Select Installed substrate and click on EDIT button → Verify that installed substrate is not editable during print; Tool tip should be displayed: Edit is currently disabled since the substrate is in print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Form section completeness: edit form contains all expected named sections
verificationPatterns.example: Content area includes 3 sections: Substrate definitions, Priming and corona, Tension

verificationPatterns.pattern: Required fields: all fields in edit form are marked/enforced as required
verificationPatterns.example: All fields are required.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sticky navigation: anchor/nav bar stays fixed while only content area scrolls
verificationPatterns.example: Only the content area can be scrolled, whereas the navigation (anchors) stays fixed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boolean property ON/OFF display in side panel
verificationPatterns.example: When Corona is required and Priming Required → side panel reflects ON state; when both disabled → Corona is OFF, Primer & Dryer is OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default vs customized label on parameter section
verificationPatterns.example: Tension section shows '(HP defaults)' when no tension params changed; shows '(Customized)' after any tension parameter is modified

verificationPatterns.pattern: Side panel reflects selected substrate's properties
verificationPatterns.example: Select any substrate → side panel data matches properties defined in substrate properties (Corona, Priming, Tension)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Single-click selection shows toolbar
verificationPatterns.example: Click on any substrate in the substrate list → verify substrate toolbar appeared

verificationPatterns.pattern: Secondary panel does not hide primary toolbar
verificationPatterns.example: Click side panel button → side panel displayed → verify substrate toolbar is still displayed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press-and-hold enables multi-selection mode
verificationPatterns.example: Press and hold any substrate until toolbar appears → click another substrate → verify multiple selection is enabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Filter activates after minimum character threshold
verificationPatterns.example: Filtering starts only after typing at least 3 characters; only matching substrates shown

verificationPatterns.pattern: Matching text highlighted in filtered results
verificationPatterns.example: The matching strings in the substrate are highlighted

verificationPatterns.pattern: Filter cleared via X icon
verificationPatterns.example: Click 'X' icon on right side of filter field → filter state canceled, full list restored

verificationPatterns.pattern: Column header click cycles sort direction with visual indicator
verificationPatterns.example: Click column title → Arrow Up (ascending) or Arrow Down (descending) appears next to title; default is ascending (A-Z, small-to-big)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Installed substrate pinned to top row; sort applies from second row down
verificationPatterns.example: Define any substrate as installed → installed substrate always top row, sorting starts from second row

verificationPatterns.pattern: List gains vertical scroll when content exceeds visible area
verificationPatterns.example: Create substrates until list exceeds vertical space → verify vertical scroll added

verificationPatterns.pattern: Substrate name truncated with ellipsis at max length
verificationPatterns.example: Name set to 46 characters → text cut and 3 dots displayed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Substrate name wraps to two lines below truncation threshold
verificationPatterns.example: Name set to 30 characters → text appears in two lines in substrate name field

verificationPatterns.pattern: Column flag verification after toggle enable
verificationPatterns.example: In the substrate list under the Priming Required column, 'V' appeared in the selected substrate row

verificationPatterns.pattern: Popup appearance confirmation
verificationPatterns.example: Substrate definitions popup window appeared after clicking Edit

verificationPatterns.pattern: Valid mid-range value save success
verificationPatterns.example: Type 100 in Thickness field, click Save → save succeeds and substrate with value 100 appears in substrate list

verificationPatterns.pattern: Maximum boundary value save success
verificationPatterns.example: Type 400 in Thickness field, click Save → save succeeds and substrate with value 400 appears in substrate list

verificationPatterns.pattern: Arbitrary valid range value save success
verificationPatterns.example: Type any number in valid range, click Save → save succeeds and substrate with new value appears in substrate list

verificationPatterns.pattern: Auto-recovery on power restore when unit not mid-operation
verificationPatterns.example: RDU & Revolver that weren't in the middle of rotation will recover automatically once power is enabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: In-progress sequence completes after recovery
verificationPatterns.example: Revolver is during replacement sequence: Revolver will complete the replacement procedure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Solid-add state continuity after recovery
verificationPatterns.example: continue solid add where needed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Config-constrained valid values check
verificationPatterns.example: For RevolverConfig=DualRevolver, position can be 0° or 180°

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify SLC inhibits motion/capability during a named operational mode
verificationPatterns.example: Verify SLC block the revolver ability to rotate and RDU solid add capability during Tube replacement

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat same SLC/RDU inhibit verification across all relevant maintenance/change modes
verificationPatterns.example: Same assertion applied to Color change and Revolver maintenance in separate steps

verificationPatterns.pattern: Upstream-first sequencing: higher-priority station must complete before lower-priority station starts
verificationPatterns.example: Send Rotate CMD to stations 1 & 2 — verify station 2 waits for station 1 completion

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fan-out after gate: multiple downstream stations may proceed in parallel once their shared upstream completes
verificationPatterns.example: Send Rotate CMD to stations 2 & 1 & 3 — after station 2 completes, stations 1 and 3 work together

verificationPatterns.pattern: Chained dependency: each station waits on the next upstream in the chain, resolving sequentially
verificationPatterns.example: Send Rotate CMD to stations 3 & 2 & 4 & 1 — stations 2 & 4 wait for station 3; station 1 waits for station 2

verificationPatterns.pattern: Partial fan-out with tail dependency: parallel pair unblocks, but a further station still waits on one of the pair
verificationPatterns.example: Send Rotate CMD to stations 4 & 3 & 2 — station 3 waits for station 4; station 2 waits for station 3

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault event raised on rotation timeout
verificationPatterns.example: Verify INK_RDU_REVOLVER_ROTATION_FAILURE event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print continues despite rotation failure during active job
verificationPatterns.example: Verify print continue, Verify event: INK_RDU_REVOLVER_ROTATION_FAILURE event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout event enqueued after raise-lift duration when LiftUpSensor remains low
verificationPatterns.example: Enqueue event INK_RDU_RAISE_LIFT_FAILURE from INK_1_Stn_3, FlowID 0, IntParam1 LiftUpSensorValue 0, IntParam2 LiftDownSensorValue 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout event enqueued after release-lift duration when LiftDownSensor remains low
verificationPatterns.example: Enqueue event INK_RDU_RELEASE_LIFT_FAILURE from INK_1_Stn_3, FlowID 0, IntParam1 LiftUpSensorValue 1, IntParam2 LiftDownSensorValue 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press remains at Ready state during lift timeout scenario
verificationPatterns.example: Press remain at Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press remains at Ready after slider command is issued with sensor mismatch
verificationPatterns.example: Expected: Press remain at Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout event is enqueued after the configured slider duration elapses
verificationPatterns.example: verify Timeout event after OpenSliderDuration=500ms (INK_RDU_SLIDER_CLOSE_FAILURE)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event source, FlowID, IntParam1 (SliderCloseSensorValue), and IntParam2 (SliderOpenSensorValue) are verified in the enqueued event
verificationPatterns.example: Enqueue event INK_RDU_SLIDER_CLOSE_FAILURE from INK_1_Stn_3, FlowID 0, IntParam1 SliderCloseSensorValue 0, IntParam2 SliderOpenSensorValue 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Each slider direction (open, close) has a corresponding distinct failure event type
verificationPatterns.example: Open direction → INK_RDU_SLIDER_CLOSE_FAILURE; Close direction → INK_RDU_SLIDER_OPEN_FAILURE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Paired sensor mutual exclusion — when one sensor activates, its complement deactivates
verificationPatterns.example: SliderOpenSensor=True & SliderCloseSensor=False after Open CMD; SliderOpenSensor=False & SliderCloseSensor=True after Close CMD

verificationPatterns.pattern: Revolver status string matches command intent
verificationPatterns.example: revolver status is Open after slide Open CMD; revolver status is Close after slide Close CMD

verificationPatterns.pattern: Command→sensor→status triple verification per actuator action
verificationPatterns.example: Send CMD → verify two sensor booleans → verify revolver status string

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence ordering check — Load
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Slide open before Tube Engage

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence ordering check — Unload
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Slide Close before Tube disengage (Extractor Up)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Conditional lift-state check before completing MechInit
verificationPatterns.example: If lift is down, Finish MI; if lift is not down, lift it up first

verificationPatterns.pattern: Rotate until sensor condition is satisfied, then execute positional move
verificationPatterns.example: Rotate until InPositionSensor=True then Lift Down; from that position go to last working position

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify active component responds to manager commands in Run state
verificationPatterns.example: Revolver is active and respond to ink manager commands

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press continues operation under degraded condition until threshold breached
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press continue to print until density drop to Exit Low

verificationPatterns.pattern: Density-based exit threshold check
verificationPatterns.example: Reduce density to 1900, 1850, etc until failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Block-while-fault: verify motion does not start when fault signal is active
verificationPatterns.example: TubeEmpty=True → verify rotation doesn't start

verificationPatterns.pattern: Trigger-and-sequence: set replacement/recovery flag then verify ordered multi-step sequence executes
verificationPatterns.example: Set Tube Replaced Flag to True → verify sequence: PumpDisengage, CloseSlider, ExtractorUP, LiftValve-on, EnableMotor, RevolverAtRotation, DisableMotor, LiftValve-off, OpenSlider, TubeEngage, ExtractorDown

verificationPatterns.pattern: Step-order assertion: verify each sub-step fires in declared order, not just that all steps complete
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Correct sequence order across 11 named steps

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault-auto-clear: verify fault signal resets to False after recovery action completes
verificationPatterns.example: After tube replace completion → TubeEmpty=False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print unavailable in non-operational states
verificationPatterns.example: In OFF, Standby, and Get-Ready: open each wizard and verify print is not available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print available only in Ready state
verificationPatterns.example: In Ready: open each wizard and verify print is available

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-gated feature availability across all wizard variants
verificationPatterns.example: Same check repeated for electrode calibration, developer calibration, and machine LIT calibration in every state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-upgrade parameter persistence check
verificationPatterns.example: Load new SW and verify color calibration parameters are matching expected result — all results are the same after the upgrade

verificationPatterns.pattern: Runtime DB consumption check during job
