verificationPatterns.pattern: MI sequence completes with subsystem bypassed
verificationPatterns.example: Verify PLC successfully complete MI Sequence without the [bypassed system]

verificationPatterns.pattern: Partial station bypass still allows full MI completion
verificationPatterns.example: Bypass few stations (for example 1,3,6) and send MI CMD — Verify PLC successfully complete MI Sequence

verificationPatterns.pattern: Immediate subsystem action on bypass
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Blanket starts immediately (WHS bypass step)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Staged sequencing — verify each stage triggers only after its prerequisite event
verificationPatterns.example: Stage 2 (Blanket) starts after IMP DONE; Stage 3 (Station per active station) starts after BKT done

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stage membership — verify all expected subsystems initialize within their assigned stage
verificationPatterns.example: Stage 1 must include: Web, CVC, CWS, IMO, LPH temperature

verificationPatterns.pattern: Active-station scoping — verify Stage 3 runs only for active stations, not all stations
verificationPatterns.example: Station (per active station)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify physical/output dimension against SW requirement value
verificationPatterns.example: Verify cleaner page length is according to SW requirements (0.88m)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify slot sequence after a fixed slot count
verificationPatterns.example: Verify after 6 print slots, there is null then stitch slots

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event presence check after operation completion
verificationPatterns.example: Verify after Cleaner print that event is appear on each completion of the cleaner page printing

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event level assertion
verificationPatterns.example: CLEANER_DONE - info

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify output cropped to configured dimension
verificationPatterns.example: Verify SW crop the image per subtract width

verificationPatterns.pattern: Selective station voltage assertion — only targeted station has active values; all others NULL
verificationPatterns.example: Verify only selected BID station is with print voltages, all the rest should be with NULL.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-wizard Manager state assertion — confirm system returns to Ready after wizard completes
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Mgr is at Ready state at end of wizard.

verificationPatterns.pattern: No fault event fired when bypass active
verificationPatterns.example: Verify no event about asid temperature invalid

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state unchanged when bypass suppresses fault
verificationPatterns.example: Verify PLC stayed in Standby state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary low: set temperature to setpoint minus low-offset, verify status flag turns true
verificationPatterns.example: change ASID temperature to aSIDTempSetPoint-aSIDTempOperatingLow → Verify "AsidAtTemperature" status changed to true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary high: set temperature to setpoint plus high-offset, verify status flag turns true
verificationPatterns.example: change ASID temperature to aSIDTempSetPoint+aSIDTempOperatingHigh → Verify "AsidAtTemperature" status changed to true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simulate sensor fault and verify specific event fired
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate communication error in ASID temperature sensor → Verify event ASID_IR_MLX_COMM_FAILURE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify CS manager state transition on critical sensor fault
verificationPatterns.example: After ASID_IR_MLX_COMM_FAILURE event → Verify CS manager state changed to Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simulate stuck/frozen sensor and verify specific event fired
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate stucked sensor error in ASID temperature sensor → Verify event ASID_IR_MLX_FREEZE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify PLC state unchanged on non-critical sensor fault
verificationPatterns.example: After ASID_IR_MLX_FREEZE event → Verify PLC state didn't change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify threshold-breach event with current/expected values
verificationPatterns.example: Verify event - aSID_TEMP_PANIC_HIGH with correct current/expected values

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify press state after panic condition
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press changed to OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify fault event fired with current/expected values
verificationPatterns.example: Verify event - ASID_TEMP_INVALID with correct current/expected values

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify press transitions to OFF state on fault
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press changed to OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify readiness flag cleared on fault
verificationPatterns.example: Verify AsidAtTemperature flag is FALSE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-station failure isolation — failed station rolls back, others continue printing
verificationPatterns.example: No values were saved for the Yellow failed station and printing continue with other stations. Failed station will rollback to previous value.

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI calibration result reflects partial failure as 'Success with errors'
verificationPatterns.example: UI calibration result = Success with errors.

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI calibration result reflects full failure as 'Failed' when calibration cannot start
verificationPatterns.example: UI calibration result = Failed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Electrometer error stops entire calibration — all stations rollback, nothing saved
verificationPatterns.example: Auto bias calibration is stopped and not started. No values were saved and all stations return to previous values.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Specific event raised per failure reason
verificationPatterns.example: Event: residual voltage out of range – below minimum | Event: Slope is out of range | Event: intercept is out of range | Event: Measurements are not consistence

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-station failure — both failed stations rollback while remaining stations continue
verificationPatterns.example: No values were saved for the Black and Magenta failed station only and printing continue with other stations.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration failure status check
verificationPatterns.example: Calibration status = Failed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure-specific event message verification
verificationPatterns.example: Event appear = Auto bias failed for station 1 - residual voltage value is below minimum

verificationPatterns.pattern: DB rollback on failure — no new value saved, previous value restored
verificationPatterns.example: DB value was not updated and last value exist

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard close + state reset verification after failed calibration
verificationPatterns.example: Wizard auto bias is closed. DB value was not updated and last value exist.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat open-calibrate-fail-close cycle per failure reason
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 4–6, 7–9, 10–12 repeat same open/fail/close/verify pattern for slope, intercept, VBg failure reasons

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify wizard restricts scope to expected stations
verificationPatterns.example: No option to select ink; only station 1 is calibrated when wizard runs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify ordered calibration sub-steps execute in sequence
verificationPatterns.example: Vlight step runs first; Transfer function from Vbg to Vcr starts only after Vlight finishes

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify overall calibration result status
verificationPatterns.example: Calibration finishes successfully

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify UI wizard shows expected pass/fail status
verificationPatterns.example: UI calibration status = Pass

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify wizard closes cleanly after finish action
verificationPatterns.example: Press Finish → Auto Bias wizard closed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify expected DB entities are written after calibration
verificationPatterns.example: AlgorithmAutoBiasUnchargedPipResidualEntity, VLightEntity, AlgorithmAutoBiasChargedPipEntity present in DB

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify new calibration values are applied in subsequent print job
verificationPatterns.example: Print 5 copies; confirm new auto bias values are used during print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button disabled when press not in ready state
verificationPatterns.example: press state = OFF → print button availability status = Button disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Precondition message appears with required state hint when button is disabled
verificationPatterns.example: Precondition appear and = Press state should be in ready state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button enabled only when press reaches ready state
verificationPatterns.example: press state = ready → print button availability status = Button Enabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Precondition message disappears once blocking condition is resolved
verificationPatterns.example: press state = ready → Precondition not appear

verificationPatterns.pattern: Intermediate transitional state (get ready) still blocks the action
verificationPatterns.example: press state = get ready → print button availability status = Button disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Algorithm phase sequencing
verificationPatterns.example: Verify each sub-step of Phase 1 (Vlight) and Phase 2 (transfer function) executes in declared order before checking outcome

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration pass status + UI message
verificationPatterns.example: Calibration status = pass; Press message = 'calibration pass successfully'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard closure after finish action
verificationPatterns.example: Press finish button → Auto bias wizard is closed

verificationPatterns.pattern: DB persistence of calibration output
verificationPatterns.example: Auto bias calibration values were saved to DB

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event emission with named parameter set
verificationPatterns.example: Event 'auto bias calibration pass successfully' appears with: Vlight, VBg, station name, intercept, slope, ASID age, residual

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-cycle averaging for measurement stability
verificationPatterns.example: Measure during at least 10 aSiD cycles before calculating average and STD

verificationPatterns.pattern: Configurable sweep values for linear-fit derivation
verificationPatterns.example: Operate charge roller at 4 predefined voltages (800, 900, 1000, 1100 V); values should be configurable; calculate linear fit of Vbg vs Vcr

verificationPatterns.pattern: Status blocked while invalid override active
verificationPatterns.example: verify AtEngage status doesn't change until override is not removed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout event fires when precondition not satisfiable
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Timeout event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Status unblocks once override removed
verificationPatterns.example: AtEngage / AtDisEngage status must not change until override is not removed (implicit: does change after removal)

verificationPatterns.pattern: EMS press triggers disengage
verificationPatterns.example: Press EMS while T1 at engage → Verify T1 disengage

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor override to induce failure, verify named error
verificationPatterns.example: Override T1 service sensor to cause failure → verify Blanket_service_position_error

verificationPatterns.pattern: Completion logging verification
verificationPatterns.example: MI completion + log expected after T1 disengage

verificationPatterns.pattern: Command completion + status change + log check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify CMD finish, status changed according + log.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Piston state assertion after each command
verificationPatterns.example: main piston On, secondary piston Off (post-Engage); main piston On, secondary piston On (post-Disengage); both pistons Off (post-Off CMD)

verificationPatterns.pattern: State progression: MI → Engage → Disengage → Off
verificationPatterns.example: Sequential commands each verified independently before advancing

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press/CVC transitions to OFF on limit violation
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press/CVC state changed to OFF (AtOFF signal = TRUE)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Output values match expected sheet after fault
verificationPatterns.example: Verify outputs values are according to the excel sheet

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary value (exactly at limit) triggers panic event, not valid-range event
verificationPatterns.example: Change the value to be exactly valid low/valid high limit — verify panic low/high error event raised

verificationPatterns.pattern: Info events do NOT change press state or outputs
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press/CVC state didn't changed. Verify outputs values didn't changed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary value coverage — test one value below valid range and one above
verificationPatterns.example: 140000 (too low) and 310000 (too high) as engage positions

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure event verification — confirm calibration emits correct failure event, not silent fail
verificationPatterns.example: Calibration failed with correct event

verificationPatterns.pattern: State restoration — confirm motor returns to previous engage position after failed calibration
verificationPatterns.example: LPH motor back to previous engage position

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault injection via out-of-range sensor value (low boundary)
verificationPatterns.example: During Focus calibration overwrite sensor value to 1000

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault injection via out-of-range sensor value (high boundary)
verificationPatterns.example: During Focus calibration overwrite sensor value to 32000

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault injection via physical sensor disconnection mid-operation
verificationPatterns.example: During Focus calibration try to disconnect sensor

verificationPatterns.pattern: On any sensor fault: verify calibration failure event raised
verificationPatterns.example: Calibration failed with correct event

verificationPatterns.pattern: On any sensor fault: verify LPH position recovery to pre-calibration state
verificationPatterns.example: LPH back to previous engage position

verificationPatterns.pattern: Physical printout inspection
verificationPatterns.example: Check on the printout that the Focus is in the center of the job.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Subset station execution check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that only defined stations performing calibration procedure.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Synchronization timing check between two subsystems
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Trigger from ELC and LPH movement start in same time

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-source engage value check: read motor engage position from both DB and OPC UA and confirm they match
verificationPatterns.example: verify two motors engage value (DB, OPC UA) — engage position changed according to db value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-print-job focus position check: start a print job from DFE and confirm all station motor positions match last calibration values
verificationPatterns.example: verify motor positions of all stations are in the correct focus position (according to last calibration)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Engage position updates after calibration input
verificationPatterns.example: After choosing best value and putting it to UI — verify engage position changed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Engage position and sensor value are invariant across ASID angles
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat test with focus calibration started on different ASID angles (use trace) — engage position and sensor value should be ~same

verificationPatterns.pattern: Best-focus output value depends on calibration set start position, but engage position and sensor value do not
verificationPatterns.example: Change default calibration set position, run calibration, choose best value — best value should differ from previous test, but engage position and sensor value should be ~same

verificationPatterns.pattern: Phase-gated procedure verification
verificationPatterns.example: In preprint: verify correct sensor position before starting learning runout procedure; after learning: verify sensor position, amplitude, and duty cycle for calibration procedure; in post-print: verify LPH motors return to previous engage position.

verificationPatterns.pattern: State verification via traces and logs
verificationPatterns.example: All states check with traces and logs.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor position correctness check with fallback hierarchy
verificationPatterns.example: Verify correct (or default or previous calibration) sensor position.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal value range/correctness check post-procedure
verificationPatterns.example: Verify correct amplitude and correct duty cycle after calibration procedure starts.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Motor position restore check
verificationPatterns.example: In post print LPH motors back to previous engage position.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify multi-station operation via trace and log
verificationPatterns.example: Verify learning started on all stations. Check it via trace and log.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify calibration output artifact counts
verificationPatterns.example: Verify correct number of samples, polynomes and luts.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify stability across repeated runs by comparing output values
verificationPatterns.example: Value of polynome should be near to previous value.

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC parameter propagation check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify PLC get new params and calibration doing according new value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration execution with updated params
verificationPatterns.example: Verify calibration doing according new value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Observe learning procedure activation during print
verificationPatterns.example: Verify during print LPH start learning procedure and then changing position according to default or last calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Validate visible focus variation on printout
verificationPatterns.example: Verify different focus on print out job

verificationPatterns.pattern: Set best per-station value via UI then reprint to confirm quality
verificationPatterns.example: On print out job choose best value for each station and put it to UI. Print again the job. Verify correct (good) focus on print out job.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Motor limit boundary triggers event error
verificationPatterns.example: Event error if during calibration motors reach to min/max cam not linear engage position

verificationPatterns.pattern: Out-of-threshold info event with diagnostic payload
verificationPatterns.example: Info event if during print sensor value is not in threshold window. Info event should include sensor value, threshold value and motors position

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tracking active: sensor value stable, engage position varies per runout
verificationPatterns.example: Verify sensor value should be ~ same. But engage position should be different.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tracking bypassed: engage position fixed, sensor value drifts
verificationPatterns.example: Engage position should be same. Sensor value should be different.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print quality check after disabling tracking
verificationPatterns.example: Verify focus on printout is the same or worse than before.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pre-calibration state check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify sensor position before calibration started (default or focus calibrated)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Off-nominal engage triggers calibration window overrun and failure event
verificationPatterns.example: Change nominal engage position to not nominal → sensor should reach over calibration window → calibration failed with correct event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Min-distance-to-ASID triggers calibration fault stop
verificationPatterns.example: Stop calibration with fault when sensor reaches min distance to ASID

verificationPatterns.pattern: Nominal engage on GR start
verificationPatterns.example: Start GR → LPH goes to nominal engage position (default/calibrated sensor value)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Disengage on GR stop
verificationPatterns.example: Stop GR → LPH returns to disengage position

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition triggers disengage
verificationPatterns.example: Transition from Ready to SB → LPH moves from engage to disengage

verificationPatterns.pattern: All-motor sensor override via DB/OPC UA
verificationPatterns.example: In SB and above, change engage sensor value for two motors via DB/OPC UA → both motors' engage positions change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Single-motor sensor override isolation
verificationPatterns.example: Change engage sensor value for one motor only → only that motor's engage position changes; other motor unaffected

verificationPatterns.pattern: Re-engage to overridden position after disengage cycle
verificationPatterns.example: Perform disengage/engage or Off/MI-engage → motors engage to new overridden position

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibrated position restoration on print start
verificationPatterns.example: Change engage motor position before print, start normal print → motor returns to calibrated sensor position

verificationPatterns.pattern: Homing procedure via home sensor → move to disengage position
verificationPatterns.example: LPH engage motors start homing procedure. Find home by home sensor and go to disengage position.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Full calibration when all sensors active → disengage → state SB
verificationPatterns.example: Run sensor calibration procedure. After calibration done LPH going to disengage position and LPH state change to SB.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Skip calibration when no sensors active → state SB
verificationPatterns.example: After homing procedure LPH change state to SB wo calibration procedure and going to disengage position.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Partial calibration on only active sensors when mixed sensor state
verificationPatterns.example: Run sensor calibration procedure only on active sensors. After calibration done LPH going to disengage position and LPH state change to SB.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault during homing → verify correct event raised
verificationPatterns.example: Cause to fault on home during MI. Verify correct event.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter default value check
verificationPatterns.example: CsEngagePressureSampTime = 50, CsEngagePressureSampNum = 5, CsEngageMinPressure = 200, CsEngageMaxPressure = 900, CsEngagePressureSetpoint = 700, CsDisengagePressure = 50, CsEngageDuration = 50, CsDisengageDuration = 50, CsEngageSensorsOverlap = 100

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout-triggered disengage failure event
verificationPatterns.example: After CsDisengageDuration time, event raised about CS_DISENGAGE_FAILURE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Illegal sensor overlap event after timeout
verificationPatterns.example: After CsEngageSensorsOverlap time, event raised about CS_ENGAGE_SENSORS_ILLEGAL_STATE

verificationPatterns.pattern: CS status falls back to AtOFF on any failure
verificationPatterns.example: CS status changed to At OFF (all three failure steps)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Station-scoped event assertion — confirm event originates from the specific station under test
verificationPatterns.example: Verify event CS_NOT_IN_PLACE raised from correct station

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC state regression check — any safety fault must drop PLC to OFF regardless of entry state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify PLC fell to OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-state coverage — run identical fault injection across all valid PLC entry states (OFF, Standby, GR, Ready, Print)
verificationPatterns.example: Be in OFF state ... test it for all stations; Be in Standby/GR/Ready/Print state ... test it for all stations

verificationPatterns.pattern: IO override as hardware substitute — use UAExpert tool to force IO to 0 when physical removal is impractical
verificationPatterns.example: take out the CS (or override IO from UAExpert tool to 0)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Physical cable disconnect triggers event
verificationPatterns.example: Unplug motor encoder cable → verify event appeared

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify active printing by confirming press is in printing operation
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press is printing

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify blanket stops at parking position after end-print command
verificationPatterns.example: Verify At the end of print Blanket Stops on parking position (AtParking = True)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify fault event raised on bad sensor signal
verificationPatterns.example: Verify event raised - BLANKET_MISS_INDEX

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify PLC state regression to Ready on fault condition
verificationPatterns.example: Verify PLC fell to Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simulate bad sensor reading by toggling index sensor True/False constantly
verificationPatterns.example: simulate bad blanket index reading by setting the index sensor to True/False constantly

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timed stop response verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify ITM stopped within 2.3 seconds.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Invalid pulse count triggers miss-index event
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate 1/2 pulses of index reading → Verify event BLANKET_MISS_INDEX

verificationPatterns.pattern: Invalid pulse triggers PLC state transition to Ready
verificationPatterns.example: Verify PLC changed to Ready state after BLANKET_MISS_INDEX

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket parks after invalid index
verificationPatterns.example: Verify blanket AtParking signal is true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Relative position resets after parking completes
verificationPatterns.example: Verify blanket relative position is 0 after AtParking = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pulse width below setpoint triggers miss-index
verificationPatterns.example: 3 pulses each with width = setpoint width - 5 → BLANKET_MISS_INDEX

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pulse width above setpoint triggers miss-index
verificationPatterns.example: 3 pulses each with width = setpoint width + 5 → BLANKET_MISS_INDEX

verificationPatterns.pattern: Single wide pulse (count=1, width=N expected pulses) triggers miss-index
verificationPatterns.example: 1 pulse with width of 3 pulses → BLANKET_MISS_INDEX

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mixed invalid pulse widths trigger miss-index
verificationPatterns.example: 2 pulses: first width=1 pulse, second width=2 pulses → BLANKET_MISS_INDEX

verificationPatterns.pattern: Index sensor noise is filtered — no spurious event
verificationPatterns.example: Randomly toggle index sensor false/true → noise filtered, no event fired

verificationPatterns.pattern: Temperature stability across separations
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the Blanket temperature is not jump between separations.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Feature bypass verification
verificationPatterns.example: Bypass — Verify feature bypass works correct

verificationPatterns.pattern: Table-driven set point verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the blanket temperature set points change according to the external table

verificationPatterns.pattern: Real temperature tracks set point per external table
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the real blanket temperature changes according to the external table

verificationPatterns.pattern: Set point follows external table per sensor
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the blanket temperature set point changes according to the external table for each IR blanket sensor

verificationPatterns.pattern: Actual temperature reaches new set point
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the Blanket temperature is according to new set point

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary torque value — verify log and event
verificationPatterns.example: Test MIN Torque during Calibration → Verify Log & Event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Override ASID torque at non-process speed and observe calibration behavior
verificationPatterns.example: Run calibration and override asid torque not at process speed (during GR)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Concurrent resource contention — first requester runs, second waits for completion
verificationPatterns.example: Two BIDs need pos optimization; first BID that reaches state starts, second BID waits for its completion

verificationPatterns.pattern: Negative-path calibration gate: confirm calibration run is blocked when precondition not met, verify via Event & Log
verificationPatterns.example: try to run Mechanical Calib while BID is installed → Should fail to run the calibration → verify Event & Log

verificationPatterns.pattern: MIN boundary torque check during Mech Calibration: trigger minimum torque condition, confirm expected Log & Event emitted
verificationPatterns.example: Test MIN Torque during Mech Calibration → Verify Log & Event

verificationPatterns.pattern: MAX boundary torque check during Mech Calibration: trigger maximum torque condition, confirm expected Log & Event emitted
verificationPatterns.example: Test Max Torque during Mech Calibration → Verify Log & Event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Precondition stabilization gate: verify ink flow to BID is stable before calibration sequence begins
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Ink flow to BID is stabilized before starting the calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Override/fault injection during active phase: run semi-engage calibration and inject asid torque override while not at process speed (during GR), observe system response
verificationPatterns.example: Run Semi engage calibration and override asid torque not at process speed (during GR)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure report propagation to BID manager and logs
verificationPatterns.example: Verify failure report to BID manager+Logs

verificationPatterns.pattern: System state fallback on motor failure
verificationPatterns.example: press and BID manager fall to OFF (might be changed)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat fault injection across each engagement state
verificationPatterns.example: Cause motor failure (acceleration to high) after Semiengage CMD / Engage CMD / Disengage CMD

verificationPatterns.pattern: Expected-failure check: attempt an operation that should be blocked, then verify via Event and Log
verificationPatterns.example: Try to run Mechanical Calib while BID is installed — Expected: Should fail to run the calibration; verify Event & Log

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary value (MIN) test: exercise minimum limit of a parameter, verify via Log and Event
verificationPatterns.example: Test MIN Torque during Mech Calibration — Verify Log & Event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary value (MAX) test: exercise maximum limit of a parameter, verify via Log and Event
verificationPatterns.example: Test Max Torque during Mech Calibration — Verify Log & Event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Table values match spec document
verificationPatterns.example: Verify table values according to the SFR (TBD)

verificationPatterns.pattern: HV inhibit on prerequisite-not-met event
verificationPatterns.example: Run ASID&CR charging CMD while ASID not at speed → verify HV doesn't turn on; expect event CRG_ASID_NOT_IN_FULL_SPEED in log

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor override to simulate disengage → HV sequence abort
verificationPatterns.example: Override CR DisEngage IoSensor to '1' → verify HV sequence doesn't continue

verificationPatterns.pattern: Out-of-range input halts sequence (TBD coverage)
verificationPatterns.example: Set electrometer reading above valid range → expected result TBD / may belong to separate feature test

verificationPatterns.pattern: All actuators off after stop command
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all RDU action stopped, pump are off, valves off, etc.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault injection per state: induce motor failure in each drive state and verify reporting
verificationPatterns.example: Cause motor failure (acceleration to high) → Verify failure report to BID manager+Logs

verificationPatterns.pattern: System fallback check: verify press and BID manager transition to OFF on motor failure
verificationPatterns.example: press and BID manager fall to OFF (might be changed)

verificationPatterns.pattern: State coverage: repeat fault injection across Semiengage, Engage, and Disengage states
verificationPatterns.example: Step 1: send Semiengage CMD ... Step 2: from semi engage send engage CMD ... Step 3: Send Disengage CMD

verificationPatterns.pattern: Availability table check
verificationPatterns.example: Check availability table

verificationPatterns.pattern: Broadcast command propagation — verify all subsystems receive command issued from PLC manager
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all subsystem get GR command from PLC manager

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition verification — verify all subsystems change to expected state after command
verificationPatterns.example: all subsystem... changed state to SB

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify all subsystem AtMI status after MI command
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all subsystem AtMI status = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify all subsystems reach standby after MI completes
verificationPatterns.example: Verify after MI done, all subsystems status AtStandby=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify station-level state after GR command
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Station status is AtGetReady.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify station-level state after Print command
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Station status is AtPrint.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Off state: all components off
verificationPatterns.example: Off → Expected: All components at off

verificationPatterns.pattern: MI state: ink tube primed
verificationPatterns.example: MI → Expected: Prime ink tube

verificationPatterns.pattern: Standby state: controls off, optional operations available
verificationPatterns.example: STNDBY → All controls are off; Ink build can be activated; Ink flow calibration can be activated; Color change is available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Transition to Off: verify full shutdown
verificationPatterns.example: Go to Off → Expected: All is Off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service state: EA operations available for specific hardware
verificationPatterns.example: Service → EA is available (revolver, extractor, RDU pump, ink tank pump)

verificationPatterns.pattern: End Service: conditional transition based on EA completion, MI done, and enable flags
verificationPatterns.example: End Service → If EA not done and MI already done and enables OK → go standby; otherwise → go to off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Get Ready state: ink preparation executes
verificationPatterns.example: Get Ready → Expected: Ink preparation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ready state: ink at set-point, tube primed, rebuild available
verificationPatterns.example: Ready → Ink prepared and kept at set-point; Ink tube is kept primed; Ink rebuild is available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Go to Standby: stop parameter control but maintain tube prime
verificationPatterns.example: Go to Standby → Stop ink parameters control; Keep ink tube primed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ordered sequence verification — assert each step completes before next begins
verificationPatterns.example: Activate CS drive → Open IMO line valve → wait flow stabilization time → verify ImoFlow>MinFlowForTempControl → Engage CS & Activate ImoTempControl

verificationPatterns.pattern: Flow threshold gate — verify measured flow exceeds minimum threshold before proceeding
verificationPatterns.example: verify ImoFlow>MinFlowForTempControl

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition only after full sequence — assert new state not entered prematurely
verificationPatterns.example: Verify only when sequence finished - state changed to AtFreeWetting

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence conformance check against SW requirements
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Mechinit sequence is according to SW requirements

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence verification — check state transitions in order
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Sequence: Disengage-engage-disengage. IOSensor should be On-off-on

verificationPatterns.pattern: Piston position reached + status propagated to manager
verificationPatterns.example: Verify PISTON reached position and status sent to manager

verificationPatterns.pattern: LED indicator matches mechanical state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify At Engage LED on / Verify At DisEngage LED on

verificationPatterns.pattern: Phase-transition on temperature window entry
verificationPatterns.example: Verify GR finish (Blanket heating status change) when Blanket temp reach Set point±working range

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pre-Print completion gated on temperature window
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Pre-print finish when Blanket temp reach Set point±working range (Enter low and high)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Active-phase status within working window
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Print is under status at working window

verificationPatterns.pattern: Hardware disconnection raises COMM_FAILURE event + log tagged with component index
verificationPatterns.example: Disconnect Melexis sensor → verify BLANKET_IR_MLX_COMM_FAILURE event + log with specific sensor number

verificationPatterns.pattern: Injecting an out-of-range/frozen value raises a FREEZE event + log tagged with component index
verificationPatterns.example: Set Melexis value to specific value → Verify BLANKET_IR_MLX_FREEZE event + log with specific sensor number

verificationPatterns.pattern: Disconnecting a dimmer raises COMM_FAILURE event + log tagged with dimmer index
verificationPatterns.example: Disconnect dimmer → Verify BLANKET_DIMMER_COMM_FAILURE event + log with specific dimmer number

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event assertion on CS removal
verificationPatterns.example: Verify event - CS_NOT_IN_PLACE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state drop on safety input loss
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press fell to OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat verification across multiple active press states
verificationPatterns.example: During Ready/Standby/GR (wetting/free wetting), override CS in place IO and change it to false — same two verifications apply

verificationPatterns.pattern: No CSC events during active print
verificationPatterns.example: Verify no events about CSC during print.

verificationPatterns.pattern: CSC calibration restarts successfully after stop/restart cycle
verificationPatterns.example: Stop print and start again with same job. Verify CSC calibration start works again.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Elasticsearch contains correct data after new run
verificationPatterns.example: Verify In ES we correct have data about new run.

verificationPatterns.pattern: CSC calibration recovers after simulated PLC failure
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate PLC failure during print. Start print again. Verify CSC calibration start works.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press returns to Ready state after PLC failure
verificationPatterns.example: Press stopped print and back to Ready.

verificationPatterns.pattern: ISF and RLSF function correctly after PLC failure recovery
verificationPatterns.example: Verify no events about CSC during print. ISF and RLSF works correct.

verificationPatterns.pattern: CSC calibration failure event surfaces in UI on PQ issue
verificationPatterns.example: Event about CSC calibration failure appears in UI.

verificationPatterns.pattern: CSC calibration self-recovers after PQ issue is fixed
verificationPatterns.example: Fix PQ issue. Verify CSC calibration back to works correct.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Elasticsearch contains correct data after PQ failure and recovery
verificationPatterns.example: Verify data in ES.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold-crossing triggers warning after timed delay with pump ON
verificationPatterns.example: After 3 seconds when pump is ON, warning appears in UI monitor and mechanical filters turn Orange

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event fires once per machine state — no duplicate on re-entry to same threshold
verificationPatterns.example: PRESSURE_TOO_HIGH does not appear since it already appeared in the same machine state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Warning clears when value returns within operational range
verificationPatterns.example: FilterPumpPressure: 1000 — no warning in UI monitor since filter pump pressure is within range

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat test across multiple machine states (dynamic ready, print) to verify state-scoped event reset
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat test in dynamic ready and print states — all steps appear as expected

verificationPatterns.pattern: Trigger calibration failure and verify named panic event appears
verificationPatterns.example: Select ambient mode and make failure -> PRESSURE_SENSOR_CALIBRATION_PANIC_HIGH; verify event PRESSURE_SENSOR_CALIBRATION_PANIC_HIGH appears

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify event Description field matches expected failure reason
verificationPatterns.example: PRESSURE_SENSOR_CALIBRATION_PANIC_HIGH Description: 'C0 coefficient is out of limit high'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify event 'What to DO' remediation text
verificationPatterns.example: Verify pressure sensor is free to ambient air. Verify sensor wiring is not damaged. Run calibration again

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify event 'Suspected cause' field
verificationPatterns.example: Sensor malfunction or User mishandling

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify event exposes correct parameter set
verificationPatterns.example: Event Parameters: SensorID, C0Value, LimitValue

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat failure injection for symmetric low-limit case
verificationPatterns.example: Select ambient mode and make failure -> PRESSURE_SENSOR_CALIBRATION_PANIC_LOW; verify mirror event with 'C0 coefficient is out of limit low'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter advancement after job
verificationPatterns.example: Counters advanced and saved after job printed successfully

verificationPatterns.pattern: Data integrity across SW+PLC restart
verificationPatterns.example: Counters values have not changed after restart — verify in Supplies counters dialogue

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI deactivation action sets corresponding BypassValue signal to True
verificationPatterns.example: Click ink station > Deactivate revolver → IBL:BypassEntity > RevolverActive > BypassValue = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI deactivation of a station type sets its BidStationActive bypass signal to True
verificationPatterns.example: Click ink station > Deactivate Ink Station → IBL:BypassEntity > BidStationActive > BypassValue = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI deactivation of a marking engine sets its MeStationActive bypass signal to True
verificationPatterns.example: Click ME station > Deactivate Marking Engine → IBL:BypassEntity > MeStationActive > BypassValue = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Exceeding maximum allowed component deactivations triggers a system event
verificationPatterns.example: Attempt to deactivate more than one ME station → event shown indicating maximum marking engines already deactivated

verificationPatterns.pattern: Filter effectiveness: HW spikes must not propagate to filtered output
verificationPatterns.example: High gradients appear on HW sensor reading, they do not appear on filtered diameter value

verificationPatterns.pattern: No spurious sensor fault events during normal operation
verificationPatterns.example: ULTRASONIC_SNS_UNSTABLE and ULTRASONIC_SNS_INVALID events do not appear without apparent reason

verificationPatterns.pattern: Control algorithm stability under large-roll load (no tension/web failures)
verificationPatterns.example: No issues related to control algorithm are observed, for example tension build failures, web breaks

verificationPatterns.pattern: Small incremental web movement (scan steps) stable at maximum roll diameter
verificationPatterns.example: No issues during small web movements for scanning

verificationPatterns.pattern: Splice detection correct at maximum roll size with speed change
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that splice is detected, and print skips over splice correctly

verificationPatterns.pattern: Roll-limit event issued to ES with actual diameter and configured limit
verificationPatterns.example: UW empty event is issued to ES with actual diameter, and limit. / RW full event is issued to ES with actual diameter, and limit.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state transitions to Ready on roll-limit condition
verificationPatterns.example: Press state changed to Ready.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Zone lock state toggle via UI
verificationPatterns.example: Unlock/lock each zone through doors and covers UI screen; verify zone reflects unlocked/locked state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Door interlock fault during print triggers named error and power disable
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate door interlock opened during print; verify correct error appears with correct door name; verify press fell to Power Disabled state

verificationPatterns.pattern: EMS button activation during print triggers identified error and power disable
verificationPatterns.example: Push EMS button during print; verify correct error event appears with correct EMS button ID; verify press reached Power Disabled state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor error message includes actual value and limit
verificationPatterns.example: Verify error appears about IMO flow sensor with correct actual value, and limit.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press transitions to expected degraded state after panic threshold breach
verificationPatterns.example: Step 1 → Ready state; Step 2 → standby state; Steps 3 & 4 → OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor fault error message includes sensor name, actual value, and configured limit
verificationPatterns.example: Verify error appeared about CWS flow sensor with actual sensor value and limit

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press transitions to OFF state on any panic-level CWS fault
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Press fell to OFF state in all cases

verificationPatterns.pattern: Both panic-low and panic-high thresholds are exercised for each sensor
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate panic low/high CWS flow during print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Search returns relevant results
verificationPatterns.example: Go to main menu, type calibration name in search — verify relevant search results appear

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-window bottom bar integrity
verificationPatterns.example: Open 5 windows simultaneously, minimize all — verify all windows appear in bottom bar

verificationPatterns.pattern: Long-click reveals context toolbar
verificationPatterns.example: Go to print queue, long-click a job — verify toolbar appears with job options

verificationPatterns.pattern: Screen opens non-empty
verificationPatterns.example: Open all UI screens including wizards — verify each opens properly and is not empty

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event file correctness
verificationPatterns.example: Verify event file saved events correctly.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log folder completeness for time range
verificationPatterns.example: Verify logs folder contains logs of PLC/APP for the relevant time.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Readme metadata accuracy
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the Readme file is correct with correct PC name/SN of press.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Screenshot capture
verificationPatterns.example: Verify screen shots taken correctly.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dump file presence in output folder
verificationPatterns.example: Verify dump file are in logs folder.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pre-print duration check (steady state)
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Pre print time is ~55 Sec for the second print (without web feed)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-print duration check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Post print time is ~16 Sec

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pre-print duration check for CC job
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Pre print time is ~55 Sec (after Start print - CC)

verificationPatterns.pattern: First-print web feed exclusion — warm-up cycle before measuring
verificationPatterns.example: first time of printing from OFF state a web feed should be done during pre print — measure on second print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Positive gap value produces exact physical gap on print
verificationPatterns.example: Set gap to +10 mm → print → verify visible gap of exactly 10 mm in job output

verificationPatterns.pattern: Negative gap value produces overlap on print
verificationPatterns.example: Set gap to -10 mm → print → verify visible overlap of exactly 10 mm in job output

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stop-print-reopen cycle before changing repeat length parameter
verificationPatterns.example: Stop printing → reopen job properties → change gap value → reprint

verificationPatterns.pattern: Offset applied after image moved up
verificationPatterns.example: verify that the job was printed with a new offset according to what was entered in job properties

verificationPatterns.pattern: Offset applied after image moved down with no continuous-marks regression
verificationPatterns.example: verify job was printed with a new offset and that all continues marks were not affected by this movement

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button active in OFF/no-tension state
verificationPatterns.example: Press RW clamp buttons → Clamps are activated by matching HW button

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button disabled when web tension present
verificationPatterns.example: When there is web tension in the press buttons are disabled (clamps are not activated when buttons pressed)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Auto-open clamps before tension build attempt
verificationPatterns.example: Clamps are automatically opened before tension build attempt

verificationPatterns.pattern: Nearest clamp auto-closes on tension release (single shaft RW behavior)
verificationPatterns.example: Clamp closest to NSR is closed automatically, as in single shaft RW

verificationPatterns.pattern: Auto-closed clamp reopens when tension restored
verificationPatterns.example: Clamp that was closed automatically opens when tension is restored

verificationPatterns.pattern: HW button activation still works after tension release
verificationPatterns.example: Clamps are activated by matching HW button

verificationPatterns.pattern: NSR roll replacement wizard triggers same auto-clamp behavior
verificationPatterns.example: Run NSR roll replacement wizard → Clamp closest to NSR is closed automatically, as in single shaft RW

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard default state check
verificationPatterns.example: Auto calibration Mode is selected by default

verificationPatterns.pattern: Action button enabled before triggering operation
verificationPatterns.example: Verify 'Play' Button enabled and run the calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Special job printed with exact sheet count and named calibration steps
verificationPatterns.example: press shall print a special job which includes 6 sheets (one sheet per calibration): Offset, 300dpi led, 200dpi led, 600 dpi led, 600dpi uniformity, alignment calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Speed verification per calibration step
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Speed at each step

verificationPatterns.pattern: All sub-calibrations succeeded check before accepting result
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that successful calibration achieved only if all calibrations succeeded

verificationPatterns.pattern: Completion button enabled and dialog dismissed
verificationPatterns.example: Verify 'OK' button is enabled and click it. Verify that window has closed.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Result persistence verified in both file system and PEX entity
verificationPatterns.example: results for each calibration are saved in s:\Press\bin\iVision\Saved and in the PEX Press.IBL.Calibrations.ConcreteCalibrations.IlsSelf.IlsSelfCalibrationResultsEntity

verificationPatterns.pattern: Uniformity-only option gated on existing calibration data
verificationPatterns.example: ILS Calibration correction data is blank → option to run Uniformity step only is unavailable; wizard must run all steps. When full calibration data exists → option is available.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Width change forces full re-calibration
verificationPatterns.example: Substrate width changes from stored calibration width (300→340 mm) → Uniformity-only option unavailable; after Save, ILS Uniformity correction data saved with new width value.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Same width as stored calibration allows partial run
verificationPatterns.example: Substrate width matches stored calibration (330 mm, data exists) → Uniformity-only option is available.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Transparent substrate triggers White background print
verificationPatterns.example: Transparent substrate installed, White ink available in last station → calibration prints with White background.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-save PEX signal verification
verificationPatterns.example: After Save, verify ILS Uniformity correction data written to Press.IBL.Calibrations.ConcreteCalibrations.IlsSelf.IlsSelfCalibrationResultsEntity.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Progress indicator during long operation
verificationPatterns.example: Verify during the calibration, a progress bar shall be displayed.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mid-operation cancel leaves UI error-free and retry available
verificationPatterns.example: Stop (cancel) wizard after first iteration. Verify the wizard stopped without error in UI. Retry (play button) should be enabled.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pre-completion cancel leaves UI error-free and retry available
verificationPatterns.example: Stop wizard before last iteration. Verify the wizard stopped without error in UI. Retry (play button) should be enabled.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cancel after completion triggers confirmation popup with correct text
verificationPatterns.example: Run calibration and wait for finish. Click Cancel button. Appears new popup window with correct text.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dismissing confirmation popup returns to previous screen
verificationPatterns.example: Click Cancel button in popup window (cancel close wizard). Wizard back to Calibration window.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Confirming close restores prior state
verificationPatterns.example: Click OK button in popup window. Wizard should be close. Previous results will be recovered.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Backup-on-start: old calibration files move to backup folder before new run begins
verificationPatterns.example: Verify old save parameters is moving in: s:\ILS_saved_images\Scanner_Calibration_Files_Backup

verificationPatterns.pattern: Incremental persistence: new results appear in Saved folder after each iteration during live calibration
verificationPatterns.example: Verify during calibration new results appears after itch calibration state in folder s:\Press\bin\iVision\Saved

verificationPatterns.pattern: Partial-run retention: completed iterations remain in Saved after mid-run stop
verificationPatterns.example: Stop calibration while 5 iteration — Verify the results for four iterations continue to be in: s:\Press\bin\iVision\Saved

verificationPatterns.pattern: Re-run isolation: backup folder unchanged when new calibration starts over existing partial results
verificationPatterns.example: Old Saved data continue to be in: s:\ILS_saved_images\Scanner_Calibration_Files_Backup Verify calibration.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault parity: fault mid-calibration produces same backup/partial-retention behavior as clean stop
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat steps 1-3 but cause to fault in step 2. Same results.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cancel-triggers-rollback: closing wizard via Cancel+OK restores previous Saved folder contents
verificationPatterns.example: Rollback should be done, and previous results will be recovered. Verify correct files in s:\Press\bin\iVision\Saved

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard available under valid baseline conditions
verificationPatterns.example: ILS installed and not bypassed, white coated or white uncoated substrate installed → Wizard available.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard unavailable with unsupported substrate type — check tooltip/reason
verificationPatterns.example: Non-white substrate installed → Wizard not available. Reason: 'Non-White substrate not supported.'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard unavailable when transparent substrate lacks white ink as last ink
verificationPatterns.example: Transparent substrate installed, white ink not available or not last → Wizard not available. Reason: 'Calibration on Transparent substrate require white ink availability'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard available when transparent substrate + white ink available and last
verificationPatterns.example: Transparent substrate installed, white ink available and last → Wizard available.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard unavailable when white ink shares station with black ink
verificationPatterns.example: Transparent substrate, white ink available but in same station as black → Wizard not available. Correct Tool Tip shown.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard unavailable when press not in Ready state
verificationPatterns.example: Press not in Ready state → Wizard not available.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard unavailable when substrate width below minimum threshold
verificationPatterns.example: Substrate width < 300 mm → Wizard not available.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard unavailable when substrate length below minimum required
verificationPatterns.example: Minimum substrate length not met → Wizard not available.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard unavailable when ILS is disconnected or powered off
verificationPatterns.example: ILS disconnected → Wizard not available. ILS powered off → Wizard not available.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inject press error mid-calibration, verify calibration aborts with correct failure message
verificationPatterns.example: Cause different press error during calibration → Verify calibration stopped with correct failure message

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inject iVision subsystem error, verify calibration aborts with correct failure message
verificationPatterns.example: Cause scanner communication failure / health check failure / start-of-scan signal error → Verify calibration stopped with correct failure message

verificationPatterns.pattern: Compare ES statistics for commit vs no-commit calibration runs
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in ES statistics with commit, and statistics without commit.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass entity gate check — confirm a feature flag is inactive before test proceeds
verificationPatterns.example: PEX.BypassEntity row for MultiSplice has BypassValue = false

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal state assertion after physical setup
verificationPatterns.example: BL:JumpOverSpliceEntity.SpliceSensorCalibrationRequired = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: End-of-job success assertion
verificationPatterns.example: Job successfully printed to end (at least 50 meters)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Elastic report counter validation — verify exact event counts after job
verificationPatterns.example: In last SpliceDetection report: splice counter = 1; multiple splice skipped = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Single-pass job completion check
verificationPatterns.example: Whole job is printed without moving to Ready (one pass)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Selective jump-over-splice: only first splice triggers skip, remaining splices are printed through
verificationPatterns.example: Jump over splice performed only for the first tape strip, printing exists on second and third

verificationPatterns.pattern: Elastic SpliceDetection report counters validation
verificationPatterns.example: In the last splice detection report: splice counter = 1; multiple splice skipped = 2

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass signal must be false before test starts
verificationPatterns.example: BypassValue = false in PEX.BypassEntity MultiSplice row

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration-not-required signal confirms splice teach skipped
verificationPatterns.example: BL:JumpOverSpliceEntity.SpliceSensorCalibrationRequired = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Prime counter confirms expected Pre-Print web feed distance
verificationPatterns.example: FP_PrimeCounter ~= 14 meters

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pre-Print phase performs expected web feed length before job
verificationPatterns.example: During Pre-Print web feed of 14 meters is performed

verificationPatterns.pattern: No false splice detection event logged in Elastic during run
verificationPatterns.example: No splice report was sent (verified in SpliceDetection report in Elastic)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass state check before test
verificationPatterns.example: Find MultiSplice in PEX.BypassEntity; if BypassValue = true, set it to false via IBL.BypassCommand before running the scenario.

verificationPatterns.pattern: SWF full-length completion check
verificationPatterns.example: Perform SWF for approx. 50 meters; expected: SWF finished successfully for all the length, without stopping.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Elastic report absence check
verificationPatterns.example: Check SpliceDetection report in Elastic after SWF; expected: no report should be sent.

verificationPatterns.pattern: SWF by length with splice position variants
verificationPatterns.example: First attempt: 15 m so splice stops between splice sensor and T2. Second attempt: 20 m so splice passes T2. Both SWF must complete for the full set length.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Recovery-to-print check after SWF by length
verificationPatterns.example: After length-based SWF, print a user job from that state; expected: user job printed successfully.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Splice detected halts active wizard with error
verificationPatterns.example: Printing stopped with WEB_SPLICE_DETECTED error; wizard marked as interrupted; Play button available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Re-run wizard recovers via pre-print web feed then completes successfully
verificationPatterns.example: Web feed for 14 meters performed in Pre-Print; wizard then printed successfully

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat coverage across all printing wizards
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat for other printing wizards, if necessary

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print button disabled with named unavailability code
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the print button is disabled (Phase 1) and there is NO AVAILABLE_JOBS_ unavailability on print button.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mismatch icon with exact title, press message key, and sub-toggle text
verificationPatterns.example: Verify icon of substrate mismatch appears with Title: 'SPM is not available', press message: 'Job__Spm__AvailabilityIssue', text under ignore toggle: 'Job will be printed without CCC.'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mismatch indication mirrored in job properties panel
verificationPatterns.example: Verify indication of mismatch shall also be given in job properties next to CCC checkbox property field.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ignore toggle visual state verification (off state)
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the ignore icon is NOT as ignore display before toggle is switched on.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ignore toggle ON clears availability issue and updates icon
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the Print availability issue does not exist; verify the ignore icon is as 'ignore display'.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ignore control disabled during active printing
verificationPatterns.example: Verify during printing the 'ignore mismatch control' is disabled.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ignore selection persists after job stop or partial print
verificationPatterns.example: The job does not remove the ignore selection after stop before fully printed.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ignore setting resets after defined end conditions
verificationPatterns.example: Ignore setting shall be reset after the conditions (all copies printed, manual removal, or DFE-Press disconnection).

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fixing root cause removes availability indication
verificationPatterns.example: Once the issue is fixed (CCC removed from job properties) the availability indication disappears and job can be printed.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tooltip content differs by mismatch type
verificationPatterns.example: Clicking each icon displays a tooltip with relevant error information specific to that mismatch

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ignore option availability is mismatch-type-conditional
verificationPatterns.example: Substrate mismatch tooltip includes an 'Ignore' option; ink mismatch tooltip does NOT include an 'Ignore' option

verificationPatterns.pattern: Side panel icon matches job management screen icon behavior
verificationPatterns.example: Availability icon in job properties side panel shows same tooltip as job management screen; clicking highlights the error area

verificationPatterns.pattern: Icon disappears after issue resolution and save
verificationPatterns.example: After resolving the substrate issue and clicking Save, the availability icon disappears and the job becomes available for printing

verificationPatterns.pattern: Top-of-queue availability issue shown in red
verificationPatterns.example: Availability issue is highlighted in red for the job at the top of the print queue list

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold comparison check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify calculated rotations compared against MaximumNumberOfRotations

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI reflects unavailability state
verificationPatterns.example: Job marked as unavailable in job management screen; icon displayed to user

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mismatch indication in properties tab
verificationPatterns.example: Indication of blanket rotations mismatch displayed in separations tab of job properties

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unavailability cleared after user correction
verificationPatterns.example: After modifying separations to reduce rotations below MaximumNumberOfRotations, JobExceededAllowedBlanketRotations is removed and job becomes available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unavailability flag triggered on resource mismatch
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that the JobNotAvailableScreenNotInstalled unavailability is triggered

verificationPatterns.pattern: Job marked unavailable in job management screen when unavailability active
verificationPatterns.example: The job is marked as unavailable in the job management screen

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mismatch icon visible in job management screen
verificationPatterns.example: Icon of screen mismatch is display

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unavailability cleared after user corrects resource property
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that the JobNotAvailableScreenNotInstalled unavailability is removed after selecting an installed screen and saving

verificationPatterns.pattern: Job becomes printable after unavailability removed
verificationPatterns.example: The job becomes available for printing

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mismatch indication shown inline next to the mismatched property field in job properties
verificationPatterns.example: A clear indication of the screen mismatch is displayed next to the screen property field in the job properties

verificationPatterns.pattern: Side panel mismatch entry navigates to property field indication
verificationPatterns.example: Click on side panel on screen mismatch — verify indication next to screen property field

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print button disabled on unavailability
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the print button is disabled (Phase 1) and there is NOAVAILABLE_JOBS_ unavailability on print button

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mismatch icon with exact caption and message
verificationPatterns.example: Title: 'Substrate Mismatch', press message: 'JobSubstrateNotInstalled', sub-text: 'Job will be printed on installed substrate.'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mismatch indication in job properties UI
verificationPatterns.example: Indication of mismatch shall also be given in job properties next to substrate property field

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ignore toggle visual state verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the ignore icon is NOT as ignore display (when off); verify ignore icon IS as ignore display (when on)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ignore toggle enables printing
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the Print availability issue does not exist after switching on ignore toggle

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ignore control disabled during active print
verificationPatterns.example: Verify during printing the 'ignore mismatch control' is disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ignore setting persistence and reset conditions
verificationPatterns.example: Job does not remove ignore selection on partial print; ignore setting shall be reset after specified conditions (full print, removal from press, DFE-Press disconnection, SW restart)

verificationPatterns.example: MeasuredVoltage = A*VoltageSetPoint+B; correction formula is VoltageSetPoint=(MeasuredVoltage-B)/A; electrometer is using the calibrated values

verificationPatterns.pattern: Feature availability on partial state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Option is selectable, not just visible

verificationPatterns.pattern: Edit properties permitted during proof

verificationPatterns.pattern: Gap enforcement between proofs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi Proof availability gated on job state

verificationPatterns.example: Update involved separation of 2nd job via DFE/Press to match first job → availability updates and Multi Proof becomes available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Report generated after proof completes contains accurate job details
verificationPatterns.example: After proof complete ensure that generate report. Verify the report contains accurate details for the job.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Billing calculated for single proof
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Billing for single job proof.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Billing and report calculated when CleanerBeforeProofDefined is set, for both single and multi proof
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in case 'CleanerBeforeProofDefined' the report and billing is calculated (On multi and single proof)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cleaner between BKT rotations triggers billing and report generation
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in case cleaner between BKT rotations insert billing calculated and report is generated.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Protected counters advance after proof, verified via Print Attempt report
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the below counters advanced. Verify thru the Print attempt report that protected counters advanced.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi proof triggers cleaners-between-cycle print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Report issued after print session

verificationPatterns.pattern: PrintType field matches proof mode
verificationPatterns.example: print attempt report contains field of PrintType with value "ProofNow" / "multi Proof"

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-job report for multi-job sessions
verificationPatterns.example: After print session completed of each job verify report is issued per job

verificationPatterns.pattern: Job-specific data accuracy in report

verificationPatterns.pattern: No duplicate or missing reports
verificationPatterns.example: Ensure no duplication or missing reports

verificationPatterns.pattern: Null data propagates to next report
verificationPatterns.example: Null data is transferred to the next report as expected without errors; verify null data is correctly attached to the next report that is going to be issued

verificationPatterns.pattern: Null data handling verified for multi-job scenario
verificationPatterns.example: Verify this steps for MultiJobs also

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press failure mirrors production printing failure path

verificationPatterns.pattern: Proof settings persist across SW upgrade and SW restart

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration resets to default behavior when bypass applied
verificationPatterns.example: Calibration should work as start from default.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Asid tables consistent regardless of which station is ref

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ref station auto-selected by greatest OD when configured ref is bypassed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Both asid and blanket tables computed correctly after bypass

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard completes without errors
