verificationPatterns.example: Perform tasks like edit job properties and click save.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Scrollbar grab in all three queues
verificationPatterns.example: Grab by finger the scrollbar in Print queue & Held Queue & Retained Queue.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Drag jobs between queues and verify
verificationPatterns.example: Drag jobs between queues by touch verify that all works as expected.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Short tap on monitor widget opens quick menu
verificationPatterns.example: Click short tap on Me stations monitor \ Web Monitor \ Ink Cabinet monitor ----> Verify quick menu opened as expected.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Long tap (mouse) on monitor widget opens quick menu
verificationPatterns.example: Click long tap on Me stations monitor \ Web Monitor \ Ink Cabinet monitor ----> Verify quick menu opened as expected.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Change job aggregation in print queue during active print
verificationPatterns.example: Change aggregation of job in print queue during print by touch.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat touch interaction verification on alternate monitor screens (PWS, PE)
verificationPatterns.example: Go to PWS Monitor screen / Go to PE Monitor screen — use the touchscreen to interact with the UI, verify quick menu opened as expected.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Action blocked — UI prevents move to Held Queue during proof
verificationPatterns.example: Attempt to move job to Held Queue during proof session; verify job cannot be moved and appropriate notification displayed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Action blocked — long-tap drag to Held Queue prevented during proof
verificationPatterns.example: Press long tap on job and try to drag to held queue; verify drag blocked

verificationPatterns.pattern: Action blocked — delete/remove via toolbar disabled during proof
verificationPatterns.example: Try to Remove job via toolbar during proof; verify no delete option and proper message shown

verificationPatterns.pattern: Action permitted — reorder job position in print queue during proof
verificationPatterns.example: Reposition job to different position in print queue during proof session; verify move succeeds

verificationPatterns.pattern: Action permitted — edit/view job properties during proof
verificationPatterns.example: Access job properties screen while proof in progress; verify properties can be viewed or modified

verificationPatterns.pattern: PEX signal update after UI change
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in PEX -> ProofOperation update according to user changes.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Settings persistence across press move and full restart
verificationPatterns.example: Move the job between presses. Do a SW restart including DFE restart and HW full Shut down and verify that proof setting is persistent.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sheet range edit saved and applied to output
verificationPatterns.example: Edit the sheet range of the job thru the proof tab. For example: 1,3-5. Click on save. Click on Proof Now. Verify the proof print the sheet range.

verificationPatterns.pattern: CSC/CCPR/CCC knockout applied on proof, corrections not printed
verificationPatterns.example: Proof shall not be printed with continuous corrections. However, knockout for corrections shall be applied. Verify that knockout corrections be applied in case CSC and CCPR and CCC active.

verificationPatterns.pattern: PEX preferences entity updated to exact value after UI save
verificationPatterns.example: PEX -> ProofPreferencesEntity -> NumberOfCleanersBeforeProof should updated to 43. PEX -> ProofPreferencesEntity -> RwInsepctionTableDistanceOffset should updated to 700000.(Unit in micron)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Out-of-range input: user notification shown, Save disabled, PEX not updated
verificationPatterns.example: Should be notification to user that the value should be in range. Save button should not be available. PEX -> ProofPreferencesEntity should not updated.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default sheet range differs by job type (All Sheets for regular, first sheet for VDP/multi)
verificationPatterns.example: The proof sheet range should default to All sheets for regular jobs and the first sheet for VDP/multi-sheet jobs.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print queue order respected in Multi Proof
verificationPatterns.example: The Multi Proof should be printed according to position in print queue from Top to bottom

verificationPatterns.pattern: First job in queue dictates separation order for all participating jobs
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the availability is according the first job — it means that the job in the highest index in print queue. For example: The first job printing order is CMYK, all other job separation order should be the same.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Separation mismatch blocks Multi Proof and triggers press message
verificationPatterns.example: If there is any mismatch in the bid order, ensure that the 'Multi Proof Now' option displays a press message indicating 'MultiProofUnmatched'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press message identifies non-conforming jobs by name
verificationPatterns.example: MultiProofUnmatched → The following jobs cannot be proofed together - jobs require a different color printing order than the first selected job: [JobNames]

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket rotation mismatch blocks Multi Proof
verificationPatterns.example: One of the selected jobs has 2 blanket rotations — Multi-proofing should be unavailable; proper press message shown

verificationPatterns.pattern: Separation fix restores Multi Proof availability
verificationPatterns.example: Update in job properties through the DFE and Press the involved separation to 2nd job to the same like the first job — Availability should updated and Multi Proof should be available

verificationPatterns.pattern: MultiProofUnmatched message takes priority over other availability issues
verificationPatterns.example: One job has 2 blanket rotations and one job has substrate mismatch — the press message MultiProofUnmatched should receive priority over other availability issues

verificationPatterns.pattern: PEX entity reflects UI-saved value
verificationPatterns.example: PEX - ProofPreferencesEntity - NumberOfCleanerBeforeProof updated to 12

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal counter matches expected BKT loop count (accounting for empty sheet)
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.PrintControl.printCtrlSlotAware.printDataControl.Out.monitor.printBktLoopsInSsn.nTotal = 13 due to empty sheet

verificationPatterns.pattern: Save button disabled when value exceeds valid range
verificationPatterns.example: Save should not be available in case value is invalid - up to 50

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cleaners printed using highest-efficiency ink available; deactivated ink skipped to next candidate
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Cleaners Printing with Magenta (Next most efficiency ink) when Yellow is deactivated

verificationPatterns.pattern: In multi-proof session, cleaners run only once at session start, not between jobs
verificationPatterns.example: In case user runs a multi proof there should be NumberOfCleanerBeforeProof ONLY on start print session

verificationPatterns.pattern: PTA (Print-attempt-start/end) log entry generated for each cleaner; job type = special job, Print type = NULL
verificationPatterns.example: Should be generated a PTA for every cleaner at start and End proofing. At PTA start: job name and job type should be special job. Print type: NULL

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket stir build inserts after every 10 BKT rotations during cleaner run
verificationPatterns.example: stir build insert after 10 BKT rotations

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cleaner sheets use same scaling factor as user job; spread length = floor(5315mm / scalingFactor)
verificationPatterns.example: maximum printable area on blanket (5315mm) divided by Image scaling factor (0.998), rounded down

verificationPatterns.pattern: RW inspection table offset persists across SW restart and SW upgrade
verificationPatterns.example: This param should be persistency even SW Restart/Upgrade performed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Entity JSON fields match exact expected values
verificationPatterns.example: RwinderInspectionTableSizeConfigEntity: RegularInspectionTableSizeMm=1000, AutomaticInspectionTableSizeMm=700

verificationPatterns.pattern: Proof availability mirrors job availability for each mismatch type
verificationPatterns.example: Proof availability should follow the same conditions as job availability; verify proof is not available with proper press message

verificationPatterns.pattern: ProofNowUnavailable signal fires when selected jobs are not available for printing
verificationPatterns.example: ProofNowUnavailable - Selected jobs for proofing are not available for printing

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fixing the mismatch restores proof availability
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in case user fix mismatch issue the proof is available for printing

verificationPatterns.pattern: Scale verification: repeat mismatch-availability checks with 10 jobs per type
verificationPatterns.example: Choose 10 jobs with INK MISMATCH issue … same expected results as single-job set

verificationPatterns.pattern: Substrate-ignore for proof is independent from substrate-ignore for job
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that the Ignore for proof is not change the status of ignore of printing job, it means there are 2 ignores: one to the proof and the second for the job

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ignoring substrate mismatch for proof makes job available for proofing
verificationPatterns.example: After clicking ignore - the press should be available for proofing

verificationPatterns.pattern: Proof-ignore persistency: survives proof-session completion, queue moves, user changes, and press SW reset
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that in case all proof session completed the ignore select for proof is not reset; verify that in case user move the job between queues the ignore select for proof is not reset; verify ignore select stay active until the user change it; verify that after press SW the ignore select didn't reset

verificationPatterns.pattern: After proof print completes, original job moves to Retained queue and can be reprinted normally
verificationPatterns.example: After print completed ensure ignore mismatch for printing JOB still not checked. Print the same job that you proofed. Ensure that after the job fully printed the job moved to Retained queue.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Continuous corrections (CSC/CCPR) are not applied during a proof session
verificationPatterns.example: Continuous corrections should not be applied during the proof session; no availability of continuous calibrations shall exist when job is printed as proof

verificationPatterns.pattern: Both LEDs lit when shaft not in top position (lower position)
verificationPatterns.example: Set LiftArmTopPosition.Value = 0 → RollerDownBottonLed.Value = 1, RollerUpBottonLed.Value = 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: LEDs remain lit regardless of up/down button presses while shaft is not in position
verificationPatterns.example: Toggle RollerUpBotton and RollerDownBotton while LiftArmTopPosition = 0 → both LEDs stay 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Both LEDs stay lit immediately after shaft reaches top position and button is released
verificationPatterns.example: Set LiftArmTopPosition.Value = 1, RollerUpBotton = 0, RollerDownBotton = 0 → both LEDs = 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Up LED turns off after holding up button for LiftArmLedOffDelay (5 s) at top position; down LED stays lit
verificationPatterns.example: Hold LiftArmTopPosition = 1, RollerUpBotton = 1 for 5 s then release → RollerUpBottonLed = 0, RollerDownBottonLed = 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Both LEDs off when UW is under tension
verificationPatterns.example: Build web tension via monitor screen → RollerDownBottonLed.Value = 0, RollerUpBottonLed.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Standalone session isolation — proof must not continue to next job in any press mode
verificationPatterns.example: Ensure that in case the press is in continuous mode the proof prints as standalone session and NOT continue to the next job.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-proof selection count — only the explicitly selected jobs are proofed, not the full queue
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that the proof is only for 9 jobs and the last job in print queue is not printing.

verificationPatterns.pattern: PRT_CMD_IMG_TO_RW_TABLE PLC command parameters — SpreadID, LE/TE flag, and RwInspectionTableDistanceOffset must all be present and correct
verificationPatterns.example: Check that the PLC got PRT_CMD_IMG_TO_RW_TABLE with: Spread ID that requires advancing to RW inspection table; parameter indicating LE or TE; offset retrieved from RwInspectionTableDistanceOffset.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Leading edge advances to RW inspection table after proof session ends, not to the cleaner leading edge
verificationPatterns.example: At the end of the session printed proof, leading edge shall be advanced to RW inspection table of Proof. Ensure that leading edge of the proof shall be advanced to the RW inspection and not the leading edge of the printed cleaner.

verificationPatterns.pattern: T2ToRwInspectionTableDistance value matches press configuration type (RW vs NSR)
verificationPatterns.example: According to MAIN_PRESS_FEED_OUTPUT_TYPE value: RW=15300, NSR=15700.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Web Manager engage/disengage lifecycle verified by scope — EngageReq before proof, DisengageReq after print, web decelerates to standstill
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Ctrl.In.Cmd.EngageReq / gInterface.Web.Ctrl.Out.Status.Engage.AtEngage on start; gInterface.Web.Ctrl.In.Cmd.DisengageReq / AtDisEngage + all WHS ActVelocity=0 on end.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-print subsystem command dispatch — all subsystems receive end-print/stop/warming commands after proof completes
verificationPatterns.example: Dryer receives EndPrint, RW decelerates per Vavg, WHS EndPrint, ILP manager EndPrint, UW decelerates per Vilm, SPM GoToWarming, ILS Stop.

verificationPatterns.pattern: webBktPosToReachRwInspectionTableInUm conditional branch — when != 0, feed web to inspection table then reset parameter to 0 before issuing post-print commands
verificationPatterns.example: Ensure that after gInterface.Web.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.webBktPosToReachRwInspectionTableInUm reached RW inspection table the parameter resets to webBktPosToReachRwInspectionTableInUm = 0.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Corona/primer active state follows substrate definition — advance to RW inspection table behavior must respect whether substrate requires corona/primer
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that in case the substrate requires corona/primer OR not requires corona/primer the advance substrate to RW inspection table is according to substrate definitions.

verificationPatterns.pattern: T2ToRwInspectionTableDistance exported parameter exists in logical solution
verificationPatterns.example: Go to logical solution and ensure that T2ToRwInspectionTableDistance has exported param.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error structure verification — confirm all error fields match spec
verificationPatterns.example: Error type: Error | Subsystem ID: UW | Problem description: Unwinder lift arm is not in upper position | Action required: Press button on Unwinder to lift the shaft up | Possible causes: Shaft not fully raised / Pneumatics defective / Sensor not calibrated

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI icon presence — verify warning icon shown when fault active
verificationPatterns.example: UW roll not in place icon presented in the UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Non-blocking fault — verify press reaches target state and job completes despite active error
verificationPatterns.example: Press reaches Standby state; Job printed successfully

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error fires once on MI start, not repeatedly during print
verificationPatterns.example: Error UW_LIFT_ARM_IS_NOT_IN_UP_POSITION is issued in UI once upon MI start

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal restore clears fault — set signal to 1 during print, verify error and icon disappear without press state change
verificationPatterns.example: Set LiftArmTopPosition.Value = 1; Press does not change state; UW roll not in place icon is not shown; No error appears

verificationPatterns.pattern: Component stays in safe circulation on error during non-print state
verificationPatterns.example: ilp component will remain in PrimerCirculation (OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ExportedData.ILP.Status.MillingStatus = true)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print-active state (PREPRINT/PRINT/POST) aborts on error
verificationPatterns.example: press print will stop; ilp component will move to PrimerCirculation; press in ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: LEVEL_INVALID event appears with structured parameters
verificationPatterns.example: event description: Level sensor is malfunctioned; sensor id: PrimerTankLevel_ErrorBit; primer Liquid Level (Unit: Liter); primer limit (Unit: Liter)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state continuity for non-print states
verificationPatterns.example: STBY/SERVICE GR/READY/DYNAMIC READY - continue same state; PREPRINT/PRINT/POST will stop

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wash sequence completes despite error bit active; ILP reaches OFF after wash
verificationPatterns.example: wash continues; after wash ends ilp liquid component in OFF — gInterface.Web.Comp.ILP.Comp.Liquids.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOFF = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat error injection across all machine states to confirm state-matrix behavior
verificationPatterns.example: change press to STBY/SERVICE GR/READY/DYNAMIC READY/PREPRINT/PRINT/POST — REPEAT steps 1-4

verificationPatterns.pattern: Confirm dry mode active via MillingStatus signal
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ExportedData.ILP.Status.MillingStatus = false

verificationPatterns.pattern: Confirm no error events from ILP or Dryer when dry mode is active
verificationPatterns.example: no error events from ILP and Dryer (due to dry mode)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Confirm press continues running in GR state despite out-of-range sensor values when dry mode is active
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = 7 (since dry mode applied)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Confirm wet mode active via MillingStatus signal after switching back
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ExportedData.ILP.Status.MillingStatus = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Confirm expected error events DO appear in wet mode when sensor thresholds are exceeded
verificationPatterns.example: since primer in milling primer event should appear; dryer event should appear

verificationPatterns.pattern: TEMP_INVALID error event raised with correct parameters
verificationPatterns.example: TEMP_INVALID error event raised after TempErrMaxPeriod; event parameters: sensorID=DryerChamberTemp, actual temperature=OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.HW_Inputs.Dryer.DryerChamberTemp, limit value=gInterface.Web.Comp.DRYER.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.DryerChamberTempValidHigh

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dryer component transitions to standby on fault
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.DRYER.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtStandBy = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press transitions to standby state on dryer fault
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = 6

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-gated event suppression: no error event in SERVICE state, error raised from GR onwards
verificationPatterns.example: service: NO error event (since monitor starts from GR); GR/READY/DYNAMIC READY/PREPRINT/PRINT/POST PRINT: TEMP_INVALID error event raised

verificationPatterns.pattern: Both boundary directions tested independently (over-temp and under-temp)
verificationPatterns.example: Step 1-2: DryerChamberTemp > DryerChamberTempValidHigh; Step 3-4: DryerChamberTemp < DryerChamberTempValidLow

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event fires with structured parameters when temp enters panic band
verificationPatterns.example: error event TEMP_PANIC_HIGH; sensorID=DryerChamberTemp; actual temperature=WEB.HW_Inputs.Dryer.DryerChamberTemp; limit value=Web.Comp.DRYER.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.DryerChamberTempValidHigh

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dryer component transitions to standby on panic event
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.DRYER.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtStandBy = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press transitions to STBY state on panic event
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = 6

verificationPatterns.pattern: No event fires when press is in STBY or OFF — monitor only active from GR start
verificationPatterns.example: Step 3: press in STBY, I/O set to panic range → NO events appear (since monitor set from GR)

verificationPatterns.pattern: No event fires in SERVICE state — monitor not active
verificationPatterns.example: Step 7: service state → NO error event (since monitor starts from GR)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event fires across all monitored states: GR, READY, DYNAMIC READY, PREPRINT, PRINT, POST PRINT
verificationPatterns.example: Step 7: GR/READY/DYNAMIC READY/PREPRINT/PRINT/POST PRINT → dryer in standby, press in STBY

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat entire test in OFF state and verify no events — used as negative baseline
verificationPatterns.example: Step 6: REPEAT TEST IN OFF → NO error event (since monitor starts from GR)

verificationPatterns.pattern: TEMP_HIGH event fires with correct parameters when dryer temp exceeds exit-high threshold
verificationPatterns.example: TEMP_HIGH error event appears; sensorID=dryer chamber; actual temperature=I/O OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.HW_Inputs.Dryer.DryerChamberTemp; limit value=dryer set point + DryerChamberTempRelativeEnterHigh

verificationPatterns.pattern: TEMP_LOW event fires with correct parameters when dryer temp drops below exit-low threshold
verificationPatterns.example: TEMP_LOW error event appears; sensorID=dryer chamber; actual temperature=I/O OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.HW_Inputs.Dryer.DryerChamberTemp; limit value=dryer set point + DryerChamberTempRelativeEnterLow

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dryer component drops exactly one state on temperature fault
verificationPatterns.example: dryer component in standby state (1 state lower from time of error); gInterface.Web.Comp.DRYER.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtStandBy=true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press machine state drops to match dryer degradation
verificationPatterns.example: press in stby: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State=6; press in ready: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State=8

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event re-fires only on state change, not on re-entry to out-of-range condition
verificationPatterns.example: According to SFR: event shall be issued again only if state was changed since last publish — only state change is event trigger WITHOUT re-enter range

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-dependent degradation target: dryer moves to ready (not standby) when fault occurs during Print state
verificationPatterns.example: Step 4/7: dryer moves to ready gInterface.Web.Comp.DRYER.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtReady=true; press in ready MachineState.State=8

verificationPatterns.pattern: No event or state change when press is in STBY or SERVICE states
verificationPatterns.example: Step 8: service/stby — no change since monitor from GR

verificationPatterns.pattern: No event when temp is between working-range boundary and exit threshold
verificationPatterns.example: dryer SP=40, ExitHigh=10, working range 35-45: temp 45-50 OK no event; from 51 event fires

verificationPatterns.pattern: PREPRINT and POST PRINT states behave like Ready: dryer stays ready, press stays ready on fault
verificationPatterns.example: Step 8: PREPRINT/POST PRINT state — dryer in ready, press in ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: DYNAMIC READY behaves like Ready: dryer in ready, press in ready on fault
verificationPatterns.example: Step 8: DYNAMIC READY — dryer in ready, press in ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: TEMP_INVALID event raised with correct structured parameters
verificationPatterns.example: TEMP_INVALID error event raised; sensorID = .DryerHeaterTemp; actual temperature = OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.HW_Inputs.Dryer.DryerHeaterTemp; limit value = gInterface.Web.Comp.DRYER.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.DryerHeaterTempValidHigh

verificationPatterns.pattern: Temperature monitor inactive before GR — no events in early states
verificationPatterns.example: In STBY/SERVICE/OFF: no error events appear (temperature monitor active only from get-ready state)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Both high and low limit violations trigger same event type with respective limit value
verificationPatterns.example: High: DryerHeaterTempValidHigh > DryerHeaterTemp triggers TEMP_INVALID with limit = ValidHigh; Low: DryerHeaterTemp < DryerHeaterTempValidLow triggers TEMP_INVALID with limit = ValidLow

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event fired with correct type and parameters
verificationPatterns.example: error event TEMP_PANIC_HIGH; sensorID = DryerHeaterTemp; actual temperature = WEB.HW_Inputs.Dryer.DryerHeaterTemp; limit value = Web.Comp.DRYER.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.DryerChamberTempValidHigh

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dryer component transitions to standby on panic
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.DRYER.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtStandBy = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press transitions to STBY machine state on panic
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = 6

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-gated monitoring: no event below GR, event fires from GR upward
verificationPatterns.example: STBY, SERVICE, OFF — NO error event (monitor starts from GR); READY/DYNAMIC READY/PREPRINT/PRINT/POST PRINT — event appears

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print stops on panic injected during PRINT state
verificationPatterns.example: print stop; dryer component in standby state; press in STBY

verificationPatterns.pattern: End-job report generated per job within BKT rotation
verificationPatterns.example: Each job in a BLK rotation has its own end job report. Verify the report contains accurate details for each job.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Spread length billed per job, not aggregated across BKT rotation
verificationPatterns.example: The spread length is calculated per job, not across the entire BLK rotation.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Single proof generates report with accurate billing details
verificationPatterns.example: After proof complete ensure that generate report. Verify the report contains accurate details for the job. Verify Billing for single job proof.

verificationPatterns.pattern: CleanerBeforeProofDefined enables billing and report for both single and multi proof
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in case 'CleanerBeforeProofDefined' the report and billing is calculated (On multi and single proof)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cleaner between BKT rotations triggers separate billing entry and report
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in case cleaner between BKT rotations insert billing calculated and report is generated.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Protected counters advance after proof, verified via Print Attempt Report
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the below counters advanced. Verify thru the Print attempt report that protected counters advanced.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cleaner revolution occurs between blanket rotations when no bypass is set
verificationPatterns.example: Ensure that a cleaner printing revolution occurs between the blanket rotations.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass flag True suppresses inter-cycle cleaner
verificationPatterns.example: IsAutoCleanerBetweenProofBktCyclesBypassed = True → There are no cleaners between blanket revolution.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass flag False restores inter-cycle cleaner
verificationPatterns.example: IsAutoCleanerBetweenProofBktCyclesBypassed = False → There are cleaners between blanket revolution.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-proof: cleaner added selectively only after BKT cycles for jobs exceeding MaxPrintableAreaLengthInMillimeters
verificationPatterns.example: During the Multi Proof session the cleaners should added after the each bkt cycle of the 2 jobs that bigger than MaxPrintableAreaLengthInMillimeters.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-proof bypass False: no cleaners added for any job regardless of size
verificationPatterns.example: During the Multi Proof session the cleaners should NOT added after the each bkt cycle of the 4 jobs that bigger than MaxPrintableAreaLengthInMillimeters.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pre-proof BKT loop count equals NumberOfCleanerBeforeProof plus one empty sheet
verificationPatterns.example: printBktLoopsInSsn.nTotal = 13 due to empty sheet (NumberOfCleanerBeforeProof = 12).

verificationPatterns.pattern: PTA generated per cleaner at proof start and end with special job type and null print type
verificationPatterns.example: Should be generated a PTA for every cleaner at start and End proofing. At PTA start: job name and job type should be special job. Print type: NULL.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Report issued after session
verificationPatterns.example: After print session completed verify report is issued

verificationPatterns.pattern: PrintType field value check
verificationPatterns.example: Ensure that the print attempt report contains filed of PrintType with value "ProofNow" / "multi Proof"

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-job report cardinality
verificationPatterns.example: Print attempt report should be issued PER joB

verificationPatterns.pattern: Job-specific data accuracy
verificationPatterns.example: Each print attempt report for a job contains the correct job-specific data. For example: Job ID, status

verificationPatterns.pattern: Null data propagation to next report
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that the null data is correctly attached to the next report that is going to be issued

verificationPatterns.pattern: Null propagation under multi-job scenario
verificationPatterns.example: Verify this steps for MultiJobs also

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print progress shows actual and total printed length during proof session
verificationPatterns.example: while the proof session in progress -> Verify that the print progress show the actual printed length and total printed length for the proof

verificationPatterns.pattern: Job name display correctness varies by session type (single vs multi)
verificationPatterns.example: Verify job Name appear correctly [single]; Verify During a multi-job proof session, the job name is not displayed due to the high speed of transition

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cleaner cycle shown in print progress with cleaner name and progress, reverting to job progress after completion
verificationPatterns.example: when the press print Cleaner cycle the print progress show cleaner name and progress; After the cleaner completes verify the print progress return to regular job print progress

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pre-proof cleaner indication shown to user before session starts
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in case user define cleaner before proof the press will display to user; Verify cleaner representation BEFORE multi proof session

verificationPatterns.pattern: BKT cleaner notification when proof length exceeds MaxPrintableAreaLengthInMillimeters
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in case Cleaner after the proof printed in case is bigger than max printable area the user will notify that BKT cleaner is printed

verificationPatterns.pattern: New core disregard indication shown when job has new core flag but core is not confirmed
verificationPatterns.example: an indication shall be given that a core is not going to be replaced - ProofNewCoreDisregard

verificationPatterns.pattern: Proof unavailable when new core is unconfirmed; proof available; roll not replaced when confirmed
verificationPatterns.example: if the core is not confirmed the print is unavailable and the proof should be available; in case the core is confirm - the roll is not replaced

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-proof new core: user notified of which jobs require new core and that cores will not be replaced
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that the user notify that that core is not going to be replaced and which jobs need new core

verificationPatterns.pattern: ProofExceedRwTable indication when total proof length (including cleaners) exceeds RW inspection table
verificationPatterns.example: Verify indication is display to user 'ProofExceedRwTable'; Verify the calculation of App side by changing the copies or add cleaners

verificationPatterns.pattern: No indication shown when total proof length is within RW inspection table limit
verificationPatterns.example: in case the total length is within the RW inspection table limit, ensure that no indication display to user

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC exports RW inspection table data

verificationPatterns.pattern: Web-movement calculation state machine: start from last saved value, use Reduce-layer until Valid, switch to v=ωr after Valid, revert to Reduce-layer if Valid lost; save last diameter when web stops while in tension

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event raised on PLC download failure
verificationPatterns.example: verify during failure the user is getting an event: PLC_DOWNLOAD_FAILED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event raised on communication error during PLC installation
verificationPatterns.example: verify after the communication failure we are getting the event: PLC_COMMUNICATION_FAILED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Auto-trigger on version mismatch
verificationPatterns.example: verify that when installer version differs from installed version, PLC auto-download is initiated

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-install version confirmation via HMI or UA Expert
verificationPatterns.example: verify via HMI or UA expert that new PLC version is installed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Artifact copy completeness check to PLC side
verificationPatterns.example: verify boot folder, drivers FW, startup list, safety package were all copied to PLC side

verificationPatterns.pattern: AtTemperatureMonitor flag reflects active monitoring state
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.Comps.AsidTemp.Out.Status.AtTemperatureMonitor = TRUE when in Get Ready/Print; FALSE after reaching Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: AtTemperature flag TRUE only when all ASIDs within threshold window
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.Comps.AsidTemp.Out.Status.AtTemperature = TRUE (bypass on, temps below threshold); FALSE when temp out of range low or high

verificationPatterns.pattern: AtUnifiedTemperature flag mirrors AtTemperature under same conditions
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.Comps.AsidTemp.Out.Status.AtUnifiedTemperature = TRUE|FALSE in lockstep with AtTemperature

verificationPatterns.pattern: ASID_TEMP_TIMEOUT event raised with SubsystemID+SensorID when temp stays out of window past timeout
verificationPatterns.example: After 10 sec timeout with temp below WindowLow-1 or above WindowHigh+1, expect event ASID_TEMP_TIMEOUT {SubsystemID, SensorID}

verificationPatterns.pattern: DelayTimeRangeArray used as delay-calc input when temp is in a delay range band
verificationPatterns.example: ASiDTemperatureForDelayCalc = gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.Comps.AsidTemp.In.Par.Local.DelayTimeRangeArray

verificationPatterns.pattern: All at-temperature signals reset to FALSE on transition to Standby
verificationPatterns.example: AtTemperatureMonitor=False, AtTemperature=False, AtUnifiedTemperature=False after Dynamic Ready → Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press falls to Standby or Ready on temp fault during state transition
verificationPatterns.example: verify press fell to Standby/Standby/Ready and the event that appears is TEMP_INVALID

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press falls to Ready on temp fault during active print job
verificationPatterns.example: print some job, simulate asid valid temp low → verify press fell to Ready and event TEMP_INVALID appears

verificationPatterns.pattern: Status output signal set True on fault condition
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.Comps.AsidTemp.Out.Status.InValidTemp=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event raised with required parameter set (Sensor, ActualTemperature, TempLimit)
verificationPatterns.example: event TEMP_INVALID with parameters: Sensor, ActualTemperature, TempLimit

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic-high fault triggers TEMP_PANIC_HIGH event and PanicHighError status True
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.Comps.AsidTemp.Out.Status.PanicHighError=True; event TEMP_PANIC_HIGH with Sensor, ActualTemperature, TempLimit

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press recovers through full GR→Standby/Ready→Standby/Dynamic Ready→Print sequence when entering operating range
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the press state is GR–>Standby/Ready–>Standby/Dynamic Ready and Print–>Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Out-of-range condition sets TempOutOfRange True only after timeout expires (AsidTempOutOfRange sec)
verificationPatterns.example: verify ASID temp out of range for AsidTempOutOfRange sec - gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.Comps.AsidTemp.Out.Status.TempOutOfRange=True; after the time over - gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.Comps.AsidTemp.In.Par.Local.TempOutOfRange

verificationPatterns.pattern: ASID_TEMP_OUT_OF_RANGE event raised with ASiD actual temperature parameter
verificationPatterns.example: verify that event appear is ASID_TEMP_OUT_OF_RANGE with parameter: ASiD actual temperature

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state fallback on safety fault
verificationPatterns.example: verify press fell to Ready/Standby/Ready state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Safety event emitted with structured parameters
verificationPatterns.example: verify event of CONTACTOR_TURNED_OFF with parameters: Contactor ID, electrical cabinet ID

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor-disconnect event emitted with identifier
verificationPatterns.example: verify event of SENSOR_DISCONNECTED with parameter - sensor ID

verificationPatterns.pattern: Heater-enable signal goes False on fault, True on recovery
verificationPatterns.example: verify the heaters not enable - gInterface.Station[X].Comp.CS.Comps.TC.Out.Status.HeaterEnabled=False; after simulation stopped: HeaterEnabled=True when temp drops below _SafetyCSHeaterTemperatureCutOff - 250_

verificationPatterns.pattern: Contactor triplet closure verified per station group
verificationPatterns.example: for stations 1-3: gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.TempCtrl.Ctrl.Out.Status.outputHeatersEnbale_1_3=False; for stations 4-6: gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.TempCtrl.Ctrl.Out.Status.outputHeatersEnbale_4_6=False

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-matrix coverage: repeat fault injection across all relevant press states
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 3-6 repeat thermocouple-disconnect test from Dynamic Ready, Ready, Get Ready, and mid-print, each expecting a distinct target fallback state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event fires only after configured delay, not immediately
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the event that appears is TEMP_INVALID only after 1 second - gInterface.Station[X].Comp.CS.Comps.TC.In.Par.Local.Monitors.Delay.HeaterTempValidErrorDurationMs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event carries three mandatory parameters: Sensor, ActualTemperature, TempLimit
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the event that appears is TEMP_INVALID ... with the following parameters: Sensor, ActualTemperature, TempLimit

verificationPatterns.pattern: Heaters drop to READY state after temperature fault event
verificationPatterns.example: verify that Heaters fell to Ready state - gInterface.Station[X].Comp.CS.Comps.TC.Out.Status.READY=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press continues in its current state (non-blocking fault): Dynamic Ready stays Dynamic Ready, Print stays Print
verificationPatterns.example: verify Press continue at Dynamic Ready / verify Press continue to print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Temperature monitor enable/disable transitions around Get Ready sequence
verificationPatterns.example: verify temp monitor ON - gInterface.Station[X].Comp.CS.Comps.TC.Out.Status.MonitorsEnabled=True ... verify the temp monitor is OFF - gInterface.Station[X].Comp.CS.Comps.TC.Out.Status.MonitorsEnabled=False

verificationPatterns.pattern: TempCtrl enable flag follows machine state
verificationPatterns.example: Standby: EnableTemperatureCtrl=False; GetReady: EnableTemperatureCtrl=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: All ASIDs below threshold → CS heaters off, CWS valve at MaxTc
verificationPatterns.example: HeaterEnable.Value=0; ProportionalValve.Value=~gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.TempCtrl.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.MaxTc

verificationPatterns.pattern: One ASID above threshold but below TempSetPoint → CS heaters on, CWS valve tracks ASID max
verificationPatterns.example: HeaterEnabled=True; HeaterCtrl.Value>0; ProportionalValve set per ASIDs max (0=full close, 90=full open)

verificationPatterns.pattern: One ASID above threshold AND above TempSetPoint → CS heaters off, CWS valve tracks ASID max
verificationPatterns.example: HeaterEnabled=False; ProportionalValve set per ASIDs max (0=full close, 90=full open)

verificationPatterns.pattern: CS heater HW output verified at two levels: logical status signal and raw HW output value
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.CS.Comps.TC.Out.Status.HeaterEnabled=True AND OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[X].HW_Outputs.CS.HeaterCtrl.Value>0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Heater enable gate check before heating begins
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.CS.Comps.TC.Out.Status.HeaterEnabled=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic and working-range monitors activate together when heating starts
verificationPatterns.example: MonitorsEnabled=True AND MonitorsActive.HeaterTempPanicHigh=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: RUN/READY are mutually exclusive during active heating
verificationPatterns.example: RUN=True while READY=False during heat phase

verificationPatterns.pattern: HW output voltage confirms heater is physically driven
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[X].HW_Outputs.CS.HeaterCtrl.Value>0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Monitors deactivate and RUN clears on Standby transition
verificationPatterns.example: MonitorsEnabled=False, MonitorsActive.HeaterTempPanicHigh=False, RUN=False

verificationPatterns.pattern: READY restores and voltage drops to zero on Standby
verificationPatterns.example: READY=True AND HeaterCtrl.Value=0 after Stop Heat

verificationPatterns.pattern: EMS active → heater enters INIT and power is disabled
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.CS.Comps.TC.Out.Status.INIT=True; gInterface.ImoSystem.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtPowerDisable=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: EMS released → safety armed (heater enable outputs go True)
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.TempCtrl.Ctrl.Out.Status.outputHeatersEnbale_1_3=True; outputHeatersEnbale_4_6=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: EMS released → heater exits INIT and power-disable clears
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.CS.Comps.TC.Out.Status.INIT=False; gInterface.ImoSystem.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtPowerDisable=False

verificationPatterns.pattern: EMS released → heater reaches READY state
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.CS.Comps.TC.Out.Status.READY=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify heater ready status before print
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.CS.Comps.TC.Out.Status.READY=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify ASID at set point temperature during print
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.Comps.AsidTemp.Out.Status.AtTemperature = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify ASID at unified temperature during print
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.Comps.AsidTemp.Out.Status.AtUnifiedTemperature = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify CS heater run status during print
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.CS.Comps.TC.Out.Status.RUN=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert ordered sequence — set point → unified temp → heater run
verificationPatterns.example: Steps must appear in this order: AtTemperature, AtUnifiedTemperature, RUN

verificationPatterns.pattern: CRC stability across multiple jobs
verificationPatterns.example: After printing 3 jobs in continuous mode, CRC value must match CRC from previous test run

verificationPatterns.pattern: Regression baseline comparison
verificationPatterns.example: Store CRC from prior run; re-run same job sequence; assert CRC unchanged

verificationPatterns.pattern: CRC regression check against stored baseline
verificationPatterns.example: verify that the CRC is not changed from the previous time

verificationPatterns.pattern: CRC regression check — compare current run output against stored baseline
verificationPatterns.example: verify that the CRC is not changed from the previous time

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary-value parameterization — use maximum allowed value for key dimension
verificationPatterns.example: maximum slice size (5292mm)

verificationPatterns.pattern: CRC regression baseline comparison
verificationPatterns.example: verify that the CRC is not changed from the previous time

verificationPatterns.pattern: Not-in-use roll (press ON): parameters update triggered by Save button

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default parameter pre-population check

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tooltip text on action tap — component-specific text

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tooltip disappear conditions

verificationPatterns.pattern: Access point via Substrate List carries selection into Roll Rep

verificationPatterns.pattern: Feature disabled on multi-selection

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pop-up trigger on status change to True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panel header, roll size/color visualization, live counters during print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tension indication present in panel
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Tension indication is shown in the Roll Replacement panel

verificationPatterns.pattern: Installed substrate caption and SWF Toggle with default

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mandatory step gate enforced by hardware state
verificationPatterns.example: 'Push unlock button to open door' step completes only if Door sensor reports open; step is mandatory to continue

verificationPatterns.pattern: Step highlighted red + warning message on incomplete prerequisite
verificationPatterns.example: If step 6 performed but roll not ready: step highlighted red, warning '[reason]. Repeat steps 3-6 to complete.'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Conditional step visibility based on substrate change
verificationPatterns.example: 'Tap to force splice' button appears only when a new substrate is selected

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-action UI state lock with panel update

verificationPatterns.pattern: Procedure branch on same vs. new substrate
verificationPatterns.example: Same substrate: steps 1–6 shown; new substrate: step 7 added

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter trigger on in-use roll during active tension
verificationPatterns.example: For 'in use' roll, while restoring tension prior to UwEndReplaceRoll operation execution — verify parameters update at that moment

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter remembered until change-roll execution for non-in-use roll
verificationPatterns.example: For not 'in use' roll, prior to 'change roll' operation, App shall remember selected substrate until change roll execution

verificationPatterns.pattern: User notification on restore-tension failure with save confirmation
verificationPatterns.example: Restore tension failed — verify user is notified with a note that parameters were saved

verificationPatterns.pattern: Save button as parameter trigger in OFF/Service state (no web tension)
verificationPatterns.example: When screen open at press OFF or Service state (no web tension, restore tension not available), trigger is pressing the 'Save' button — verify param updated in OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Roll replacement blocked when tension is ON in Service state
verificationPatterns.example: Replacement at Service state when tension is ON will not be possible — verify REP is not possible when tension is on

verificationPatterns.pattern: In-use roll OFF-state behavior mirrors single REP behavior
verificationPatterns.example: Roll in use — verify is the same behaviour as single REP

verificationPatterns.pattern: Door state per roll path
verificationPatterns.example: Roll not in use — door should be unlocked; Roll in use — verify door unlocked after RWPreparaeReplaceRoll OP

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tension and clamp state after release OP
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the tension is released, verify the clamps are closed (after RWPreparaeReplaceRoll)

verificationPatterns.pattern: User instruction clarity check at each major step
verificationPatterns.example: Verify instructions to user are clear without any mistake (repeated at Remove Roll and Load Roll steps)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter update deferred until explicit user confirmation
verificationPatterns.example: Core diameter — verify the param is updated ONLY after click finish or saved

verificationPatterns.pattern: MaxRollDiam range configuration check
verificationPatterns.example: Select max Roll dim — verify range configuration against NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.RW.Param.MaxRollDiam

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tension restore and door/clamp state after load OP
verificationPatterns.example: Restore tension by RwEndReplaceRoll — verify RW built tension, clamps released, door locked

verificationPatterns.pattern: Read RollInUse signal to determine which flow branch to exercise
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ExportedData.RW.Monitor.RollInUse drives 'Roll in use' vs 'Roll not in use' path

verificationPatterns.pattern: Web guide mode transition on substrate width change
verificationPatterns.example: validate the transition of web guide mode once the user change from the narrow substrate to wide substrate

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wash notification shown when transitioning from prime-required to non-prime substrate
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that the user notifies 'Washing is required before changing the new roll' with link to ILP wash wizard

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wash notification link opens ILP wash wizard
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the Link is open in the WASH wizard

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wash notification suppressed when transitioning from non-prime to prime-required substrate
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that the user NOT notifies 'Washing is required before changing the new roll' with link to ILP wash wizard

verificationPatterns.pattern: Read-only enforcement by roll status
verificationPatterns.example: Roll setup parameters shall be read only for Active roll, and editable in Standby, Pending or Ready — verify no option to change setup once roll status is active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter unit display updates on user change
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the core diameter updated in units when the user changes core diameter; verify roll direction is updated when user changes roll orientation param

verificationPatterns.pattern: Substrate change resets dependent parameters to defaults
verificationPatterns.example: When user selects different substrate, roll orientation, core diameter and minimum roll diameter shall be changed to default values — verify once user changes selected substrate the params change to default

verificationPatterns.pattern: Installed substrate reflects force splice trigger
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the installed substrate updated to Roll in use and verify the installed substrate is updated when force splice is triggered

verificationPatterns.pattern: End-to-end propagation: UI → Roll Rep → Entity → PLC → units
verificationPatterns.example: Verify once user changes setup through Roll Rep, Entity Unwinder Roll is updated; once Entity is updated PLC is updated; once PLC updated NSR/NSU units also updated

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-gated operation availability — verify operation is shown/hidden based on machine state
verificationPatterns.example: Be at G.Ready, Standby, Mi - Verify the OP of release tension is available. Verify during Pre-print, Print, Post-print there is no option to release tension to Roll in use.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard step sign-off — verify a completed mechanic action is reflected as signed in the flow
verificationPatterns.example: Be at OFF\service state - Verify the step of Release tension already signed.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Roll status tracking — verify Roll status signal updates to match roll state throughout the flow
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the status of the Roll update accordingly of the Roll State. / Verify the status of Roll change to Active.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter persistence — verify params retain previous values when same substrate is reused
verificationPatterns.example: Same substrate: Verify the param stay as the previous param for specific Roll.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter reset on new substrate — verify substrate-specific params (core diameter, direction) are reconfigurable
verificationPatterns.example: New substrate: Verify there is an option to select a new substrate. / Verify there is an option to select Roll core diameter. / Verify there is an option to select Roll orientation CW\CCW.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter dispatch on user action — verify OPCUA params are sent when user triggers a UI action
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the parameters are sent when the user clicks on restore tension. / Verify once the user clicks on Force Splice that the parameters sent and the Web guide change to treading mode.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Web guide mode transition — verify web guide enters treading mode at the correct flow step
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the web guide are in treading mode. / Web guide change to treading mode.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blocked action during print — verify destructive or disruptive operations are unavailable during active printing
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the Force Splice is not available during printing.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Roll status progression by path — verify correct terminal status per scenario (Pending / Ready / Active)
verificationPatterns.example: New substrate: Verify the status of Roll is pending. Same Substrate: Verify the status of the Roll is Ready. Roll in use: Verify the status of Roll change to Active.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Finish action cleanup — verify Finish returns web guide to last mode and closes the flow screen
verificationPatterns.example: Click on Finish web guide should return to last mode and screen close.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Substrate advance option — verify UI offers advance-to-Rewinder or advance-to-Impression after load
verificationPatterns.example: Verify there is an option to advance the substrate to Rewinder\impression.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard opens without errors
verificationPatterns.example: The wizard should open properly without any issues (expected result repeated per entry point)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal-triggered UI availability
verificationPatterns.example: Once RollStatus reaches 'ready to splice', verify popup contains option to enter Roll Replacement screen

verificationPatterns.pattern: Rewinder-specific entry points
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Rewinder (NSR) roll replacement accessible from monitor screen and main menu

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state reverts to READY on iDO error
verificationPatterns.example: Press state change to READY

verificationPatterns.pattern: User-facing error message matches expected text exactly

verificationPatterns.pattern: iDO report generated with all parameters after failure
verificationPatterns.example: After IDO failure verify IDO report generate with all parameters — Report generated with all parameters

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press blocks further printing until hardware fault resolved

verificationPatterns.pattern: Statistics report field validation: verify AlarmType, AlarmState, Units, Limits, and CurrentValues match injected alarm parameters
verificationPatterns.example: AlarmType=FanSpeed, AlarmState=Warning, Units=RPM, Limits=1000-1500; then AlarmState=Severe, Limits=0-1000

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI vs backend discrepancy check: confirm that some alarm types produce no UI event but still write a statistics report

verificationPatterns.pattern: Report batching / throttle verification: rapid state changes within a 10-second window produce a single emitted event; NumOfNonReportedAlarms is non-zero until window elapses

verificationPatterns.pattern: Alarm teardown: cancel all injected alarms by setting each back to Normal and confirm system returns to baseline

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error code coverage: simulate named IDo error codes and verify report is issued with relevant parameters and error shown in UI per SWR 5.6.1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold-based severity split: one signal value triggers abort/block, a lower value restores normal operation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Continue-on-error mode: verify print resumes past fault point while event still fires
verificationPatterns.example: After few meters, printing will be continue but event will appear: LPH_SLICE_PRINTED_REPORT_TIMEOUT

verificationPatterns.pattern: CS reaches wetting state during GR

verificationPatterns.pattern: aSID starts rotation after blade-wet delay; delay param selected by CS type (pad vs sponge)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard completion status indicator

verificationPatterns.pattern: Informational text below action button

verificationPatterns.pattern: Job sequence, ink assignment, and periodicity within wizard
verificationPatterns.example: 10 cleaner pages on substrate with Yellow at start; STIR peeling every 18 rotations; cleaner page every 100 rotations with Yellow; Gray 50 job 1 rotation every 20 on BRU with black; 10 cleaner rotations on substrate at finish; total = 400

verificationPatterns.pattern: Scaling side-effect verification during cleaner print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Completion status UI with optional non-mandatory recommendation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-run event parameters verified against expected ink/substrate meter values

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sort options menu completeness check

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sort persistence across restart
verificationPatterns.example: After SW restart, verify previously selected sort (estimated time) is still active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Reset button gated by job status: hidden when no job is partially printed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Partially printed status triggered by start+stop cycle

verificationPatterns.pattern: Reset button visible for single partially-printed job, hidden for multi-select with mixed status
verificationPatterns.example: After 1st job partially printed: select that 1 job → reset appears; select 2 jobs (1 partial + 1 not) → reset hidden

verificationPatterns.pattern: Reset button visible for multi-select when ALL selected jobs are partially printed
verificationPatterns.example: After jobs 1 and 2 both partially printed: select both → reset button appears

verificationPatterns.pattern: TOP button repositions job to head of queue
verificationPatterns.example: Select 2nd job, press TOP → 2nd job moves to top of print queue

verificationPatterns.pattern: Reset clears progress but effect is deferred until next print
verificationPatterns.example: Press reset → 'job progress is reset but will not appear until printing'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-select reset applies to all selected jobs simultaneously
verificationPatterns.example: Select 2 partially-printed jobs, press reset → progress reset for both jobs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-reset verification: job starts from 0 on next print run
verificationPatterns.example: Print each job one by one → job progress starts from 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Filter by job name — matching jobs visible, search term highlighted
verificationPatterns.example: All jobs that are matching the filter will be shown, and the text in filter will be highlighted in the jobs names

verificationPatterns.pattern: Filter by substrate name — matching jobs visible, search term highlighted in substrate field
verificationPatterns.example: All jobs that are matching the filter will be shown, and the text in filter will be highlighted in the jobs substrate names

verificationPatterns.pattern: Filter persists after bulk action (move to print queue)
verificationPatterns.example: Filter still working, jobs selected moved to print queue and filter still active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Selection + action while filter active — only filtered-visible jobs move
verificationPatterns.example: Select some jobs and press move to print queue — filter still working, jobs selected moved to print queue

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print all queued jobs and verify completion
verificationPatterns.example: Print the jobs; verify all 100 jobs printed successfully

verificationPatterns.pattern: Drag-and-drop parity with button actions
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat all move operations using drag and drop; verify same outcomes as button-based steps

verificationPatterns.pattern: No 'Next to print' in OFF state
verificationPatterns.example: Press state = OFF and there is no 'Next to print' indication

verificationPatterns.pattern: No 'Next to print' while queue loaded but press in Standby
verificationPatterns.example: 5 jobs loaded successfully to print queue and there is no 'Next to print' indication

verificationPatterns.pattern: 'Next to print' appears only for first job when press reaches Ready
verificationPatterns.example: Press state = get ready and there is 'Next to print' indication for the first job

verificationPatterns.pattern: Printing state replaces 'Next to print' with 'Now printing' for current job
verificationPatterns.example: Press state = Printing and there is no 'Next to print' indication, instead appear now printing status for the current printing job

verificationPatterns.pattern: Only first job in queue shows 'Next to print' after restoring retained jobs
verificationPatterns.example: 5 jobs loaded successfully to print queue the 1st jobs only appear as next to print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Special jobs (e.g. lph focus calibration) show neither 'Next to print' nor 'Now printing'
verificationPatterns.example: Press state = Printing and there is no 'Next to print' indication, and no now printing indication

verificationPatterns.pattern: Short jobs concurrent print: multiple jobs appear in 'Now printing' simultaneously
verificationPatterns.example: While printing 2 jobs appear in now printing indication

verificationPatterns.pattern: Single-job action in maximized retain list
verificationPatterns.example: Select 1 job and press held → Selected job move to held list

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-job (2) action in maximized retain list
verificationPatterns.example: Select 2 jobs and press held button → Selected jobs move to held list

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-job move to print queue preserves order
verificationPatterns.example: Select 2 jobs and press move to print queue → Selected jobs move to print queue list as last in order

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-job remove from press
verificationPatterns.example: Select 2 jobs and press remove from press → Selected jobs move to DFE press controller

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat all retain-list actions in mini-window view
verificationPatterns.example: Open the retain list in mini window → repeat single/multi held, move to print queue, remove from press actions

verificationPatterns.pattern: Single-job drag to print queue appends last
verificationPatterns.example: Select 1 job and drag to print queue → job appears as last in print queue order

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-job (2) drag to print queue appends last
verificationPatterns.example: Select 2 jobs and drag to print queue → both jobs appear as last in print queue order

verificationPatterns.pattern: Single-job remove-from-press routes to DFE
verificationPatterns.example: Select 1 job and press 'remove from press' → job moves to DFE press controller

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-job (2) remove-from-press routes to DFE
verificationPatterns.example: Select 2 jobs and press 'remove from press' → jobs move to DFE press controller

verificationPatterns.pattern: Drag-to-print-queue works from mini window
verificationPatterns.example: Open retain list in mini window, select 1 or 2 jobs and drag → jobs append last to print queue

verificationPatterns.pattern: All operations repeat successfully during active print
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat all drag/remove steps while press is printing → all steps pass

verificationPatterns.pattern: Single job move via toolbar button
verificationPatterns.example: Select 1 job in print queue and press on held button → Selected job move to held jobs list.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-job move via toolbar button
verificationPatterns.example: Select 2 jobs in print queue and press held button → Selected jobs move to held jobs list.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Move to print queue preserves order
verificationPatterns.example: Select 1 job from held list and select move to print queue → Selected job move to print queue as last in order.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Remove job sends to DFE press controller
verificationPatterns.example: Select 1 job from held list and press remove → Selected job remove from press to DFE press controller.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-job remove sends to DFE press controller
verificationPatterns.example: Select 2 jobs from held list and press remove → Selected jobs remove from press to DFE press controller.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat all toolbar actions when held list is maximized
verificationPatterns.example: When held list is maximize, Select 1 job in print queue and press on held button → Selected job move to held jobs list.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat all toolbar actions when held list is in mini screen
verificationPatterns.example: When held list is in mini screen, Select 1 job from held list and select move to print queue → Selected job move to print queue as last in order.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify layout state before action (maximize / mini)
verificationPatterns.example: Maximize held jobs list → Held Job list is maximized. / Maximize the print queue and open the held list in mini screen → Held job is open in mini window.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Single-job drag from print queue to held list
verificationPatterns.example: Select 1 job in print queue and drag it to held — selected job moves to held jobs list

verificationPatterns.pattern: Single-job drag from held list to print queue (appends at end)
verificationPatterns.example: Select 1 job from held list and drag it to print queue — selected job moves to print queue as last in order

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-job drag from held list to print queue (appends at end)
verificationPatterns.example: Select 2 jobs from held list and drag to print queue — selected jobs move to print queue as last in order

verificationPatterns.pattern: Drag to held button while held list is maximized (single job)
verificationPatterns.example: When held list is maximized, select 1 job in print queue and drag it to held button — selected job moves to held jobs list

verificationPatterns.pattern: Drag to held button while held list is maximized (multi-job)
verificationPatterns.example: When held list is maximized, select 2 jobs in print queue and drag to button — selected jobs move to held jobs list

verificationPatterns.pattern: Remove jobs from press via held mini-screen (multi-job)
verificationPatterns.example: When held list is in mini screen, select 2 jobs from held list and select remove — selected jobs remove from press to DFE press controller

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat full drag-and-drop matrix during active print
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat steps during print — all steps pass successfully

verificationPatterns.pattern: View state toggle: maximize held list / mini-screen held list
verificationPatterns.example: Maximize held jobs list — held job list is maximized; maximize print queue and open held list in mini screen — held job opens in mini window

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI length display correctness
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that the job length are displayed correctly in the UI.

verificationPatterns.pattern: No IBS position or WHS errors after print
verificationPatterns.example: Jobs are printed successfully, no IBS position or WHS in general errors observed.

verificationPatterns.pattern: No significant substrate gap between consecutive images
verificationPatterns.example: There should be no significant gap between the images on the substrate.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Short-then-long job sequence with all length variants
verificationPatterns.example: Place 1m job first in print queue and 5.2m second. Repeat replacing 1m with 2m, 3m, 4m, 5m, and max printable area increments.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mixed scaling factors on short+long job pairs
verificationPatterns.example: Print a combination of short job followed by a long one, with different scaling factors.

verificationPatterns.pattern: ILS self-calibration success (short jobs, slow web advance)

verificationPatterns.pattern: ATP wizard print passes without WHS errors
verificationPatterns.example: No IBS position or WHS in general errors observed.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Continuous mode with various job sizes creates diverse transitions
verificationPatterns.example: Print 5-6 not too short jobs with various sizes, in continuous mode, to create various transitions.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event publication check — verify named LPH event is published after alarm injection
verificationPatterns.example: Ensure LPH_FW_UPGRADE_FAILED Event is published

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press falls from Print to Ready on non-critical alarms
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the press fell to Ready from Print; Verify in case issue still appear there is availability on print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press falls Ready → OFF on critical/fatal thermal or internal severity-2 alarms
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the press fall to Ready and after that to OFF; Ensure the SW turn off lph voltage

verificationPatterns.pattern: LPH voltage off — verify SW shuts off LPH voltage on critical thermal events
verificationPatterns.example: Ensure the SW turn off lph voltage

verificationPatterns.pattern: LPH moves to wait_setup on startup-class alarms
verificationPatterns.example: LPH's should move to wait setup

verificationPatterns.pattern: SWR event table completeness check — all alarm types have a What to Do description
verificationPatterns.example: Go to SWR event table. Verify all events appear with What to do Description.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error is logged on operation failure
verificationPatterns.example: in any operations that failed - Error logged

verificationPatterns.pattern: No ERROR EVENT surfaced to user on operation failure
verificationPatterns.example: No ERROR EVENT display to user

verificationPatterns.pattern: ABORT_SESSION alarm → PC aborts active session, falls to Ready, emits PC event
verificationPatterns.example: ALARM_TYPE_LINK_DISCONNECTION: 'Abort session immediately if needed; Fall to ready; Give availability on print if issue still persists' → PC Event: LPH_OPTIC_CABLE_DISCONNECTED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Critical overheat alarm (SW or HW threshold) → abort, fall to Ready then Off, SW actively disables LPH voltage
verificationPatterns.example: ALARM_TYPE_OVERHEAT_CRITICAL_SW_THRESHOLD: 'Abort session immediately if needed; Fall to ready and then to Off; SW app shall actively turn of LPHs by setting disable_voltage_LPH_heads[x]' → PC Event: LPH_TEMP_PANIC_HIGH

verificationPatterns.pattern: POWER_CYCLE alarm → abort session, fall to Ready then Off
verificationPatterns.example: ALARM_TYPE_SPARK_INTERNAL_SW_FAILURE: 'Abort session immediately if needed; Fall to ready and then to Off' → PC Event: LPH_INTERNAL_ERROR

verificationPatterns.pattern: Startup/init failure (LPHC moves to wait_setup) → PC issues error, emits LPH_STARTUP_FAILED
verificationPatterns.example: ALARM_TYPE_LPH_STARTUP_FAILURE: 'Issue Error' → PC Event: LPH_STARTUP_FAILED; same pattern for ALARM_TYPE_FPGA_SIDE_TEST_FAILURE, ALARM_TYPE_CONNECTORS_FAILURE, ALARM_TYPE_DIAGNOSTIC_TEST_FAILURE, ALARM_TYPE_NVRAM_FAILURE

verificationPatterns.pattern: LPHC NONE action + no-state-change expected → PC takes no action
verificationPatterns.example: ALARM_TYPE_OVERHEAT_WARNING_SW_THRESHOLD: 'no state change' → PC Event: LPH_TEMP_HIGH

verificationPatterns.pattern: Hot-folder-only alarms with NONE action → PC no action needed
verificationPatterns.example: ALARM_TYPE_SPARK_ZMOD_RAMP_AUTO_UPDATE_FAILED and ALARM_TYPE_LED_UNIFORMITY_AUTO_UPDATE_FAILED: 'no action needed'

verificationPatterns.pattern: ALARM_TYPE_SW_ERROR PC response branches on alarm severity
verificationPatterns.example: ALARM_SEVERITY_ATTENTION → no action needed; ALARM_SEVERITY_RESTART_LPHC → abort session, fall to ready, reset LPH host and LPHC → PC Event: LPH_INTERNAL_ERROR

verificationPatterns.pattern: FSM error with LPHC_RESET action → abort, fall to ready, reset LPH host and LPHC (future)
verificationPatterns.example: ALARM_TYPE_FSM_ERROR: 'Abort session immediately; Fall to ready; reset LPH host and LPHC FUTURE' → PC Event: LPH_INTERNAL_ERROR

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mismatch alarms (SEP ID, line count) with NONE LPHC action → press stops printing from APP side, abort, fall to ready
verificationPatterns.example: ALARM_TYPE_SEP_ID_MISMATCH: 'Abort session immediately; Fall to ready' → PC Event: LPH_SLICE_MISSMATCH

verificationPatterns.pattern: FW upgrade failure → PC gives availability on GR (future work marker)
verificationPatterns.example: ALARM_TYPE_SPARK_UPDATE_FAILED: 'Give availability on GR FUTURE' → PC Event: LPH_FW_UPGRADE_FAILED

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI opens and lists only active items
verificationPatterns.example: INK status opened and displaying the active INKs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Window renders within screen bounds when opened from secondary screen
verificationPatterns.example: Window open and displayed in screen bounds.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Deactivating a station removes it from the status view
verificationPatterns.example: INK station should not be displayed on window

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert report raised per active LPH after print trigger
verificationPatterns.example: Daily status report shall be raised for each active LPH

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify named fields present in ES report payload
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in ES: LphSN, FrontRunoutArray, RearRunoutArray, FrontSensorArray, RearSensorArray, ASIDMotorArray, HardStopFrontMotorPosition, HardStopRearMotorPosition, HardStopFrontSensorReading, HardStopRearSensorReading

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-active-station report isolation
verificationPatterns.example: LPH run-out report shall be raised separately for each active LPH (6 stations)

verificationPatterns.pattern: ES field presence check for run-out data
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in ES: LphSN, FrontRunOutAfterCorrectionP2P, FrontRunOutBeforeCorrectionP2P, RearRunOutAfterCorrectionP2P, RearRunOutBeforeCorrectionP2P, MotorLphEngageFrontPosition, MotorLphEngageRearPosition

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass reduces active station count — verify no ES data for bypassed stations
verificationPatterns.example: Set bypass for two stations and repeat test; verify new data appears in ES only for active stations (4 stations)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration action flags reflect start-mode: Previous skips full reset; Default triggers full reset
verificationPatterns.example: Start=Previous → asid tables precalibration=False, zero blanket tables=False, zero Offsets=False; Start=Default → all three=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI reports Pass after calibration regardless of scenario
verificationPatterns.example: UI: Pass (all three steps)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-calibration CPR Result state matches expected snapshot
verificationPatterns.example: After step 1: PreviousCalibrationRunWithEncoder flips False (was True pre-cal); PreviousCalibrationEncoderDataValid and PreviousCalibrationReferenceStation retain or update per scenario

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert asid tables precalibration flag matches expected value
verificationPatterns.example: asid tables precalibration = True (steps 1,2,6) or False (steps 3,4,5); note extra first iteration when False but encoder present or reference station mismatch

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert zero blanket tables flag matches expected value
