verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert zero Offsets flag matches expected value
verificationPatterns.example: zero Offsets = True when PreviousCalibrationEncoderDataValid=True; False when PreviousCalibrationEncoderDataValid=False (steps 5,6)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert UI reports Pass after calibration run completes
verificationPatterns.example: UI: Pass — verified in all six steps regardless of precondition combination

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert CPR Result fields updated correctly post-calibration
verificationPatterns.example: PreviousCalibrationRunWithEncoder and PreviousCalibrationEncoderDataValid reflect actual run outcome; PreviousCalibrationReferenceStation retains config value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard pass with quantitative threshold verified via Kibana
verificationPatterns.example: Wizard passed. CPR result should be < 100um. See in Kibana

verificationPatterns.pattern: Success-with-warning result includes exact advisory text message when ILS encoder data unavailable
verificationPatterns.example:
Result: Success with warning
Text message: Missing data from ILS encoder. Scaling linearity calibration was not performed. Check the ILS encoder wiring connection. Contact Customer Care.

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-sequence check: confirm Stir is Engaged before blanket returns to print, cross-referenced against BKT lifecycle status signals
verificationPatterns.example: After AtPeeling ends, verify AtEngage is true before AtPrePrint / AtPrint / AtPostPrint / AtDynamicReady transitions occur

verificationPatterns.pattern: Scope time-marker transition capture: place marker at exact timestamp of a boolean signal false→true edge
verificationPatterns.example: Place time marker at the moment gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Comp.Engage.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtEngage transitions from false to true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket-position calculation from raw encoder value: (raw_value × scaling_factor) / 1000 = distance in mm from blanket start
Range-based pass/fail: assert calculated mm position falls within the nonprintable area bounds
verificationPatterns.example: Assert result is between 5330 mm and 5880 mm (nonprintable area)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stir engage rises to TRUE after peeling ends and before print starts (PRE-print gate)
verificationPatterns.example: Verify AtEngage goes false→true after AtPeeling drops, while AtPrePrint is active and before AtPrint asserts

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket position at engage moment must map to non-printable area via scaling formula
verificationPatterns.example: Read BktPosRel_units at exact AtEngage false→true transition; compute (raw_value × 0.12465054251280902) / 1000 = mm from blanket start; acceptable range is 5330–5880 mm

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stir engage during POST-print also confined to non-printable area (repeat position check)
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat steps 1-5 for the post-print stage; same scaling formula and 5330–5880 mm acceptance range applies

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify reference station ID updated in PEX signal after calibration save
verificationPatterns.example: Ref station changed (Press.IBL.Calibrations.ConcreteCalibrations.Cpr.CprIlsAlgorithmResultEntity.ReferenceStationIdOfLastCalibration.ID)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify new reference station ASID table values reset to zero
verificationPatterns.example: Asid table values of new reference station changed to zero

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify bypassed/old reference station receives updated ASID table values
verificationPatterns.example: Old reference station (5) got new asid table values

verificationPatterns.pattern: Active stations have non-zero ASID tables; reference station has all-zero ASID table
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in PEX that all active station have asid tables exclude reference station. In ref. station should be all zero

verificationPatterns.pattern: ASID table values unchanged after re-running calibration from previous state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in PEX that all values of asid tables was not changed after last calibration.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify wizard outcome via Kibana log
verificationPatterns.example: Wizard passed with correct CPR result (see in Kibana).

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify signal value updated to expected integer after calibration run
verificationPatterns.example: Ref station changed to 5 in: Press.IBL.Calibrations.ConcreteCalibrations.Cpr.CprIlsAlgorithmResultEntity.ReferenceStationIdOfLastCalibration.ID

verificationPatterns.pattern: Flag-on-property-change: assert calibration-required flag set when substrate property differs
verificationPatterns.example: PEX:IBL.JumpOverSpliceEntity.SpliceSensorCalibrationRequired = True after changing substrate material/type/thickness/facestock

verificationPatterns.pattern: Scope-spike: assert boolean output signal pulses True at start of Print operation
verificationPatterns.example: Scope on gIOs.Web.Ctrl.Out.SpliceTeach.Data.Value shows a 'True' spike at print start

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC-step-status: assert OPCUA StepsStatus[0] transitions through known enum values (0=Idle, 1=InProgress, 4=Succeeded)
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUA.Global.Operations.Print.OperationData0.StepsStatus[0] = 1 during calibration, then = 4 on success

verificationPatterns.pattern: Feedback-signal: assert hardware OK feedback signal goes True after successful teach
verificationPatterns.example: gIos.Web.Ctrl.In.SpliceSensOKFdbk.Data.Value = True on calibration success

verificationPatterns.pattern: Flag-cleared: assert calibration-required flag resets to False after successful teach
verificationPatterns.example: PEX:IBL.JumpOverSpliceEntity.SpliceSensorCalibrationRequired = False after teach succeeds

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor-reading: assert binary sensor value matches physical state (0=no splice, 1=splice present)
verificationPatterns.example: gIOs.Web.Ctrl.In.SpliceSens.Data.Value = 0 over regular substrate, = 1 when over splice or manually covered

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log-message: assert specific log entry appears and no Kibana event is emitted
verificationPatterns.example: 'WebMngr, Detect splice in web, 0' in logs with no Kibana event

verificationPatterns.pattern: No-repeat-teach: assert teach output stays False and StepsStatus remains Idle on next print when no substrate change
verificationPatterns.example: gIOs.Web.Ctrl.Out.SpliceTeach.Data.Value = False throughout print; OPCUA.Global.Operations.Print.OperationData0.StepsStatus[0] = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Re-trigger-on-new-substrate: assert calibration-required flag resets to True when different substrate type installed
verificationPatterns.example: PEX:IBL.JumpOverSpliceEntity.SpliceSensorCalibrationRequired = True after installing substrate of different type

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration-required flag set when substrate property changes
verificationPatterns.example: PEX:IBL.JumpOverSpliceEntity.SpliceSensorCalibrationRequired = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: No teach pulse during paperless wizard — scope data stays False
verificationPatterns.example: no 'True' spike in scope data of gIOs.Web.Ctrl.Out.SplieTeach.Data.Value

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC step status reflects idle when teach not performed
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUA.Global.Operations.Print.OperationData0.StepsStatus[0] = 0 (Idle)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration-required flag persists True after paperless wizard completes
verificationPatterns.example: PEX:IBL.JumpOverSpliceEntity.SpliceSensorCalibrationRequired = True after AutoBias

verificationPatterns.pattern: Teach pulse fires and returns during printing wizard — momentary True then False
verificationPatterns.example: gIOs.Web.Ctrl.Out.SplieTeach.Data.Value becomes 'True' for a short time then returns to 'False'

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC step status reflects success when teach performed
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUA.Global.Operations.Print.OperationData0.StepsStatus[0] = 4 (Succeeded)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration-required flag clears after successful teach in printing wizard
verificationPatterns.example: PEX:IBL.JumpOverSpliceEntity.SpliceSensorCalibrationRequired = False at end of print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Force input signal to simulate failure state, verify dependent feature is disabled
verificationPatterns.example: Force gIOs.Web.Ctrl.In.SpliceSens.Data.Value = 1 → confirm Jump Over Splice feature not active. NOTE: Not implemented yet.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter controls output signal active duration: set param, run teach, scope output signal on-time matches param value
verificationPatterns.example: Set WebFeedLengthDuringTeach = 5 → gIOs.Web.Ctrl.Out.SpliceTeach.Data.Value raised True for 5 metres of substrate feed during teach

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter controls output signal trigger threshold: set param, run teach, scope confirms output rises only after measured variable crosses threshold
verificationPatterns.example: Set WebMinVelocityForTeach = 1 → gIOs.Web.Ctrl.Out.SpliceTeach.Data.Value raised True after Vavg reaches 1 m/s

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass activation state check via BypassEntity signal
verificationPatterns.example: After executing BypassCommand(35).JumpOverSpliceBypass, verify PEX:IBL.BypassEntity(35).JumpOverSpliceBypass = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Teach suppression during active bypass: scope signal shows no spike
verificationPatterns.example: Scope gIOs.Web.Ctrl.Out.SplieTeach.Data.Value during print; expect no True spike while bypass is active

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC StepsStatus idle when operation is suppressed by bypass
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUA.Global.Operations.Print.OperationData0.StepsStatus[0] = 0 (Idle) indicates calibration was not performed

verificationPatterns.pattern: CalibrationRequired flag persists during bypass, clears after successful teach
verificationPatterns.example: SpliceSensorCalibrationRequired = True while bypassed; = False after teach completes successfully post-bypass-removal

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass deactivation state check via BypassEntity signal
verificationPatterns.example: After removing bypass, verify PEX:IBL.BypassEntity(35).JumpOverSpliceBypass = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Teach execution confirmed via transient True spike on scope signal
verificationPatterns.example: gIOs.Web.Ctrl.Out.SplieTeach.Data.Value becomes True briefly then returns to False during next print

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC StepsStatus success after unblocked operation completes
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUA.Global.Operations.Print.OperationData0.StepsStatus[0] = 4 (Succeeded) after teach runs post-bypass-removal

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration-required flag set by substrate change
verificationPatterns.example: PEX:IBL.JumpOverSpliceEntity.SpliceSensorCalibrationRequired = True after thickness save

verificationPatterns.pattern: Teach output signal produces a True spike at print start
verificationPatterns.example: Scope on gIOs.Web.Ctrl.Out.SpliceTeach.Data.Value shows a 'True' spike at beginning of Print operation

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC manager step status transitions: InProgress then Failed/Succeeded
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUA.Global.Operations.Print.OperationData0.StepsStatus[0] = 1 (InProgress) -> 3 (Failed) or 4 (Succeeded)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event visible in UI and logs without stopping print job
verificationPatterns.example: WEB_SPLICE_TEACH_FAILED appears in UI and logs; job prints to end

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration-required flag persists after failure
verificationPatterns.example: PEX:IBL.JumpOverSpliceEntity.SpliceSensorCalibrationRequired remains True after both failure cases

verificationPatterns.pattern: Splice detection suppressed when calibration failed
verificationPatterns.example: 'Web splice detected' error does NOT appear in Web_Ctrl PLC logs when sensor triggered during failed-calibration state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Successful teach on next print clears calibration-required flag
verificationPatterns.example: gIOs.Web.Ctrl.Out.SplieTeach.Data.Value True then False; SpliceSensOKFdbk = True; StepsStatus[0] = 4 (Succeeded); SpliceSensorCalibrationRequired = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boolean flag toggles on substrate property change
verificationPatterns.example: PEX:IBL.JumpOverSpliceEntity.SpliceSensorCalibrationRequired = False before change, True after Set as installed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Scope spike confirms signal goes True during operation
verificationPatterns.example: Scope of gIOs.Web.Ctrl.Out.SpliceTeach.Data.Value shows a True spike at beginning of Print

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC step status progresses through defined enum values
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUA.Global.Operations.Print.OperationData0.StepsStatus[0]: 1 (InProgress) during teach, 4 (Succeeded) on completion, 0 (Idle) when teach not performed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Feedback signal confirms hardware success
verificationPatterns.example: gIos.Web.Ctrl.In.SpliceSensOKFdbk.Data.Value = True when splice sensor returns calibration success

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor binary reading verified against physical state
verificationPatterns.example: gIOs.Web.Ctrl.In.SpliceSens.Data.Value = 0 over regular substrate, = 1 over splice or manually covered

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log message present but no event forwarded to monitoring
verificationPatterns.example: "WebMngr, Detect splice in web, 0" appears in logs; no event sent to Kibana

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal stays False on subsequent print when teach not needed
verificationPatterns.example: gIOs.Web.Ctrl.Out.SpliceTeach.Data.Value = False throughout printing after successful teach

verificationPatterns.pattern: Teach flag set after substrate property change
verificationPatterns.example: PEX:IBL.JumpOverSpliceEntity.SpliceSensorCalibrationRequired = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Teach execution confirmed via scope spike
verificationPatterns.example: True spike in scope data of gIOs.Web.Ctrl.Out.SplieTeach.Data.Value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Teach execution confirmed via OPC-UA calibration status
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUA.Global.Operations.Print.OperationData0.StepsStatus[0] = 4 (Succeeded)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Teach flag cleared after successful print
verificationPatterns.example: PEX:IBL.JumpOverSpliceEntity.SpliceSensorCalibrationRequired = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Splice sensor simulation — manual (tape) or forced via IO Editor
verificationPatterns.example: Put tape under splice sensor OR force gIOs.Web.Ctrl.In.Splice_Sens.Data.Value = 1 via IO Editor; clear when web begins to move

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard title shows installed substrate name
verificationPatterns.example: Under the title of Blanket Cleaning the Name of installed substrate appear

verificationPatterns.pattern: Validation error disables action button
verificationPatterns.example: When Validation Error occurred the Play button is disabled (e.g. Empty rotations 5555555, Cleaner Rotations 5555555555)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Manual numeric entry accepted for spin-box fields
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the user can enter manually Num of rotations according to the Req

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dynamic estimation text updates with spin-box values
verificationPatterns.example: "Based on above values cleaning will use about {length} {lengthUnits} of substrate" and "This usually takes about {time} {timeUnits}"

verificationPatterns.pattern: In-progress state: inputs locked, button transitions, progress text replaces estimation, Close disabled
verificationPatterns.example: Spin-boxes disabled; Button changes to Stop; estimation replaced with "Rotation {current} of {required}"; Close button disabled; Current action label shows "Cleaning..."

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stop action restores idle-like state and shows stopping reason
verificationPatterns.example: Stop button changes to Replay; Time estimation replaces progress text; Spin-boxes and Close button re-enabled; Stopping reason is shown

verificationPatterns.pattern: External press state change interrupts wizard
verificationPatterns.example: While wizard is in progress, change press to OFF → wizard status changes to interrupted

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation state transition on trigger
verificationPatterns.example: BKT Cleaning operation should initiate and system should transition to the cleaning process

verificationPatterns.pattern: Full-area solid color print output
verificationPatterns.example: solid yellow color across the entire printable area (100% Solid Yellow)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Component engagement verified via signal value
verificationPatterns.example: T2 Should engaged — NS4|String|gInterface.Web.Comp.WHS.Comp.IPE.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtEngage

verificationPatterns.pattern: Image clipping bounded by substate width
verificationPatterns.example: Image should clipping according to substate width

verificationPatterns.pattern: Scaling factor derived from formula (max printable area / image scaling factor)
Coexistence: verify concurrent subsystem completes its cycle without interference during wizard run
verificationPatterns.example: Stir performs build after 10 BKT rotations and peeling without issue while BKT cleaning passes

verificationPatterns.pattern: Resource-exhaustion interruption: verify press stops gracefully and Run button becomes unavailable with correct tooltip
verificationPatterns.example: During BKT cleaning UW/RW goes empty/full; press stops post-print at end of BKT rotation; Run button disabled with right tooltip

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fallback selection: verify wizard substitutes next most-efficient resource when configured resource is deactivated
verificationPatterns.example: Yellow ink deactivated at OFF state; wizard prints on next ink by clean efficiency (magenta)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal-triggered interruption: inject signal value to simulate fault and verify wizard is interrupted
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate low ink density (OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Inks.Ink2.HW_Inputs.Rdu.Density = 500); wizard is interrupted

verificationPatterns.pattern: Image geometry clipping: verify image width is clipped to match installed substrate width across multiple substrate types
verificationPatterns.example: Run wizard with substrates 330, 220, 270 width; with BOPP, coated paper, uncoated paper; image clipped to substrate width each time

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI info disclosure: verify wizard description is accessible via info icon
verificationPatterns.example: Click 'i' icon in Blanket Cleaning wizard; short description appears

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter persistence across SW upgrade: change params, run wizard, close, perform SW upgrade, reopen and verify values retained
verificationPatterns.example: EmptyBlanketRevolutions and CleanerBlanketRevolutions keep persistency after SW upgrade

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bidirectional UI/entity sync: change param via UI and verify entity updates; change entity and verify UI updates
verificationPatterns.example: Change EmptyBlanketRevolutions / CleanerBlanketRevolutions default; verify UI updates; change via UI and verify entity updated

verificationPatterns.pattern: Report generation: verify Print Attempt report and local report are published including wizard parameters
verificationPatterns.example: PTA published; local report includes EmptyBlanketRevolutions and CleanerBlanketRevolutions; Print Sessions captured

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press-state availability matrix: verify wizard operation is available only in expected states
verificationPatterns.example: BlanketCleaning OP available at Ready and D.Ready; not available at OFF, Mech, GR, Service, Print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal mapping: verify PEX entity field transfers to OPC-UA imported data counterpart
verificationPatterns.example: PEX.PrimingProfileEntity.Corona.MinPower -> OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.Corona.Param.MinPower.Value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dry print: verify active corona and priming values match expected profile values during print execution
verificationPatterns.example: Perform a dry print; confirm correct priming and corona values are used

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-transition coverage: repeat substrate value verification entering SWF from each applicable machine state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify correct substrate priming and corona values during SWF from Standby, Ready, and Dynamic Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Write-lock check: verify substrate properties are read-only while SFW or Print is active
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that substrate properties cannot be changed during SFW or Print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Compare PEX entity field values against spec table for priming profile defaults
verificationPatterns.example: Compare profile values in PEX:IBL.PrimingProfileEntity 1-7 with table 3.2.2; verify Corona required/not required, Corona power, Priming required/not required, Dryer Ready/Print, Blower Ready/Print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Compare PEX entity field values against HP recommended limits in spec
verificationPatterns.example: Compare profile values in PEX:IBL.PrimingProfileEntity 0-7 with table 3.2.2 (HP recommended); verify Corona power, Dryer temperature Ready/Print, Blower speed Ready/Print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Compare PEX config entity fields against allowed min/max values in spec
verificationPatterns.example: Compare profile values in PEX:IBL.PrimingAndCoronaConfigEntity 1-7 with table 3.2.2 (Possible values); verify Corona power, Dryer temperature Ready/Print, Blower speed Ready/Print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify PEX value changes propagate to UI and OPCUA after wizard restart
verificationPatterns.example: Arbitrarily change working point (HP default), HP recommended, and min/max profile values in PEX; restart Substrate list wizard; confirm HP defaults and recommended changes appear in UI priming profile, and min/max changes reflect correctly in OPCUA

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default priming profile values match expected profile constants
verificationPatterns.example: Corona - Not required; Priming - Required; Dryer Ready=40, Print=70; Blower Ready=3300, Print=5000; Anilox=Hex 3.25; Rubber=EPDM 70; Primer=Q4324

verificationPatterns.pattern: PEX-created substrate properties match IBL entity reference for the same profile
verificationPatterns.example: Expand properties of PEX substrate, verify Priming and Corona equal IBL:PrimingProfileEntity.Profile 4

verificationPatterns.pattern: Duplicated substrate properties are identical to the original substrate
verificationPatterns.example: Compare priming and corona properties of original and duplicated substrate — all fields must be equal

verificationPatterns.pattern: Type change triggers correct profile reassignment with partial custom overrides
verificationPatterns.example: Change Type=Film, material=PVC; set Corona power=411, Dryer Print=69, Blower Ready=2345; verify remaining fields retain profile 6 defaults (Blower Print=4500, Anilox=Hex 3.25, Rubber=EPDM 70, Primer=Q4324)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Duplicate of customized substrate carries all custom field values
verificationPatterns.example: Compare priming and corona of custom substrate and its duplicate — all fields including overrides must be equal

verificationPatterns.pattern: Priming/corona values set on installed substrate are applied exactly during print and SWF
verificationPatterns.example: Set substrate as installed, print arbitrary job, perform SWF, verify exact dryer and primer values in use

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI priming/corona property values after type+material change
verificationPatterns.example: After Label->PE: Corona=Required, Corona power=400, Priming=Required, Dryer Ready=40, Dryer Print=60, Blower Ready=3300, Blower Print=5000, Anilox=Hex 3.25, Rubber=EPDM 70, Primer=Q4324

verificationPatterns.pattern: PEX verification: priming profile entity matches expected profile number
verificationPatterns.example: Expand changed substrate properties, verify Priming and Corona equal IBL:PrimingProfileEntity.Profile 2

verificationPatterns.pattern: Non-type/material property changes must not alter priming profile
verificationPatterns.example: Change all properties of substrate, keep only type=Paper and material=Coated; verify priming/corona values remain unchanged

verificationPatterns.pattern: Installed substrate is read-only during Print or SWF
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that installed substrate cannot be edited during Print or SWF (screenshot evidence expected)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default and recommended range display on field activation
verificationPatterns.example: Enable Corona treating, activate Corona field, enter 1100 + activate another field → HP default and recommended values appear per PrimingProfileEntity; Save button available.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Out-of-allowed-range entry shows red validation and blocks save with error dialog
verificationPatterns.example: Enter Corona=3000 → allowed values shown in red per PrimingAndCoronaConfigEntity; Save button available but pressing it shows error dialog and substrate is not saved.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cancel discards in-session change and retains last-saved value
verificationPatterns.example: After entering out-of-range 3000, press Cancel → Corona power remains 1100 for selected substrate.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sibling substrate sharing same priming profile is unaffected by edits to another substrate
verificationPatterns.example: Check second substrate created at test start (never edited) → Priming and Corona values unchanged (Corona=400).

verificationPatterns.pattern: Restore HP Defaults reverts all user changes to profile defaults
verificationPatterns.example: Select edited substrate → Priming&Corona area → Restore HP defaults → Corona power = 400.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Yellow warning on every user-defined value that deviates from newly selected default profile
verificationPatterns.example: Change substrate to Type=Label, Material=Wine white/cream → yellow warnings on all user-defined values differing from new default; priming parameters retain previous user values.

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI priming/corona property verification after substrate creation
verificationPatterns.example: Expand the properties of newly created substrate, verify that Priming and Corona properties are equal: Corona - Required/Not required, Corona power = <value>, Priming - Required, Dryer Ready = <value>, Dryer Print = <value>, Blower Ready = <value>, Blower Print = <value>, Anilox - Hex 3.25, Rubber - EPDM 70, Primer - Q4324

verificationPatterns.pattern: PEX priming/corona property verification against IBL PrimingProfileEntity
verificationPatterns.example: Expand the properties of newly created substrate, verify that Priming and Corona properties are equal to IBL:PrimingProfileEntity.Profile <N>

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print-time dryer and primer value verification during SWF
verificationPatterns.example: Print arbitrary job and perform SWF. Verify exact values of dryer and primer used during printing and SWF.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default material auto-selection verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that default material is selected (Other paper / Other film / Other label) when no material is explicitly chosen

verificationPatterns.pattern: Priming profile mapping by substrate type and material
verificationPatterns.example: Paper → Profile 4; Film default → Profile 7; Film PVC → Profile 6; Label default → Profile 8; Label PP → Profile 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Queue job during active print — verify next job auto-starts in continuous mode
verificationPatterns.example: During print in continues mode with one job - add another job to print queue; After press will finished the first job - press should continue printing the job that add to queue

verificationPatterns.pattern: Remove job from queue mid-print — verify removal allowed and remaining job prints in same session
verificationPatterns.example: during print add 2 jobs and remove one job from print queue; Remove is available during print and the job that left on print queue print in the same session as the job that printed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify press state after step mode job completion
verificationPatterns.example: press goes to Dynamic ready after print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mode button selection state
verificationPatterns.example: Step mode selected and button marked

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI control availability during print
verificationPatterns.example: Print mode buttons are disabled during print (Step); Print mode buttons enable during print (Continuous)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Job throughput matches mode behavior
verificationPatterns.example: Print start and stop after first job done (Step); The press printing all 5 jobs on queue (Continuous)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard failure state on mid-step fault
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate tension lost / web break during restore tension → wizard marked as failed (red) with notification that wizard values saved

verificationPatterns.pattern: Values persisted after wizard failure
verificationPatterns.example: Verify values saved after failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Graceful exit option on press state change during wizard
verificationPatterns.example: Move press to OFF from standby during UW replacement → wizard adds 'Save' button and user able to finish wizard

verificationPatterns.pattern: Web guide auto-mode transition on width change
verificationPatterns.example: Web guide should move to auto mode with new width value as the new substrate

verificationPatterns.pattern: User notification on substrate width delta >6mm
verificationPatterns.example: User shall notify when there is a change in substrate width "manual UW and RW web guide adjustment is required"

verificationPatterns.pattern: Web guide threading CMD on tension restore at Standby
verificationPatterns.example: Web guide gets "threading" CMD

verificationPatterns.pattern: Web guide returns to last mode after wizard close
verificationPatterns.example: WG return to "automatic mode" (Last WG mode)

verificationPatterns.pattern: User alert for splice reaching PWS web guide
verificationPatterns.example: User shall alerted "make sure splice reached PWS web guide."

verificationPatterns.pattern: Automatic splice jump on print start after UW replacement
verificationPatterns.example: The system will jump over splice automatically, no action is required from user.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Statistics report contains expected roll data after replacement
verificationPatterns.example: Statistics report should receive for the new roll: Substrate name, Removed Roll diameter, New Roll diameter, Core diameter

verificationPatterns.pattern: Feature unavailable when conflicting system state is active
verificationPatterns.example: Start web feed and try to release tension via UW replace wizard WHS_SYSTEM_WEB_FEED_IN_PROGRESS — Release tension not available with TT

verificationPatterns.pattern: Feature unavailability verified across multiple press modes
verificationPatterns.example: Open UW replace and verify on 1.Pre print 2.post print 3.MI that Release tension not available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Component enable state verified after substrate change
verificationPatterns.example: Verify after replacement to unprimed substrate that all ILP component enable ILp and dryer with all component active (Primer tank sensors, waste, dryer)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Physical actuator state verified at each step of a multi-step operation
verificationPatterns.example: Perform Release tension → tension released - clamps are down; restore tension → Clamps are up

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button enable/disable state reflects press state
verificationPatterns.example: 'Save and restore tension' button is disabled; 'Save' button appears with note 'Tension can not be restored in OFF...'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Close without saving leaves installed substrate unchanged
verificationPatterns.example: After pressing 'Close' button wizard is closed, installed substrate does not change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Save commits substrate selection and transfers data to PLC via OPC UA signals
verificationPatterns.example: After pressing 'Save' button wizard is closed, installed substrate changes to selected substrate; OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.UW.Param.Roll1.CoreDiameter.Value and IsDirectionCW.Value are written

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard greys out and offers reset/close options when press state changes while wizard is open

verificationPatterns.pattern: 'Are you sure' confirmation dialogue appears on Close in states above OFF
verificationPatterns.example: 'Cancel replacement' / 'No' dialogue appears; 'No' re-enables wizard with all information intact (not reset)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Correct tension status exported after Save and restore tension
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ExportedData.UW.Status.AtTension reflects current tension state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Release tension step skipped if tension already released before opening wizard
verificationPatterns.example: 'Release tension' button should be unavailable (Step marked as done)

verificationPatterns.pattern: WebFeed from wizard moves splice to RW inspection table
verificationPatterns.example: Perform WebFeed to RW from the wizard; WebFeed moves the splice to RW inspection table

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wash-required suppressed when milling never started
verificationPatterns.example: During UW replacement no notification for 'Wash required' since no milling start

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wash-required triggered when milling ran before replacement
verificationPatterns.example: Start milling on Standby with unprimed substrate and replace to primed substrate → Wash is required marked to user

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wash link present alongside wash-required indication
verificationPatterns.example: Link for wash should add

verificationPatterns.pattern: Get Ready disabled while unprimed substrate is loaded
verificationPatterns.example: perform Get ready to press with the unprimed substrate → get ready should be disable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print unavailable with tooltip (TT) when unprimed substrate active in ready state
verificationPatterns.example: Print should be unavailable to print with relevant TT

verificationPatterns.pattern: Clean replacement completion with no unexpected indications after swap
verificationPatterns.example: UW replacement should completed without special issues / indications

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default wizard option matches installed substrate
verificationPatterns.example: UW replacement opened with 'Continue with assigned substrate' as default

verificationPatterns.pattern: Web feed state reflects substrate selection (same vs different)
verificationPatterns.example: Web feed set to 'Impression' when same substrate selected; web feed set to 'Rewinder' when different substrate selected

verificationPatterns.pattern: New install option presented when different substrate selected
verificationPatterns.example: Screen shall be open with 'install a new substrate' option with the selected substrate

verificationPatterns.pattern: Roll replacement shortcut and info visible when opened from main UI tension-release menu
verificationPatterns.example: Bar opened with the 'Roll replacement' Shortcut; information about new roll replacement displayed; wizard for UW roll opened

verificationPatterns.pattern: Confirmation dialog appears when user attempts to close wizard mid-replacement
verificationPatterns.example: Question should pop up to user with question if he sure to close this window?

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard opens consistently from all entry points and aligns with screen
verificationPatterns.example: From substrate list, from UI, from main menu wizard — wizard open as expected and align with screen

verificationPatterns.pattern: Read-only params enforced when subsystem is under tension
verificationPatterns.example: Roll orientation and core diameter parameters shall be read only when tension is ON

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal-gated state: verify boolean/status signal reflects expected state after UI action

verificationPatterns.pattern: SingleWindowGroup=TRUE prevents parallel opening of grouped wizards
verificationPatterns.example: Verify wizards with SingleWindowGroup=TRUE (e.g. Color calibration, Quick scaling, Auto bias, CPR calibration, corner x, ILS calibration, LPH focus, LPH uniformity) cannot be opened in parallel; wizards with SingleWindowGroup=FALSE (e.g. ASID replacement, BID engage, web control) may be opened in parallel

verificationPatterns.pattern: ZONE_BUSY blocks Prepare button when same logical zone in use by another wizard in service MOO
verificationPatterns.example: While an operation is in progress at service sequence MOO, attempt to open a wizard requiring a different service MOO in the same logical zone; verify AppSW blocks the other wizard's Prepare button with message ZONE_BUSY; verify zone is released after operation completes

verificationPatterns.pattern: ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_PRALLEL blocks save substrate during active conflicting wizard
verificationPatterns.example: With color calibration open, attempt to Save installed substrate properties; verify message ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_PRALLEL. Same check with web control open.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press messages match specified format and parameter casing rules
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all press messages (ZONE_BUSY, PROCESS_ALREADY_OPEN, WINDOW_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_PRALLEL, ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED_IN_PRALLEL, EXIT_SERVICE) display correct text and that screen-name parameters have first letter capitalised, rest lower case

verificationPatterns.pattern: ASID selection blocked on deactivated ME station
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that user cannot select ASID from deactivated ME station

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tooltip indicates station inactive and unavailable for wizard
verificationPatterns.example: tool tip shall indicate station is not active and so not available for wizard operation

verificationPatterns.pattern: BID removal/installation changes not reflected in UI when BID station is deactivated
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that BID removal and installation is not reflected

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI displays explicit message placing responsibility on user for inactive BIDs
verificationPatterns.example: UI shall reflect a clear message for user, since Its user responsibility to remove not active BID's as required

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI ignores in-place status from inactive BIDs
verificationPatterns.example: UI shall ignore BID in place status from Inactive BIDs

verificationPatterns.pattern: BID remove step auto-marked done by UI for inactive BID
verificationPatterns.example: BID remove step shall be marked as done by UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cancel-at-every-step guard
verificationPatterns.example: Go through the wizard and verify that in every window of the wizard before clicking on Confirm and Continue button user can cancel the operation

verificationPatterns.pattern: SN field updates after scan
verificationPatterns.example: ASID SN should update

verificationPatterns.pattern: Hardware state gate before action
verificationPatterns.example: Support arm closed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dependent window opens after action
verificationPatterns.example: Linked calibration window opened

verificationPatterns.pattern: Re-scan resets wizard to step 1
verificationPatterns.example: User should redirected to first wizard step

verificationPatterns.pattern: Duplicate SN in same station — rejection message
verificationPatterns.example: Try to replace ASID with same SN that is in the selected station → user receives message that same SN ASID already installed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Duplicate SN across different station — rejection message
verificationPatterns.example: Try to replace ASID with SN installed in a different station than selected → user receives message that same SN ASID already installed

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI element enable/disable based on prior selection
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that 2nd ASID stations are disabled; Second ASID stations became enabled after ROR for 1st ASID selected

verificationPatterns.pattern: Window content matches reference screenshot
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that the instructions in the window are according the picture below

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service Maintenance state active after unlock
verificationPatterns.example: Verify service maintenance state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Side bar displays ASID metadata for both ASIDs
verificationPatterns.example: On the right side bar should appear data of: First ASID from station: Station, Installation time, SN, Impressions; Second ASID from station: Station, Installation time, SN, Impressions

verificationPatterns.pattern: Barcode scan populates SN field in wizard
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that when user get ASID SN field, Scanned ASID SN appears in the field

verificationPatterns.pattern: ASID counter data swapped between stations after Swap flow
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that ASIDs counter data also swapped: TotalaSiDRotations, TotalChargedaSiDRotations, ...

verificationPatterns.pattern: ASID counter values reset to 0 after Replace flow
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that ASIDs counter values set to '0': TotalaSiDRotations, TotalChargedaSiDRotations, ...

verificationPatterns.pattern: PEX reflects ASID swap
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that ASIDS swapped in the PEX

verificationPatterns.pattern: ROR assignment and IsSwap flag verified after swap
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that selected ROR connected to 1st chosen ASID; Verify that the second ASID ROR tagged automatically as SWAP; Verify that IsSwap flag = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Accepted SN format types verified
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that 3 types of SN accepted

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify proxy presence in service containers
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that Indigo proxy defined inside Connection service and Uploader containers

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify proxy cleared in containers after script sets empty string
verificationPatterns.example: Run Ofer M. script, when defined proxy is an empty string; Verify that proxy is empty in Connection service and Uploader containers

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify cloud connection status matches expected proxy configuration
verificationPatterns.example: Verify cloud connection / Verify that cloud not connected

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify ES data upload outcome matches proxy/connection state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that ES data uploaded to AWS / Verify that ES data not uploaded to AWS

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify custom proxy value propagated to both containers
verificationPatterns.example: Run Ofer M. script, when defined proxy is some not empty string; Verify that tested proxy was added to Connection service and Uploader containers

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify proxy value survives restart and SW startup
verificationPatterns.example: Restart computer; Start press SW; Verify that tested proxy in containers is not overridden

verificationPatterns.pattern: Screen title and default control state
verificationPatterns.example: Screen title is 'Printing Counters'; 'Meters' radio button selected by default under 'Display usage in:'; 'Close' button present

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ink column ordering: priority group first, then alphabetical
verificationPatterns.example: CMYKOVG inks listed first in left-hand column top to bottom; remaining inks listed alphabetically starting from middle column

verificationPatterns.pattern: No-data state shows placeholder string
verificationPatterns.example: If no data exists for an ink, counter displays '---'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Installed but unused ink shows zero
verificationPatterns.example: If ink installed but not yet used, counter displays '0'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ink name paired with correct color icon
verificationPatterns.example: Each ink entry shows a color drop icon representing that ink's correct color

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counters reflect active print job separations
verificationPatterns.example: After printing DFE job with random color separations, all relevant ink counters change accordingly

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button lit state reflects availability
verificationPatterns.example: UW SWF physical button is not lit. RW SWF physical button is not lit.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button press has no effect when blocked
verificationPatterns.example: When UW SWF physical button is pressed, SWF is not started. When RW SWF physical button is pressed, SWF is not started.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button lit and SWF starts when conditions met
verificationPatterns.example: UW SWF physical button is lit. When UW SWF physical button is pressed, SWF is started.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Roll diameter threshold gates SWF availability
verificationPatterns.example: Set roll diameter in UW to 166mm → buttons not lit. Set roll diameter in RW to 750mm → buttons not lit.

verificationPatterns.pattern: ILP primer fault blocks SWF only when substrate requires priming
verificationPatterns.example: Set primer level to 1 (Value = 1) with priming substrate → buttons not lit; with non-priming substrate → buttons lit and SWF starts.

verificationPatterns.pattern: ILP wash states (required, in progress) block SWF when substrate requires priming
verificationPatterns.example: Get Ready not available with tooltip 'ILP wash required'. UW/RW SWF physical buttons not lit.

verificationPatterns.pattern: SWF re-press mid-deceleration resumes acceleration
verificationPatterns.example: Before web comes to stop press physical button again and hold. Web starts decelerating, and when the button is pressed again starts accelerating.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Primer tank not in place blocks SWF only when substrate requires priming
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.HW_Inputs.ILP.PrimerTankInPlace.Value = 0 with priming substrate → buttons not lit; with non-priming substrate → buttons lit.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button lit state matches expected availability per press state
verificationPatterns.example: OFF state: UW clamp buttons are lit. RW clamp buttons are lit.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button press activates clamp only when button is lit
verificationPatterns.example: When UW clamp buttons are pressed, clamps are activated. / When RW clamp buttons are pressed, clamps are not activated.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tension release per axis independently enables that axis clamp buttons
verificationPatterns.example: Release tension in UW → UW clamp buttons lit, RW clamp buttons not lit. Release tension in RW → both lit.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Clamp buttons disabled in all states except OFF and tension-released condition
verificationPatterns.example: Power disabled, Standby, Get Ready, Ready/Dynamic Ready, Pre-Print, Print, Post-Print: buttons not lit, clamps not activated.

verificationPatterns.pattern: State traversal covers full press lifecycle in sequence
verificationPatterns.example: Power disabled → OFF → Standby → Get Ready → Ready → tension release steps → Pre-Print → Print → Post-Print → Ready.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Rebuilding tension on one axis re-disables that axis clamp while other stays enabled
verificationPatterns.example: Build tension in UW, keep RW released: UW buttons not lit, RW buttons lit.

verificationPatterns.pattern: SWF button LED encodes system state (lit=ready, blinking=transition pending)
verificationPatterns.example: UW SWF physical button is lit / RW SWF physical button is blinking

verificationPatterns.pattern: First SWF press when ILP not in Milling triggers ILP-to-Milling transition; SWF deferred until Milling reached
verificationPatterns.example: ILP does begins transition to Milling. SWF is performed only when ILP reaches Milling.

verificationPatterns.pattern: SWF does NOT auto-start once ILP reaches Milling; explicit button press required
verificationPatterns.example: UW SWF physical button is lit constantly. SWF is not performed (web is not moving).

verificationPatterns.pattern: Buzzer gated on 30-second cooldown between SWF presses
verificationPatterns.example: Buzzer is sounded if 30 seconds were passed from previous SWF button press.

verificationPatterns.pattern: SWF active only while button held; releases on button release
verificationPatterns.example: SWF continues all the time the button is pressed. Release UW SWF button — SWF is stopped successfully.

verificationPatterns.pattern: ILP remains in Milling state throughout and after SWF cycles
verificationPatterns.example: ILP remains in Milling. / ILP remains in Milling (does not change states).

verificationPatterns.pattern: Subsequent SWF waits for dryer to return to production temperature when ILP already in Milling/Ready
verificationPatterns.example: SWF is performed when dryer returns to production temperature since ILP is in Ready.

verificationPatterns.pattern: SWF button lit state tracks press state
verificationPatterns.example: In OFF state: UW/RW SWF physical button is not lit. In Standby state: UW/RW SWF physical button is lit.

verificationPatterns.pattern: SWF not performed when press is in OFF state
verificationPatterns.example: When UW SWF physical button is pressed, SWF is not performed. When RW SWF physical button is pressed, SWF is not performed.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Buzzer sounds on SWF button activation
verificationPatterns.example: Buzzer is sounded.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Both UW and RW SWF buttons blink during SWF execution
verificationPatterns.example: UW SWF physical button is blinking. RW SWF physical button is blinking.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dry mode: ILP stays out of Milling and dryer stays off
verificationPatterns.example: ILP does not transition to Milling state, dryer is not activated.

verificationPatterns.pattern: SWF executes ASAP without waiting for ILP in dry mode
verificationPatterns.example: SWF is performed ASAP, not waiting for ILP.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pre-condition failure blocks SWF start and keeps press in Standby
verificationPatterns.example: Force dryer temperature below production value → SWF is not started, press remains in Standby, after timeout press falls to ... State, both UW/RW SWF buttons remain lit but pressing them does not start SWF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Interruption during SWF (OFF/panic/web break) stops SWF and unlit both buttons
verificationPatterns.example: Bring press to OFF while button pressed → SWF stopped successfully, press reaches OFF state, UW and RW SWF buttons not lit, pressing either does not start SWF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simultaneous button press before SWF: both held keeps SWF running; both released stops it
verificationPatterns.example: Press both UW and RW SWF buttons simultaneously → while one is held SWF continues; when both released SWF is stopped

verificationPatterns.pattern: Second button press during active SWF is ignored; first button retains control
verificationPatterns.example: Press one SWF button, then while SWF in progress press other button and release → SWF ignores second press, only first button controls SWF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Clamp activation in RW disables UW SWF button availability while keeping RW button lit
verificationPatterns.example: Activate clamps in RW (OFF state, no tension) → UW SWF button not lit and pressing it does not activate SWF; RW SWF button is lit but pressing it also does not activate SWF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard play button disabled with tooltip when SWF started from physical button
verificationPatterns.example: Press SWF physical button to activate web feed, then open SWF wizard → Play button inactive with tooltip 'Operation in progress'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Master velocity cap verification during SWF button hold
verificationPatterns.example: Press and hold SWF button, monitor MasterVelocity scope → velocity must not exceed 2 m/s (2000000 or 2e6 in mastervelocity units)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button illumination reflects state eligibility
verificationPatterns.example: UW SWF physical button is not lit. RW SWF physical button is not lit. (Power Disabled / OFF / Pre-Print / Print / Post-Print)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button action blocked when state ineligible
verificationPatterns.example: When UW SWF physical button is pressed, SWF is not performed. When RW SWF physical button is pressed, SWF is not performed.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button lit and SWF starts when state eligible
verificationPatterns.example: UW SWF physical button is lit. When UW SWF physical button is pressed, SWF is started. (Standby / Get Ready / Ready / Dynamic Ready)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Momentary-hold behavior: SWF active and button lit only while button held
verificationPatterns.example: SWF continues while the button is pressed. During SWF the button is lit, while pressed.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button re-enables after returning from inhibited state
verificationPatterns.example: Return to Ready/Dynamic Ready states. UW SWF physical button is lit. When UW SWF physical button is pressed, SWF is started.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Symmetric verification for both UW and RW on each state
verificationPatterns.example: Both UW and RW buttons verified independently for lit status and SWF response in every state step.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default parameter assertion before modification
verificationPatterns.example: ???.swfButtonAccleration = 0.5 / ???.UwRwMaxAccleration = 1 / ???.ilpPrintTimeout = 2000

verificationPatterns.pattern: Physical button illumination state after parameter write
verificationPatterns.example: UW SWF physical button is lit. RW SWF physical button is lit.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Proportional behavioral change verification via scope after parameter halving
verificationPatterns.example: Web speed should be half the speed that was before.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Symmetry check — repeat same verification for counterpart button (UW vs RW)
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat the web feed for the other physical button.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Restore original values after test to leave system in known state
verificationPatterns.example: Return the original values (0.5 and 1).

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button illumination reflects machine state
verificationPatterns.example: UW SWF physical button is not lit (OFF); button is lit (Standby/Milling); button is blinking (transitioning to Milling)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button press has no effect in disallowed states
verificationPatterns.example: When UW/RW SWF physical button is pressed in OFF or during print, SWF is not performed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Auditory feedback on valid button press
verificationPatterns.example: Buzzer is sounded on UW SWF button press; buzzer sounds on second press only if 30 seconds passed since previous press

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition triggered by button, verified via signal poll
verificationPatterns.example: Press UW SWF button → ILP starts transition to Milling; wait for MillingStatus = True before verifying next state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Momentary hold behavior: action continues while button held, stops on release
verificationPatterns.example: While SWF button is pressed web is moving; when button is released it is stopped

verificationPatterns.pattern: Gradual acceleration profile verification
verificationPatterns.example: Web feed is performed slowly at first, then speed gradually increases after substrate begins moving

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button lockout during print cycle phases
verificationPatterns.example: During Pre-Print, Print, and Post-Print: buttons not lit and SWF not performed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Symmetric UW/RW coverage: repeat test for counterpart unit
verificationPatterns.example: Step 8: Repeat for RW SWF physical button

verificationPatterns.pattern: Interlock lock status reflects expected locked/unlocked state via OPC-UA signal
verificationPatterns.example: RW interlock is unlocked: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockLockStatus.RW_FRNT_LEFT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: RW component OFF state confirmed via control output signal
verificationPatterns.example: RW is in OFF state: gInterface.Web.Comp.RW.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOFF = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tension state confirmed via exported data signal (built vs. released)
verificationPatterns.example: Tension in RW is released: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ExportedData.RW.Status.AtTension = false

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state does not regress during RW door/tension operations
verificationPatterns.example: Press remains in Ready state

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI action buttons become unavailable with descriptive tooltip when interlock is unlocked
verificationPatterns.example: Print button is not available with a tooltip: 'Rewinder is unlocked'; System web feed is not available with a tooltip: 'Rewinder is unlocked'

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI action button unavailable with door-open tooltip when both interlock input poles read 0
verificationPatterns.example: 'Replace roll' button (or Tension On/Off toggle) is not available with a tooltip: 'Rewinder door is open'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event displayed in UI (including interlock name) when interlock operation fails
verificationPatterns.example: Error event that interlock can not be unlocked is displayed in UI, including the name of the interlock

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI substrate area reflects updated roll diameter after successful roll replacement and lock
verificationPatterns.example: RW area in main UI displays minimal diameter

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simulate interlock failure by forcing lock status signal while operation is in progress
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate RW interlock unlock failure: force OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockLockStatus.RW_FRNT_LEFT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simulate door-open condition by forcing both interlock input pole signals to 0
verificationPatterns.example: Keep RW door open: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockInputPoleA.RW_FRNT_LEFT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0 and OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockInputPoleB.RW_FRNT_LEFT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat nominal scenario across multiple press states to verify state-independence
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat RW door opening and closing in Standby, Get Ready, Dynamic Ready states

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI button disabled with tooltip when press state prerequisite not met
verificationPatterns.example: RW Unlock button is disabled with tooltip 'Press state OFF required.' in all states above OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state transition on interlock unlock
verificationPatterns.example: Pressing Unlock in OFF state moves press to Service state; Unlock button replaced with unlocked icon (or open-door icon when door is open)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal-based interlock lock status verification
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockLockStatus.RW_FRNT_LEFT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0 confirms interlock unlocked

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-pole simultaneous signal forcing to simulate door open/close
verificationPatterns.example: Set InterlockInputPoleA.RW_FRNT_LEFT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0 AND InterlockInputPoleB.RW_FRNT_LEFT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0 simultaneously to simulate open

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dependent UI action blocked with tooltip when interlock is open
verificationPatterns.example: Web control wizard Play button unavailable with tooltip 'Rewinder door is open' while RW is unlocked

verificationPatterns.pattern: Re-lock blocked while door is physically open; state and tension preserved
verificationPatterns.example: Exit Service with door open: interlock remains unlocked (Value=0), RW stays AtOFF=true, tension not built, press stays Service, tooltip 'Interlock is open' on Exit Service button

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unlock failure: force lock-status signal to simulate hardware failure, verify UI and press state unchanged
verificationPatterns.example: Force InterlockLockStatus.RW_FRNT_LEFT_DOOR_INTLK.Value=1 while unlocking; press stays OFF, Unlock button remains available, error event with interlock name shown in UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Locking failure: force lock-status signal after successful unlock, verify tension not built and error displayed
verificationPatterns.example: Force InterlockLockStatus.RW_FRNT_LEFT_DOOR_INTLK.Value=0 after unlocked; press stays Service, AtTension=false, Exit Service still available, error event shown

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unexpected door open during printing causes safety fallback to Power Disabled
verificationPatterns.example: Set InterlockInputPoleA.RW_FRNT_LEFT_DOOR_INTLK.Value=0 during active print job; press falls to Power Disabled, InterlockLockStatus=0; on door close press returns to OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Max diameter parameter updated after HW config change
verificationPatterns.example: IBL:RewinderEntity.MaxRollDiameterMm = 800 instead of 650; OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.RW.Param.MaxRollDiam.Value = 800 instead of 650

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press stops and reaches Ready state when RW hits max diameter during printing
verificationPatterns.example: Set OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.HW_Inputs.RW.RollDiameter.Value = 800; expect printing stopped, press in Ready, Play deactivated with tooltip 'Rewinder is full'

verificationPatterns.pattern: RW full UI indicators all fire simultaneously
verificationPatterns.example: RW is full warning press message appears; RW full icon displayed in substrate area (roll marked red); Play button deactivated with tooltip 'Rewinder is full'; IBL:RewinderEntity.UW_Roll_Length_mm.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: RW tension retained at max diameter
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ExportedData.RW.Status.AtTension = true after stop

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print-requiring calibrations blocked at max diameter; non-print calibrations remain available
verificationPatterns.example: Color calibration: Play not available, tooltip 'Rewinder is full'; Auto bias: Play available, calibration finishes successfully

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration marked Failed when RW hits max diameter mid-run
verificationPatterns.example: Set RollDiameter.Value = 805 during calibration; expect Calibration marked as Failed, printing stopped, press in Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Web stepping stops and press stays in Standby at max diameter
verificationPatterns.example: Set RollDiameter.Value = 800 during web stepping; expect web stepping stopped, press remains in Standby, Play deactivated

verificationPatterns.pattern: Roll replacement procedure via door interlock + tension toggle restores RW
verificationPatterns.example: Long press RW area, Tension Off, open door (both poles to 0 simultaneously), replace roll, close door (both poles to 1 simultaneously), Tension On, press Play

verificationPatterns.pattern: After roll replacement: interlock locked, tension built, UI shows minimal diameter
verificationPatterns.example: InterlockLockStatus.RW_FRNT_LEFT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 1; AtTension = true; RW area shows 90 (three-inch core)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Single failure from Ready causes state transition to Standby
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press in ready state and simulate failure that move press state to Standby → press state move to standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Second failure within 4-second window from first failure causes transition to OFF
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate another failure in time range of 4 seconds from the first error → Press state move to OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cumulative failure display: new failure shown on UI in addition to prior failures
verificationPatterns.example: Failure displayed from relevant subsystem in addition to the first failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Single failure from Standby causes direct transition to OFF
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press in standby state and simulate failure on press Standby to OFF case → Press state move to OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter update verification after HW config change
verificationPatterns.example: IBL:RewinderEntity.MaxRollDiameterMm = 800 instead of 650

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print auto-stop at max roll diameter with full UI and signal state check
verificationPatterns.example: Set IBL:RewinderEntity.RollDiameterMm = 800 during print; expect press stops, Ready state, Play button deactivated with tooltip 'Rewinder is full', IBL:RewinderEntity.UW_Roll_Length_mm.Value = 0, RW full warning + red icon, OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ExportedData.RW.Status.AtTension = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Roll replacement via UI tension toggle while press stays in Ready state
verificationPatterns.example: Long press RW area, move Tension toggle OFF; expect interlock unlocked (InterlockLockStatus.RW_FRNT_LEFT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0), RW AtOFF = true, AtTension = false, Print button unavailable with tooltip 'Rewinder is unlocked', press remains Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-pole door interlock open/close with simultaneous pole signal assertion
verificationPatterns.example: Open door: InterlockInputPoleA.RW_FRNT_LEFT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0 AND InterlockInputPoleB.RW_FRNT_LEFT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0 simultaneously; close: both = 1 simultaneously

verificationPatterns.pattern: RW re-lock and tension rebuild after roll replacement resumes print
verificationPatterns.example: Close door (both poles = 1), tension toggle On, press Play; expect InterlockLockStatus = 1, AtTension = true, press Ready, RW UI shows 90mm (three-inch core), job continues

verificationPatterns.pattern: Doors and Covers dialogue RW area with state-gated unlock button
verificationPatterns.example: In Ready state, Unlock button disabled with tooltip 'Press state OFF required.'; in OFF state, button active; after unlock, button replaced with unlocked icon (door closed) or open-door icon (door open)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service state entry via Doors and Covers unlock in OFF state
verificationPatterns.example: Press Unlock in RW area while in OFF; press moves to Service, WEB enters Service-Maintenance (AtServiceRw or AtServiceGetMnt), RW AtOFF = true, interlock unlocked

verificationPatterns.pattern: Interlock lock blocked while door is open; lock succeeds when door is closed
verificationPatterns.example: Door open + Exit Service pressed: InterlockLockStatus remains 0, press stays Service, tooltip 'Interlock is open'; door closed + Exit Service pressed: InterlockLockStatus = 1, press reaches OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: State assertion after setup
verificationPatterns.example: press at pre print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure message visible from relevant subsystem
verificationPatterns.example: Failure from relevant subsystem displayed

verificationPatterns.pattern: State downgrade on single failure
verificationPatterns.example: press move to ready state\Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timed second-fault triggers deeper state downgrade
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate another failure in time range of 4 seconds from the first error → Press state move to OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cumulative failure display — all active faults shown
verificationPatterns.example: Failure displayed from relevant subsystem in addition to the first failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition via signal injection
verificationPatterns.example: Set OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.BKT.HW_Inputs.Stir.StirIRTempSens: 108 → verify press transitions to Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cascading failures within 2s window move press to Standby
verificationPatterns.example: In cache of 2s prior 2s delay, simulate error → Press State is Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Third failure within 1-3s time range moves press to OFF with all failures visible on UI
verificationPatterns.example: 3 failures displayed on UI with relevant details after press reaches OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Reset and re-trigger: print again from OFF, inject failure, verify OFF state with correct failure detail
verificationPatterns.example: Set OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.HW_Inputs.Dryer.TemperatureSensor: 0 → Press is at OFF state with relevant failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure injected >3s after previous failure is NOT displayed on UI
verificationPatterns.example: After 4s from last failure, inject OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.HW_Inputs.RW.DancerPos: 20 → no failure displayed on UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Single failure during print triggers ready-state transition with correct failure event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Hardware event generated on simulated fault

verificationPatterns.pattern: Separation enable/disable persists per save

verificationPatterns.pattern: Job properties accessible via two entry points
verificationPatterns.example: Open Separation and Print Order tab via right-side job button and via toolbar job properties button

verificationPatterns.pattern: Substrate duplicate-edit-install workflow

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sidebar search starts filtering from first character

verificationPatterns.example: DryBIDRequired=False; wizard available to perform dry BID again after success

verificationPatterns.pattern: Read OPC-UA HV signal and assert exact voltage during print mode
verificationPatterns.example: During print start, CleanerVoltSet_v.Value == 280V

verificationPatterns.example: After NULL simulation, SqueegeeVoltSet_v.Value == 220V

verificationPatterns.example: BID voltages during null: squeegee voltage in all stations is 5 higher than developer voltage

verificationPatterns.example: Bypass VJOS from PLC and App; verify print voltages and mode applied during print and on seam

verificationPatterns.pattern: HV moves to VJOS voltages at non-printing area
verificationPatterns.example: HV shall move to VJOS voltages at none printing area

verificationPatterns.pattern: HV returns to slot voltages a parameterized distance before slot start
verificationPatterns.example: return to slot voltages, BidVjosToPrintStabilizationDist microns before slot start

verificationPatterns.pattern: BID disengage-to-semi-engage on job boundary
verificationPatterns.example: When first job ends, on the non-printable area BID A goes to semi engage position ('just touch') and voltage is 'Null voltage'

verificationPatterns.pattern: BID engage with slot voltage on job handoff
verificationPatterns.example: BID B goes to engage and the voltage of the BID is 'slot voltage'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Job switch occurs within non-printable area
verificationPatterns.example: Non printable area is about 500mm; BID state transitions happen during this window

verificationPatterns.pattern: Developer VJOS = DeveloperRelativeVjosVoltage + ASiD bias
verificationPatterns.example: Expected: _DeveloperRelativeVjosVoltage_ + ASiD bias

verificationPatterns.pattern: Electrode VJOS = developer_absolute + ElectrodeVjosVoltageDelta*(100+VjosPID)/100
verificationPatterns.example: shall be calculated as developer absolute value+ _ElectrodeVjosVoltageDelta*(100+VjosPID_)/100_

verificationPatterns.pattern: Squeegee VJOS = developer_absolute + SqueegeeVjosVoltageDelta*(100+VjosPID)/100
verificationPatterns.example: Shall be calculated as developer absolute value + SqueegeeVjosVoltageDelta*(100+VjosPID)/100

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cleaner VJOS = developer_absolute - CleanerVjosVoltageDelta*(100+VjosPID)/100
verificationPatterns.example: Shall be calculated as developer absolute value - CleanerVjosVoltageDelta*(100+VjosPID)/100

verificationPatterns.pattern: CR holds voltage at non-printing area until App signals next slot preparation
