verificationPatterns.example: Step 3 ink-to-BID failure: BID HV turned off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Init from all states on communication/DSP error
verificationPatterns.example: BIMHV_DSP_COMMUNICATION_ERROR → init; BIMHV_COMMUNICATION_ERROR → INIT

verificationPatterns.pattern: Off from all states on safety-critical fault (current leakage, overcurrent, DSP reset, HV not enabled)
verificationPatterns.example: BID_DSP_CURRENT_LEAKAGE / BID_DSP_OVERCURRENT_FAULT / BID_DSP_RESET → Off; BIMHV_HV_NOT_ENABLED → Off state from all states

verificationPatterns.pattern: No mode change for info-severity or non-critical diagnostic signals
verificationPatterns.example: BIMHV_DOWNLOAD_SUCCESS, BID_DSP_CALIBRATION_ERROR, BID_DSP_INTERNAL_FAULT, BID_DSP_OVERRIDES, BID_DSP_VOLTAGE_NOT_REACHED, BID_DSP_AT_TIME_OF_FAULT, BID_HV_FAIL_INFO → No mode change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Download fallback: if previous firmware version exists → no press state change; if previous version cannot function → press goes to Init
verificationPatterns.example: Step 5 auto-download failure branching logic

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold-triggered fault: set squeegee voltage above named threshold for named duration to induce ink-to-BID fault
verificationPatterns.example: Set Squeegee voltage above BidSqNoInkVoltage for BidSqNoInkTime msec → INK_TO_BID_DELIVERY_FAILURE

verificationPatterns.pattern: File corruption injection: corrupt the BIMHV download file to trigger download error signal
verificationPatterns.example: Step 4: corrupt BIMHV download file → BIMHV_DOWNLOAD_ERROR_IN_FILE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Delayed monitoring activation: failure must appear only after BidHvMonitorStartDelay ms from last HV sequence command
verificationPatterns.example: BID HV voltage and current monitoring should start BidHvMonitorStartDelay msec after BID HV was commanded to perform the last step in the HV sequence → Verify failure appear BidHvMonitorStartDelay msec after the HV command

verificationPatterns.pattern: Monitoring deactivation on HV off: verify monitoring parameter changes when HV is commanded off
verificationPatterns.example: BID HV monitoring will be turned off right before BID HV is set to off → Verify monitoring parameter change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass suppresses failure: when monitor is bypassed via IO override, no error event is raised
verificationPatterns.example: Bypass the monitor, override Current and Voltage IOs → Verify no failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-component error coverage: repeat error injection and verification for all four HV components (Developer, Cleaner, Electrode, Squeegee) for both voltage and current
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat for BidHvDeveloperVoltageError, BidHvCleanerVoltageError, BidHvElectrodeVoltageError, BidHvSqueegeeVoltageError, BidHvDeveloperCurrentError, BidHvCleanerCurrentError, BidHvElectrodeCurrentError, BidHvSqueegeeCurrentError

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify HV state at power disable baseline
verificationPatterns.example: Verify BID HV at power disable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify interlock enable signal asserted by PLC on mech-init
verificationPatterns.example: On mech-init, PLC will activate the enable signal (interlock) to the BID HV power supplies boards

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify voltage profile transitions from wet (preprint) to print values during print sequence
verificationPatterns.example: Print - verify wet voltages are given during Preprint. Then changes to print values.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify immediate HV shutdown on EMS trigger
verificationPatterns.example: Once EMS is pressed, BID-HV goes to off *immediately* and turn-off HV power supply outputs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert boolean signal equals expected state
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.ILP.Param.ILPWetMode.Value = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert velocity signal exceeds minimum threshold
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.WHS.Comp.Avg.Out.Monitor.SetVelocity > 125000

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert nip disengage signal during active SPM patch scan (paper stationary)
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.HW_Outputs.ILP.ImpDisEngage.Value = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert axis velocity signal is below minimum threshold
verificationPatterns.example: AxesList.gWebAxes.Vilm.Crtl.Basic_axis.Output.monitor.SetVel > 0.125 m/s

verificationPatterns.pattern: Capture positional signal at step start as baseline X for later comparison
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.ILP.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.ILBPosition = X (record initial)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert positional signal is monotonically increasing toward stop position
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.ILP.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.ILBPosition (increasing to TBD stop)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert positional signal returns to recorded baseline after sequence completes
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.ILP.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.ILBPosition = x (initial)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert numeric speed/rate signal equals specific value
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.HW_Outputs.ILP.ImpDisEngage.Value = 300000 (primer milling speed)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-step assertion: verify nip moves to engage state after each calibration step completes
verificationPatterns.example: verify after each step the ILP nip is moving to engage

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-step assertion: verify coating velocity mode transitions to priming
verificationPatterns.example: the coating velocity is changing to priming

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert velocity signal increases back to operational threshold after step
verificationPatterns.example: the vilm velocity is increasing to 125000; OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.HW_Outputs.ILP.ImpDisEngage.Value = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boolean flag equals True
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.ILP.Param.ILPWetMode.Value = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Velocity threshold guard before feature activation
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.WHS.Comp.Avg.Out.Monitor.SetVelocity > 100000

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter/accumulator increases during run (functional activity proof)
verificationPatterns.example: After pressing Play and waiting ~20 sec, 'total run' value should increase

verificationPatterns.pattern: Velocity returns to zero on stop
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.WHS.Comp.Avg.Out.Monitor.SetVelocity = 0 after Stop button pressed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-print state flag and hardware output both verified together
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.ILP.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtPostPrint = True AND OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.HW_Outputs.ILP.ImpDisEngage.Value = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Axis velocity compared against minimum threshold
verificationPatterns.example: AxesList.gWebAxes.Vilm.Crtl.Basic_axis.Output.monitor.SetVel > 0.125 m/s

verificationPatterns.pattern: Capture baseline position before motion
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.ILP.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.ILBPosition = X (record start position)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Monitor position monotonically increasing toward stop position
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.ILP.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.ILBPosition increasing toward stop (TBD)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Position returns to initial value after sequence completes
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.ILP.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.ILBPosition = x (matches captured baseline)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Numeric setpoint on OPCUA output verified against expected value
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.HW_Outputs.ILP.ImpDisEngage.Value = 300000

verificationPatterns.pattern: LockStatus=1 for all PE doors when no open command sent and poles both=1 (press reaches Print)
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockLockStatus.PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 1 ... Press reaches Print state successfully.

verificationPatterns.pattern: LockStatus=0 for all PE doors when open command was sent (even if poles still=1, door physically closed)
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockLockStatus.PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0 [all four PE locks]

verificationPatterns.pattern: EndService availability=false with reason code 55 (ILK_IS_OPEN) when door is physically opened after open command
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.EndService.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = false, Reason[0].Reason = 55 (ILK_IS_OPEN)

verificationPatterns.pattern: AtServiceMode node map assertion for Service-Maintenance state
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Manager.ExportedData.Sys.Status.AtServiceMode = { node 0 = 0; nodes 1 to 36 = 3, node 37 = 4; node 38 = 3; nodes 39 to 44 = 4, nodes 45 to 54 = 3}

verificationPatterns.pattern: MachineState=POWER_DISABLED + ZONE_OPENED_UNEXPECTEDLY event when door opens without prior open command during Get Ready
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = 2 (POWER_DISABLED). ZONE_OPENED_UNEXPECTEDLY from Safety, FlowID 0, Sensor PE_RR_MID_DOOR_INTLK event is issued.

verificationPatterns.pattern: MachineState=POWER_DISABLED + ZONE_UNLOCK_FAILED event when PoleA != PoleB (dual-channel mismatch)
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = 2 (POWER_DISABLED). ZONE_UNLOCK_FAILED from Safety, Sensor PE_RR_FEED_DOOR_INTLK event is issued.

verificationPatterns.pattern: On mechanical lock failure: press reaches Service state, forced-locked interlock LockStatus=1, all others=0, ZONE_UNLOCK_FAILED shown in UI with specific Sensor ID
verificationPatterns.example: PE front interlock is still locked: PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 1; PE_RR_EXIT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0; ZONE_UNLOCK_FAILED error appears in UI, Sensor ID = PE_RR_EXIT_DOOR_INTLK

verificationPatterns.pattern: All LockStatus signals verified together as a group after each state transition
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that all zones were locked: PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0, PE_RR_EXIT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0, PE_RR_FEED_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0, PE_RR_MID_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: EMS press transitions machine to POWER_DISABLED and blocks PowerEnable with ILK_IS_OPEN reason
verificationPatterns.example: MachineState.State = 2 (POWER_DISABLED); InterlockLockStatus.INTERLOCK_NAME.Value = 0 for all interlocks; PowerEnable.AvailabilityStatus.Available = false; Reason[0].Reason = 57 (ILK_IS_OPEN)

verificationPatterns.pattern: EMS release while any door interlock remains open keeps machine in POWER_DISABLED
verificationPatterns.example: Set PE_RR_MID_DOOR_INTLK PoleA/B = 0, then restore EmsInputPoleA/B = 1 → MachineState.State still 2 (POWER_DISABLED); PowerEnable.Available still false; Reason[0].Reason still 57 (ILK_IS_OPEN)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Closing all doors and launching PowerEnable operation recovers machine to OFF
verificationPatterns.example: After door interlock closed and PowerEnable operation launched → MachineState.State = 3 (OFF)

verificationPatterns.pattern: All safety zones show unlocked indicator on small schema and in Doors and Covers wizard when EMS is active
verificationPatterns.example: PE, PWS web, PWS priming, UW zones are marked as unlocked on small schema; All interlocks of PE, PWS web, PWS priming, UW zones are marked as unlocked

verificationPatterns.pattern: Turn-press-on button disabled with tooltip 'Emergency button pressed' while EMS is active; Off/Standby/Get Ready buttons also unavailable
verificationPatterns.example: Turn the press on button is unavailable with tooltip 'Emergency button pressed'. Off, Standby and Get Ready buttons are unavailable.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unlock-doors buttons hidden and 'Door movement is disabled' note shown under PE front door line while EMS is active
verificationPatterns.example: 'Unlock doors' buttons do not appear. 'Door movement is disabled' note is displayed under PE front door line.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Opening interlock inputs (Pole A and Pole B = 0) while EMS active replaces Unlocked icons with Open icons in both wizard and small schema
verificationPatterns.example: Open icons replace Unlocked icons in wizard, with relevant names. Open icons replace Unlocked icons in small schema.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press remains in OFF (Doors unlocked) state while any door is open, even after EMS is released; tooltip changes to 'Interlock is open'
verificationPatterns.example: Press remains in OFF (Doors unlocked) state. Turn the press on button is unavailable with tooltip 'Interlock is open'.

verificationPatterns.pattern: After all doors closed, pressing Turn-press-on recovers press to OFF state and Unlock-doors buttons reappear in wizard
verificationPatterns.example: Press reaches OFF state successfully. 'Unlock doors' buttons are displayed instead of unlocked and open icons in all areas of Doors and Covers wizard.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button LED reflects availability: LED off means button inactive and presses have no effect on press state; LED on means button is active
verificationPatterns.example: Up button LED is off. Pressing Up button has no influence on press state. Down button LED is off. Pressing Down button has no influence on press state.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Partial availability: when PE section is unlocked but interlock fork is still seated, only the away-from-interlock direction (Up) is enabled
verificationPatterns.example: Up button LED is on. Down button LED is off (because interlock fork is in interlock). Pressing Down button does not activate down door motion.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Momentary hold-to-move: door moves only while button is held; releasing the button stops motion mid-travel
verificationPatterns.example: Press Up button for 1-2 seconds and release. PE front door raises while button is pressed.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mutual exclusion active-over-opposite: pressing the opposite direction button while one direction is moving has no effect; active-direction LED stays on, opposite LED stays off
verificationPatterns.example: Down button LED is off. Front door continues to raise, Down button press has no effect.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Opposite-direction LED transition tied to interlock fork position: turns on when fork exits interlock, turns off while motion button is held, turns back on when motion button is released
verificationPatterns.example: Down button LED turns on when interlock fork is out of interlock, then is off while Up button is pressed, and is on when Up released.

verificationPatterns.pattern: EMS disables all door motion: both LEDs go off, both buttons become inoperative, wizard displays a 'Door movement is disabled' note under the affected door line
verificationPatterns.example: Up button LED is off. Pressing Up button has no influence on press state. Down button LED is off. 'Door movement is disabled' note is displayed in 'Doors and Covers' wizard under PE front door line.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-EMS recovery: release EMS, wait for press to return to operational state, then verify door can be driven to home (lower limit) position and LEDs return to correct idle state
verificationPatterns.example: Release EMS button. Wait for press to return to operational state. Press Down button until the door reaches lower position (interlock fork enters the interlock). Up button LED is on. Down button LED is off.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unlock buttons disabled outside OFF state with tooltip
verificationPatterns.example: All unlock buttons are unavailable. When buttons are pressed, 'Press state OFF is required' tooltip is shown

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press transitions to SERVICE state when section unlock button pressed
verificationPatterns.example: Press reaches Service state successfully: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = SERVICE

verificationPatterns.pattern: All InterlockLockStatus signals for the section go to 0 after unlock
verificationPatterns.example: PE front interlock is unlocked: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockLockStatus.PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unlock button disappears from wizard after successful unlock
verificationPatterns.example: 'Unlock doors' button disappears.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard shows per-door unlocked icons with relevant names after unlock
verificationPatterns.example: 4 unlocked icons appear in Printing Engine area in wizard, with relevant names.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Small schema area icon updates to unlocked state after section unlock
verificationPatterns.example: PE area is marked with unlocked icon on small schema.

verificationPatterns.pattern: OFF and Standby buttons unavailable in Service-Maintenance state
verificationPatterns.example: Press is in Service-Maintenance state: OFF and Standby buttons are unavailable in UI.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Both InterlockInputPoleA and InterlockInputPoleB signals set simultaneously to simulate open door
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockInputPoleA.PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0 and OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockInputPoleB.PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press remains in SERVICE when door opened; exit SERVICE blocked with tooltip
verificationPatterns.example: Press remains in Service state successfully. Exit Service state is unavailable with a tooltip 'Interlock is open'.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard shows per-door opened icons after door physically opened
verificationPatterns.example: 4 door opened icons appear in Printing Engine area in wizard, with relevant names.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Small schema area icon updates to opened state after door opened
verificationPatterns.example: PE area is marked with opened icon on small schema.

verificationPatterns.pattern: PWS priming unlock requires ILP wash confirmation dialog before proceeding
verificationPatterns.example: 'Unlocking Primer door requires in line primer wash that takes several minutes. Are you sure that you want to proceed?' dialogue appears. No changes in press state.

verificationPatterns.pattern: ILP wash progress monitored via state signal and remaining-time signal; interlock stays locked during wash
verificationPatterns.example: ILP wash is performed: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.Wash.OperationData.State = 2 (IN_PROGRESS). During ILP wash remaining time is displayed: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ExportedData.ILP.Monitor.WashRemainingTime. During ILP wash OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockLockStatus.WHS_PRM_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 1.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unlock sequence begins only after ILP wash completes successfully
verificationPatterns.example: When ILP wash is finished, OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.Wash.OperationData.State = 3 (COMPLETED_SUCCESSFULLY), doors unlocking sequence begins.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Each section reset to closed before next section tested (zone independence)
verificationPatterns.example: Close PE doors. Bring the press to OFF state by exiting Service state. Menu -> Doors and Covers wizard. Press 'Unlock doors' in Unwinder section.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify machine state signal equals expected state constant
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = SERVICE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify interlock lock status is unlocked (Value = 0) for each named door interlock
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockLockStatus.PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify AtServiceMode node array matches expected per-node pattern
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Manager.ExportedData.Sys.Status.AtServiceMode = { node 0 = 0; nodes 1 to 36 = 3, node 37 = 4; node 38 = 3; nodes 39 to 44 = 4, nodes 45 to 54 = 3}

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify UI wizard shows correct count of unlocked/open-door icons with relevant names in the zone area
verificationPatterns.example: 4 unlocked icons appear in Printing Engine area in wizard, with relevant names

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify zone area on small schema reflects correct icon state (locked/unlocked)
verificationPatterns.example: PE area is marked with unlocked icon on small schema

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify conditional button visibility: 'Unlock doors' button not shown when zone already unlocked
verificationPatterns.example: 'Unlock doors' button is not shown

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simulate door open in automation by setting both InterlockInputPoleA and InterlockInputPoleB to 0 simultaneously for each target door
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockInputPoleA.PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0 and OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockInputPoleB.PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify action button is disabled with tooltip when an interlock is open
verificationPatterns.example: Exit Service state button is unavailable with tooltip 'Interlock is open'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Check operation availability and blocking reason in Standby before unlock
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.ServiceMode.Maintenance.PE.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = false; Reason[0].Reason = 94 (SERVICE_REQUIRED)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Confirm dialog appears and all Unlock buttons are disabled when precondition not satisfied
verificationPatterns.example: 'Unlocking Primer door requires in line primer wash that takes several minutes. Are you sure that you want to proceed?' dialogue appears. All Unlock doors buttons are unavailable. No changes in press state.

verificationPatterns.pattern: ILP wash sequence: verify IN_PROGRESS state, remaining time display, and interlock locked during wash
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.Wash.OperationData.State = 2 (IN_PROGRESS); OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ExportedData.ILP.Monitor.WashRemainingTime displayed; OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockLockStatus.WHS_PRM_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 1 during wash

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify wash completion transitions to door unlock sequence
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.Wash.OperationData.State = 3 (COMPLETED_SUCCESSFULLY), then doors unlocking sequence begins

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify interlock unlocked and Service-Maintenance node distribution after PE operation completes
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockLockStatus.WHS_PRM_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0; OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Manager.ExportedData.Sys.Status.AtServiceMode = { node 0 = 0; node 42 = 3; all other nodes = 4 }

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simulate door open/close via simultaneous dual-pole interlock signal injection (PoleA + PoleB)
verificationPatterns.example: Open: set InterlockInputPoleA.WHS_PRM_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0 and InterlockInputPoleB.WHS_PRM_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0 simultaneously. Close: set both to 1 simultaneously.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify EndService is blocked with ILK_IS_OPEN reason while door is open
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.EndService.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = false; Reason[0].Reason = 55 (ILK_IS_OPEN)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure mode: insufficient cleaner tank level prevents or aborts ILP wash; verify press still reaches Service with interlock unlocked
verificationPatterns.example: Set OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.HW_Inputs.ILP.CleanerTankLevel.Value = 0 before or during wash; expected: Service state reached, WHS_PRM_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure mode: force interlock stuck locked, verify ZONE_UNLOCK_FAILED error appears in UI with correct Sensor ID
verificationPatterns.example: Force OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockLockStatus.WHS_PRM_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 1; expected: ZONE_UNLOCK_FAILED error in UI, Sensor ID = PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK; operation state = 3 (COMPLETED_SUCCESSFULLY)

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI button availability gated by press state
verificationPatterns.example: All unlock buttons are unavailable. When buttons are pressed, 'Press state OFF is required' tooltip is shown

verificationPatterns.pattern: Confirmation dialogue before long/destructive operation
verificationPatterns.example: 'Unlocking Primer door requires in line primer wash that takes several minutes. Are you sure that you want to proceed?' dialogue appears

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wash operation state signal transitions verified in sequence
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.Wash.OperationData.State = 2 (IN_PROGRESS) ... then State = 3 (COMPLETED_SUCCESSFULLY)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Remaining time displayed during long operation via signal
verificationPatterns.example: During ILP wash remaining time is displayed in the wizard window: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ExportedData.ILP.Monitor.WashRemainingTime

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-pole interlock signals set simultaneously for automatic door open/close simulation
verificationPatterns.example: Simultaneously set InterlockInputPoleA.WHS_PRM_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0 and InterlockInputPoleB.WHS_PRM_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service-Maintenance state enforced: OFF and Standby buttons unavailable in UI
verificationPatterns.example: Press is in Service-Maintenance state: OFF and Standby buttons are unavailable in UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Precondition failure still completes unlock but surfaces error in UI
verificationPatterns.example: Primer interlock is unlocked: InterlockLockStatus.WHS_PRM_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0. 'ILP - level is below low limit' error is displayed in UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Interlock unlock failure reported via ZONE_UNLOCK_FAILED error with Sensor ID
verificationPatterns.example: ZONE_UNLOCK_FAILED error appears in UI, Sensor ID = WHS_PRM_DOOR_INTLK. Primer interlock displayed as red unlocked icon

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button state during in-progress operation: inactive, shows progress text and tooltip
verificationPatterns.example: 'Unlock doors' button appears inactive. If pressed again 'Operation in progress' tooltip appears. Button text replaced with 'Preparing: Service operational' / 'Preparing: Service maintenance'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation completion state check
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.ServiceMode.Maintenance.PWS_WEBHNDL.OperationData.State = 3 (COMPLETED_SUCCESSFULLY)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state reaches SERVICE
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = SERVICE

verificationPatterns.pattern: All 4 PWS web handling interlocks unlocked (lock-status Value=0)
verificationPatterns.example: InterlockLockStatus.WHS_DRY_DOOR_INTLK.Value=0, PWS_RR_DOOR_INTLK.Value=0, WHS_DNCR_DOOR_INTLK.Value=0, PWS_FRNT_EXIT_DOOR_INTLK.Value=0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service-Maintenance AtServiceMode node-map assertion
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Manager.ExportedData.Sys.Status.AtServiceMode = { node 0=0; nodes 1-36=3; node 37=4; node 38=3; nodes 39-44=4; nodes 45-54=3}

verificationPatterns.pattern: EndService blocked while any interlock is open (reason 55/ILK_IS_OPEN)
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.EndService.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available=false, Reason[0].Reason=55 (ILK_IS_OPEN)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simulate door open/close by setting both PoleA and PoleB interlock inputs simultaneously
verificationPatterns.example: Set InterlockInputPoleA.WHS_DRY_DOOR_INTLK.Value=0 AND InterlockInputPoleB.WHS_DRY_DOOR_INTLK.Value=0 (and same for PWS_RR, WHS_DNCR, PWS_FRNT_EXIT) to open; Value=1 on both poles to close

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dryer temperature too-high causes IN_PROGRESS delay with PwsDryerAtCool reason; interlocks remain locked (Value=1)
verificationPatterns.example: PWS_WEBHNDL.OperationData.State=31 (OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS), DelayReason=PwsDryerAtCool; all 4 InterlockLockStatus.Value=1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dryer cool-down succeeds before timeout: operation completes, interlocks unlock
verificationPatterns.example: Set Temperature_A.Value < ServMntPwsDryerTempHighLimitForUnlock before ServMntPwsDryerCoolTimeout expires; verify MachineState=SERVICE and all InterlockLockStatus.Value=0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dryer cool-down timeout failure: timeout expires with temp still high; interlocks unlock anyway and dryer cooling error event appears
verificationPatterns.example: Wait ServMntPwsDryerCoolTimeout without reducing Temperature_A; verify InterlockLockStatus.Value=0 for all 4 interlocks and dryer cooling error event in UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Forced interlock unlock failure triggers ZONE_UNLOCK_FAILED error with specific Sensor ID
verificationPatterns.example: Force InterlockLockStatus.WHS_DNCR_DOOR_INTLK.Value=1 before launching maintenance op; verify ZONE_UNLOCK_FAILED error in UI with Sensor ID=WHS_DNCR_DOOR_INTLK while other interlocks unlock normally

verificationPatterns.pattern: Maintenance operation unavailable in non-OFF state (Standby)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log verification for expected warning message in Manager thread
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in logs that Service: 'WARN-Go to Mntn PE - ..._CONFIG' message appears in Manager thread.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Re-entry behavior: operation succeeds idempotently when precondition already met (door already unlocked/opened)
verificationPatterns.example: 'Unlock' operation should be performed successfully if the door is already unlocked. / 'Unlock' operation should be performed successfully if the door is already unlocked and opened.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence reached confirmation: action button replaced by next-step button
verificationPatterns.example: When transition is finished successfully 'Prepare' button is replaced by 'Run all' button.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button inactive with tooltip when press not in required state
verificationPatterns.example: In Standby: 'Prepare for calibration' button inactive; pressing it shows tooltip 'Press state OFF is required'; button remains unavailable.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button availability changes when press reaches required state
verificationPatterns.example: After transitioning press to OFF state, 'Prepare for calibration' button becomes available.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button text cycles through named phases during multi-step transition; button stays depressed/inactive with circular animation throughout
verificationPatterns.example: Text: 'Preparing(Service)' -> 'Preparing (Sequence)' -> 'Preparing(Imaging Oil System)'; circular waiting animation shown; button appears depressed and inactive during all phases.

verificationPatterns.pattern: On successful transition, action button is replaced by next-action button and dependent controls enable
verificationPatterns.example: 'Prepare for calibration' replaced by 'Run all'; Play buttons become available for all active colors.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify specific OPCUA subsystem nodes hold SEQ value after Service-Sequence transition, others remain operational
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Manager.ExportedData.Sys.Status.AtServiceMode: nodes 46-49, 7-18 = SEQ; all others = operational.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simulate subsystem failure by forcing a signal to fault value; verify UI reflects unavailability with tooltip and withholds next-step controls
verificationPatterns.example: Force OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.HW_Inputs.Reservoir.ReservoirDirtyLevel.Value = 0; 'Prepare for calibration' becomes inactive with tooltip 'Imaging oil reservoir level in dirty tank is too low'; Play buttons and 'Run all' do not appear.

verificationPatterns.pattern: After removing failure condition, button re-enables and transition can be completed from the interrupted phase
verificationPatterns.example: Unforce ReservoirDirtyLevel to suitable level; 'Prepare for calibration' becomes active; press again; transition resumes from 'Preparing(Imaging Oil System)' and completes successfully with 'Run all' appearing.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Exit-service action restores all service-mode signals to initial/OFF values
verificationPatterns.example: Press exit service button; OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = OFF; all AtServiceMode nodes = N/A; AtServiceReady = false; AtOFF = True.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button availability tied to press state precondition
verificationPatterns.example: Verify 'Prepare for color change' button is disabled when press is not in OFF state; tooltip 'Press state OFF is required' appears on hover

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button text reflects each sub-phase of multi-step transition
verificationPatterns.example: Text changes: 'Prepare for color change' -> 'Preparing(Service)' -> 'Preparing (Sequence)' -> 'Preparing(Imaging Oil System)' during respective sub-phases

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button visual feedback during async operation (animation + depressed + inactive)
verificationPatterns.example: During all processes circular waiting animation displayed; button appears depressed and is inactive

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button becomes inactive with success tooltip on completion
verificationPatterns.example: When transition finished successfully button becomes inactive with tooltip 'Press already in required state'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard step visual feedback reflects pass/fail
verificationPatterns.example: On success: wizard step text marked green, wizard advances. On failure: step text marked red, bullet changes to 'X', wizard does not advance

verificationPatterns.pattern: AtServiceMode signal nodes verified per selected station set
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Manager.ExportedData.Sys.Status.AtServiceMode: nodes 46-49, 17 have SEQ value, according to selected stations

verificationPatterns.pattern: MachineState.State verified at each major transition boundary
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = 4 (Service) after prepare; = 3 (OFF) before prepare; = OFF after exit

verificationPatterns.pattern: IMO readiness failure triggered by forcing signal value, then verified via tooltip
verificationPatterns.example: Force OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.HW_Inputs.Reservoir.ReservoirDirtyLevel.Value = 0; expect tooltip 'Imaging oil reservoir level in dirty tank is too low'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Recovery: unforce signal, verify button re-enables, re-run sub-step to completion
verificationPatterns.example: Unforce ReservoirDirtyLevel; 'Prepare(Imaging Oil System)' button becomes active; press it; verify success signals and wizard advance

verificationPatterns.pattern: Persist-in-service verification after wizard close without auto-exit
verificationPatterns.example: After finishing or cancelling wizard steps, verify AtServiceMode nodes and MachineState remain in Service state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Exit Service verifies all subsystem signals reset to off/N/A
verificationPatterns.example: After exit service: AtServiceMode all N/A, AtServiceReady = false, AtOFF = True, MachineState = OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button state gating by press state
verificationPatterns.example: Unlock button unavailable in Standby; tooltip 'Press state OFF is required' when pressed; becomes available only after press reaches OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button text and animation during async state transition
verificationPatterns.example: Unlock button text changes to 'Preparing(Service)' then 'Preparing (Maintenance)'; circular waiting animation displayed; button appears depressed and inactive throughout

verificationPatterns.pattern: PE front door interlock signal verification after unlock
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockLockStatus.PE_Front.Value = 0 after successful unlock; = 1 before unlock or after exit service

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service zone node state verification by node range
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Manager.ExportedData.Sys.Status.AtServiceMode: nodes [1-38, 46-55] = MNT; [16] = Sequence; [4, 10, 22, 28, 34, 39-45] = Operational after Service-Sequence transition

verificationPatterns.pattern: PE zone maintenance state verification
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.ServiceMode.Maintenance.PE.OperationData.State = 3 (COMPLETED_SUCCESSFULLY) after successful unlock; Reason[0].Reason = 93 (SERVICE_REQUIRED) before unlock

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket tension position held constant across state transitions
verificationPatterns.example: AxesList.gBktAxes.BktTenF.Crtl.Basic_axis.Output.monitor.ActPosition = constant ~56881 in OFF/Service states; ~56800 after door open

verificationPatterns.pattern: Backing roller (T1) hardware output verification
verificationPatterns.example: Subsystems.BKT.HW_Outputs.BR[1].PositionPistonPilot=0, MainPistonA=0, MainPistonB=0 during service; PositionPistonPilot=1 after exit service

verificationPatterns.pattern: BID in-place override simulation for automation
verificationPatterns.example: Set OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStations.MEStation4.HW_Inputs.Bids.Bid2.BID_Main.BidFiInPlace.Simulation.Value = 0; set BidInPlaceOverride.Value = 2; increment MessageIndex by one

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard step visual completion indicator
verificationPatterns.example: Step text marked green and wizard advances on success; marked red with X bullet and wizard does not advance on failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Emergency stop mid-transition failure recovery
verificationPatterns.example: Trigger EmsInputPoleA/B.UIC_OPR_ST_ESTOP = 0 during unlock; verify state = Power_Disable and all AtServiceMode nodes = N/A; release ESTOP; wait ~20s for state = OFF; re-attempt unlock succeeds

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure case: hardware interlock stuck forced via simulation
verificationPatterns.example: Force InterlockLockStatus.PE_Front.Value = 1 during unlock; verify button changes to red failed-unlock icon; wizard step marked red; Play/Run All buttons inactive; error displayed in UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure case: backing roller sensor simulation during transition
verificationPatterns.example: During unlock simulate OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.BKT.HW_Inputs.BR[1].EngSensFront.Value = 1 and EngSensRear.Value = 1; verify failed-unlock icon, red wizard step, no advance

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state signal verification at each press state
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = 4 (SERVICE) during service; = OFF after exit service; = Power_Disable after ESTOP

verificationPatterns.pattern: MntMechConfig zone config held after transitions
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.MgmtCtrl.Out.Status.AtMntMechConfig_Zones[1-55] = REGULAR_CONFIG across all service sub-states and after exit service

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log message verification for manual tests
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in Manager thread logs: 'WARN-Go to Mntn PE - REGULAR_CONFIG' appears after entering Service-Maintenance

verificationPatterns.pattern: Prepare for calibration button gating by door and BID state
verificationPatterns.example: 'Prepare for calibration' unavailable until BID removed and front door closed; tooltip 'ALL BIDS are in place' in Standby, 'Service mode required' in OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Door open simulation via dual interlock pole signals
verificationPatterns.example: Set OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockInputPoleA.PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Simulation.Value = 0 and InterlockInputPoleB.PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Simulation.Value = 0 simultaneously

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button disabled with state-requirement tooltip when press not in required state
verificationPatterns.example: In Standby: 'Prepare for calibration' inactive; pressing it shows tooltip 'Press state OFF is required'; button remains inactive

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button activates when all preconditions met (press reaches required state)
verificationPatterns.example: After press reaches OFF state: 'Prepare for calibration' button becomes active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button shows progressive text + animation during multi-phase transition
verificationPatterns.example: Text cycles 'Preparing(Service)' → 'Preparing (Sequence)' with circular waiting animation; button stays depressed and inactive throughout

verificationPatterns.pattern: OPCUA AtServiceMode node-range verification after Service-Sequence entry
verificationPatterns.example: Nodes 1-36 (active MEStations), 51, 53-55 = SEQ (2); all other nodes = OP (4)

verificationPatterns.pattern: OPCUA AtServiceMode all-N/A verification when not in service
verificationPatterns.example: Before entering service or after exit: all AtServiceMode nodes = N/A (0)

verificationPatterns.pattern: MachineState.State enum value check for press state
verificationPatterns.example: OFF = 3, Service = 4; verified via OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State

verificationPatterns.pattern: Idempotent re-entry: button depressed + tooltip when press already in required state
verificationPatterns.example: Re-opening wizard while already in Service-Sequence: button depressed, inactive, tooltip 'Press is already in required state'; Play button available

verificationPatterns.pattern: State persistence after wizard close without auto-exit checked
verificationPatterns.example: Close wizard without 'Exit Service state automatically': AtServiceMode nodes retain SEQ/OP values; MachineState.State = 4

verificationPatterns.pattern: Emergency-stop interrupt disables Prepare button and emits expected event
verificationPatterns.example: EmsInputPoleA/B UIC_OPR_ST_ESTOP = 0: Prepare button disabled, tooltip 'Press state OFF is required', Event_ID = EMS_WAS_ACTIVATED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Recovery after emergency-stop release restores OFF state and re-enables flow
verificationPatterns.example: EmsInputPoleA/B UIC_OPR_ST_ESTOP = 1 + power-enabled button if needed → MachineState.State = 3; full Prepare sequence repeatable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button state gates wizard progression — unavailable button + greyed subsequent steps before precondition met
verificationPatterns.example: Unlock button is unavailable, all the following steps are greyed out. 'Confirm & Continue' button in the bottom row of the wizard is greyed out.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tooltip on disabled button explains missing precondition
verificationPatterns.example: Tooltip 'Press state OFF is required' appears on 'Unlock' button.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button text and animation reflect async transition phases
verificationPatterns.example: During entering Service-Operational mode the 'Unlock' button text changes to 'Preparing(Service)'. During transition to Service-Maintenance mode starts the button text changes to 'Preparing (Maintenance)'. During both processes circular waiting animation is displayed on the button.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button icon changes to reflect final outcome (success vs failure)
verificationPatterns.example: When transition is finished 'Unlock' button changes to unlocked icon. [Failure case:] 'Unlock' button changes to failed unlock icon (red unlocked icon).

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard step text color encodes step result (green = success, red = failure)
verificationPatterns.example: The text 'Unlock and open the Printing Engine door' is marked in green, and the wizard advances to next step. [Failure:] marked in red, and the wizard does not advance to next step.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Interlock signal verifies physical door lock/unlock state
verificationPatterns.example: PE front door remains locked: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockLockStatus.PE_Front.Value = 1 / unlocked: Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: ServiceMode.Maintenance AvailabilityStatus.Reason distinguishes pre-transition from post-transition
verificationPatterns.example: PE zone has not moved to Service-Maintenance: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.ServiceMode.Maintenance.PE.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].Reason = 93 (SERVICE_REQUIRED) vs. State = 3 (COMPLETED_SUCCESSFULLY)

verificationPatterns.pattern: AtServiceMode node map distinguishes MNT vs operational nodes after entering service
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Manager.ExportedData.Sys.Status.AtServiceMode: nodes 1-38, 46-55 have MNT value. All the rest are operational.

verificationPatterns.pattern: MachineState.State tracks global press state across transitions
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = OFF / Service / Power_Disable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket tension axes remain constant during service entry (no unintended motion)
verificationPatterns.example: Blanket remains tensioned: AxesList.gBktAxes.BktTenF.Crtl.Basic_axis.Output.monitor.ActPosition = constant, ~56800

verificationPatterns.pattern: Backing roller HW outputs verify physical position unchanged during service entry
verificationPatterns.example: Subsystems.BKT.HW_Outputs.BR[1].PositionPistonPilot= 0, MainPistonA= 0, MainPistonB= 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Emergency stop aborts unlock, marks step red, fires error event, and sets Power_Disable state
verificationPatterns.example: After unsuccessful attempt 'Unlock' button change to prepare and button is disabled. Relevant error event is sent regarding pressing emergency button. OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = Power_Disable

verificationPatterns.pattern: After E-stop release, press recovers to OFF within ~20 s and re-enables Unlock
verificationPatterns.example: After about 20 seconds press state is OFF. OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = OFF. Unlock button is enabled.

verificationPatterns.pattern: MntMechConfig_Zones remains REGULAR_CONFIG throughout all phases (no config change during BID wizard flow)
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.MgmtCtrl.Out.Status.AtMntMechConfig_Zones[1-55] = REGULAR_CONFIG

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log message confirms service configuration intent
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in logs that Service: 'WARN-Go to Mntn PE - REGULAR_CONFIG' message appears in Manager thread.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Door open simulation uses dual-pole interlock signals set simultaneously
verificationPatterns.example: Simultaneously set OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockInputPoleA.PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Simulation.Value = 0 and OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockInputPoleB.PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Simulation.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: After exit-service, door re-locks, all AtServiceMode nodes return N/A, and PositionPistonPilot returns to 1
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockLockStatus.PE_Front.Value = 1. AtServiceMode: [1-55] all nodes = N/A. BR[1].PositionPistonPilot= 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard UI gates button availability and step progression on press-state preconditions
verificationPatterns.example: Unlock button unavailable + all following steps greyed out + Continue greyed out while press is in Standby; button becomes available only after press reaches OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tooltip content validates required press state on inactive button press
verificationPatterns.example: Pressing inactive Unlock button shows tooltip 'Press state OFF is required'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Async button text and visual state tracks multi-phase transition progress
verificationPatterns.example: Unlock button text: 'Preparing(Service)' during Service-Operational entry, then 'Preparing (Maintenance)' during Service-Maintenance entry; circular animation shown; button appears depressed and inactive throughout

verificationPatterns.pattern: PE front door lock status verified via InterlockLockStatus signal (1=locked, 0=unlocked)
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockLockStatus.PE_Front.Value = 0 after successful Unlock

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service-Maintenance transition completion verified via OperationData.State = 3 (COMPLETED_SUCCESSFULLY)
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.ServiceMode.Maintenance.PE.OperationData.State = 3

verificationPatterns.pattern: ServiceMode node MNT status verified across zone ranges via AtServiceMode export
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Manager.ExportedData.Sys.Status.AtServiceMode nodes 1-38, 46-55 have MNT value; nodes outside range remain N/A or OP

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket Service position verified via front and rear tension axis ActPosition signals
verificationPatterns.example: AxesList.gBktAxes.BktTenF.Crtl.Basic_axis.Output.monitor.ActPosition = 25000, BktTenR = 25000

verificationPatterns.pattern: Backing roller Service state verified via all three HW_Output signals set to 0
verificationPatterns.example: Subsystems.BKT.HW_Outputs.BR[1].PositionPistonPilot=0, MainPistonA=0, MainPistonB=0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service config zone assignment verified via AtMntMechConfig_Zones signal per zone range
verificationPatterns.example: OCB_saPLC.OCB.gInterface.MgmtCtrl.Out.Status.AtMntMechConfig_Zones 1-38, 46-55 = BKT_REPLACEMNT_CONFIG

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pre-transition ServiceMode state confirms press is NOT yet in Service-Maintenance
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.ServiceMode.Maintenance.PE.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].Reason = 93 (SERVICE_REQUIRED) before Unlock is pressed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Door-open simulation for automation uses dual-pole interlock simulation signals set simultaneously
verificationPatterns.example: Set InterlockInputPoleA.PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Simulation.Value = 0 AND InterlockInputPoleB.PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Simulation.Value = 0 simultaneously

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure mode: hardware interlock failure shows failed-unlock icon; step text marked red; wizard does not advance
verificationPatterns.example: Force InterlockLockStatus.PE_Front.Value = 1; after transition Unlock button shows red unlocked icon; step text stays red

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure mode: EMS interrupt during transition marks step red, disables button with tooltip, re-enables ~20s after EMS release
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate EMS via EmsInputPoleA/B UIC_OPR_ST_ESTOP = 0; after ~1 min step marked red, tooltip 'Press state Off is required'; after cancel override ~20s Unlock re-enables

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-exit state: AtServiceMode nodes return to N/A and service config reverts to REGULAR_CONFIG
verificationPatterns.example: After exit service: AtServiceMode nodes 1-38, 46-55 = N/A; AtMntMechConfig_Zones = REGULAR_CONFIG; InterlockLockStatus.PE_Front.Value = 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard close without 'Exit Service automatically' checkbox leaves press in Service-Maintenance with door open
verificationPatterns.example: After Cancel/finish: InterlockLockStatus.PE_Front.Value = 0, AtServiceMode nodes 1-38 46-55 = MNT, blanket and BR remain in Service position

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pre-condition gate: button disabled until press state met
verificationPatterns.example: Unlock button unavailable in Standby; tooltip 'Press state OFF is required' on click; becomes available only after press reaches OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button text/icon progression during async transition
verificationPatterns.example: Unlock -> 'Preparing(Service)' -> 'Preparing (Maintenance)' (with circular animation, depressed/inactive) -> unlocked icon on success, red unlocked icon on interlock failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Interlock lock status signal confirms door locked/unlocked
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockLockStatus.PE_Front.Value = 1 (locked) / 0 (unlocked)

verificationPatterns.pattern: ServiceMode zone state confirms transition completed
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.ServiceMode.Maintenance.PE.OperationData.State = 3 (COMPLETED_SUCCESSFULLY)

verificationPatterns.pattern: AtServiceMode node range check for MNT vs N/A values
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Manager.ExportedData.Sys.Status.AtServiceMode nodes 1-38, 46-55 = MNT after unlock; nodes 1-38, 46-55 = N/A after exit service

verificationPatterns.pattern: MechConfig zone transitions between ASID_REPLACEMENT_CONFIG and REGULAR_CONFIG
verificationPatterns.example: OCB_saPLC.OCB.gInterface.MgmtCtrl.Out.Status.AtMntMechConfig_Zones[1-38,46-55] = ASID_REPLACEMENT_CONFIG in maintenance; = REGULAR_CONFIG after exit

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket tension axes remain at constant position during service state
verificationPatterns.example: AxesList.gBktAxes.BktTenF.Crtl.Basic_axis.Output.monitor.ActPosition = constant ~56882 (in maintenance), ~56877 (door open); same for BktTenR

verificationPatterns.pattern: Backing roller piston outputs verify service position
verificationPatterns.example: Subsystems.BKT.HW_Outputs.BR[1].PositionPistonPilot=0, MainPistonA=0, MainPistonB=0 in service; PositionPistonPilot=1 after exit

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simulate door open via dual-pole interlock simulation signals
verificationPatterns.example: Set InterlockInputPoleA.PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Simulation.Value=0 AND InterlockInputPoleB.PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Simulation.Value=0 simultaneously

verificationPatterns.pattern: EMS failure: simulate via dual-pole EMS signals, verify ~1 min timeout, re-enable and verify ~20 sec recovery then retry succeeds
verificationPatterns.example: EmsInputPoleA/B.UIC_OPR_ST_ESTOP.Simulation.Value=0 triggers failure; cancel override -> Unlock re-enables after ~20s; wizard completable on second run

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard step text color indicates step result (green=success, red=failure)
verificationPatterns.example: 'Unlock and open the Printing Engine door' marked green on success, red on backing roller or EMS failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log message verification for service mode entry (manual only)
verificationPatterns.example: Manager thread log: 'WARN-Go to Mntn PE - ASID_REPLACEMENT_CONFIG'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Downstream wizard steps greyed out until current step completes
verificationPatterns.example: All steps after Unlock greyed out; Continue button greyed out until Unlock step fully succeeds

verificationPatterns.pattern: State persists after wizard close/cancel
verificationPatterns.example: After Cancel: PE door remains unlocked, PE zone remains COMPLETED_SUCCESSFULLY, AtServiceMode nodes retain MNT

verificationPatterns.pattern: AvailabilityStatus.Reason value note: 150 and 93 both represent SERVICE_REQUIRED
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.ServiceMode.Maintenance.PE.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].Reason = 150 or 93 (both valid, not a defect)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-calibration wizard adjustment check
verificationPatterns.example: All wizards should adjust to the new image placement after the correction.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Measurement parity against baseline job
verificationPatterns.example: The measure should be exact as the user job printed from the start of the print.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Full wizard coverage — run each wizard in sequence and confirm each reflects updated image placement
verificationPatterns.example: CC (simple and expert), SPM Validation, LPH uniformity, color uniformity, CPR, ILS, Quick scaling, StiR + auto insertion (stitch printing), Cleaner - PEX, CCC, LPH focus, Auto bias

verificationPatterns.pattern: Missing-ink fallback: press substitutes highest OD installed ink when expected ink absent
verificationPatterns.example: calibration printed without black separation; press should take the INK with the highest OD installed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass-station exclusion: wizard omits any station whose ink is installed on it when running with bypass
verificationPatterns.example: Wizard printed without the station that the INK installed on it

verificationPatterns.pattern: Highest-density ink selection: when multiple inks on one station, press selects ink with highest density
verificationPatterns.example: On print, press should select the V INK due to highest density (Y and V INKs installed on one station)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Station reference anchoring: note reference station number for calibration reproducibility
verificationPatterns.example: For now the reference is station 5

verificationPatterns.pattern: White ink installation gate check before wizard opens
verificationPatterns.example: verify White installed on press IBL: ImagePlacementDefaultParametersEntity — White installed and Wizard opened

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration sheet prints with white separation on top when White is installed
verificationPatterns.example: calibration printed with white separation on top

verificationPatterns.pattern: Negative XY offset shifts calibration sheet toward negative scale side
verificationPatterns.example: insert negative value on Y direction and negative value on X direction — prints moves the calibration sheet to the negative scale side

verificationPatterns.pattern: Positive XY offset shifts calibration sheet toward positive scale side
verificationPatterns.example: repeat step 2 for positive values — print moves the calibration sheet to the positive scale side

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mixed XY offsets produce independent per-axis directional shift
verificationPatterns.example: positive value on X direction and negative value on Y direction — print moves the calibration sheet to the positive scale side on X and negative on Y

verificationPatterns.pattern: Full XY offset matrix repeated with White not installed
verificationPatterns.example: verify White *not* installed on press — White not installed and Wizard opened; repeat steps 2-5

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pre-print ink station presence check
verificationPatterns.example: verify no White available on press before print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Color separation output check — no optional ink installed
verificationPatterns.example: On CPR squares only Black printed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Color separation output check — optional ink installed
verificationPatterns.example: On CPR squares White separation printed with Black background

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mechanical cycle count verification after print
verificationPatterns.example: press perform 2 blanket revolves

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI input range enforcement on measurement window
verificationPatterns.example: Window open with ask to enter front visible number -> need to enter the relevant number that visible (5-84)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Entity data persistence after wizard step
verificationPatterns.example: verify all data inserted into PEX->Entities

verificationPatterns.pattern: CPR zero-crossing status check after measurement
verificationPatterns.example: CPR Printed according to photo attached. All colors that available on press should be printed. Only Black separation background printed.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Before/after correction delta verification on user job
verificationPatterns.example: After Corner wizard, the image of the job corrected as the values inserted

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print fits installed substrate width
verificationPatterns.example: The print is fit to the substrate width installed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Maximum printed length capped at 50mm for 300mm substrate (line count: 50mm / 2mm per line = 25 lines)
verificationPatterns.example: verify maximum line number that printed is 50mm (each line =2mm)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Correction applied after data entry in print dialog
verificationPatterns.example: verify the correction done after data inserting

verificationPatterns.pattern: Max print area = substrate width / 2 / 2; job clipped to substrate width
verificationPatterns.example: Maximum print area is the Substrate width\2\2; job is clip according to the width

verificationPatterns.pattern: DFE exposes all required image position options in the margins table
verificationPatterns.example: DFE shall enable the user to set the Imposed Spread to one of: Bottom Center, Center (default), Top Center, Bottom Left, Left, Top Left, Bottom Right, Right, Top Right, Manual (horizontal + vertical)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Left margin offset shifts image start by the specified value
verificationPatterns.example: Insert Left margin value 20mm → 20mm added to left side of image (10mm each side)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Right margin offset mirrors left margin behavior
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat for Right 20mm margin → result same as left margin case

verificationPatterns.pattern: Job narrower than substrate with one-sided margin produces no clipping
verificationPatterns.example: Job 300mm wide + left margin 10mm → no clipping; only left side moves 10mm before image starts printing

verificationPatterns.pattern: Job wider than substrate with 'Print on installed substrate' selected loads and prints with potential right-side clipping
verificationPatterns.example: 340mm job on 324mm substrate → job ready to print; image not centered correctly and right side may be clipped

verificationPatterns.pattern: Width-arrangement-per-wizard: after starting each named wizard, SW must set effective/printable width equal to installed substrate width
verificationPatterns.example: For each wizard started the SW should arrange the width according to substrate width

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-width repeatability: repeat the same wizard-launch verification at boundary substrate widths (narrowest installable, 324mm printable-area boundary)
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat test for the narrowest substrate that can install on press / Repeat test for 324mm substrate width

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard enumeration coverage: exercise all listed bypass-centering/clipping wizards in a single pass rather than testing one wizard per case
verificationPatterns.example: Corner-X, Auto-bias, StiR, LPH Uniformity, Color calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Special mark not bypassed; associated control algorithm is active and behaves as defined
verificationPatterns.example: Verify CCC not bypassed and the color control is active and works as define.

verificationPatterns.pattern: All position-on-blanket algorithms consolidated into single value set sent to LPH
verificationPatterns.example: All the following position-on-blanket related algorithms below will be consolidated and passed on to LPH as a single set of values

verificationPatterns.pattern: Substrate margin is exactly 2mm on each side between image and substrate edge
verificationPatterns.example: Verify marge on substrate is 2mm each side.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat full sequence (load → print → verify) for each mark type variant
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat 1-2 for: Color Plain Registration (CPR), Scaling Calibration (SC), Continues Color Plain Registration (CCPR), Continues Scaling Calibration (CSC)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat full sequence with a narrower substrate width to confirm behavior generalizes
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat step 1-3 for substrate width is 320mm

verificationPatterns.pattern: Disable non-velocity controls during active operation
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all buttons except velocity is disabled during web feed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Conditional warning message display based on system state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify warning messages: Primer Required, Corona Required, Primer not Required, Corona not Required

verificationPatterns.pattern: Numeric input range enforcement
verificationPatterns.example: Verify speed limits 0.1 Meters/min - 50 Meters/min

verificationPatterns.pattern: Resource availability boundary check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify it's not possible to feed more substrate than available at the UW/RW

verificationPatterns.pattern: Equal bilateral clip margin when image width equals substrate width
verificationPatterns.example: 340mm substrate, 340mm job: each side margin = (340 - 324) / 2 = 8mm; verify both side margins equal 8mm

verificationPatterns.pattern: Equal edge cut when job width exceeds substrate width
verificationPatterns.example: 320mm substrate, 324mm job: output width = 320mm after clip with equal cuts on both sides

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameterized value selection with PLC write verification
verificationPatterns.example: Select tension value (3kg, 4kg, 5kg) in SWF wizard, then verify the corresponding tension value is set in the PLC

verificationPatterns.pattern: Feed at speed (m/min) with specific Premier/Corona flags, then verify PLC parameters reflect the command
verificationPatterns.example: Feed at 15m/min with Premier: True and Corona: False and verify parameters in the PLC

verificationPatterns.pattern: Exhaust all boolean combinations of Premier and Corona flags across multiple feed operations
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 2–5 cover (T,F), (F,T), (F,F), (T,T) combinations

verificationPatterns.pattern: Vary both speed (m/min) and distance (meters) across steps to cover different feed modes
verificationPatterns.example: 15m/min in step 2; 40m/min in step 3; 40 meters in step 4; 50 meters in step 5

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boolean flag matrix: iterate combinations of two boolean parameters (Premier, Corona) across multiple feed lengths, verifying PLC state after each feed
verificationPatterns.example: Feed 5m Premier:True Corona:False → verify PLC; Feed 25m Premier:False Corona:True → verify PLC; Feed 40m Premier:False Corona:False → verify PLC; Feed 50m Premier:True Corona:True → verify PLC

verificationPatterns.pattern: Length escalation: test increasing feed lengths (5, 25, 40, 50 meters) to cover short/medium/long range behavior
verificationPatterns.example: Feed 5 meters ... Feed 25 meters ... Feed 40 meters ... Feed 50 meters

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC parameter verification: after each feed command, read back PLC state to confirm parameters were transmitted correctly
verificationPatterns.example: verify parameters in the PLC

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unavailability reason check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the unavailability reason is correct when web feed is unavailable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button availability by wizard state
verificationPatterns.example: Close button disabled during wizard; Stop button available immediately after Run; Cancel disabled once wizard in progress

verificationPatterns.pattern: Controls disabled except target control
verificationPatterns.example: All enums and properties disabled and not editable, except speed process spin box and +/- buttons

verificationPatterns.pattern: Enum auto-selection matches installed substrate properties
verificationPatterns.example: Open SWF wizard, verify enum is selected according to substrate properties; repeat for each priming/corona combination

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mismatch alert per substrate definition deviation
verificationPatterns.example: Alerts: 'Substrate doesn't require Corona treatment', 'Substrate requires priming', 'Substrate requires both Corona treatment and priming', etc.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tension value inherits from substrate definition when tension mode selected
verificationPatterns.example: When tension substrate definition selected, Web tension equals tension of installed substrate

verificationPatterns.pattern: Property editable only in specific press state
verificationPatterns.example: User can change tension property ONLY at STD state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Spin box range enforcement with visual error indicator
verificationPatterns.example: Values outside range show red frame; RW roll full shows red frame with 'RW roll full' caption in red

verificationPatterns.pattern: Slider max capped by physical constraint
verificationPatterns.example: Length slider max = min(substrate remaining on unwinder, 50m); if 40m left on UW, max is 40m; exceeding shows spinbox red frame with error

verificationPatterns.pattern: Priming unavailable when substrate already primed
verificationPatterns.example: When installed substrate is primed, user cannot change to prime option

verificationPatterns.pattern: Accumulative and actual advance counters reset on screen open
verificationPatterns.example: Actual/Last web advance and accumulative SWF+WEB step advance shown and reset on screen opening

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default wizard state check
verificationPatterns.example: Primer ON, Corona OFF, Feed by Speed, default speed 15, tension Substrate defined

verificationPatterns.pattern: SWF active signal fires on web start
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.WHS.Ctrl.Out.Status.SWFActive = True when Play pressed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Subsystem AtPrime signals verified on web start
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.ILP.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtPrime = True and gInterface.Web.Comp.DRYER.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtPrime = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Corona state signal matches UI toggle selection
verificationPatterns.example: Corona OFF -> AtOFF = True; Corona ON -> AtRun = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Web average speed signal matches configured velocity
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ExportedData.WHS.Monitor.WebAvgSpeed = 250 at speed 15; = 2000 at speed 120

verificationPatterns.pattern: Line velocity parameter signal matches slider position
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.WHS.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.WebFeed.SWF_lineVelocity = 70 after slider move

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI controls change state during active feed
verificationPatterns.example: Play button changes to Stop, web counter advances, Close button disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Physical web length equals displayed counter value
verificationPatterns.example: Mark start/end web position, stop feed, measure actual length, compare to counter

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard closes cleanly after feed cycle
verificationPatterns.example: Press Close button after Stop; wizard closed successfully

verificationPatterns.pattern: Action available only when WebCtrl at Standby or Ready
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtStandBy = True OR gInterface.Web.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtReady = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Action unavailable when RW roll is full
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.RW.Ctrl.Out.Status.RollFull = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Action unavailable when UW roll is at end-of-roll
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.UW.Ctrl.Out.Status.EndOfRoll

verificationPatterns.pattern: Action unavailable when wash is in progress (wet required)
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.ILP.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtWash = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Action unavailable when primer tank is panic-low (wet required)
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.ILP.Comp.Liquids.Ctrl.Out.Status.PrimerTankPanicLow = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Action unavailable when primer tank level is invalid (wet required)
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.ILP.Comp.Liquids.Ctrl.Out.Status.PrimerTankLevelInValid = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Action unavailable when primer tank is not in place (wet required; not for automation)
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.ILP.Comp.Liquids.Ctrl.Out.Status.PrimerTankNotInPlace = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Action unavailable when primer tank is panic-high (wet required)
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.ILP.Comp.Liquids.Ctrl.Out.Status.PrimerTankPanicHigh = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Action unavailable when waste tank level is invalid (wet required)
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.ILP.Comp.Liquids.Ctrl.Out.Status.WasteTankLevelInValid = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Action unavailable with reason ID during roll replacement state; includes WEB_TENSION_REQUIRED + subsystem ID
verificationPatterns.example: Press.IBL.PaperHandling.RollReplacement.UnwinderPrepareReplaceRollOperation / Press.App.UIServer.Buzzerables.UnwinderEndReplaceRoll.BuzzerableUnwinderEndReplaceRollOperation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Action unavailable when ILP liquid stuck in AfterFault over MaxTimeForRecovery (wet required)
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.ILP.Comp.Liquids.Ctrl.Out.Status.WashRequired = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Availability reason is OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS while substrate feed via wizard is active
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.WebFeedWetNoCorona.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.MainReasonStr = OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS

verificationPatterns.pattern: Below threshold: roll diameter < StartTaperTensionDiameter → TaperRatio = 1, RequiredTension = substrate-defined value
verificationPatterns.example: RollDiameter=490, StartTaperTensionDiameter=500 → TaperRatio=1, RequiredTension=8000

verificationPatterns.pattern: At/above threshold: once roll diameter reaches StartTaperTensionDiameter during print → TaperRatio < 1 and RequiredTension decreases
verificationPatterns.example: RollDiameter above 500 → TaperRatio < 1, RequiredTension reduces from 8000

verificationPatterns.pattern: Below-threshold static check: TaperRatio==1 and RequiredTension==substrate nominal
verificationPatterns.example: RollDiameter=170 < StartDiameter=180 → TaperRatio=1, RequiredTension=8000

verificationPatterns.pattern: At/above-threshold dynamic check: TaperRatio<1 and RequiredTension decreases as diameter rises past start value
verificationPatterns.example: RollDiameter above 180 → TaperRatio less than 1, RequiredTension value reduces

verificationPatterns.pattern: Persistence check: configured value survives SW and PLC restart
verificationPatterns.example: After restart, TaperTensionStartDiameter.Value still reads 180

verificationPatterns.pattern: Below-minimum boundary rejection
verificationPatterns.example: Set Tension.RewinderTaperTensionStartDiameter to 160 (below core diameter) — verify value is rejected

verificationPatterns.pattern: Above-maximum boundary rejection
verificationPatterns.example: Set Tension.RewinderTaperTensionStartDiameter to 550 (above 500) — verify value is rejected

verificationPatterns.pattern: UsesTensionDefaults resets signal to default value
verificationPatterns.example: Enable 'Uses tension defaults' checkbox — verify NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.RW.TaperTensionStartDiameter.Value reverts to default

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pre-taper baseline: TaperRatio = 1, RequiredTension = substrate-defined value when roll diameter is below threshold
verificationPatterns.example: TaperRatio = 1, RequiredTension = 8000 when RollDiameter (320) < StartTaperTensionStartDiameter (350)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-threshold activation: TaperRatio drops below 1 and RequiredTension decreases as roll diameter rises above StartTaperTensionStartDiameter
verificationPatterns.example: RollDiameter.Value above 350 → TaperRatio < 1, RequiredTension value reduces

verificationPatterns.pattern: Check Available=False when blocking state active
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.LphCooling.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.Operations.GoToStandby.Available = False (when in Off state)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Check Available=True when required state active
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.LphCooling.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.Operations.GoToStandby.Available = True (when in Ready/Print/etc.)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify Reason signal populated when Available=False
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.LphCooling.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.Operations.GoToStandby.Reason

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify SubsystemID in global AvailabilityStatus reason array index 0
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.GetReady.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].SubsystemID = LPH COOLING

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify SensorID in global AvailabilityStatus reason array index 37 matches required machine state
verificationPatterns.example: Reason[37].SensorID = READY_REQUIRED (GoToStandby blocked) or STANDBY_REQUIRED (GoToOff blocked)

verificationPatterns.pattern: PowerEnable becomes unavailable when fault injected
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Reason[0].Reason matches expected fault code for the injected condition
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].Reason = TANK_LEVEL_PANIC_LOW

verificationPatterns.pattern: Reason[0].SubsystemID identifies LPH Cooling as the source subsystem
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].SubsystemID = LPH Cooling

verificationPatterns.pattern: Reason[N].SensorID matches the specific sensor or fault token for the condition
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].SensorID = LPHTankLevelPanicLow

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI Standby button grays out whenever Available = False
verificationPatterns.example: Standby button gray out with relevant error

verificationPatterns.pattern: PowerEnable becomes available once fault condition is cleared (AtOFF = True)
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: OFF_REQUIRED reason reported when LPH cooling subsystem is not in OFF state
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].Reason = OFF_REQUIRED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Availability positive check — OperationData or Monitor.Operations.Available reflects Available when component is in required state
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.GetReady.OperationData = Available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unavailability reason code on OperationData — top-level OperationData string equals the blocking reason code
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.GetReady.OperationData = STANDBY_REQUIRED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Reason[0].Reason field — AvailabilityStatus or Monitor reason array index 0 holds the expected reason code
