verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.GetReady.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].Reason = STANDBY_REQUIRED

verificationPatterns.pattern: SubsystemID check — Reason[0].SubsystemID must equal 'LPH COOLING'
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.GetReady.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].SubsystemID = LPH COOLING

verificationPatterns.pattern: SensorID check — Reason[37].SensorID must equal the blocking reason code
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.GetReady.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[37].SensorID = STANDBY_REQUIRED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Monitor.Operations.Available flag for service operations — Available = False when operation is blocked
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.LphCooling.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.Operations.GoToService.Available = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Monitor.Operations.Reason for service operations — Reason field holds SubsystemID 'LPH COOLING' and per-state reason code
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.LphCooling.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.Operations.GoToService.Reason[0].SubsystemID = LPH COOLING

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multiple unavailability reason codes per operation phase — GoToService maps each wrong LPH cooling state to a distinct reason (OFF_REQUIRED, STANDBY_REQUIRED, READY_REQUIRED)
verificationPatterns.example: Power disable & mechinit = OFF_REQUIRED; GetReady = STANDBY_REQUIRED; PrePrint/PostPrint/Print = READY_REQUIRED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Transition-in-progress reason — when press transitions between states while service move is pending, reason = SERVICE_AT_TRANSITION
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.LphCooling.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.Operations.ServiceGoToSeq.Reason = SERVICE_AT_TRANSITION

verificationPatterns.pattern: Zone-disabled reason — when PE interlock simulation is FALSE, reason = ZONE_DISABLED
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.LphCooling.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.Operations.ServiceGoToSeq.Reason = ZONE_DISABLED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-calibration print job success check
verificationPatterns.example: Job is printing without any error.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service state entry verification via signal
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.MgmtCtrl.Out.Status.AtService = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI default checkbox state assertion
verificationPatterns.example: Verify checkbox marked by default - 'Exit Service state upon close'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard failure then conditional recovery button appearance
verificationPatterns.example: Click Stop → verify wizard failed → verify Recalibrate button appeared

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter save verification via signal path
verificationPatterns.example: Verify results are saved in: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.In.Par.Save.ProcessSpeed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Negative save verification — close without Recalibrate must NOT persist data
verificationPatterns.example: Verify results are not saved in: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.In.Par.Save.ProcessSpeed

verificationPatterns.pattern: State restoration after wizard close
verificationPatterns.example: Click Close → Verify press state is Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat test with alternate path to cover negative branch
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat test; instead of Step 3 (Recalibrate), go directly to Step 4 (Close)

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI control disabled in non-service press states
verificationPatterns.example: Verify ASID speed calibration wizard play button is disabled in Off/GR/Ready/Print/PostPrint/PrePrint state

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI control enabled only in Service/Standby press states
verificationPatterns.example: Verify ASID speed calibration wizard play button is Enabled in Service/Standby state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard failure UI indicators
verificationPatterns.example: 'Calibration failed' text displayed under Play button in red; dialogue title marked in red; Play button available with 'Recalibrate' title; Close button available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault-specific failure event raised
verificationPatterns.example: ASID_SPEED_CALIB_NOT_CONVERGE raised when AtSpeedCalibRough = True; BR engage failure event; Blanket heating timeout event; ASID heating timeout event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press remains in Service state after wizard failure
verificationPatterns.example: Press remains in Service state (verified across all failure scenarios)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Last calibration date not updated on failure
verificationPatterns.example: Last calibration date not updated (verified across all failure scenarios)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault injection via forced sensor value
verificationPatterns.example: Force sensor signal to out-of-range value before running wizard to trigger specific failure path

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-gated button availability with tooltip
verificationPatterns.example: Play button is not available with tooltip 'Service state required'; Prepare for calibration is not available with tooltip 'OFF state required'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service state signal assertions on wizard entry
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.MgmtCtrl.Out.Status.AtService = True; gInterface.CVC.Ctrl.Out.Status.service.CVC_Main.Seq = True; gInterface.Station[X].Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.Ctrl.Seq = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button label and animation transitions during wizard lifecycle
verificationPatterns.example: 'Prepare for calibration' → 'Preparing calibration' with circular animation; Play → Stop on run start; Stop → Play on stop

verificationPatterns.pattern: Incomplete calibration indicated by red text
verificationPatterns.example: Recalibrate + 'Not completed' red text appears under Play button after Stop pressed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Successful calibration indicated by green visual indicators
verificationPatterns.example: 'Passed' green text under Play button; green line on top of dialogue and wizard shortcuts row

verificationPatterns.pattern: Last calibration date updated only on successful completion
verificationPatterns.example: Last calibration date is not updated during Prepare or mid-run; updated to current date and time only after Passed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration results written to all stations with uniform value
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.In.Par.Save.ProcessSpeed — verify all stations have same value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Result persistence across SW restart
verificationPatterns.example: After restart and printing a user job, gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.In.Par.Save.ProcessSpeed retains same values as end of calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI wizard triggers press state transition; verify via status signal
verificationPatterns.example: Enter ASID speed calibration wizard and click Continue → gInterface.MgmtCtrl.Out.Status.AtService = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-station status flag check (X=1-6 loop) sustained for a parameter-defined duration
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.Out.Status.AtSpeedCalibFreeRun = True for AsidTrqStabTime (SpeedCalibTrqStabTime) on all stations

verificationPatterns.pattern: Motor output speed matches saved process speed parameter
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.Out.Monitor.AxisSetSpeed = gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.In.Par.Save.ProcessSpeed for AsidTrqStabTime

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timer countdown monitor then verify downstream subsystem receives command after delay elapses
verificationPatterns.example: Wait BktHeatStartSec seconds; monitor blanketHeatingTimeRemain counter; then verify BKT heating signals active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simultaneous multi-signal verification: all conditions must be true at the same moment before advancing
verificationPatterns.example: Verify concurrently: BKT.Lateral.Ctrl AtRun=True AND BKT.Tension.Ctrl AtBldPrcssTen=True AND BKT.Temperature.AK.Ctrl[2] Activated=True, then verify AtProcessSpeed=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Phase completion flag checked in both component and station manager layers
verificationPatterns.example: Phase-1 done: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.Out.Status.SpeedCalibFreeRunDone = True AND gInterface.Station[X].SeqCtrl.Out.Status.AsidSpeedCalib.FreeRunDone = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Temperature-sorted sequential engagement: actuator engages coldest unit first, advances to next coldest, until all engaged and average reaches setpoint
verificationPatterns.example: T1 engages coldest ASID (lowest Temp_MelexisSens.Value); when that station reaches next-coldest temp, T1 engages next; repeat until all stations engaged and asidTempAvrg at setpoint

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timed engage/disengage cycle verified against parameter-driven durations
verificationPatterns.example: BKT.Seq AtBrEngageRepeatedly=True; arrBr[X] AtEngage for BrEngTime_sec, then AtDisengage for BrDisengTime_sec across X=1-6

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard teardown: verify stop propagated to all subsystems and actuators returned to safe/off state
verificationPatterns.example: BKT StopDone=True, CVC BlowersAtOffSpeed=True, all arrBr[X] AtDisengage=True, all Station[X] StationStopDone=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard close with exit-service checkbox restores press to original state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify 'Exit Service state upon close' checked by default → press returns to Standby after Close

verificationPatterns.pattern: Feature blocked until calibration flag cleared
verificationPatterns.example: INKs not available to print due to INK flow calibration wizard InkFlowCalibrationRequired=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard first-run state — no prior calibration date/time shown
verificationPatterns.example: On wizard - No date and time display for last calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Access point reachable from press unavailability message
verificationPatterns.example: User shall get access point to wizard from 'Unavailability press message'

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC parameters match SW requirements table
verificationPatterns.example: Verify parameters in PLC are according to SW requirements - 'Parameters Table – Summary' (table 2.15)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Disabled-BID availability gate — station linked to disabled BID is not selectable in wizard
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that ink preparation for ink station that connected to disabled BID is unavailable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass indicator on station — bypass icon shown when bypass is active on ink station
verificationPatterns.example: When bypass is active bypass indicator shall be visualized

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unavailability reason display — informative reason shown to user for unavailable station
verificationPatterns.example: An informative reason will be displayed to user for unavailable station

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pre-activation rollback allowed — user can roll back wizard before operation is activated
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that till the operation activation, user can roll back the wizard

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-activation wizard lock — no rollback and no close permitted while operation is running
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that during ink preparation activation running, user can not rollback the wizard / Verify that user can not close the wizard

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-instance limit — wizard supports up to 12 simultaneous instances
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that user can change to another instance of this wizard up to 12 instances

verificationPatterns.pattern: OPC-UA signal on activation start — InkPrepare signal set to 'start'
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation.Operations.Station[index].Ink[bidIndex].InkPrepare() = start

verificationPatterns.pattern: OPC-UA signal on stop + UI result — signal set to 'Stopped', UI displays 'Interrupted'
verificationPatterns.example: UI shall display the build operation result - Interrapted / OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation.Operations.Station[index].Ink[bidIndex].InkPrepare() = Stopped

verificationPatterns.pattern: OPC-UA signal on completion + UI result + progress params — signal set to 'Completed', UI shows 'Pass', progress includes Ink tank level, Density, Conductivity, Temperature
verificationPatterns.example: UI shall display the build operation result - Pass / OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation.Operations.Station[index].Ink[bidIndex].InkPrepare() = Completed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ready-status persistence — ink ready status held until user triggers get-ready or reduces back to standby
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that after ink is ready it shall keep the status until user will perform get ready or decide to reduce status back to standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: OPC-UA standby signal on standby — InkToStandby signal in completed state after station returns to standby
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that next parameter is in completed state: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation.Operations.Station[index].Ink[index].InkToStandby()

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parallel multi-station execution — all selected ink stations run preparation simultaneously
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that the Ink preparation of all ink station running parallelly

verificationPatterns.pattern: ImO empty auto-pause and auto-resume — operation pauses when imaging oil tank is empty, resumes automatically on refill if within timeout
verificationPatterns.example: When operation in progress and ImO got empty - operation shall be paused (No UX required) and automatically processed when refilled if not exceeded timeout

verificationPatterns.pattern: Get-Ready parallel with ink preparation — get-ready process starts concurrently with wizard
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that get ready process will started parallelly with ink preparation wizard

verificationPatterns.pattern: PrintOS audit record — user actions, pass/fail with timestamps, bypass tag, BID A/B, ME station, ink info sent to PrintOS and verifiable there
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that all operations that were done sent to PrintOS — including start timestamp, operation duration, pass/fail, stop timestamp, 'bypassed' tag if bypass persists, BID A/B, ME Station, Ink Info (color and index)

verificationPatterns.pattern: All-sensors-bypassed blocks wizard — wizard disabled and non-runnable when all monitored sensors (Ink tank level, Density, Conductivity, Temperature) are bypassed
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that the ink station in the ink preparation wizard is disabled automatically and wizard can not be run

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass icon on bypassed station in wizard
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that bypass icon is present on the bypassed ink station

verificationPatterns.pattern: Partial-bypass run allowed — wizard runs ignoring bypassed sensors, reports data from non-bypassed sensors only
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that user can run the wizard, and bypassed sensors will be ignored and user will get the not bypassed sensors data

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event table validation — each defined event fires with correct accompanying data
verificationPatterns.example: Go over the table and verify that the events are popping out with relevant data

verificationPatterns.pattern: ReasonID display for simulated unavailability — correct ReasonID shown per simulated case in reference table
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that the wizard is not available when simulating the cases that in the table and right ReasonID is displayed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simulate invalid measurement on Linear Fit step, verify correction sub-flow entered
verificationPatterns.example: On Linear Fit of Volume Vs. Time step - Simulate Invalid measurement → Measure invalid and INK flow correction step entered

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert Dry BID executes by checking DrainDone signal goes active
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Dry BID step starts NS4|String|gInterface.arrInk[1].Pump.Ctrl.Out.Status.DrainDone → Dry BID performed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simulate flow error exceeding tolerance boundary, assert calibration fails
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate Error Flow > maxiAllowedFlowTolerance on InkFlowResult signal → INK flow calibration failed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simulate flow error below tolerance boundary, assert calibration proceeds to correction wizard
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate Error Flow < maxiAllowedFlowTolerance on StableInkFlow signal → Calibration proceed to fix the INK flow

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert correction wizard provides full UX: explanation, screw illustration/animation, and cause data
verificationPatterns.example: Flow too low → user receives: (1) wizard explanation, (2) screw-turn illustration/animation, (3) maximum data on suspected cause

verificationPatterns.pattern: After user adjustment, assert recalibration restarts by checking AtInkFlowCalib sequence signal
verificationPatterns.example: After adjustment user proceeds → NS4|String|gInterface.arrInk[1].Main.Out.Status.Seq.InkFlowCalib.AtInkFlowCalib active → INK flow wizard restarts

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal state check after condition trigger
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.arrInk[1].Main.Out.Status.InkFlowValidationPassed — verify signal reflects 'Validation required' after threshold met

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence start verification via Get Ready
verificationPatterns.example: Start Get Ready and verify validation sequence starts for INK stations that require flow validation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Success path — signal confirms pass
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.arrInk[1].Main.Out.Status.InkFlowValidationPassed — verify signal changes to 'Validation passed successfully'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure path — cascading state changes
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate flow validation failure during GR; verify InkFlowCalibrationRequired = True for selected station and station becomes unavailable with relevant message

verificationPatterns.pattern: Station unavailability after calibration failure with specific message and flag state
verificationPatterns.example: INK not available; InkFlowCalibrationRequired set to True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bulk calibration trigger via wizard 'Run all' starts all stations simultaneously with UI status
verificationPatterns.example: All INKs start calibration with relevant status on UI after clicking 'Run all'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Close button disabled while at least one calibration still running
verificationPatterns.example: Stop all calibrations except one station — Close button should be disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Close button re-enabled only when final running calibration stops
verificationPatterns.example: Stop the last station that calibrated — Close button available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Availability and TT use cases validated against SWR section table
verificationPatterns.example: All availability/TT are according to table at 2.17 Wizard Availability / Sequence Activation (For EA)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold comparison: signal value must be below a panic-high derived limit
verificationPatterns.example: InkFlowValue < InkFlowCalculatedDeltaPanicHigh — verified on CalibratedRpm after simulating invalid parameter 2.6

verificationPatterns.pattern: Iteration-count guard: correction loop must not exceed a maximum retry count
verificationPatterns.example: Verify max 3 iterations of noisy calibration correction (Step 3)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic-limit breach detection on array signal: factored flow result compared against absolute panic limit
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate Factored Flow < InkFlowPanicHigh (13000 ml/min) on NS4|String|gInterface.arrInk[1].Main.Out.Exported.Calib.InkFlow.arrFactoredFlowResult triggers 'Correction required' state

verificationPatterns.pattern: User-facing message format verification: message must contain measured value, units, and quantified corrective action
verificationPatterns.example: "Measured flow [ ] [units] is too high and shall be reduced. Please close (clockwise) [ ] turns to reduce the flow."

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-correction success gate: re-run calibration signal must show passing result after manual adjustment
verificationPatterns.example: After screw adjustment, NS4|String|gInterface.arrInk[1].Main.Out.Exported.Calib.InkFlow.InkFlowResult must reflect successful calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-signal confirms wizard phase completion
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.arrInk[1].Main.Out.Status.Seq.InkFlowCalib.AtInkFlowCalib → 'Delta BID calculation finished'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calculated value stays within panic-high delta bound
verificationPatterns.example: InkFlowValue < InkFlowCalculatedDeltaPanicHigh, where delta = (SetInkRPMis3300 - inkPumpCalibrationRPM)*(inkFlowPanicHigh - inkFlowSetPoint)/(SetInkRPMis3300 - SetInkRPMis2700)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Noise check drives RPM selection and calibration result display
verificationPatterns.example: SW checks if RPM measure is noisy; CalibratedRpm signal reflects final selection; result shown to user

verificationPatterns.pattern: Invalid measure triggers automatic re-measure retry
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate invalid RPM → SW starts RPM measure again (CalibratedRpm signal re-evaluated)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Three consecutive failures raise max-iteration failure event
verificationPatterns.example: After 3rd INK_FLOW_RPM_MEASURE_FAILURE: event INK_FLOW_CALIBRATION_MAX_ALLOWED ITERATIONS_FAILURE raised

verificationPatterns.pattern: Station locked out for print after calibration failure on wizard exit
verificationPatterns.example: Exit wizard after failure → INK station not available for print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration timeout locks station when wizard exceeds time limit
verificationPatterns.example: Wizard running > InkFlowCalibTimeOut (InfFlowCalibrationTimeoutSec) → selected station shall fail

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-conditional wizard branching: wizard skips preparation when INK already Ready
verificationPatterns.example: Wizard starts with 'Skip the INK preparation and start the return validation step' when INK is in Ready state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pre-condition state check: verify INK in Standby before flow start
verificationPatterns.example: Before starting the INK flow INK in SB mode (INK not ready)

verificationPatterns.pattern: In-progress signal assertion during build phase
verificationPatterns.example: Calibration starts → INK preparation starts (build INK) → INK *Not* circulate via BID

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure injection and error message validation
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate failure (Volume too low, Density...) → Wizard failed on relevant error; error code INK_PREPARATION_TIMEOUT

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition: INK moves to SB with timed stabilization delay at Flow=0 and RPM pump=0
verificationPatterns.example: INK move from ready to SB; Flow=0 & RPM pump=0; InkStabilizationDelaySec=5 (min=1 max=10) delay starts

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump OFF + timed additional stabilization before supplying ink to BID
verificationPatterns.example: KIDS pump OFF; wait InkToBidDelaySec=10s before recording INK delta at BID

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump ON + timed drain sequence, then verify DrainDone and bypass valve closed
verificationPatterns.example: KIDS pump ON; DrainBidDurationSec=8s delay; verify DrainDone signal and BypassValveOpen=false

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tolerance boundary check: measured delta <= threshold passes; simulate > threshold to verify failure error
verificationPatterns.example: Measured level - Recorded level <= AllowedInkReturnTolerance (0.2L) → pass; repeat steps 1-5 with simulated >0.2L → INK_RETURN_FAILURE wizard error displayed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-calibration state reset: pump RPM returns to default, tank returns to ready state
verificationPatterns.example: CalibratedRpm back to default value; Sys.Status = ready state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass blocks wizard availability
verificationPatterns.example: Set bypass BYPASS_IS_ACTIVE on station → 'Calibration not available' shown with reason

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inactive component blocks wizard
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate INK tank not in place → wizard not available for that station (COMPONENT_INACTIVE)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wrong press state blocks wizard with tooltip
verificationPatterns.example: SB, Ready, OFF states → wizard unavailable; tooltip with relevant message displayed (SERVICE_REQUIRED)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Correct state exposes wizard with metadata
verificationPatterns.example: Service SEQ state → wizard available, last calibration time shown, Run All and Close buttons present

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-color calibration progress uses infinite spinner
verificationPatterns.example: During calibration: LPM, RPM, date not displayed; progress indicator is infinite spinner (process type)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration sequence steps verified in order
verificationPatterns.example: 1. INK preparation/build → 2. Return validation/leak check (rough tolerance) → 3. Delta BID calculation (fine tolerance) → 4. RPM calibration → 5. Result + timestamp saved

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pass/fail result with per-station visualization
verificationPatterns.example: Completed stations show tick + calculated value; failure shows error message with event logged

verificationPatterns.pattern: Result persisted to entity
verificationPatterns.example: PEX: INKflowcalibrationEntity updated with timestamp and calibration data on completion

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal-driven empty state verification
verificationPatterns.example: Press.IBL.InkPlumbing.InkStation.InkStationEntity,[ink station index],SasInfo.RevolverInfo.InkTubeInfos[tube index].TubeLevel = Empty

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal-driven revolver bypass verification
verificationPatterns.example: Press.IBL.InkPlumbing.InkStation.InkStationEntity,[ink station index],SasInfo.SasConfiguration.RevolverActive = false

verificationPatterns.pattern: Replacement window lifecycle: appeared then closed after confirmation with SN persisted
verificationPatterns.example: Ink Tube Replacement window appeared; Window closed, and new Ink tube SN saved

verificationPatterns.pattern: Manual S/N entry validated before wizard closes
verificationPatterns.example: Type manually the ink tube S/N; S/N validated; Window closed, and new Ink tube SN saved

verificationPatterns.pattern: Duplicate-color single-empty: empty tube auto-selected
verificationPatterns.example: Two ink stations with same color installed; one empty simulated; Empty Ink tube selected automatically

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-confirmation reset delay: all stations unselected 1.5 s after confirmation
verificationPatterns.example: 1.5 Seconds after replacement confirmation, all stations are unselected and user can select next station

verificationPatterns.pattern: Duplicate-color both-empty: user manually selects station; only matching-color stations selectable
verificationPatterns.example: Select the ink station that you would like to replace the ink tube (You should be able to select only ink stations with scanned color)

verificationPatterns.pattern: PEX tube position swap after replacement: outside tube becomes inside (active), inside becomes outside
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that tubes position in the PEX switched. The outside tube became inside tube (Active Tube) and Inside tube became outside tube

verificationPatterns.pattern: Not-in-place state verification via signal, then confirmed resolved after revolver rotation
verificationPatterns.example: Press.IBL.InkPlumbing.InkStation.InkStationEntity -> [Ink Station] -> SasInfo -> ActiveTubeNotInPlace = true; after replacement and revolver rotation full tube should become active tube and not-in-place side should be outside

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal confirms simulated empty tube state
verificationPatterns.example: Press.IBL.InkPlumbing.InkStation.InkStationEntity,[ink station index],SasInfo.RevolverInfo.InkTubeInfos[tube index].TubeLevel = Empty

verificationPatterns.pattern: Replacement wizard appears then closes with new S/N persisted
verificationPatterns.example: Ink Tube Replacement window appeared; Window closed, and new Ink tube SN saved

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inner tube transitions to full+active; outer tube stays empty until S/N scan completes
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that the inner tube is now full and active; Verify that outer tube is still empty till tube replacement (SN scanning)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Revolver rotation occurs after replacement confirmation
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Revolver rotation

verificationPatterns.pattern: 1.5-second post-confirmation delay before all stations deselect
verificationPatterns.example: 1.5 Seconds after replacement confirmation, all stations are unselected and user can select next station

verificationPatterns.pattern: Manual S/N entry validated before wizard proceeds
verificationPatterns.example: S/N validated; Ink tube S/N validated

verificationPatterns.pattern: Empty station auto-selected when duplicate-color has exactly one empty tube
verificationPatterns.example: Empty Ink tube selected automatically

verificationPatterns.pattern: User must manually pick station when duplicate-color has both tubes empty; only stations matching scanned color are selectable
verificationPatterns.example: Select the ink station that you would like to replace the ink tube (You should be able to select only ink stations with scanned color)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Notification shown when scanned tube targets a non-empty active tube
verificationPatterns.example: Before the replacement window, user should get notification that the replacement is not required yet

verificationPatterns.pattern: ActiveTubeNotInPlace signal set true; revolver rotates so full tube becomes active tube
verificationPatterns.example: Press.IBL.InkPlumbing.InkStation.InkStationEntity -> [Ink Station] -> SasInfo -> ActiveTubeNotInPlace = true; After Ink Tube replacement, revolver should rotate and full tube should became as active tube and not in place revolver side should be out side

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press-state gate on wizard entry: wizard only accessible in STANDBY; OFF state shows inline message instead
verificationPatterns.example: Under 'Confirm Replacement' button appear text: In order to load tube, switch to standby and above

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor-driven button enable/disable: Confirm And Continue disabled while ActiveTubeNotInPlace = true, enabled when false
verificationPatterns.example: Tube In Place sensor is False → Confirm and continue button is disabled; Tube In Place sensor is True → Confirm and continue button is enabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Color mismatch scan rejection with explicit user message
verificationPatterns.example: Verify message: Scanned ink serial number color belongs to deactivated station. Validate that you scanned the correct tube; Verify message: Scanned ink serial number color is not installed on the press. Validate that you scanned the correct tube

verificationPatterns.pattern: Invalid S/N inline validation: red error text under S/N field and Confirm disabled until corrected
verificationPatterns.example: Under the tube S/N text box should appear text in red color: Serial Number is not valid; Confirm and Continue button disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Scan ignored when wizard is open; user notified of ignore
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that scan session was ignored due to wizard is open and user notified regarding the ignore.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Close-with-unsaved-data requires confirmation dialog; cancelling preserves progress, confirming discards
verificationPatterns.example: dialog asking the user if he is sure that he wants to close the process; Process closed, Data not saved

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-replacement timing: configurable display of confirmation for N seconds, then all stations unselected
verificationPatterns.example: 1.5 Seconds after replacement confirmation, all stations are unselected and user can select next station

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-station same-color, one empty: auto-select the empty station in wizard
verificationPatterns.example: Empty Ink tube selected automatically; Right Tube station visualized empty

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-station same-color, both empty: wizard forces manual station selection filtered to scanned color
verificationPatterns.example: Select the ink station that you would like to replace the ink tube (You should be able to select only ink stations with scanned color)

verificationPatterns.pattern: TubePulsesCounter resets to 0 per ink station after tube replacement; verify via PEX signal
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that 'Press.IEngine.PLC.Common.Counters.PlcCounterEntity->OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Ink[InkID.Ink1].ExportedData.Sys.Counters.TubePulsesCounter' parameter value is '0' in every ink station

verificationPatterns.pattern: Replacing a tube that is the same physical tube as the simulated-empty one still saves data and changes status to FULL in PEX
verificationPatterns.example: SN validated; Data saved and tube status changed to FULL in the PEX

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability check via OPC-UA status signals
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.Sequence.Resrvoir.ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = true AND MainReasonStr = Available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button state transition on sequence activation (Activate→disabled, Stop→enabled; paired operation fully disabled)
verificationPatterns.example: 'Activate' button of Refill becomes unavailable, 'Stop' becomes available; 'Activate' and 'Stop' of Drain both become unavailable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump activation at expected speed value
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.ExportedData.Reservoir.Motors.FilterPumpInvActSpeed ~ 3240

verificationPatterns.pattern: Secondary pump activation with dynamic setpoint as speed reference
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.HW_Outputs.Reservoir.InkImoPumpSpeed.Value = OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.ImportedData.Resrvoir.ImoToIcFlowSetPoint

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence completion verified via State=3 (Success) plus multi-component OFF state
verificationPatterns.example: ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.State = 3; gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.Reservoir.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true; gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.WasteCtrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true; gInterface.Station(X).Comp.CS.Main.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOFF = true; CsPump.Value = 0; FilterPumpInvActSpeed = 0; InkImoPumpCtrl.Value = false; InkImoPumpSpeed.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify local control parameter equals expected numeric default
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.Reservoir.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.ImoConductivityRecoveryThreshold = 12

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify OPC UA imported data signal equals expected numeric default
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.ImportedData.Resrvoir.FilterPumpSpeed = 3080

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability check via AvailabilityStatus signals before activation
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.Sequence.Resrvoir.ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = true AND MainReasonStr = Available

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI button state transition on operation activate: Activate becomes unavailable, Stop becomes available; paired operation (Drain) also becomes fully unavailable
verificationPatterns.example: 'Activate' button of Refill becomes unavailable; 'Stop' button of Refill becomes available; 'Activate' and 'Stop' of Drain both become unavailable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequential pump activation: filter pump activates immediately, reservoir (inks) pump activates after fixed delay (5 seconds)
verificationPatterns.example: Filter pump active at FilterPumpInvActSpeed ~ 3240; after 5s InkImoPumpCtrl.Value = true AND InkImoPumpSpeed = ImoToIcFlowSetPoint

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simulate hardware level sensor transition by toggling HW_Inputs level signals within a timeout window derived from local parameters
verificationPatterns.example: Set ReservoirCleanLevelHigh.Value = false before (ImOCleanRefillToHighTimeout + ImOCleanRefillToHighTimeoutOffest) elapses from reservoir pump activation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Conductivity phase gate: set conductivity to threshold value to enter reduction verification phase, then wait less than the verification delay before dropping further
verificationPatterns.example: Set ReservoirCond = 16 to enter reduction verification; wait < ImOConductivityReductionVerificationDelay (e.g. 10s); then set ReservoirCond = 13 (decrease by ImOConductivityReductionVerification)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pumps remain active and unchanged throughout conductivity reduction verification phase; no intermediate state changes expected
verificationPatterns.example: FilterPumpInvActSpeed ~ 3240, InkImoPumpCtrl.Value = true, InkImoPumpSpeed = ImoToIcFlowSetPoint during ~280s verification window

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation completion verified via done flag, OperationData.State = 3 (Success), and full component OFF-state cascade
verificationPatterns.example: CleanTankRefillDone = true; ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.State = 3; Reservoir AtOff = true; WasteCtrl AtOff = true; Station CS AtOFF = true; CsPump = 0; FilterPumpInvActSpeed = 0; InkImoPumpCtrl = false; InkImoPumpSpeed = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard button state machine: verify enabled/disabled state of Service mode, Enable activations, Activate, and Stop buttons at each operation phase
verificationPatterns.example: Step 3: 'Service mode' enabled; 'Enable activations', 'Activate', 'Stop' disabled. Step 7: Drain 'Activate' unavailable (reason: 'Operation in progress'), Drain 'Stop' available, Refill buttons unavailable (reason: 'Component busy').

verificationPatterns.pattern: Availability signal pair check: verify AvailabilityStatus.Available = true and AvailabilityStatus.MainReasonStr = 'Available' together after state transitions
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Manager.Sequence.ImoCleanTankDrain.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = true and MainReasonStr = Available (Step 4); same pattern for ImoCleanTankRefill after drain completes (Step 12).

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout-based failure: force sensor HW_Input to trigger failure condition, wait fixed timeout, verify operation stops with Failed status and UI event published
verificationPatterns.example: Step 10: Force ReservoirCleanLevelHigh = true, wait 2 min → IMO_RSV_CLEAN_TANK_TIMEOUT event, drain stops. Step 16: wait 24 s → IMO_RSV_CLEAN_TANK_LEVEL_TOO_LOW. Step 18: wait 30 s → IMO_RSV_CLEAN_TANK_REFILL_TIMEOUT. Step 20: wait 120 s → IMO_RSV_SG_CONDUCTIVITY_REDUCTION_TIMEOUT.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Scope-based order-of-operations verification: record scope on key gInterface/gIos signals before activating a sequence, then verify correct ordering from the trace or Service window
verificationPatterns.example: Step 6–8: scope on WasteCtrl.AtMechInit, CS.AtFreeWetting, CS.AtMechinit, CsInletPump, IMO_Valve (stations 1 & 2); verify IMO waste MI → CS MI → CS valve 1 open, valve 2 closed → CS inlet pump on → CS1 at FreeWetting until drain ends.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-component shutdown sequence: after operation Success, verify IMO Reservoir, IMO Waste, all CS stations, and all pumps reach OFF state in correct order
verificationPatterns.example: Step 11/24: gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.Reservoir.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true; gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.WasteCtrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true; gInterface.Station(X).Comp.CS.Main.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOFF = true; CsPump.Value = 0; ImoReturnPump.Value = 0; FilterPumpInvActSpeed = 0; InkImoPumpCtrl.Value = false.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation state value check: verify OperationData.State = 3 (Success) on completion
verificationPatterns.example: Step 11: ImoCleanTankDrain.OperationData.State = 3. Step 24: ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.State = 3.

verificationPatterns.pattern: CS flow rate parameter parity check: after drain, verify working flow setpoint is restored to imported setpoint
verificationPatterns.example: Step 13: gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.Reservoir.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.CsWorkingFlowSetPoint = gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.Reservoir.Ctrl.In.Par.Import.ImoFlowSetPointPerCS.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Conductivity reduction verification phase: set conductivity to drop by required delta within verification delay window; confirm refill continues without failure
verificationPatterns.example: Step 23: wait < ImOConductivityReductionVerificationDelay (e.g. 10 s), set ReservoirCond.Value = 13; verify no failure and refill continues ~200 s with filter and reservoir pumps still active.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor-level mapping: three discrete reservoir level states encoded by two boolean signals (Low + High); use combinations to set 'low', 'norm'/'medium', or 'high' logical level
verificationPatterns.example: Low=true, High=true → logical 'low' (Step 11/15). Low=false, High=true → logical 'medium' (Step 17). Low=false, High=false → logical 'high' (Step 19/21).

verificationPatterns.pattern: End-to-end press recovery: after wizard completes, exit Service state, cycle press to Standby then Ready, print arbitrary job to confirm no regression
verificationPatterns.example: Step 25: close wizard, exit Service state, press reaches OFF, bring to Standby then Ready, print job successfully.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability gate: check both UI button state and OPC-UA AvailabilityStatus signals agree
verificationPatterns.example: 'Activate' button available with reason 'Available'; OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.Sequence.Resrvoir.ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = true; MainReasonStr = Available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button mutual-exclusion on sequence start: Activate becomes unavailable, Stop becomes available; sibling operation (Drain) buttons both go unavailable
verificationPatterns.example: 'Activate' button of Refill becomes unavailable; 'Stop' button of Refill becomes available; 'Activate' and 'Stop' buttons of Drain operation both become unavailable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump activation and speed check: verify both control flag and actual speed reach expected setpoint
verificationPatterns.example: Filter pump: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.ExportedData.Reservoir.Motors.FilterPumpInvActSpeed ~ 3240; Reservoir pump: InkImoPumpCtrl.Value = true AND InkImoPumpSpeed.Value = ImoToIcFlowSetPoint

verificationPatterns.pattern: Level-sensor timing boundary: simulate level transition (true→false) before the configured timeout elapses from pump activation
verificationPatterns.example: Set ReservoirCleanLevelLow.Value = false before ImOCleanRefillToLowTimeout passes from Filter pump activation; set ReservoirCleanLevelHigh.Value = false before ImOCleanRefillToHighTimeout (+offset) passes from Reservoir pump activation

verificationPatterns.pattern: User abort produces State=4 (Interrupted) and all actuators off; verify every pump and component individually
verificationPatterns.example: ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.State = 4; FilterPumpInvActSpeed = 0; InkImoPumpCtrl.Value = false; InkImoPumpSpeed.Value = 0; CsPump.Value = 0; Reservoir.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true; WasteCtrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true; Station(X).CS.Main.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOFF = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-abort recovery: re-run full successful sequence and confirm State=3 (Success) with identical actuator-off postconditions
verificationPatterns.example: CleanTankRefillDone = true; ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.State = 3; all pump and component OFF checks identical to abort case

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability via AvailabilityStatus signals
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.Sequence.Resrvoir.ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = true AND MainReasonStr = 'Available'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service-state bypass of conductivity monitoring
verificationPatterns.example: Set ReservoirCond.Value = 20; expected: no machine state change, conductivity monitor not active in Service

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button state transition on sequence activation
verificationPatterns.example: 'Activate' button becomes unavailable, 'Stop' button becomes available for Refill; both Drain buttons become unavailable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump speed verification against setpoint signal
verificationPatterns.example: FilterPumpInvActSpeed ~ 3240 (matches ImportedData.Resrvoir.FilterPumpSpeed.Value setpoint)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Level-sensor phase gate with timeout reference
verificationPatterns.example: Set ReservoirCleanLevelLow.Value = false before ImOCleanRefillToLowTimeout elapses; no state change expected

verificationPatterns.pattern: Secondary pump activation after fixed delay
verificationPatterns.example: Reservoir (inks) pump activates 5 s after filter pump; InkImoPumpCtrl.Value = true, InkImoPumpSpeed.Value = ImoToIcFlowSetPoint

verificationPatterns.pattern: Compound timeout trigger: delay + recovery window
verificationPatterns.example: Keep conductivity = 13 for ImOConductivityReductionVerificationDelay + ImOConductivityRecoveryTimeout ms; error fires when value stays above ImoConductivityRecoveryThreshold

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error-induced full shutdown: operation state, component OFF status, and all pump outputs
verificationPatterns.example: ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.State = 5 (Failed); FilterPumpInvActSpeed = 0; InkImoPumpCtrl.Value = false; InkImoPumpSpeed.Value = 0; CsPump.Value = 0; Reservoir.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true; WasteCtrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true; Station(X).CS.Main.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOFF = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability via OPCUA AvailabilityStatus signals
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.Sequence.Resrvoir.ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = true AND MainReasonStr = Available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button state transitions on sequence activation (Activate -> unavailable, Stop -> available)
verificationPatterns.example: 'Activate' button of Refill becomes unavailable; 'Stop' button of Refill becomes available; 'Activate' and 'Stop' buttons of Drain become unavailable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Actuator speed verification against ImportedData setpoint
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.ExportedData.Reservoir.Motors.FilterPumpInvActSpeed ~ 3240 (matching FilterPumpSpeed.Value setpoint)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inject HW_Input signal to simulate sensor state for automation
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.HW_Inputs.Reservoir.ReservoirCleanLevelLow.Value = false to simulate level reached before timeout

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout error event visible in press UI
verificationPatterns.example: IMO_RSV_CLEAN_TANK_REFILL_TIMEOUT event is issued in press UI after ImOCleanRefillToHighTimeout + ImOCleanRefillTohighOffsetTimeout ms

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation state = 5 (Failed) after error
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.Sequence.Resrvoir.ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.State = 5

verificationPatterns.pattern: Full actuator shutdown and component AtOff verification after failure
verificationPatterns.example: FilterPumpInvActSpeed = 0, InkImoPumpCtrl.Value = false, InkImoPumpSpeed.Value = 0, CsPump.Value = 0, Reservoir.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true, WasteCtrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation returns to Available after failure (self-reset)
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.Sequence.Resrvoir.ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = true after Refill fails

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability check via AvailabilityStatus before and after state transitions
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.Sequence.Resrvoir.ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = true AND MainReasonStr = Available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump activation state and speed verification after each sequence step
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.Reservoir.Ctrl.Out.Status.FilterPumpOn = true; gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.Reservoir.Comp.FilterPumpInv.Out.monitor.ActSpeed = 3080

verificationPatterns.pattern: Named timeout error event issued in press UI and logs within expected parameter-driven delay
verificationPatterns.example: IMO_RSV_SG_CONDUCTIVITY_REDUCTION_TIMEOUT event issued after ImOConductivityReductionVerificationDelay (80 ms) from reservoir pump activation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation transitions to Failed state (State = 5) after error condition met
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.Sequence.Resrvoir.ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.State = 5 (Failed)

verificationPatterns.pattern: All actuator components reach AtOff state after failure
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.Reservoir.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true; gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.WasteCtrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: All pump HW outputs explicitly zero/false after failure
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.HW_Outputs.Reservoir.InkImoPumpCtrl.Value = false AND InkImoPumpSpeed.Value = 0; FilterPumpInvActSpeed = 0; CsPump.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation re-availability confirmed after failure to allow retry
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.Sequence.Resrvoir.ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = true (after State = 5)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability via UI button state and OPCUA AvailabilityStatus signals
verificationPatterns.example: 'Activate' button becomes available with reason 'Available'; OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.Sequence.Resrvoir.ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = true; MainReasonStr = Available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence start confirmed by Activate→unavailable and Stop→available button transitions
verificationPatterns.example: 'Activate' button of Refill becomes unavailable; 'Stop' button of Refill becomes available; Drain Activate and Stop both unavailable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Hardware actuator activation verified via actual speed signal against imported setpoint
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.ExportedData.Reservoir.Motors.FilterPumpInvActSpeed ~ 3240 (setpoint from OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.ImportedData.Resrvoir.FilterPumpSpeed.Value)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event issuance verified in press UI and operation State transitions to Failed (5)
verificationPatterns.example: IMO_RSV_CLEAN_TANK_ILLEGAL_LEVEL event appears in press UI; OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.Sequence.Resrvoir.ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.State = 5

verificationPatterns.pattern: On error: all related components and pumps verified to shut down via AtOff status and HW_Outputs signals
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.Reservoir.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true; gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.WasteCtrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true; CsPump.Value = 0; FilterPumpInvActSpeed = 0; InkImoPumpCtrl.Value = false; InkImoPumpSpeed.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-error operation returns to Available (not blocked), confirming reset readiness
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.Sequence.Resrvoir.ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = true after failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability: assert both UI button state and backing OPCUA availability signals agree before triggering the sequence
verificationPatterns.example: "Activate" button availability reason = "Available"; OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.Sequence.Resrvoir.ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = true; MainReasonStr = Available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button state transition on sequence start: Activate becomes unavailable, Stop becomes available; cross-operation button states also update (Drain Activate and Stop both become unavailable)
verificationPatterns.example: After pressing Activate: Refill Activate unavailable, Refill Stop available, Drain Activate unavailable, Drain Stop unavailable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Actuator speed verification: confirm motor/pump speed signal reaches expected numeric value after sequence activation
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.ExportedData.Reservoir.Motors.FilterPumpInvActSpeed ~ 3240

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout-triggered error: wait for the configured timeout parameter value, then assert the error event appears in press UI and operation state transitions to Failed (5)
verificationPatterns.example: Wait gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.Reservoir.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.ImOCleanRefillToLowTimeout ms; IMO_RSV_CLEAN_TANK_LEVEL_TOO_LOW event issued; ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.State = 5

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-failure shutdown: verify all related components reach OFF/zero state — component status flags, pump output values, and motor speed signals all cleared
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.Reservoir.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true; gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.WasteCtrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true; CsPump.Value = 0; FilterPumpInvActSpeed = 0; InkImoPumpCtrl.Value = false; InkImoPumpSpeed.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-failure re-availability: after a failed sequence the operation must return to Available so recovery can be attempted
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.Sequence.Resrvoir.ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = true after state = 5

verificationPatterns.pattern: Availability gate: both operations show Available=true when press is in Service-Operational state and all zones are in Service-Sequence state
verificationPatterns.example: "Activate" button of Drain becomes available with reason "Available"; OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Manager.Sequence.ImoCleanTankDrain.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = true and MainReasonStr = Available. Same for Refill.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mutual exclusion A→B: starting Drain sets Refill Available=false with Reason[0].Reason = "OperationInProgress"
verificationPatterns.example: Press 'Activate' on Drain → OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.Sequence.Resrvoir.ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = false and Reason[0].Reason = "OperationInProgress"

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mutual exclusion B→A: starting Refill (after Drain finishes) sets Drain Available=false with Reason[0].Reason = "OperationInProgress"
verificationPatterns.example: Wait for Drain to finish, press 'Activate' on Refill → OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Manager.Sequence.ImoCleanTankDrain.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = false and Reason[0].Reason = "OperationInProgress"

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability gate: check AvailabilityStatus signals and UI button state match
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.Sequence.Resrvoir.ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = true AND MainReasonStr = Available AND 'Activate' button shows availability reason 'Available'

verificationPatterns.pattern: HW input injection to simulate analog sensor value (conductivity)
verificationPatterns.example: Set OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.HW_Inputs.Reservoir.ReservoirCond.Value = 20; verify no state change in Service mode

verificationPatterns.pattern: HW input injection to simulate discrete level sensor (both Low and High bits set for 'below low' state)
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.HW_Inputs.Reservoir.ReservoirCleanLevelLow.Value = true AND ReservoirCleanLevelHigh.Value = true → logical level is 'low'

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI operation button state transition on sequence activation (Activate→unavailable, Stop→available; sibling operation buttons also become unavailable)
verificationPatterns.example: 'Activate' button of Refill becomes unavailable, 'Stop' button becomes available; 'Activate' and 'Stop' of Drain both become unavailable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Motor speed verification via ExportedData actual-speed signal compared to expected RPM
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.ExportedData.Reservoir.Motors.FilterPumpInvActSpeed ~ 3240

verificationPatterns.pattern: HW output pump control verification: boolean enable signal + speed setpoint signal match ImportedData setpoint
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.HW_Outputs.Reservoir.InkImoPumpCtrl.Value = true AND InkImoPumpSpeed.Value = OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.ImportedData.Resrvoir.ImoToIcFlowSetPoint

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout-bounded phase progression: inject level/sensor change before timeout parameter elapses to advance sequence phase
verificationPatterns.example: Set ReservoirCleanLevelLow.Value = false before gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.Reservoir.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.ImOCleanRefillToLowTimeout elapses from filter pump activation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Conductivity reduction verification phase: set conductivity above threshold, wait < verification delay, then drop by required delta
verificationPatterns.example: Set ReservoirCond.Value = 16, wait < ImOConductivityReductionVerificationDelay (e.g. 10 s), then set to 13 (drops by ImOConductivityReductionVerification); verify phase completes successfully

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence completion state check: OperationData.State = 3 (Success) plus component AtOff status signals
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.Reservoir.Ctrl.Out.Status.CleanTankRefillDone = True AND ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.State = 3

verificationPatterns.pattern: Full system return-to-OFF verification after sequence success: reservoir, waste, CS stations, and all pumps
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.Reservoir.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true; WasteCtrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true; gInterface.Station(X).Comp.CS.Main.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOFF = true; FilterPumpInvActSpeed = 0; InkImoPumpCtrl.Value = false; InkImoPumpSpeed.Value = 0; CsPump.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Drain availability gate: button enabled only when press is Service-Operational and all IMO/CS zones are Service-Sequence
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Manager.Sequence.ImoCleanTankDrain.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = true; MainReasonStr = Available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Drain failure state: operation stops with State = 5 on any error
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Manager.Sequence.ImoCleanTankDrain.OperationData.State = 5 (Failed)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Full component shutdown after drain stop (failure or abort): IMO Reservoir and waste AtOff, all CS AtOFF, CS pump off, filter pump 0, ink/IMO pump off
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.Reservoir.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true; gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.WasteCtrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true; gInterface.Station(X).Comp.CS.Main.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOFF = true; OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.HW_Outputs.Reservoir.CsPump.Value = 0; OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.ExportedData.Reservoir.Motors.FilterPumpInvActSpeed = 0; OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.HW_Outputs.Reservoir.InkImoPumpCtrl.Value = false AND InkImoPumpSpeed.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Drain timeout is formula-driven and scales with active ME station count
verificationPatterns.example: {(ImoCleanTankVolume * 60) / (CsFlowLongFreeWetSetPoint * Number of active ME stations)} + ImoCleanDrainTimeoutOffset/1000; error = IMO_RSV_CLEAN_TANK_DRAIN_TIMEOUT

verificationPatterns.pattern: Availability pre-condition block: specific unavailability reason string returned when a blocking condition is detected before activation
verificationPatterns.example: Clean tank already low → reason 'IMO_CLEAN_TANK_LEVEL_ALREADY_LOW'; catch tray full + no waste bottle → reason 'IMO_UC_WASTE_NO_DESTINATION'; Stop button always unavailable with 'Operation is not in progress' when idle

verificationPatterns.pattern: User abort mid-operation lands in same failed/shutdown state as hardware failures
verificationPatterns.example: Press Stop when CS reach Free Wetting → State = 5; all pumps and components go to OFF same as failure path

verificationPatterns.pattern: Successful drain completion: State = 3, same component shutdown as failure path
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Manager.Sequence.ImoCleanTankDrain.OperationData.State = 3 (Completed successfully); all pumps off, IMO Reservoir/waste AtOff, CS AtOFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Force hardware sensor to inject failure condition mid-operation to trigger specific error event in UI
verificationPatterns.example: Force IMOflowMonitor.Value < CsFlowLongFreeWetSetPoint → 'IMO flow low' UI error; force CS_EngageFront_Sens=1 while CS_Disengage_Sens=1 → 'CS sensor illegal state' UI error; set ImoRtnBfrVol.Value=25 → IOS_CS_BFFR_LVL_PRSSR_SNS LVL_PANIC_HIGH UI event

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-gated UI button availability with reason string
verificationPatterns.example: 'Service mode' button is unavailable with reason 'Off state required' in Standby; becomes available in OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: OPC UA signal check for machine state transition
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = 4 (Service) after pressing 'Service mode'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability requires both service zone AND sequence mode — check Available flag plus MainReasonStr
verificationPatterns.example: ImoCleanTankDrain.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = false, MainReasonStr = SEQ_REQUIRED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-zone service mode level verification via AtServiceMode map (EA=1, SEQ=2, OP=4)
verificationPatterns.example: Zones 19-24, 44-47 at 2 (SEQ); all other zones at 4 (OP) after Enable Activations for Drain

verificationPatterns.pattern: Single zone removal from SEQ blocks dependent operations — partial zone failure test
verificationPatterns.example: Set zone 19 = 1 (EA) via OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.ServiceMode.Common; verify Drain and Refill Activate buttons go unavailable with SEQ_REQUIRED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-path test action: manual HMI path documented alongside automation OPC UA signal path
verificationPatterns.example: Manual: HMI->Manager->Service-Station->Press EA near Cleaning station ME1; Automation: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.ServiceMode.Common zone 19 = 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability check via OPCUA status + UI button state
verificationPatterns.example: 'Activate' button of Drain operation becomes available, AvailabilityStatus.Available = true, AvailabilityStatus.MainReasonStr = Available

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI button mutual exclusion on sequence start
verificationPatterns.example: 'Activate' button becomes unavailable, 'Stop' button becomes available when Drain is running

verificationPatterns.pattern: Short-lived status flag verification (AtMechInit pulse)
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.ImoSystem.Comp.WasteCtrl.Out.Status.AtMechInit = true for short period of time

verificationPatterns.pattern: Hardware output value check for pump activation
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.HW_Outputs.Reservoir.CsPump.Value > 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Flow setpoint equality check after mode change
verificationPatterns.example: CsWorkingFlowSetPoint = CsFlowLongFreeWetSetPoint (currently 3)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-station valve state check keyed by active/inactive status
verificationPatterns.example: Active stations: IMO_Valve.Value = 1; Deactivated stations: IMO_Valve.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-phase CS state sequence verification (MechInit -> FreeWetting -> remain)
verificationPatterns.example: AtMechinit = true briefly, then AtGoToFreeWetting = true, then AtFreeWetting = true sustained

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor injection to prevent timeout mid-sequence
verificationPatterns.example: Set ReservoirCleanLevelHigh.Value = true while ReservoirCleanLevelLow.Value = false to keep drain running without timeout

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold injection to trigger conditional sub-component activation
verificationPatterns.example: Set ImoRtnBfrVol.Value = 16 to trigger ImoReturnPump.Value = 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence completion state check via operation State enum
verificationPatterns.example: ImoCleanTankDrain.OperationData.State = 3 (Success)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-completion OFF state verification for all sub-components
verificationPatterns.example: Reservoir.AtOff = true, WasteCtrl.AtOff = true, CS.Main.AtOFF = true per active station

verificationPatterns.pattern: Delay-bounded completion: final sensor set triggers timed shutdown
verificationPatterns.example: After ImoCleanDrainDelay time from ReservoirCleanLevelLow = 1, drain stops and all components reach OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Flow setpoint revert verification post-operation
verificationPatterns.example: CsWorkingFlowSetPoint reverts to CsFlowSetPointPerCS (imported param, not local)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual verification path: automation signals OR HMI window observation
verificationPatterns.example: For manual testing: use CS window in HMI->MEStation or Service-ImoSGReplacement window under Manager

verificationPatterns.pattern: Motor speed ramp-up profile verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that Pump motor speed reached the 3000 rpm from 450 rpm in ~3 seconds with steps of 95 rpm every 100 milliseconds

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual digital output combination → fault event mapping
verificationPatterns.example: A=1 & B=1 → MOTOR_STALLED; A=0 & B=1 → MOTOR_OVER_TEMP; A=1 & B=0 → MOTOR_UNDERVOLTAGE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault event visible in new UI after signal simulation
verificationPatterns.example: Verify event: MOTOR_STALLED in new UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mode progression gate before functional test
verificationPatterns.example: Click Get Ready button → reach Ready mode → Print Any job, then verify motor behavior

verificationPatterns.pattern: WG offsets reset to 0 on new substrate install
verificationPatterns.example: WG offsets (auto and manual) shall be reset (0) while installing new substrate

verificationPatterns.pattern: Substrate width value matches WG menu display
verificationPatterns.example: Verify substrate width match to the width on WG menu

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal-to-UI binding check: verify UI fields display correct signal values
verificationPatterns.example: UI displays WG actual position (pwsWebGuideActualPos), actual position, and substrate width (pwsWebGuideSubstrateWidth) after mode switch

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dynamic response check: manually trigger physical condition, verify system reacts automatically
verificationPatterns.example: During print, move substrate manually; verify WG tracks substrate edges and centers it dynamically

verificationPatterns.pattern: Numeric input range and step validation: verify value can be changed in defined increments within signal-defined bounds
verificationPatterns.example: During print/SWF/Ready state, change offset in steps of 0.1mm within range defined by pwsWebGuideAutoRange

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mode status signal confirms active mode
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.Web.Comp.WHS.Comp.WebGuide.Output.Status.Manual — expected: WG is in manual mode

verificationPatterns.pattern: Offset value persists after menu adjustment
verificationPatterns.example: Adjust offset to 4mm on menu; expected: Offset is 4mm

verificationPatterns.pattern: Automatic mode offset resets to zero on transition from manual
verificationPatterns.example: Switch WG mode to Automatic during print; NS4|String|gInterface.Web.Comp.WHS.Comp.WebGuide.Output.Status.AutoMode — expected: Offset on automatic mode should zero (0)

verificationPatterns.pattern: No substrate movement when switching from automatic to manual during print
verificationPatterns.example: During automatic mode change WG mode to manual; expected: No substrate movement changed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal injection to trigger COM fault in SB state
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate COM error via NS4|String|gInterface.Web.Comp.WHS.Comp.WebGuide.Output.Status.fault — Expected: Communication error display

verificationPatterns.pattern: COM error visibility during active print job
verificationPatterns.example: Start print job and simulate WG COM error — Expected: WG COMMUNICATION_ERROR message shall display

verificationPatterns.pattern: COM error visibility during SWF
verificationPatterns.example: Start SWF and simulate WG COM error — Expected: WG COMMUNICATION_ERROR message shall display

verificationPatterns.pattern: UW/RW toggle reachable by user
verificationPatterns.example: The user shall be able to active/deactivate the UW/RW

verificationPatterns.pattern: App→PLC: Unwinder active triggers tension build
verificationPatterns.example: Unwinder active - build UW tension

verificationPatterns.pattern: App→PLC: Unwinder deactivate releases tension
verificationPatterns.example: Unwinder deactivate - release UW tension

verificationPatterns.pattern: App→PLC: Rewinder active inflates core then builds tension (two-phase sequence)
verificationPatterns.example: Rewinder active - inflate RW core → build RW tension

verificationPatterns.pattern: App→PLC: Rewinder deactivated releases tension then deflates core (two-phase sequence, reverse order)
verificationPatterns.example: Rewinder deactivated - release RW tension → deflate RW core

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mode auto-transition on press state change
verificationPatterns.example: Move press to Stand By → WG mode moves to automatic as default

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default values table comparison
verificationPatterns.example: Verify default values as attached table — values same as table values (WG default values - PEX.PNG)

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI navigation and sensor indication
verificationPatterns.example: Open main menu → Web Guide → WG window opened; sensor indications show relevant WG mode

verificationPatterns.pattern: Automatic mode substrate centering during print
verificationPatterns.example: Start SWF/print in automatic mode → substrate centralized, movement parallel to PWS idlers, offset displayed on WG menu

verificationPatterns.pattern: Center mode substrate mid-placement
verificationPatterns.example: Start SWF/Print when WG in Center mode → substrate placed in middle of WG

verificationPatterns.pattern: Max-position offset fault triggers press stop and UI error
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate WG at max position offset (Auto mode) → Event POSITION_SNS_INVALID sent, press stops and falls to Ready state, error displayed on UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cross-mode fault scenario repeat
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat max-position step in SWF → verify max position does not issue during the process

verificationPatterns.pattern: Activate winder builds tension
verificationPatterns.example: Unwinder active - build UW tension

verificationPatterns.pattern: Deactivate winder releases tension
verificationPatterns.example: Unwinder deactivate - release UW tension

verificationPatterns.pattern: Rewinder activation sequence: inflate core then build tension
verificationPatterns.example: Rewinder active - inflate RW core → build RW tension

verificationPatterns.pattern: Rewinder deactivation sequence: release tension then deflate core
verificationPatterns.example: Rewinder deactivated - release RW tension → deflate RW core

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal state after deactivate
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.RW.Comp.TensionCtrl.Out.Monitor.At_Tension = False AND gInterface.Web.Comp.RW.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtDeactivate = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal state after activate
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.RW.Comp.TensionCtrl.Out.Monitor.At_Tension = True AND gInterface.Web.Comp.RW.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtDeactivate = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Physical roll swap sequence
verificationPatterns.example: Cut paper → remove roll → install new roll → arm core pneumatics → duct tape new substrate

verificationPatterns.pattern: Web feed after reactivation
verificationPatterns.example: Perform web feed to confirm RW ready state post-replacement

verificationPatterns.pattern: Deactivate UW — verify tension released and deactivate status set
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.RW.Comp.TensionCtrl.Out.Monitor.At_Tension = False; OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ExportedData.UW.Status.AtTension = False; gInterface.Web.Comp.UW.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtDeactivate = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Lower UW arm — verify arms-down command acknowledged
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.UW.Ctrl.In.Cmd.ArmsDown = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Activate UW after roll install — verify deactivate cleared and tension restored
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.UW.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtDeactivate = False; gInterface.Web.Comp.RW.Comp.TensionCtrl.Out.Monitor.At_Tension = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: CE code gates feature unlock
verificationPatterns.example: Enter CE code → verify press SW can now be minimized

verificationPatterns.pattern: Restart resets protected UI state to default
verificationPatterns.example: Restart PC and start press SW → verify full mode restored and minimize no longer available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wrong CE code shows inline error and disables confirm
verificationPatterns.example: Enter wrong CE code → verify 'invalid password' text shown and confirm button not pressable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Restore from minimized state via UI control
verificationPatterns.example: Press minimize icon → press restore full mode button → verify full window restored

verificationPatterns.pattern: Exception thrown and SW halts on invalid bypass state transition
verificationPatterns.example: Exception should be thrown, error appear. SW launch should be stopped at this point.

verificationPatterns.pattern: DB file unchanged when SW is halted by exception
verificationPatterns.example: DB file should not change.

verificationPatterns.pattern: DB created in expected schema when bypass flag set before first launch
verificationPatterns.example: Open the newly created DB file (S:\Press\PressSB.db). Verify that a DB was created in old scheme.

verificationPatterns.pattern: SQLite schema structure check — old vs new layout
verificationPatterns.example: Before upgrade: one 'Ver' column and all data aggregated in one other column. After upgrade: data separated into distinct columns, each holding correct values.

verificationPatterns.pattern: App log clean-start check after schema change
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that no DB errors appear in App logs after startup, and new DB file is created.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Entity value parity before/after migration via PEX
verificationPatterns.example: Compare values and structure of selected entities before and after the upgrade — values and structure should be the same.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-migration CRUD validation covering simple, composed, and collection-of-composed entity types
verificationPatterns.example: Change arbitrary values, add field, remove field, save to Data Center — all operations should succeed and data saved correctly.

verificationPatterns.pattern: No DB errors in App logs after feature-bypass removal and startup
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that no DB errors appear in App logs after startup.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Entity values and structure preserved across schema migration (compare pre/post snapshots)
verificationPatterns.example: Compare the values and the structure of the selected entities before and after the upgrade. The values and structure should be the same.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Full CRUD on entities succeeds after upgrade (add field, remove field, save)
verificationPatterns.example: Try changing arbitrary values in the entity. Add field to an entity. Remove field from an entity. Save the results (in Data Center). All the operations should be performed successfully, data should be saved correctly.

verificationPatterns.pattern: SQLite schema correctly transitions from single JSON blob column to flat columns; composed/nested entities split into related tables
verificationPatterns.example: Before the edit there was one 'Ver' column and all data aggregated in one other column. After the upgrade the data is separated to different columns. Entities that consisted of 'table inside table' are now split to two entities with related names.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Conversion is idempotent — not re-executed on subsequent SW launches
verificationPatterns.example: Close press SW. Launch it again. No DB related errors appear, the PEX data is not corrupt.

verificationPatterns.pattern: No conversion errors when installing a newer SW version over an already-converted DB
verificationPatterns.example: Install newer press SW version on top of DB already converted to a new scheme. No DB related errors appear, the PEX data is not corrupt.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Entity lifecycle operations succeed
verificationPatterns.example: Add Entity, Remove Entity — operations pass successfully

verificationPatterns.pattern: Property lifecycle operations succeed
verificationPatterns.example: Add Property, Remove Property, Rename Property, Change Enum Name, Change Property Type — operations pass successfully

verificationPatterns.pattern: Data CRUD operations succeed
verificationPatterns.example: Update Data, Insert Data, Remove Data — operations pass successfully

verificationPatterns.pattern: Foreign key lifecycle operations succeed
verificationPatterns.example: Add FK, Remove FK, Change FK — operations pass successfully

verificationPatterns.pattern: Scroll and navigation coverage across all UI areas
verificationPatterns.example: This test checks in the Supplies Counters wizard that the scroll and navigation are as expected in all areas.

verificationPatterns.pattern: State pair assertion: verify Press state AND PLC state together
verificationPatterns.example: Press state = Ready, PLC state = Dynamic ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Component active/inactive checklist after transition
