verificationPatterns.example: Blanket rotate and heating is working; Stir is disengaged; All T1 are engaged; ME station keeps get ready all components active; CVC blower stay in get ready speed; Air knife full speed; Cleaning station is engaged

verificationPatterns.pattern: Temperature target range check
verificationPatterns.example: ASID keeps temperature control to ASID temp target. 42 +- 8

verificationPatterns.pattern: Standby/OFF component shutdown checklist
verificationPatterns.example: Blanket rotation stop, standstill; All T1 disengage; ME station standstill, no ASID rotation, CR/CS/BID disengaged; Temperature control OFF; Imaging oil flow OFF; Imaging oil temperature control OFF; Inks/LPH cooling active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout boundary: verify default and maximum limits
verificationPatterns.example: Timeout is 10 minutes. Maximum limit is 100 minutes.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass: activation, cold-ready mode behavior, persistency across press+PLC restart
verificationPatterns.example: When bypass activate, press work in cold ready mode. Verify persistency after restart press and PLC.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Negative transition guard: verify disallowed state change is blocked
verificationPatterns.example: Verify user can not go to service from dynamic ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event recovery: verify correct fallback state per source state
verificationPatterns.example: Error during dynamic ready → go to ready; Error during print → go to ready; verify go to standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-print counter validation
verificationPatterns.example: Check in the Supplies Counters wizard that all counters are updated as expected after print.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Check blanket install information in Supplies Counters wizard
verificationPatterns.example: checks in the Supplies Counters wizard the blanket install information

verificationPatterns.pattern: Check consumable install info in Supplies Counters wizard after physical replacement
verificationPatterns.example: checks in the Supplies Counters wizard the bid install information

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-consumable-install wizard data validation
verificationPatterns.example: Open Supplies Counters wizard and confirm ASID install information is present and accurate after replacement

verificationPatterns.pattern: CCC-marked job remains available to print when CCC is unavailable
verificationPatterns.example: When CCC is not available - As SPM not connected or missing separation, We still be able to print the job

verificationPatterns.pattern: Transparent substrate print availability
verificationPatterns.example: Transparent substrate? Expected: TBD

verificationPatterns.pattern: Navigation anchor scroll-sync
verificationPatterns.example: Press BID area anchor on left; verify contents pane scrolls to BID section. Scroll contents pane; verify the anchor for the reached section highlights.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-wizard counter reset: S/N, timestamp, and A3 counter = 0
verificationPatterns.example: After Blanket wizard: SerialNumber == Press.IBL.HwParts.Blanket.BlanketEntity->InstalledInfo.SerialNumber; ReplacementTime == InstalledInfo.ReplacementTime; Blanket A3 counter = 0. Same pattern for ASID and BID base/roller.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Reset button UX: animation + green acknowledge + event emitted
verificationPatterns.example: Press any consumable reset button; verify pressed-depressed animation, 'Report sent' green message appears under button, SuppliesReplacementReport event appears in Kibana and logs with correct consumable type and time.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-ASID counter isolation on reset
verificationPatterns.example: Press 'Charge roller' for one ASID row; verify PEX.IEngine:PlcCountersEntity.TotalCREngageAboveCRDCThreshold resets only for that ASID, other ASIDs unchanged. Same isolation check for CS Brush, CS Wiper, CS Sponge, LPH buttons.

verificationPatterns.pattern: A3 counter formula verification after print job
verificationPatterns.example: Blanket A3 = IBL.AppCounterEntity.Blanket.Counters.BlanketT1EngagesPrint * 766.5 / 490; ASID A3 = IBL.PLCCounterEntity.Manager.ExportedData.Sys.Counters.TotalPrintaSiDRotationsT1 * 766.5 / 490; BID base/roller A3 = IBL.AppCounterEntity.BID(n).Counters.BidBase/RollerTotalRotationsEngagePrint * 125.66 / 490.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter reset during active print does not crash
verificationPatterns.example: Trigger a consumable counter reset while a print job is in progress; verify press does not crash.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Report send failure shows error message
verificationPatterns.example: Disconnect network or simulate send error; verify relevant error message appears in dialogue.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Setting persists after hardware/service restart
verificationPatterns.example: Restart Edison and verify after reset jobs stay at print queue; CCC remain with the mark

verificationPatterns.pattern: Setting persists after job execution completes
verificationPatterns.example: Print the job and verify after print ends, CCC still marked in job properties

verificationPatterns.pattern: Setting persists after consumable/media replacement
verificationPatterns.example: Perform substrate replacement; verify CCC still checked at the job

verificationPatterns.pattern: Setting persists after SW restart
verificationPatterns.example: Perform SW restart and Verify CCC still checked at the job

verificationPatterns.pattern: Setting persists after calibration procedure
verificationPatterns.example: Perform CC; verify CCC still checked at the job

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify default checked state of PQ toggle via PEX entity
verificationPatterns.example: Scroll down to PQ Tools headline - Verify CCC is marked PEX: jobPropertiesEntity → CCC marked as default

verificationPatterns.pattern: Uncheck toggle, save, verify unchecked state persisted
verificationPatterns.example: Unmarked CCC and save action → CCC unchecked

verificationPatterns.pattern: Check toggle, save, verify checked state persisted
verificationPatterns.example: Checked CCC in the job and save → CCC marked

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print job and verify feature-specific output included for all separations
verificationPatterns.example: Print the selected job → Job printed with CCC strips with all selected separations

verificationPatterns.pattern: Reprint job and verify toggle state and output persist across consecutive prints
verificationPatterns.example: Print the job again → CCC remain selected and the CCC strips include in the print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequential job pass-then-fail validation
verificationPatterns.example: First job prints without issue; second job with high ink coverage does not print successfully

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary condition on ink coverage threshold
verificationPatterns.example: Normal job passes max ink coverage check; high-coverage job fails max ink coverage check

verificationPatterns.pattern: Over-limit coverage triggers print failure
verificationPatterns.example: one of the pages is above the limit, printing fails with event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print fail + event when total coverage exceeds max
verificationPatterns.example: 2 premium white (340%) + 2 standard (200%) = 540% > 470% → print fails, event raised

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print succeeds when total coverage is below max
verificationPatterns.example: 2 premium white (340%) + 1 standard (100%) = 440% < 470% → print succeeds

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print succeeds when total coverage equals max exactly
verificationPatterns.example: 1 premium white (170%) + 3 standard (300%) = 470% = 470% → print succeeds

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary length exclusion — jobs shorter than MinLengthForInkCovCalc must not be blocked by ink coverage check
verificationPatterns.example: Print a Job that the length is under 40CM (MinLengthForInkCovCalc) with above 500% coverage → Print succeeded

verificationPatterns.pattern: Coverage region position — high-coverage area confined to job tail does not trigger failure
verificationPatterns.example: Print a job with 1M length the 500% coverage area in the job will be at the end of the job (20CM in the button of the job) → Print succeeded

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert calibration logs emit INK coverage events
verificationPatterns.example: Logs from the calibration should issue about INK coverage

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert event payload contains required fields
verificationPatterns.example: Events send with: BlanketRevMode (Phase 3, phase 1 = 1), ErrorReason, maxInkCovValues, JobIdentifier, spread, copy, stripe

verificationPatterns.pattern: Config boundary value check
verificationPatterns.example: MinLengthForInkCovCalc = 40cm. Max value is 50cm

verificationPatterns.pattern: Below-threshold job triggers slice accumulation
verificationPatterns.example: Load job with length under 40 CM and above 500% coverage; SW takes ink coverages of previous slices until total length exceeds MinLengthForInkCovCalc

verificationPatterns.pattern: High-coverage zone at job tail with stripe-level length breakdown
verificationPatterns.example: 1M job, 500% coverage area at end (20 CM at bottom); e.g., 1st stripe 30 CM, 2nd stripe 19 CM, 3rd stripe 20 CM

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error on excessive ink coverage — check pre-print or early-page trigger
verificationPatterns.example: Press start pre-print and issue an error about InkCoverageTooHigh OR error appears during first pages; press falls to ready state

verificationPatterns.pattern: High total ink coverage (440%) prints without error
verificationPatterns.example: Print 2 P.white 100% + 1 100% from YMCK (total 440%); expect no issues

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mixed PW + YMCK coverage prints without error
verificationPatterns.example: Print PW 100% and YMC 100%; expect no issues

verificationPatterns.pattern: Non-PW station sharing slot not normalized by 1.7 factor
verificationPatterns.example: Install P.white with a YMCK ink; print YMCK 100% from that station; verify job prints without issue and station is not normalized by 1.7

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pre-print error before high-coverage page is reached
verificationPatterns.example: Press start pre-print and issue an error about InkCoverageTooHigh

verificationPatterns.pattern: In-print error during first pages of the job
verificationPatterns.example: During first pages of the job the error InkCoverageTooHigh appear

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket rotation capped at one round when coverage error occurs
verificationPatterns.example: Blanket rotates max 1 round

verificationPatterns.pattern: Config value assertion via DB — check named numeric field equals expected constant
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Premium white factor equal 1.7 in PrintConfigEntity under Inkcoverage data structure (*DB* \ink entity)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold config assertion via Meta Data — check named threshold field equals expected constant
verificationPatterns.example: Verify OneRevInkCovMaxThresh equal 329 in Meta Data; expected Max = 500 (note: step value and expected value differ in source)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event fires during print when coverage exceeds threshold — assert event ID appears within first pages
verificationPatterns.example: Load YMCKW 100% job, start print; during first pages InkCoverageTooHigh event must appear and print must stop

verificationPatterns.pattern: Atomic stop assertion — when error halts print, no partial separation set is output
verificationPatterns.example: Verify no '2 of 4 separations printed' state exists after stop (manual testing)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Queue ordering — normal-coverage job loaded after an over-threshold job still prints first
verificationPatterns.example: Load job with coverage < 329%; verify it is the first to print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-job threshold boundary — first job completes normally, second job above threshold stops the press
verificationPatterns.example: Load second job with coverage > 329%, print continuously; first job finishes with no issue, press stops on second job

verificationPatterns.pattern: Compare algorithm input data against ELC source data for equality
verificationPatterns.example: Compare data from ELC and data from algorithm — Should be same

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify non-bypassed stations still produce valid data when subset of stations is bypassed
verificationPatterns.example: Set bypass to stations 1,4 and ran calibration. Compare data from station 2,3,5,6 — Should be same.

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-transition position invariant — verify Asid relative position equals SB reference after each state change
verificationPatterns.example: In Ready state Verify asids relative position remain same as in SB

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-GR-start position check — confirm position invariant holds immediately after GR start
verificationPatterns.example: 1.start GR → In Ready state Verify asids relative position remain same as in SB

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-print position check — confirm position invariant holds after a print cycle completes
verificationPatterns.example: 2.start print → In Ready state after print Verify asids relative position remain same as in SB

verificationPatterns.pattern: Round-trip SB→Ready position check — confirm position invariant survives SB re-entry and return to Ready
verificationPatterns.example: 3.Move to SB and again to Ready → In Ready state after print Verify asids relative position remain same as in SB

verificationPatterns.pattern: EM waits for all hosts to complete initialization during boot
verificationPatterns.example: verify element manager is waiting for all Hosts to finish initialization

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boot fails with component-specific message when any host closes or crashes during SW boot
verificationPatterns.example: if any of the hosts are being closed or crashing that boot will fail with a message according to failed component

verificationPatterns.pattern: Killing a non-vital process does not block work or printing
verificationPatterns.example: kill non vital process such as ivision and verify you still can work and print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Killing a vital process blocks work and requires SW restart
verificationPatterns.example: kill vital process such as iDO that you can't work and SW restart is needed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Closing Elastic VM before boot causes EM boot timeout failure
verificationPatterns.example: close the elastic VM and verify element manager will fail to boot due to timeout

verificationPatterns.pattern: Starting Elastic VM mid-boot allows boot to complete successfully
verificationPatterns.example: close the elastic VM, start the press SW and during boot start the VM. verify that the SW boot finished succesfully.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Closing EM during SW boot shows EM-down message in UI
verificationPatterns.example: close the element manager during boot SW and verify in UI that a message that EM is down shown

verificationPatterns.pattern: HW IO signal assertion after button press
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Outputs.PowerDisablePbLed.Value =1 and OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.PowerEnablePB.Value = 1 after pressing power enable button

verificationPatterns.pattern: Automatic state transition on SW boot
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press state changed to Off automatically — OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State

verificationPatterns.pattern: Commanded state transition verification
verificationPatterns.example: Move press SW to SB state; verify OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State reflects SB

verificationPatterns.pattern: Emergency button press triggers power disable state
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Safety.EmgPB_IsPressed=True → verify press moved to power disable state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Latch persistence during emergency — IO signals unchanged
verificationPatterns.example: While EMG active: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Outputs.PowerDisablePbLed.Value =1 and OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.PowerEnablePB.Value = 1 still hold

verificationPatterns.pattern: Emergency button release triggers state recovery
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Safety.EmgPB_IsPressed=False → verify press moved to OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert OPC UA output signal equals expected integer value
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Outputs.PowerDisablePbLed.Value = 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert OPC UA input signal equals expected integer value after physical button press
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.PowerEnablePB.Value = 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert MachineState.State reaches expected state after action
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State (checked after power disable, then again after button press)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert UI displays specific safety message to operator
verificationPatterns.example: Message '{color: 172b4d}*Safety- Press the power Enable button*{color}' is shown

verificationPatterns.pattern: Correlated IO pair check: verify both output LED and input PB signals flip together on button press
verificationPatterns.example: PowerDisablePbLed.Value=1 AND PowerEnablePB.Value=1 after pressing enable button

verificationPatterns.pattern: Positive scan — SW closed
verificationPatterns.example: Scan Tube/Consumable with barcode while Press SW closed and Notepad open → SN displayed in Notepad successfully

verificationPatterns.pattern: Negative scan — SW open (Kiosk mode exited)
verificationPatterns.example: Open Press SW, scan again while Notepad open → SN NOT inserted into Notepad

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mode-gate verification
verificationPatterns.example: Same physical action (barcode scan) produces opposite result depending on Press SW state, confirming Kiosk mode gate

verificationPatterns.pattern: Double-click with 5-second lockout: first click triggers buzzer and disables button for 5 s; second click executes operation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Buzzer activation on first click of any state-transition button
verificationPatterns.example: On the first click, buzzer is activated — verified for Go To Standby, Get Ready, Print, Wizard activation, and Exit Service buttons

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button re-enable gate: wait for button to re-enable before performing second click
verificationPatterns.example: After Print button enabling, wait more than 5 seconds and press on Print button / Click on Print button second click

verificationPatterns.pattern: State assertion after double-click sequence: verify press reached expected state
verificationPatterns.example: Expected: Press is in Standby mode / Expected: Press is in Ready mode / Expected: Press reached Standby mode

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard invocation follows same double-click + buzzer pattern as state-transition buttons
verificationPatterns.example: Navigate to Auto Bias Wizard / Click on Wizard activation button once ... Wizard activation button became unclickable for 5seconds / Second click is activating Wizard operation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Low-density event triggers timed buzzer (duration-specific)
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate low density in any ink station — verify that before solid add operation, buzzer for 1.5 seconds

verificationPatterns.pattern: Driver compatibility check via Device Manager

verificationPatterns.pattern: Scan triggers correct wizard or SN read

verificationPatterns.example: BID base S/N displayed equals IBL.BidStationEntity.InstalledBidBaseInfo.SerialNumber; BID roller S/N displayed equals IBL.BidStationEntity.InstalledBidRollerInfo.SerialNumber

verificationPatterns.example: BID base ReplacementTime displayed equals IBL.BidStationEntity.InstalledBidBaseInfo.ReplacementTime; BID roller ReplacementTime displayed equals IBL.BidStationEntity.InstalledBidRollerInfo.ReplacementTime

verificationPatterns.example: After Blanket Cleaning job (0 rotations without ink, 4 with ink), BID base and roller counters advance by 43 A3 units; PLC BidTotalRotationsEngagePrint diff = 167

verificationPatterns.pattern: Installation/replacement time UI vs PEX signal match
verificationPatterns.example: ASID S/N displayed equals to IBL.AsidEntity.(2).InstalledInfo.ReplacementTime

verificationPatterns.example: CR counter reset button + 3 CS counter reset buttons (CS wiper, CS Sponge, CS PAD) all active; disabled after reset when value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Elastic report verification for consumable replacement events
verificationPatterns.example: Search 'Cleaning*' → 3 CS replacement reports; search 'Charge*' → CR replacement report; check correct date and counter value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter advancement calculation after single-color print job
verificationPatterns.example: Blanket Cleaning wizard, 0 rotations without ink + 4 rotations with ink: ASID counter +45 A3 units; CS and CR counters +43 A3 units

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter advancement calculation after two-color print job with copies

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dialog closes cleanly via Close button
verificationPatterns.example: Window closed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Modal/window opens on action
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that ILP Wash wizard opens in a new window after pressing Wash in EA Center Wizards tab

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button becomes unavailable after state transition
verificationPatterns.example: 'Service mode' button becomes unavailable after press enters Service state; Service mode availability window displays 'OFF_REQUIRED'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Availability window progresses through states
verificationPatterns.example: EA zone availability window displays 'Operation started' then 'Available' after pressing 'Enable wizard'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state advances on wizard action
verificationPatterns.example: 'Enable wizard' transitions press to Service-Sequence state; 'Activate' starts ILP wash operation

verificationPatterns.pattern: OPC-UA boolean flag confirms operation active
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ExportedData.ILP.Status.WashStatus = True after Activate pressed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert all three wizard buttons (Service mode, Enable Wizard, Activate) each report correct availability and reason code for a given press state
verificationPatterns.example: "Service mode" button is greyed out, with reason OFF_REQUIRED. "Enable Wizard" button is greyed out, with reason SERVICE_REQUIRED. "Activate" wash button is greyed out, with reason SERVICE_REQUIRED.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify press state transition via OPC UA machine-state signal (manual: check UI; automatic: read signal value)
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState = 4 (Service)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inject hardware fault by setting OPC UA simulation value + enable flag, then assert blocking reason code on affected button
verificationPatterns.example: Set OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.HW_Inputs.ILP.CleanerTankLevel.Simulation.Value = 0 and NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.HW_Inputs.ILP.CleanerTankLevel.Simulation.Enable = True; expect 'Activate' wash button greyed out with reason TANK_LEVEL_PANIC_LOW.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Remove simulated fault and verify previously blocked button becomes available without leaving Service-Sequence mode

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-progression gate check: each wizard button unlocks strictly in sequence (Service mode → Enable Wizard → Activate), with prior-step reason code blocking later buttons until prerequisites are met
verificationPatterns.example: In Standby: Service mode Available, Enable Wizard greyed out (SERVICE_REQUIRED), Activate greyed out (SERVICE_REQUIRED). In Service: Enable Wizard Available, Activate greyed out (SEQ_MODE_REQUIRED). In Service-Sequence (no faults): Activate Available.

verificationPatterns.example: CRU_EC_3-FwUpd, GET_FW_VER_ON_BOARD, State 2 ... CRU_EC_3-FwUpd, DONE, State 12

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log confirms version mismatch triggers update

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log confirms version match skips update
verificationPatterns.example: CoNode "CRU_EC_3" area=boot: Not Need Update : FW version on board and in file are the same

verificationPatterns.pattern: OPCUA signal confirms up-to-date status after update cycle
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.Version.CRU(X).Entry[1].VersionStatus = up_to_date (1)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat verification for all CRUs
verificationPatterns.example: 4. Repeat for all CRUs.

verificationPatterns.pattern: No timeout errors during FW download wait
verificationPatterns.example: Press SW should wait till FW download to CRUs is completed correctly, no timeout errors.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Functional sanity print after FW update
verificationPatterns.example: Print a job — CRU should function correctly.

verificationPatterns.pattern: FW update state machine progression logging
verificationPatterns.example: CRU_EC_3-FwUpd, GET_FW_VER_ON_BOARD, State 2 ... SELECT_FILE_BY_HW_VER, State 3 ... READ_FILE, State 4 ... SEND_NEW_FW_PARAMS, State 9

verificationPatterns.pattern: Version comparison log check (update required vs not required)
verificationPatterns.example:
CoNode "CRU_EC_3" area=boot: Need Update : FW version on board and in file are different
CoNode "CRU_EC_3" area=boot: Not Need Update : FW version on board and in file are the same.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mid-transfer cable disconnect to trigger download failure
verificationPatterns.example: When CoNode "CRU_EC_3" area=boot: program block: len=128 cnt=65 remain=84908 appears, disconnect EtherCAT (green) cable from CRU

verificationPatterns.pattern: FW download failure state and fault log verification
verificationPatterns.example:
CRU_EC_3-FwUpd, State 11 ,SubState 50, FlowID 0, Fault - By Event
CHName, Boot - CoNode "CRU_EC_3" area=boot: ERROR update. Ignore: trying other areas

verificationPatterns.pattern: OPC-UA VersionStatus signal check during and after update
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.Version.CRU(X).Entry[1].VersionStatus = update_in_progress (during), update_failed (after)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event verification per failure type
verificationPatterns.example: DEVICE_BOOT_UPDATE_FAILED CRU X / DEVICE_FW_UPDATE_FAILED CRU X / DEVICE_UPDATE_FAILED_FILE_NOT_FOUND CRU X / DEVICE_UPDATE_FAILED_OLD_VER CRU X

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sibling CRU update isolation check
verificationPatterns.example: For other CRUs update should be successful (boot failure) / For other CRUs not is required (appl/dspc failure)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Missing file error log verification
verificationPatterns.example: CoNode "CRU_EC_3": Error 0x70c open file c:/NodesFW/cru4_EC.bin

verificationPatterns.pattern: Corrupt file (CRC failure) blocks FW download before transfer starts
verificationPatterns.example: Change file content via HxD, change version/date to trigger update requirement, verify State 11 fault without successful transfer

verificationPatterns.pattern: Outdated file date blocks FW download (pre-May 31 2020 cutoff)
verificationPatterns.example: Set file date to 01-Jan-2018 via HxD, verify DEVICE_UPDATE_FAILED_OLD_VER event and State 11 fault

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify imported-type signal value matches OPC UA signal path
verificationPatterns.example: ImageScalingFactor=0.986 (min=0.972/max=1.028) type=imported → Global.ImportedData.Dimensions.ImageDimensions.ImageScalingFactor

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify imported-type signal value matches WHS OPC UA signal path
verificationPatterns.example: RLScalingFactor=1.0147 (min=0.99/max=1.03) type=imported → OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.WHS.RLScailingFactor

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify application-type max correction bound matches config entity field
verificationPatterns.example: RLScalingMaxCorrection=1.025 type=application → QuickScalingCalibrationConfigEntity: RepeatLengthScalingMax

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify application-type min correction bound matches config entity field
verificationPatterns.example: RLScalingMinCorrection=0.992 type=application → QuickScalingCalibrationConfigEntity: RepeatLengthScalingMin

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify image scaling max/min correction bounds against config entity fields
verificationPatterns.example: ImageScalingMaxCorrection=1.025 / ImageScalingMinCorrection=0.992 type=application → QuickScalingCalibrationConfigEntity: ImageScalingMaxCorrection / ImageScalingMinCorrection

verificationPatterns.pattern: Behavior-change gate: confirm old path is blocked
verificationPatterns.example: Verify user cannot enter values and save without performing print sessions (behavior changed: must print before entering values)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pex entity state verification after calibration save
verificationPatterns.example: Go to Pex Entities and verify values updated after values added and saved; check QuickScalingCalibrationResultsEntity

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button state on idle — Print button available before values entered; subtext reads 'Tap to print'
verificationPatterns.example: Print Button - available according to Scaling Values entered; text under the button 'Tap to print'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button swap on print start — Stop button replaces Print button; status text changes to 'Printing...'
verificationPatterns.example: The stop button shall replace the print button. The text shall change to 'Printing...'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stop tap restores idle state — Play button reappears; entered scaling values are preserved
verificationPatterns.example: If the stop was tapped, play button shall appear again and the entered scaling values shall remain

verificationPatterns.pattern: Controls disabled during printing — Job selection, scaling value fields (desired + actual), Undo, Restore Default, Save all disabled
verificationPatterns.example: The following shall be disabled: Job selection, Scaling values - desired and actual, Undo, Restore default, Save

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-print reset — Play button visible, progress bar empty, actual scaling values cleared, desired values retained
verificationPatterns.example: Play button shall appear again; progress bar shall be empty; Actual scaling values shall be deleted; desired shall remain as is

verificationPatterns.pattern: Image Length Scaling display post-print — Current shows last saved factor (or default if never changed); New shows entered value or '---' if none entered
verificationPatterns.example: Current - the last saved scaling factor (if never changes = default substrate values). New - changes according to entered scaling values; if no scaling values were entered, 3 dots shall appear (---)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat Length Scaling display post-print — same dual Current/New pattern as Image Length Scaling
verificationPatterns.example: Current - the last saved scaling factor. New - changes according to entered scaling values; if no scaling values were entered, 3 dots shall appear (—)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Restore Default enable/disable — enabled when Current differs from original values; disabled when both Image Length Scaling and Repeat Length Scaling equal original values
verificationPatterns.example: If the current 'Image Length Scaling' and/or 'Repeat Length Scaling' status is different than original values > Restore Default button shall be enabled. If equal to original values > Restore Default button shall be disabled.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Undo enable/disable — disabled when no iteration performed (all 3 scaling values entered correctly without prior iteration); enabled after at least one iteration
verificationPatterns.example: If no iteration was performed, Undo button shall be disabled. If at least one iteration was performed, Undo button shall be enabled.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Label presence check
verificationPatterns.example: verify Title Label: 'Scaling Values'; verify instructional label 'Measure the following to calculate the Image Length scaling and the Repeat Length scaling'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Clear All button resets all fields (desired and actual)
verificationPatterns.example: Press the Clear all button - verify it clears all fields below it (desired and actual)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Numeric field increments/decrements by 0.1 mm via plus/minus buttons
verificationPatterns.example: enter a value in Desired image length and verify Pressing on the plus and minus buttons changes the value in 0.1 mm respectively to the button

verificationPatterns.pattern: Out-of-range input shows red border and displays allowed range beneath field
verificationPatterns.example: If the entered value is out of range, the box will be framed in red and the allowed range will appear beneath the box

verificationPatterns.pattern: Undo button enabled/disabled by iteration count; reverts to last iteration values
verificationPatterns.example: Press the Undo button - verify it is enabled/disabled depending on the number of iterations; if more than 1 iterations were printed than pressing the UNDO button should revert the values to last iteration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Save button disabled until all mandatory fields filled
verificationPatterns.example: Press the Save button and verify it is disabled once no values were entered on all mandatory fields

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print button disabled until all mandatory values entered
verificationPatterns.example: Press the Print button to verify it is disabled until all mandatory values are entered

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cancel button always enabled; triggers 'Are you sure?' confirmation popup
verificationPatterns.example: Press the Cancel button - verify it is enabled. If the user taps Cancel, a pop-up message 'Are you sure?' shall appear

verificationPatterns.pattern: Side panel appends new scaling value after all mandatory fields are filled
verificationPatterns.example: Enter the 3 mandatory values — the right side panel scaling info will change accordingly, i.e., in addition to the current scaling value, a new scaling value shall be added

verificationPatterns.pattern: Conditional display: Last Scaling Correction Date shown only if past correction exists
verificationPatterns.example: Last Scaling Correction Date shall appear below the Scaling Values area if a correction was done in the past. If not, nothing will be presented

verificationPatterns.pattern: Question mark icon opens tooltip with instructional text
verificationPatterns.example: Tapping on the question mark will reveal the label: 'Use web feed to move the substrate to the relevant location'; tapping on it will open a tooltip with text instructions

verificationPatterns.pattern: Measurement illustration displayed beneath input field
verificationPatterns.example: verify under actual image length: An illustration showing what needs to be measured

verificationPatterns.pattern: Section title and subtitle label verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Label 'Job' and subtitle label 'Make sure to select a job with reference points within 650mm range' are present

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dropdown header label verification
verificationPatterns.example: Dropdown header label reads 'Job from print queue'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dropdown auto-selects next-to-print job
verificationPatterns.example: A default job shall be selected automatically from the list = the 'next to print' job in the queue

verificationPatterns.pattern: Empty queue state: label, button, and dropdown states
verificationPatterns.example: When no jobs available: label shows 'No available jobs in Print Queue', Print button disabled, drop-down list enabled, no image shown

verificationPatterns.pattern: Informational note below dropdown
verificationPatterns.example: Under the drop-down list verify note: 'Special marks will be added to allow exact measurement'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Substrate-filter checkbox default state
verificationPatterns.example: Checkbox 'Show only jobs that match the installed substrate' is checked by default

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unchecking substrate filter shows all jobs and adds substrate name
verificationPatterns.example: Unchecking changes list to all queue jobs regardless of substrate; substrate name added below each job name

verificationPatterns.pattern: Job list item includes name, image, and scroll
verificationPatterns.example: Each job item shows its name and a small image representing it; scroll added if list overflows

verificationPatterns.pattern: Conditional note on job selection when repeat length gap correction present
verificationPatterns.example: After selecting such a job, label appears: 'This job contains a repeat length gap correction that will be ignored during the current Substrate Scaling Correction'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Substrate mismatch confirmation popup
verificationPatterns.example: If selected job substrate does not match installed substrate, popup shows 'Are you sure you want to continue using this job?' with Yes/No buttons; No returns to default job

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pex entity update after save
verificationPatterns.example: Go to Pex entities and verify values were updated after values were added and saved. Expected: QuickScalingCalibrationResultsEntity

verificationPatterns.pattern: Formula-based calculation correctness
verificationPatterns.example: NEW ImageScalingFactor=(DesiredLengthM1/ActualLengthM1)*(OLD ImageScalingFactor); NEW RLScalingFactor=(OLD RLScalingFactor*JobImageLength)/(ActualRL*NEW ImageScalingFactor); verify computed values match formula outputs for given M1=505, M2=531.5, desired=500mm

verificationPatterns.pattern: Correction factor range/limit enforcement
verificationPatterns.example: Image scaling correction factor limited to -2.5% to +0.8% (0.975–1.008); Repeat length correction factor limited to 0.8% to +2.5% (0.992–1.025)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket rotation count stop
verificationPatterns.example: Set BlanketRotations=3 in Pex QuickScalingCalibrationConfigEntity; verify printing stops after 3 blanket revolutions

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cancel discards unsaved values in Pex
verificationPatterns.example: Press Cancel button; verify in Pex that no values were saved. Expected: QuickScalingCalibrationResultsEntity unchanged

verificationPatterns.pattern: Undo reverts to previous iteration in UI and Pex
verificationPatterns.example: After >1 print iteration, press Undo; verify results revert to previous iteration result both in UI and in QuickScalingCalibrationResultsEntity

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-print mark verification
verificationPatterns.example: verify i mark is printed after the blanket stitch

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket rotation counter check via OPCUA signal after configured revolutions elapse
verificationPatterns.example: verify blanket rotations at: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ExportedData.WHS.Counters.NumberOfT2Engage

verificationPatterns.pattern: Physical measurement input and save, then Pex entity update confirmation
verificationPatterns.example: enter measured values (M1 actual image length, M2 image length over blanket leading edge) to correct field, press save, verify QuickScalingCalibrationResultsEntity updated in Pex Entities

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify calibration completion after start
verificationPatterns.example: Start Calibration and verify the calibration is done

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify calibration results updated per station
verificationPatterns.example: Verify calibration results updated for station 2 and 3

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify Front and Rear MechCalib values per station
verificationPatterns.example: For station 2 and station 3 Verify Front MechCalib and Rear MechCalib

verificationPatterns.pattern: Re-calibrate and re-verify results consistency
verificationPatterns.example: Re-calibration and verify the calibration is done; Get Bid Engage Mechanical Calibration results values; Verify Bid Engage Mechanical Calibration results values

verificationPatterns.pattern: Compare last calibration timestamp between UI and PEX data
verificationPatterns.example: Get the last calibrations time from UI; Verify with the PEX data; Verify with last calibration sampled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify all BIDs enabled for calibration before starting
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all Bids are enabled to calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify calibration completes successfully after start
verificationPatterns.example: Start Calibration and verify the calibration is done

verificationPatterns.pattern: Read and assert per-station MechCalib result values post-calibration
verificationPatterns.example: Get Bid Engage Mechanical Calibration results values / Verify Bid Engage Mechanical Calibration results values

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify Front MechCalib and Rear MechCalib for every station
verificationPatterns.example: For all station verify Front MechCalib and Rear MechCalib

verificationPatterns.pattern: Re-verify MechCalib results persist after BID reinsertion, go-to-Off, and wizard close
verificationPatterns.example: Insert all the bids and Go to Off / Close the wizard / For all station verify Front MechCalib and Rear MechCalib

verificationPatterns.pattern: Selective enable/disable check before calibration
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the relevant bids are enabled and the others are disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI timestamp vs PEX data cross-check
verificationPatterns.example: Get the last calibrations time from UI; Verify with the PEX data

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI timestamp vs sampled value cross-check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify with last calibration sampled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button label progression during async operation
verificationPatterns.example: After pressing 'Unlock': label changes to 'Preparing (Service)' → 'Preparing (Maintenance)' → replaced by open lock icon

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard step bullet state machine (idle → in-progress → success → next active)
verificationPatterns.example: Circular animation on bullet, bold white text while in-progress; checked checkbox + green text after door opens; step 2 bullet activates

verificationPatterns.pattern: OPC UA signal read to assert machine state transition
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = 4(Service)

verificationPatterns.pattern: OPC UA signal read to assert zone unlock completion
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.ServiceMode.Maintenance.PE.OperationData.State = 3(COMPLETED_SUCCESSFULLY)

verificationPatterns.pattern: OPC UA signal read to assert door unlocked (state = 0)
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.ServiceMode.Maintenance.PE.OperationData.State = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-pole interlock simulation for door open/close
verificationPatterns.example: Simultaneously set InterlockInputPoleA.PE_Front.Simulation.Value = 0 AND InterlockInputPoleB.PE_Front.Simulation.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button unavailability with timed re-enable on precondition failure
verificationPatterns.example: 'Unlock' becomes unavailable for 5 seconds then available; step 1 text red; bullet = 'X'; tooltip 'Off state required'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure injection via forced signal, then verify UI failure state
verificationPatterns.example: Force gInterface.CVC.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtGoToStandby = true → after ~5 min Service transition fails → bullet shows 'X', text red, button inactive 5 s, failure message bottom-left

verificationPatterns.pattern: Recovery after failure: revert forced signal, re-attempt operation, assert full happy-path progression
verificationPatterns.example: Unforce gInterface.CVC.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtGoToStandby; press 'Unlock' again; verify same 6-step progression as successful path

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI parity between mirrored controls (upper vs lower button)
verificationPatterns.example: Bring button to each state; verify upper and lower 'Unlock' buttons above/below BIDs graphic table show identical state

verificationPatterns.pattern: BID station parameterisation via MEStation(X)/BID(Y) index placeholders
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation(X).HW_Inputs.BID(Y).BID_Main.BidFiInPlace.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard minimize/maximize resilience: state preserved across minimize
verificationPatterns.example: Minimize wizard, change press state to OFF, maximize, press 'Unlock' — full happy-path expected

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button inactive with tooltip in non-Service press states
verificationPatterns.example: 'Allow' button is inactive with correct tooltip when press is in Standby, Ready, Get Ready, etc.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button inactive when physical preconditions not met (BIDs present or door open)
verificationPatterns.example: 'Allow' button is still inactive with correct tooltip when door closed but BIDs not removed, or when BIDs removed but door open.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button activates only when all physical preconditions satisfied simultaneously
verificationPatterns.example: 'Allow' button becomes active only after BIDs are removed AND PE front door is closed.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard step UI progression: bullet→checked checkbox, text→green, icon→open door, next step activates with bold-white text and circular animation
verificationPatterns.example: After opening PE front door interlock: bullet of step 1 → checked checkbox, text color → green, icon → open door icon, step 2 bullet → circular animation with bold white text.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify OPCUAInterface signal values after Unlock action
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = 4 (Service); OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.ServiceMode.Maintenance.PE.OperationData.State = 3 (COMPLETED_SUCCESSFULLY).

verificationPatterns.pattern: Allow button triggers active BID stations (with removed BIDs) to Service-Sequence state; others stay OFF
verificationPatterns.example: Active BID stations with BIDs removed enter Service-Sequence state. Other BID stations remain in OFF state. When all available BIDs in Service-Sequence, 'Allow' becomes inactive.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unlock resets all BID stations to OFF and re-enables Allow conditions
verificationPatterns.example: After pressing Unlock again: all BID stations enter OFF state, 'Allow' button becomes active.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unlock and Allow buttons are independent — each responds to its own conditions regardless of the other's state
verificationPatterns.example: In Service state with PE zone unlocked (Service-Maintenance), door closed, BID removed: 'Allow' is active and pressing it brings active BID stations with removed BIDs to Service-Maintenance state.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration in-progress UI state
verificationPatterns.example: One calibration in progress icon shown in wizard header; circular progress icon and stop button replace play button

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration success UI state
verificationPatterns.example: Green V icon in dialogue header; green 'Passed' text above BID in table; play button replaced by active recalibrate button; wizard auto-scrolls to bottom; Unlock button active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timestamp update on calibration completion
verificationPatterns.example: Calibration time and date changed to current time and date in wizard UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: PEX IEngine saved data verification after calibration
verificationPatterns.example: AverageFriction field changes value; EngineTime updated to current time and date for both front and rear motors in PlcSavedDataPrivateEntity.MEStaion(X)SavedData.BidEng.1/2.FrontMechCalib and RearMechCalib

verificationPatterns.pattern: Recalibration clears prior results before rerunning
verificationPatterns.example: Successful calibration notifications cleared from wizard header and BID table before new calibration in-progress state appears

verificationPatterns.pattern: Recalibration results differ from prior run
verificationPatterns.example: AverageFriction value differs slightly from previous calibration; timestamp updated

verificationPatterns.pattern: Finishing steps wizard UI validation
verificationPatterns.example: Unlock button active and functional; all completed steps marked green; correct BID number displayed in instructions

verificationPatterns.pattern: PEX data persistence after wizard close
verificationPatterns.example: AverageFriction and EngineTime values match last calibration results; timestamp not updated after close

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-gated UI availability: wizard actions disabled unless press in required state
verificationPatterns.example: IBL.BidMechCalibOperation.STATION_KEY.StartAvailability.IsAvailable = False; 'Unlock' button shows tooltip 'Press state OFF is required' when press not in OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Force/unforce hardware interlock signal to simulate door lock/unlock failure and success
verificationPatterns.example: Force OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Safety.HW_Inputs.InterlockLockStatus.PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0 to simulate door unlock failure; unforce to simulate success

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-pole simultaneous signal set to simulate door open/close
verificationPatterns.example: Set InterlockInputPoleA.PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0 AND InterlockInputPoleB.PE_FRNT_DOOR_INTLK.Value = 0 simultaneously to simulate door open

verificationPatterns.pattern: Distinguish BID FI open from full BID removal using separate signal paths
verificationPatterns.example: BidFiInPlace.Value = 0 via MEStations.MEStation2.HW_Inputs.Bids.Bid2.BID_Main does NOT advance wizard step 2; BID_Main.BidFiInPlace via MEStation(X).HW_Inputs.BID(Y) removal DOES advance it

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequential wizard step activation: each step becomes active only after prior step completes
verificationPatterns.example: Step 2 activates only after PE front door is open (both poles = 0); Step 3 activates only after BIDs removed; Step 4 activates only after door closed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inject calibration failure via torque limit parameter boundary
verificationPatterns.example: Set gInterface.Stations.Station1.Comp.Bid1.Comp.Engage.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.MechCalib.MaxTorqueLimit = 0.06 or MinTorqueLimit = 0.94 to force failure; revert to 0.95 / 0.05 for success

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stopped calibration does not persist result; MI remains blocked
verificationPatterns.example: Cancel wizard after Stop pressed → MI unavailable with tooltip 'The following motor requires performing BID Engage Mechanical Calibration: X BID Y'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failed calibration does not persist result; MI blocked on affected station
verificationPatterns.example: After calibration failure: red 'Failed' bar shown, MI unavailable with tooltip 'The following motor requires performing BID Engage Mechanical Calibration: X BID Y'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify calibration result persistence to PEX entity after successful run and job print
verificationPatterns.example: Check PEX:IEngine.PlcSavedPrivateEntity.Data.BidEng, PEX:IEngine.MechCalibEntity.TimeSamp, Front/RearMechCalib.AvgFriction are updated

verificationPatterns.pattern: Re-open wizard after calibration to confirm last calibration timestamp updated
verificationPatterns.example: Launch wizard again; verify date/time displayed under calibrated BID matches calibration just performed

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI unavailability reason matches expected string on calibration failure
verificationPatterns.example: UI should display unavailability reason "BID Mechanism calibration required"

verificationPatterns.pattern: Status signal set true for failed component
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation(X).ExportedData.BID(Y).Status.MechCalibRequired = true for the failed BID

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error window contains deep-link to remediation wizard
verificationPatterns.example: In the error window should be a link to BID Mechanical Calibration wizard

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard launches successfully via error window link
verificationPatterns.example: Launch BID Mechanical Calibration wizard from the link, verify that the wizard starts successfully

verificationPatterns.pattern: Date displayed in expected locale format with time component
verificationPatterns.example: The date should be displayed in a correct format, for example "Nov 18, 20'", along with calibration time

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration dates for all BIDs update to current date after wizard run-all completes
verificationPatterns.example: Calibration dates for all BIDs should be updated to current date; BID that failed before should display now the calibration date

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration date persists after wizard is closed and reopened
verificationPatterns.example: Launch the wizard again; verify that the calibration date for the BID that failed before remains as in previous step

verificationPatterns.pattern: Door unlock failure UI feedback
verificationPatterns.example: Animation stops, Unlock button reactivates, red X replaces bullet 1, step 1 text turns red, door unlocking failure event appears in UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Successful door unlock UI feedback
verificationPatterns.example: Animation continues, button replaced by yellow unlocked icon, step 1 text highlighted white, step 2 not yet active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration failure injection via signal override
verificationPatterns.example: Set DisEngageTargetPos=20000 (instead of 27000), or MaxTorqueLimit=0.06, or MinTorqueLimit=0.94 to force failure on a specific BID

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration in-progress indicators
verificationPatterns.example: One calibration-in-progress icon in wizard header; circular progress icon and stop button replace play button; AtMechCalib=true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pass result UI display
verificationPatterns.example: Green V icon in wizard header, green 'Passed' text above BID in table, play button changes to active Recalibrate button, time shows 'Just now'

verificationPatterns.pattern: PEX save verification on calibration pass
verificationPatterns.example: PlcSavedDataPrivateEntity.MEStaion(X)SavedData.BidEng.1/2.FrontMechCalib.AvgFriction and RearMechCalib.AvgFriction both change value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fail result UI display
verificationPatterns.example: Red X icon in wizard header, red 'Failed' text above BID in table, active Recalibrate button, red warning that BID cannot be reinstalled

verificationPatterns.pattern: PEX not saved on calibration failure
verificationPatterns.example: PlcSavedDataPrivateEntity.MEStaion(X)SavedData.BidEng.1/2.FrontMechCalib.AvgFriction and RearMechCalib.AvgFriction remain unchanged

verificationPatterns.pattern: MI blocked for uncalibrated BID after wizard close
verificationPatterns.example: MI unavailable with tooltip 'The following motor requires performing BID Engage Mechanical Calibration: X BID Y'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Recovery: failed BID passes after removing failure conditions
verificationPatterns.example: Revert DisEngageTargetPos=37000; failed BID shows 'Calibration required' before run, then passes and result changes to 'Passed'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Access restricted by user level — feature absent from UI for lower-privilege users
verificationPatterns.example: Load press SW on operator level; verify BID mechanical calibration not enabled in Menu and in error message

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mutex interlock: press state transition blocked during active calibration with 'Operation in progress' message
verificationPatterns.example: Try to start transition to Standby (Mech-Init) while AtMechCalib=true; verify Standby button unavailable with message 'Operation in progress'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mutex interlock: Print/Play blocked during active calibration with 'Operation in progress' message
verificationPatterns.example: Press Print button while AtMechCalib=true; verify play button unavailable with message 'Operation in progress'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mutex interlock: other wizards cannot be launched during active calibration with 'Operation in progress' message
verificationPatterns.example: Launch Blanket replacement and ASID speed calibration wizards while AtMechCalib=true; verify both blocked with 'Operation in progress'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Prerequisite step enforces required press state — button temporarily disabled then re-enabled with state tooltip
verificationPatterns.example: In Ready state, Unlock button unavailable 5 s then re-enables; step 1 text red, bullet becomes X; tooltip 'OFF state required'; Play and Run-all disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard UI adapts to current press state — Unlock button replaced by lock/unlocked-door icon when precondition already met
verificationPatterns.example: In Service-Maintenance (door already open), door-unlocked icon replaces Unlock button; first pre-requisite step shown in green text

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard drives press state transition when precondition not met — Unlock button triggers state change and physical interlock

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass active: press does not fall to off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Monitor active (no bypass) at panic-high: pump on, error event sent, press falls to off
verificationPatterns.example: Activate silca gel and monitor and verify pump goes on, error event is sent and press falls to off as required

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass suppresses pump and press fallback
verificationPatterns.example: Set silica gel active and conductivity monitor bypass and verify pump is off and the press doesn't fall to off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Active monitor triggers pump on + error event + press falls to off
verificationPatterns.example: Activate silca gel and monitor and verify pump goes on, error event is sent and press falls to off as required

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cond in high-but-not-panic range: pump on, press stays in standby
verificationPatterns.example: Set the cond to value between "resConductivitHigh" to "resConductivitPanicHigh". Verify pump is On, press remain in standby.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump state off under low condition
verificationPatterns.example: Set cond value to minimum - Verify pump is off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press does not transition out of standby on bypassed monitor

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold boundary trigger: set value to threshold + 1, verify activation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass-then-activate: confirm no reaction with bypass on, then remove bypass and confirm reaction
verificationPatterns.example: Set conductivity monitor bypass and verify pump is off and the press doesn't fall to off. Activate monitor and verify pump goes on.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-output verification: single trigger checked against pump state, error event, and press state simultaneously
verificationPatterns.example: Activate silica gel and monitor and verify pump goes on, error event is sent and press falls to off.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability: verify button state matches OPCUA AvailabilityStatus.Available + MainReasonStr

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation start: Activate→unavailable, Stop→available; peer operation (Drain) Activate and Stop both go unavailable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump activation: verify HW_Outputs boolean and actual speed signal reaches expected setpoint

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence completion: done flag true + OperationData.State = 3 (Success)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-completion multi-component OFF: Reservoir, Waste, all CS stations, CS pump, Filter pump, Inks pump all reach OFF/0/false

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability check via OPCUA status and UI button state
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.Sequence.Resrvoir.ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = true; AvailabilityStatus.MainReasonStr = Available; 'Activate' button shows availability reason 'Available'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button-state flip on sequence start: Activate locked, Stop unlocked for active operation; both locked for inactive sibling operation
verificationPatterns.example: 'Activate' button of Refill becomes unavailable, 'Stop' button of Refill becomes available; 'Activate' and 'Stop' buttons of Drain both become unavailable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump activation with timed sequencing: first pump activates immediately, second pump activates after fixed delay

verificationPatterns.pattern: Conductivity phase-gate: reduction must be observed within verification delay window to progress sequence

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence completion: verify done flag, operation state = 3 (Success), all components reach OFF state, all pumps turn off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability via button state and OPCUA AvailabilityStatus signals

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump activation verified by actual speed output signal matching imported setpoint

verificationPatterns.pattern: All ME station CS components reach OFF state on operation end (abort or success)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability check via OPC-UA AvailabilityStatus signals

verificationPatterns.pattern: Hardware sensor simulation for level and conductivity inputs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump activation state verification via gInterface and OPC-UA output signals

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify filter pump activates at ImportedData setpoint speed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simulate HW level sensor transitions within timeout windows to advance Refill phases

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify complete pump shutdown and component OFF state on error

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify operation state = Failed and re-availability after error (not stuck)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability gate: check AvailabilityStatus node before activating sequence

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button state transition on sequence start: Activate -> unavailable, Stop -> available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Actuator speed verification after sequence start

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event issuance in press UI on illegal sensor state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation failure state after error: OperationData.State = 5

verificationPatterns.pattern: Component AtOff status after error shutdown

verificationPatterns.pattern: All reservoir output signals zeroed/deactivated after error

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mutual exclusion symmetric — verify both directions: start second op only after first finishes, then check first is now blocked

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability check via OPCUA AvailabilityStatus signals
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.Sequence.Resrvoir.ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = true AND MainReasonStr = Available

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI button state transition on sequence start (Activate -> unavailable, Stop -> available; opposing operation fully unavailable)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Active actuator speed verification against expected RPM

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation State = 5 (Failed) with availability immediately restored

verificationPatterns.pattern: All pumps deactivated (speed = 0 and/or control signal = false) after failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability check via OperationData signals and UI button state
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.Sequence.Resrvoir.ImoCleanTankRefill.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = true and MainReasonStr = Available; 'Activate' button available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mutually exclusive operation button states on sequence start

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump speed verification via exported data signal approximate match

verificationPatterns.pattern: Conductivity reduction verification via two-step set: wait < delay, then decrease by required delta

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-component OFF state verification on sequence completion

verificationPatterns.pattern: Done flag check on completion

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure 4 – Return buffer overflow: once all active CS reach Free Wetting, set ImoRtnBfrVol to 25; expect IOS_CS_BFFR_LVL_PRSSR_SNS - LVL_PANIC_HIGH event and State=5
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.IMO.HW_Inputs.Reservoir.ImoRtnBfrVol.Value = 25 after Free Wetting reached

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure 5 – Dirty tank high + catch tray full + no oil waste barrel: trigger after return pump starts; expect IMO_WASTE_SENSOR_FAILURE event and State=5

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pre-condition block – no waste destination: Drain Activate unavailable with reason IMO_UC_WASTE_NO_DESTINATION when UC catch tray is full and no waste bottle present

verificationPatterns.pattern: Successful completion: State=3 (Completed successfully) with same pump/component shutdown postcondition as failures

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability check: verify OPCUA AvailabilityStatus signals and UI button enabled state match
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.Manager.Sequence.ImoCleanTankDrain.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = true; MainReasonStr = Available; 'Activate' button shows availability reason 'Available'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor injection via HW_Input to drive level-based sequence transitions

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence completion by state enum: OperationData.State = 3 (Success)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Very-low value produces no state change (pump stays same)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump on in high-conductivity range, press holds standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Below-low-threshold conductivity: pump turns off while machine remains in standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: During wet print: ILP wet-mode status true, Corona run status true

verificationPatterns.pattern: HMI cross-check: manual tester verifies same values at Web > ILP and WebCtrl > Manager paths

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wet substrate custom priming values survive edit+save and are reflected in PEX and OPC-UA before and during print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-path signal parity: every imported parameter must match on both OPCUAInterface and gInterface paths
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.Corona.IsRequired = False AND gInterface.Web.Comp.Corona.Ctrl.In.Par.Import.IsRequired = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Toggle-off defaults: when a feature toggle is OFF, verify the system reverts to known default values (not just clears)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Runtime status signals during print: verify ILP and Corona output status signals are set correctly while a job is actively printing

verificationPatterns.pattern: ILP wash gate before dry-print test: perform ILP wash (trigger Wash cmd, confirm WashDone) when transitioning from wet-print scenario to dry-print scenario

verificationPatterns.pattern: AtReady4Prime status at Ready state when both Corona and Priming&Dryer are ON

verificationPatterns.pattern: HMI cross-check: after every signal verification, confirm same values visible in HMI at Web->ILP and WebCtrl->Manager paths

verificationPatterns.pattern: OPC-UA-to-PLC import signal parity: each substrate property must match between OPCUAInterface path and corresponding gInterface import path

verificationPatterns.pattern: Alternate error injection via CoE-Online error code: expand 'cri status 0x200c', set last error=<code>, set isError=1, then set isError=0 to clear
verificationPatterns.example: Expand 'cri status 0x200c' row. Double-click 'last error', set value=9. Double-click 'isError', set value=1. When the error appears double-click 'isError', set value=0.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error includes measured value and limit in payload where applicable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify multi-spread monochrome black job prints all spreads from same station and BID B

verificationPatterns.pattern: PsHwError pulse injection with actual-value context: additionally set PsHwErrorActualValue before pulsing Error.Enable

verificationPatterns.pattern: ROR selection + mandatory comment enables Continue button
verificationPatterns.example: Select 'Electrical breakdown' ROR, enter comment in text box → verify Continue button is enabled and virtual keyboard is displayed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unlock button disables after click; door icon and radio button reflect new state
verificationPatterns.example: Click unlock button → Unlock button becomes disabled, radio button checked, opened door icon appears

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state transitions to Service (value 4) after unlock
verificationPatterns.example: OPSUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState = 4

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-pole door interlock signals both 1 when open, both 0 when closed
verificationPatterns.example: arrIntrlkA[11] and arrIntrlkB[11] both = 1 on open; both = 0 on closed

verificationPatterns.pattern: T1 blanket in Service state, selected station at AtOperational, blanket keeps tension
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.ComparrBr[index].Ctrl.Out.Status.AtServise; gInterface.Station[index].Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.AtOperational; gInterface.BKT.Comp.Tension.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtBldStandbyTen

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press remains at Service State while door is open
verificationPatterns.example: Open printing engine door → verify press remains at Service State

verificationPatterns.pattern: In-wizard '?' help text matches specification screenshot
verificationPatterns.example: Click '?' in step 5 → verify displayed text matches reference screenshot

verificationPatterns.pattern: Continue button disabled until required fields satisfied
verificationPatterns.example: Select 'Other' ROR without entering text — verify Continue is disabled; enter text — verify Continue is enabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: ROR with mandatory free-text comment enables Continue
verificationPatterns.example: Select 'Electrical breakdown' ROR, enter comment in text box — verify Continue is enabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Iterate all ROR values (excluding specific exemption) to verify consistent behavior
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat step 4 for every ROR except 'Auto bias' — all RORs selectable with free text enterable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cancel dismisses wizard without side effects
verificationPatterns.example: Click Cancel — verify Asid Replacement window closed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Initial value matches pre-loaded configuration
verificationPatterns.example: Verify value for retain job on press is matching expected result (e.g., Retention = Remove job from press)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Edit box hidden when retention mode is 'indefinitely'
verificationPatterns.example: No value appear for retain job on press edit box when retention is set to indefinitely

verificationPatterns.pattern: Red error on out-of-range input with stated allowed range
verificationPatterns.example: Enter 100 for hours -> Red error appear - allowed range 1-99; enter 1000 for days -> Red error appear - allowed range 1-999

verificationPatterns.pattern: No error on boundary-valid input after correcting from out-of-range
verificationPatterns.example: Change retain for hours to 99 (after 100 was rejected) -> No error appear

verificationPatterns.pattern: Save-without-required-field triggers popup, then returns to job properties
verificationPatterns.example: Press Save with empty hours edit box -> Pop-up appear - not all fields were entered; Press OK -> Pop-up closed and job properties is open

verificationPatterns.pattern: Save completes and change syncs to DFE
verificationPatterns.example: Job properties saved and synced to DFE (verified after each successful save across hours, minutes, days modes)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Changing retention type clears/resets edit box
verificationPatterns.example: Change retain on press to minutes and erase the edit box, focus on different field -> Red error appear - allowed range 1-99

verificationPatterns.pattern: Field is read-only when job is printing
verificationPatterns.example: Print job and stop in the middle — verify field is read only; job length shows total, not remaining

verificationPatterns.pattern: Numeric field range validation (1–9999) shows inline red error
verificationPatterns.example: Set copies to 10000 → red error: allowed range is between 1-9999; set to 0 or blank → red error or mandatory-field error

verificationPatterns.pattern: Save blocked when mandatory field is empty; pop-up appears
verificationPatterns.example: Erase copies field and press Save → pop-up: 'not all fields were entered'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Confirm dialog when reducing copies below already-printed count
verificationPatterns.example: Change copies to value lower than printed-so-far → pop-up: 'is lower than printed so far. Would you like to reset the job and change it permanently to?'; No restores previous value, Yes applies new value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cancel discards in-progress changes without saving
verificationPatterns.example: After accepting lower-copies warning, press Cancel → changes are not saved

verificationPatterns.pattern: Saved value reflects in dependent UI location
verificationPatterns.example: After save, verify copies updated in DFE side panel → print progress

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dropdown field disabled with fixed value for single-spread jobs
verificationPatterns.example: Load single-spread job → print range is disabled and shows 'All'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dropdown options enumerated for multi-spread jobs
verificationPatterns.example: Click print range dropdown on multi-spread job → options: All, Custom

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print range auto-switches to Custom/All based on range field content
verificationPatterns.example: Type 1-5 in range field → print range = Custom; type 1-10 (equals full spread count) → print range = All

verificationPatterns.pattern: Range field out-of-bounds value shows inline red error
verificationPatterns.example: Type spread index beyond job size (11 for 10-spread job) → red error: 'Range is not allowed'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Question-mark icon shows tooltip/help text
verificationPatterns.example: Click '?' on range field → text: 'Enter specific pages and/or range, separate them using comma. For example, "1-3, 5" - will print sheets 1-3 and sheet 5.'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Collated field display conditional on spread count and collate setting
verificationPatterns.example: Single spread → collate field not shown; multi-spread + collate=True → 'Collated'; multi-spread + collate=False → 'non-Collated'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Average current below lower limit triggers error after detection interval
verificationPatterns.example: Set gIos.Station(X).CR_Hv.Input.CrBrCurMon_ua.Value below BrCurrentDetectionMinCurrent; after BrCurrentDetectionInterval time, CRG_BR_CURRENT_MONITORING_AVERAGE_FAILED sent to UI and logs with BrCurrentAverage and BrCurrentMinValue; station and press go to OFF state.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Std dev above upper limit triggers error after repeated current swaps
verificationPatterns.example: Swap gIos.Station(X).CR_Hv.Input.CrBrCurMon_ua.Value between two distinct values (e.g. 2000/4000, both > BrCurrentDetectionMinCurrent) with delay per swap so voltage gIos.Station(X).CR_Hv.Input.CrBrVoltMon_v.Value tracks; after 4-5 swaps std dev exceeds BrCurrentDetectionMaxStdDev; CRG_BR_CURRENT_MONITORING_AVERAGE_FAILED sent with BrCurrentAverage and BrCurrentMinValue; station and press go to OFF state.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event contains required diagnostic fields
verificationPatterns.example: CRG_BR_CURRENT_MONITORING_AVERAGE_FAILED must include BrCurrentAverage and BrCurrentMinValue in both average and std-dev failure scenarios.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Station and press transition to OFF on BR current fault
verificationPatterns.example: Relevant ME station and the press should go to OFF state upon CRG_BR_CURRENT_MONITORING_AVERAGE_FAILED.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass active suppresses fault — no error propagates to UI or logs
verificationPatterns.example: After BrCurrentDetectionInterval time error should NOT be sent to UI and logs. Expected: No error should be sent.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Feature enabled triggers named error event with diagnostic payload and drives system to OFF
verificationPatterns.example: CRG_BR_CURRENT_MONITORING_AVERAGE_FAILED error event should be sent to UI and logs, including BrCurrentAverage, BrCurrentMinValue. Relevant ME station and the press should go to OFF state.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inject out-of-range IOS value to trigger error after detection interval
verificationPatterns.example: Set gIos.Station(X).CR_Hv.Input.CrBrCurMon_ua.Value smaller than BrCurrentDetectionMinCurrent; after BrCurrentDetectionInterval time, verify error sent to UI and logs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify error event content includes relevant diagnostic fields
verificationPatterns.example: CRG_BR_CURRENT_MONITORING_AVERAGE_FAILED must include BrCurrentAverage and BrCurrentMinValue; CRG_BR_CURRENT_MONITORING_STD_FAILED must include BrCurrentActualStdValue and BrCurrentMaxStdValue

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify station and press transition to OFF state on error
verificationPatterns.example: Relevant ME station and the press should go to OFF state after error event is raised

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary test for configurable limit parameter: confirm no error above new limit, error below new limit, then revert
verificationPatterns.example: Decrease BrCurrentDetectionMinCurrent to 1000; set IOS value above new limit — verify no error; set IOS value below new limit — verify CRG_BR_CURRENT_MONITORING_AVERAGE_FAILED; revert parameter to default

verificationPatterns.pattern: Induce high standard deviation by swapping IOS current value between two distinct values with delay between swaps
verificationPatterns.example: Swap CrBrCurMon_ua.Value between 2000 and 4000 (both above BrCurrentDetectionMinCurrent) with delay so control algorithm reacts and changes BrVoltMon; after 4-5 swaps verify CRG_BR_CURRENT_MONITORING_STD_FAILED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify detection interval parameter by measuring wall-clock time from fault injection to AtCharging = False
verificationPatterns.example: With BrCurrentDetectionInterval = T 5s, expect AtCharging = False within 6–12 s; with interval = T 15s, expect AtCharging = False within 19–33 s

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stepping assertion immediately after switching to wet mode
