verificationPatterns.pattern: Idempotency check — repeat same wet print, assert no stepping on second run

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stepping resumes after web feed with prime

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold not crossed → behavior preserved on next trigger

verificationPatterns.pattern: Baseline verification before transition — confirm expected state in prior mode

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter does NOT reset without mechinit
verificationPatterns.example: Change around press states and verify no reset is performed when no mechinit is done

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter reset after dry web feed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter decrement after wet web feed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dry mode suppresses stepping

verificationPatterns.example: Set Wet Mode; Stepping Print Verification

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeated wet print produces no stepping
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat Wet Print and verify no stepping is done

verificationPatterns.pattern: Web Feed Without Prime resets fpCount
verificationPatterns.example: Web Feed Without Prime and verify fpCount is reset

verificationPatterns.pattern: Web Feed With Prime triggers stepping
verificationPatterns.example: Web Feed With Prime and verify stepping is done

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter unchanged under non-target fault

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter resets under target fault
verificationPatterns.example: Set Ilp fault and verify fpCount is reset

verificationPatterns.pattern: Baseline stepping assertion before mode change
verificationPatterns.example: Verify stepping is active during pre print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat operation and assert stepping state changed
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat wet print and verify stepping isn't active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-bypass assertion: stepping suppressed in web feed with prime
verificationPatterns.example: Verify no stepping is done in web feed with prime

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-bypass assertion: stepping suppressed in pre print
verificationPatterns.example: Verify no stepping is done in pre print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter invariant across all dry-mode operations in a given press state
verificationPatterns.example: Perform web feed without prime, web with prime, stepping without prime, stepping with prime — FP_PrimeCounter = 0 after each

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter invariant repeated at each distinct press state (Standby → Ready → Printing)
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 3-6 repeat same four operations in Standby; steps 8-11 repeat them in Ready; step 12 adds a print job — all expect FP_PrimeCounter = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: No PrePrint stepping in dry mode — image printed immediately with no blank substrate
verificationPatterns.example: During PrePrint no stepping should be performed. The image is printed immediately, no blank substrate appears before image.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter resets to zero on transition back to dry mode from wet mode
verificationPatterns.example: Switch to wet mode, advance FP_PrimeCounter to maximal value, return to Standby, switch back to dry mode — FP_PrimeCounter = 0 at the return to dry mode

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wet→dry mode transition test: saturate counter in wet mode then verify reset in dry mode
verificationPatterns.example: Print arbitrary job, perform web feed without prime to bring FP_PrimeCounter to maximal value, return to Standby, uncheck 'With prime', bring to Ready, print — FP_PrimeCounter = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter reset to max on transition to Ready
verificationPatterns.example: FP_PrimeCounter should be at the maximal value after press reaches Ready state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter decrements during web feed with prime (feature enabled)
verificationPatterns.example: FP_PrimeCounter should reduce during stepping (web feed with prime, stopped before counter reaches 0)

verificationPatterns.pattern: PrePrint stepping runs until counter hits zero (feature enabled)
verificationPatterns.example: In first PrePrint stepping should be performed until FP_PrimeCounter = 0 (WHS in status Stepping)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter stays at zero once depleted (feature enabled)
verificationPatterns.example: FP_PrimeCounter should remain 0 after it reached 0 for the first time

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter is zero on Ready when bypass active
verificationPatterns.example: After setting PrePrimedSubstrateBypass=True and cycling to Ready: FP_PrimeCounter = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Web feed with prime does not alter counter when bypassed
verificationPatterns.example: FP_PrimeCounter should not change during web feed with prime (feature disabled)

verificationPatterns.pattern: No PrePrint stepping when bypassed
verificationPatterns.example: FP_PrimeCounter should not change at all the steps. No stepping is performed in PrePrint

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter decrements during web feed with prime (Ready state)
verificationPatterns.example: Perform web feed with prime → verify FP_PrimeCounter decreases while substrate is fed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter resets to maximum during web feed without prime (Ready state)
verificationPatterns.example: Perform web feed without prime → verify FP_PrimeCounter returns to its maximum value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter stays at 0 after first reaching 0 — no-change condition across stop/resume/state-cycle
verificationPatterns.example: Step until FP_PrimeCounter=0; print another job; stop/resume printing; cycle Standby→Ready → FP_PrimeCounter should remain 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter stays at 0 after non-ILP error that returns press to Ready
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate MEStation temp sensor error (Temp_MelexisSens.Simulation.Value=32); clear error; resume printing → FP_PrimeCounter remains 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter resets to maximum on ILP-Liquids fault (empty primer tank simulation)
verificationPatterns.example: Set PrimerTankLevel.Simulation.Value=0 + Enable=True; verify ILP-Liquids AtReadyAfterFault; press falls to Standby; disable simulation → FP_PrimeCounter returns to maximum

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter decrements during web feed with prime (Standby state)
verificationPatterns.example: Reach Standby; perform web feed with prime → verify FP_PrimeCounter decreases while substrate is fed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter resets to maximum during web feed without prime (Standby state)
verificationPatterns.example: Perform web feed without prime → verify FP_PrimeCounter returns to its maximum value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter resets to maximum after Dry-to-Wet mode transition
verificationPatterns.example: Uncheck 'With priming' → perform ILP wash → print job → bring to OFF → check 'With priming' → Standby with WEB MechInit → FP_PrimeCounter at maximum

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter resets to maximum after PLC reset
verificationPatterns.example: Perform PLC reset; reach Standby state → FP_PrimeCounter should be at maximum value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Feature inactive in dry mode: counter at 0, no web feed in PrePrint
verificationPatterns.example: FP_PrimeCounter = 0; during pre-print no Stepping active status in Web Control (WHS)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Feature active in wet mode: web feed during PrePrint until counter drops below threshold
verificationPatterns.example: FP_PrimeCounter = 17400 at Ready; WHS status Stepping during PrePrint until FP_PrimeCounter < 30

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter stays at 0 across stop/resume when substrate already primed at T2
verificationPatterns.example: FP_PrimeCounter remains 0 in Ready and during print; no WHS Stepping in PrePrint

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter resets to buffer position after web feed without prime
verificationPatterns.example: FP_PrimeCounter = 17400 on simulator after short web feed without prime in wet mode

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter retains partial value if web feed stops before reaching 0
verificationPatterns.example: PrePrint resumes web feed from saved FP_PrimeCounter value from previous step, not reset; job prints successfully

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter reaches max after prime cycle
verificationPatterns.example: After OFF→Standby with MI, FP_PrimeCounter should be at the maximal value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter increment proportional to parameter delta (ratio 1000:1)
verificationPatterns.example: Adding 1,300,000 to PrimerT2ToBlanketT2 increases FP_PrimeCounter by 1300 after OFF→Standby with MI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Restore parameter and verify counter reverts to original value
verificationPatterns.example: Restore original PrimerT2ToBlanketT2, cycle to Ready; original FP_PrimeCounter value restored

verificationPatterns.pattern: Encoder-counter distance ratio: NIP position delta equals maxFP_PrimeCounter * 1000
verificationPatterns.example: Difference in FI NIP ActPosition before/after Pre-Print = maximal FP_PrimeCounter * 1000

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stepping longer than uncoated length: counter decrements to 0 and does not reset at print start
verificationPatterns.example: FP_PrimeCounter updates during stepping until 0, stops; image printed immediately with no blank substrate

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stepping shorter than uncoated length: counter retains value, continues in Pre-Print until 0
verificationPatterns.example: FP_PrimeCounter reduces during stepping, retained until Pre-Print, counts down to 0; some blank substrate appears before image

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify stepping velocity signal equals expected constant
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.PrimeSteppingVelocity = 1000 during PrePrint stepping

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI message matches localization JSON entry by text box ID

verificationPatterns.pattern: Trigger failure state and verify localized error message via text box ID

verificationPatterns.pattern: Trigger UI action and verify localization message box appears with expected message ID

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cross-reference UI displayed message against JSON localization file by message box ID

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI state check — named screen element visible after navigation

verificationPatterns.example: Change type Paper→Label → popup 'Change substrate type: Changing substrate type will reset all it's properties. Are you sure you want to change it?'; press No → type unchanged; press Yes → Width/Thickness blank, Material = other label, Facestock = white, Gloss = gloss, Corona = OFF, Primer = DP680, Anilox = GTTS, Unwinder = 6KG, Engine Entrance = 6KG, Engine Exit = 6KG, Rewinder = 6KG, Taper = 10, Nips = 4 bar

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default substrates (Paper, Label, Film) have Name and Type fields as read-only with warning

verificationPatterns.pattern: Save persists all properties to UI and DB
verificationPatterns.example: Press Save → substrate saved; reopen edit and verify all field values match what was saved; confirm DB record matches

verificationPatterns.pattern: Edit buttons disabled for installed substrate while press is printing, with per-button tooltip
verificationPatterns.example: While printing: select installed substrate → both edit buttons disabled; press first edit button → tooltip 'edit button is disabled because press is printing and substrate can not be editable'; press second edit button → first tooltip disappears, new tooltip on second button with same message

verificationPatterns.pattern: Yellow advisory when a customized section conflicts with a changed substrate-definition field
verificationPatterns.example: Customize tension then change Width → yellow dot on Tension navigation button; yellow text beside Restore button: 'Consider applying HP defaults that match the changes made in substrate definitions'; yellow text at screen bottom: 'Indicates suggested changes of customized values following update in substrate definitions'; disappears after pressing Restore or after saving and reopening

verificationPatterns.pattern: Save button enabled only when unsaved changes exist
verificationPatterns.example: Open edit → Save disabled; change any property → Save enabled; revert property to original value → Save disabled again

verificationPatterns.pattern: Duplicate substrate name rejected with inline error
verificationPatterns.example: Change Name to existing 'Paper' → press Save → popup 'Review required fields'; press OK → Name field shown in red with message 'Substrate name is already in use'; press arrow → name reverts to previous value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-edit toolbar disables Edit button and shows tooltip
verificationPatterns.example: Press-and-hold to enter multi-edit → select second substrate → Edit button in multi-edit toolbar is disabled; press Edit → tooltip appears; pressing per-row Edit button opens properties only for that row's substrate

verificationPatterns.pattern: Combo-box option lists are type-specific
verificationPatterns.example: Material Paper: [Coated, Uncoated, Other Paper]; Material Film: [Polypropylene, Polyester, Polyvinyl chloride, Other Film]; Material Label: [Polypropylene, Polyethylene, Polyester, Polyvinyl chloride, paper coated, paper uncoated, wine white / cream (rough texture), Other Label]; Facestock Paper: [White] only; Facestock Label/Film: [White, Transparent]

verificationPatterns.pattern: Section navigation scrolls to target section and updates highlight
verificationPatterns.example: Press Tension in left navigation → screen scrolls to show all tension fields, Tension navigation item highlighted; press Priming and Corona → scrolls to priming fields, highlight moves; selecting a field inside a section updates the navigation highlight to that section

verificationPatterns.pattern: Name field validates max length and mandatory state with inline messages
verificationPatterns.example: Enter 47-char name → red frame + 'Substrate Name is too long; only 46 characters are allowed'; erase all characters → 'Required field up to 46 characters'; header updates live to reflect current name value

verificationPatterns.pattern: PEX write → PLC signal propagation: write a value via PEX and confirm the corresponding PLC signal reflects the same value
verificationPatterns.example: PEX -> WebEntity -> ILP.MillingTimeout.Value = 10 → gInterface.Web.Comp.ILP.Comp.Liquids.Ctrl.In.Par.Import.MillingTimeout = 10

verificationPatterns.pattern: Countdown timer decrement: poll a 'remaining time' PLC signal and verify it decrements sequentially to 0
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.Web.Comp.ILP.Comp.Liquids.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.RemainMillingTimeout = 10..9..8..7..until 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI indication sync with PLC countdown: verify UI displays the remaining countdown text matching PLC signal value
verificationPatterns.example: UI under ILP indications shows 'Starting wash in X minutes' in sync with RemainMillingTimeout

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition on counter reaching zero: when a countdown signal hits 0, verify the next-state PLC signal asserts True
verificationPatterns.example: RemainMillingTimeout = 0 → NS4|String|gInterface.Web.Comp.ILP.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtWash = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI progress indicator during active operation: verify progress bar starts full and empties, and remaining time updates on a fixed interval (2 s)
verificationPatterns.example: Wash progress bar starts full and gets emptied; remaining wash time displayed in minutes and updated every 2 seconds

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter increment after operation completes: wait for the completion signal to deassert, then verify PLC and PEX counters incremented by 1
verificationPatterns.example: AtWash = False → NS4|String|gInterface.Web.Comp.ILP.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.Export.Counters.TotalWashOperations = 1; PEX -> WebEntity.ILP.TotalWashCounter.Value = 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter reset via UI gesture: trigger reset through UI (long press → popup confirm) and verify counter returns to 0 in PEX
verificationPatterns.example: Long press ILP → popup to reset wash counter → PEX -> WebEntity.ILP.TotalWashCounter.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Max parameter value verification against requirements: read PEX parameter and cross-check against spec/requirements document
verificationPatterns.example: PEX -> WebEntity.ILP.MaxWashOperations.Value verified against requirements parameters table entry MaxWashOperations

verificationPatterns.pattern: Low density triggers solid add sequence
verificationPatterns.example: Set density lower than setpoint, start Get Ready → solid add sequence should start shortly (AtSolidAdd = True)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Empty tube debug during solid add triggers tube unload and 'Waiting for user' state
verificationPatterns.example: Press Ink ctrl → Ink (X) → RDU → Empty tube (debug) during solid add → AtUnloadTube = True, station stops at 'Waiting for user'

verificationPatterns.pattern: TubeEmptyTimeout expiry raises INK_PREPARATION_FAILED_TUBE_EMPTY event and aborts Get Ready
verificationPatterns.example: After TubeEmptyTimeout (ms) elapses in 'Waiting for user' state → INK_PREPARATION_FAILED_TUBE_EMPTY event sent including ink station number, Get Ready aborted

verificationPatterns.pattern: TubeEmptyTimeout is configurable and the new value is respected on next Get Ready
verificationPatterns.example: Change TubeEmptyTimeout = 100000, start Get Ready again → event fires after new timeout value

verificationPatterns.pattern: TubeInPlace = False on user confirm raises INK_TUBE_NOT_IN_PLACE event without aborting press state
verificationPatterns.example: Set gIos.INK(X).Rdu.Main.Input.TubeInPlace.Value = False, press Tube replaced → INK_TUBE_NOT_IN_PLACE event to UI and logs, press remains in current state (Get Ready or Print)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Successful tube replace (TubeInPlace = True, density at setpoint) completes tube load and advances press state
verificationPatterns.example: Set TubeInPlace = True, density = 2000, press Tube replaced → AtLoadTube = True, solid add performed, ink preparation finished, Ready/Printing state reached

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tube unload/load cycle during Print state keeps press in Print state throughout
verificationPatterns.example: Trigger empty tube debug during printing → unload, wait-for-user, load, solid add → ink station returns to Printing, press remains in Print state

verificationPatterns.pattern: TubeInPlace sensor deactivated during Print raises error (not failure) and press continues printing until low density
verificationPatterns.example: Tube in place sensor deactivated while printing → INK_TUBE_NOT_IN_PLACE error event, press continues printing until ink tank density falls to low level

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simulating tube installation (sensor activated) after deactivation completes tube load
verificationPatterns.example: Tube in place sensor reactivated → tube is loaded

verificationPatterns.pattern: Deactivated station icon shows fixed field set; ink level, unloading counter, and state are hidden
verificationPatterns.example: Displayed: station number, color text, color icon, greyed-out activation indicator, one can. Not displayed: ink level, unloading counter, ink station state.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Deactivated display is state-invariant across all eInkSystemState values
verificationPatterns.example: Set eInkSystemState to each of Init, PowerDisable, OFF, MechInit, StdBy, Service, GetReady, Ready, Print, PostPrint — icon remains 'Deactivated' type each time.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Active-OFF icon (eInkSystemState = OFF, MechInit, StdBy) shows partially greyed activation, one can, 3-stage ink level, dashes for percentage and unloading counter
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.arrInk(X).Main.In.Par.Config.Active.Value = true + eInkSystemState = OFF (3) → icon type 'Active-OFF'; ink level Full/Almost empty/Empty displayed; percentages shown as '--'; unloading counter shown as '--:--'.

verificationPatterns.pattern: State label visibility is ink-system-state-dependent: shown in Standby and Print, hidden in OFF and Ready
verificationPatterns.example: eInkSystemState = MechInit or Standby → 'Standby' label shown. eInkSystemState = Print → 'Printing' label shown. eInkSystemState = OFF or Ready → state label not displayed.

verificationPatterns.pattern: In-progress status shown during GetReady/ink-preparation phase
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation.ExportedData.Ink.Sys.Status.inProcess = TRUE → ink station state shows 'in Progress'.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Active-ON icon (eInkSystemState = Ready, Print, Service) shows full-brightness activation, one can, 3-stage ink level, dashes for percentage and unloading counter
verificationPatterns.example: eInkSystemState = Ready (8) → icon type 'Active-ON'; activation at full brightness; one can; ink level stages visible; percentages '--'; unloading '--:-'.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Long-press on active station (both Active-OFF and Active-ON) opens context menu; X button closes it
verificationPatterns.example: Long press on ink station icon → menu appears (menu2.PNG). Press X → menu closes.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Deactivating parent ME station forces ink station into Deactivated display regardless of ink activation signal
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station(X).Ctrl.In.Par.Config.Active.Value set to deactivate ME station → ink station icon switches to 'Deactivated' type.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Deactivating connected BID forces ink station into Deactivated display
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation(X).ImportedData.BID(X).Config.Active = True (BID deactivated) → ink station icon shows 'Deactivated' type.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Empty tube condition shows empty-can icon variant
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate empty tube → icon type 'Active-OFF/empty' (empty.png); all standard Active-ON fields present except state label.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Two same-color single stations display independent, non-duplicated readings
verificationPatterns.example: Define two single ink stations with the same color → each station displays its own distinct values, not copies of each other.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Kibana dashboard opens and lists correctly
verificationPatterns.example: Dashboards list opens after navigating Kibana → Dashboards.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Filter wildcard edit changes scope of displayed IOs
verificationPatterns.example: Change wildcard portion in filter dialogue to IO name substring; filter type updates to the desired IO.

verificationPatterns.pattern: IO state changes visible in graph for selected time range
verificationPatterns.example: In graph area of dashboard all changes in IO state in selected time range are displayed after refreshing.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Kibana index presence check
verificationPatterns.example: Open Kibana -> Discover -> Filters; search for plc-analog-data or plc-digital-data to confirm data is being stored for policies

verificationPatterns.pattern: JSON syntax error message validation
verificationPatterns.example: Trigger a JSON parse error; verify error message displays both the line number and the failure type

verificationPatterns.pattern: Duplicate IO in config causes recorder abort
verificationPatterns.example: Overwrite config with duplicate IO entry; run PressTools.OpcUaRecorder.exe; verify duplicate IO named in error and recorder loading aborted

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unknown IO name logged as error but recorder continues
verificationPatterns.example: Overwrite config with non-existent IO name; run PressTools.OpcUaRecorder.exe; verify incorrect name appears in error but recorder keeps running

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLCAnalogData CSV export produces one row per second with per-IO columns
verificationPatterns.example: Run export.cmd, select PLCAnalogData, set 15-min window; verify output folder created with long timestamped name, CSV has time column with 1-second intervals and one column per recorded IO

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLCDigitalData CSV export produces one row per state-change event
verificationPatterns.example: Run export.cmd, select PLCDigitalData, set 15-min window; verify CSV has time column, parameter-name column, and value column where each row is a change event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Off-to-Ready-to-Off transition triggers data recording
verificationPatterns.example: Bring press from Off to Ready state then back to Off before running export to populate recording window

verificationPatterns.pattern: Restore original config file as teardown step
verificationPatterns.example: After all sub-tests, restore original S:\Press\OpcUaRecorderDataConfig.json

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard success gate before functional test
verificationPatterns.example: Verify wizard passed.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-calibration GR/Print smoke test
verificationPatterns.example: Verify job is printing without any error.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service state on wizard entry
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.MgmtCtrl.Out.Status.AtService = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default checkbox state
verificationPatterns.example: Checkbox 'Exit Service state upon close' is marked by default

verificationPatterns.pattern: Recovery UI element appears on failure
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Recalibrate button appeared after wizard failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard pass after Recalibrate
verificationPatterns.example: Verify wizard passed after clicking Recalibrate

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration result persisted to signal on success
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.In.Par.Save.ProcessSpeed contains saved results

verificationPatterns.pattern: State restoration to Standby on close
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press state is Standby after clicking Close

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration result NOT persisted when closed without recalibrate
verificationPatterns.example: Verify results are not saved in gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.In.Par.Save.ProcessSpeed when Close clicked instead of Recalibrate

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard play button disabled in non-service press states
verificationPatterns.example: Verify ASID speed calibration wizard play button is disabled when press is in Off/GR/Ready/Print/PostPrint/PrePrint state.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard play button enabled in service/standby press states
verificationPatterns.example: Verify ASID speed calibration wizard play button is Enabled when press is in Service/Standby state.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard failure assertion
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the wizard failed.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event raised during rough calibration phase
verificationPatterns.example: Verify event raised during ASID rough calibration (when NS4|String|gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.Out.Status.AtSpeedCalibRough = True) about: ASID_SPEED_CALIB_NOT_CONVERGE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration result rollback on failure
verificationPatterns.example: Verify last calibration result returned to default/last calibration result

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state regression to Service after fault
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press fell to Service state.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Exit-Service-on-close checkbox default and state transition to Standby
verificationPatterns.example: Verify 'Exit Service state upon close' is checked by default and click Close; verify press state is Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault-specific event raised assertion
verificationPatterns.example: Verify event raised about bkt temperature / lateral-tensioner motor / AK blower / ASID temperature too low

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify subsystem service sequences are True during calibration run
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.CVC.Ctrl.Out.Status.service.CVC_Main.Seq = True; gInterface.BKT.Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.BktHndl.Seq = True; gInterface.Station[X].Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.Ctrl.Seq = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify calibration results persisted to parameter save path, consistent across all stations
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.In.Par.Save.ProcessSpeed — verify all stations hold same value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify all service sequence flags clear to False after wizard completion
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.CVC.Ctrl.Out.Status.service.CVC_Main.Seq = False; gInterface.BKT.Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.BktHndl.Seq = False; gInterface.Station[X].Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.Ctrl.Seq = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify press returns to Standby after closing wizard with 'Exit Service state upon close' checked
verificationPatterns.example: Close wizard → press state is Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: LPH reaches operational after transition to standby
verificationPatterns.example: Step 1: move to standby → verify LPHs go to operational

verificationPatterns.pattern: LPH remains operational after GR and return to standby
verificationPatterns.example: Step 2: perform GR and go back to standby → verify LPHs remain at operational

verificationPatterns.pattern: Duty cycle DB change takes effect in LPHs after mech init
verificationPatterns.example: Step 3: change off-state duty cycle in DB and perform mech init → verify duty cycle in practice changed in LPHs

verificationPatterns.pattern: LPH blocked from operational and event raised on NVRAM read failure
verificationPatterns.example: Step 5: cause failure on reading nvram data → verify LPH does not go to operational and event is given

verificationPatterns.pattern: Zmod changes applied only between spreads, not within slices
verificationPatterns.example: Step 6: print wizard that changes zmod between spreads → verify zmod are only changed between spreads and not between slices

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI wizard step triggers system-level state transition
verificationPatterns.example: Click Continue in ASID speed calibration wizard → verify gInterface.MgmtCtrl.Out.Status.AtService = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-station array signal verified across all 6 stations (X=1-6)
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.Out.Status.AtSpeedCalibFreeRun = True for X=1-6

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal held True for a duration read from a parameter signal
verificationPatterns.example: AtSpeedCalibFreeRun = True sustained for SpeedCalibTrqStabTime seconds (read from gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.In.Par.Import.SpeedCalibTrqStabTime)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Speed output matches process speed parameter
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.Out.Monitor.AxisSetSpeed = gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.In.Par.Save.ProcessSpeed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simultaneous multi-signal condition check before a sequential dependency is verified
verificationPatterns.example: BKT lateral active + tension at process + AK activated must all be True simultaneously, then verify BktV.AtProcessSpeed = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Phase completion verified at both component level and station-manager level
verificationPatterns.example: SpeedCalibFreeRunDone = True (ASID component) AND AsidSpeedCalib.FreeRunDone = True (SeqCtrl) for X=1-6

verificationPatterns.pattern: Temperature-driven sequential engagement: T1 engages coldest station first, progresses until all stations reach setpoint at the same time
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Comp.arrBr[X].Ctrl.Out.Status.AtEngage transitions station by station in ascending temperature order; convergence monitored via gInterface.MgmtCtrl.Seq.Out.Monitor.AsidSpeedCalib.asidTempAvrg

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timed engage/disengage cycle verified against parameter signals for all stations
verificationPatterns.example: T1 engages for BrEngTime_sec (AtEngage = True), then disengages for BrDisengTime_sec (AtDisengage = True), for arrBr[X] X=1-6

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard close triggers full multi-subsystem teardown verified via Done/Stop/Off flags
verificationPatterns.example: BKT StopDone = True, CVC BlowersAtOffSpeed = True, all arrBr[X] AtDisengage = True, Station[X] StationStopDone = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press returns to originating state after wizard closes
verificationPatterns.example: With 'Exit Service state upon close' checked by default, verify press state returns to Standby after clicking Close

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stop-before-threshold then reprint: peeling absent on interrupted job, present at start of reprint
verificationPatterns.example: Print job ≥13 rotations, stop at 5/6/11/12 rotations → AtPeeling=False; reprint → AtPeeling=True at job start

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press error during active peeling: StiR disengages to OFF, peeling re-enters on next print
verificationPatterns.example: Trigger error when AtPeeling=True → AtDisEngage=True, AtOFF=True; reprint → AtPeeling=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Job at exact peeling threshold: peeling deferred to next session
verificationPatterns.example: Print 6 rotations → AtPeeling=False; next session → AtPeeling=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Consecutive-job queue: peeling fires after first threshold job, not after second
verificationPatterns.example: Queue two 6-rotation jobs → AtPeeling=True after job 1 ends; AtPeeling=False after job 2 ends

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert AtPeeling = False during calibration cycle
verificationPatterns.example: OCB_saPLC.OCB.gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtPeeling = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert AtPeeling = False during cleaner run with minimum bkt rotation count
verificationPatterns.example: Run cleaner with at least 13 bkt rotations; verify STIR peeling is not entering during calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify default parameter values against SW requirements chapter
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all STIR peeling default parameters are according SW requirements, chapter 2.20.1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Enumerate specific named signals to check per requirement reference
verificationPatterns.example: Parameters that needs verification: StirPeelSpeed, StirPeelingTempSetPoint, StirPeelingTime

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify substrate-specific tension values in both DB and PLC
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all tensions in DB and PLC for Paper substrate

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify cyclic trigger: peeling activates at configured rotation/build interval
verificationPatterns.example: AtPeeling = True every 12 bkt rotations (every 6 STIR build insertions); bkt rotation counted by AtEngage = False transitions; STIR build counted by slotLenUm = 180000

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify STIR moves to service/peeling position on peeling entrance
verificationPatterns.example: OCB_saPLC.OCB.gIos.BKT.Stir.Out.Stir_Service_engage = '1' AND interface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Comp.ServiceEng.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtService = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify AtPeeling status holds for exactly the configured peeling duration
verificationPatterns.example: OCB_saPLC.OCB.gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtPeeling = True for 5 seconds

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify STIR motor not rotating during peeling (before and after)
verificationPatterns.example: OCB_saPLC.OCB.gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Comp.Roller.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.ActVelocity = 0 while AtPeeling = True and after peeling finishes

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify no STIR build job prints while peeling is active
verificationPatterns.example: G_PrintCtrl.printCtrl.printDataControl.out.monitor.logSlotAllocPrint.slotLenUm != 180000 when OCB_saPLC.OCB.gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtPeeling = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify substrate-specific tension values in both DB and PLC after substrate install
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all tensions in DB and PLC for Label substrate

verificationPatterns.pattern: Three-layer signal propagation: IBL entity property → OPCUAInterface imported value → PLC gInterface signal all equal same value
verificationPatterns.example: InstalledSubstrateEntity->Tension.UnwinderTension=6 | OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.Ctrl.UnwinderTension.Value=6 | gInterface.Web.Comp.UW.In.Par.Local.Tension.PrintTention=6

verificationPatterns.pattern: Two-layer signal propagation (no gInterface): IBL entity property → OPCUAInterface imported value only
verificationPatterns.example: InstalledSubstrateEntity->Tension.NipsPressure=4 | OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.Ctrl.PWSNipsPressure.Value=4

verificationPatterns.pattern: Width unit conversion: IBL stores value in microns (×1000), OPCUAInterface stores in mm
verificationPatterns.example: InstalledSubstrateEntity->Substrate.Width=336000 | OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.Ctrl.SubStrateWidth.Value=336

verificationPatterns.pattern: Substrate type enum verified on IBL entity only
verificationPatterns.example: InstalledSubstrateEntity->Substrate.SubstrateType = Label

verificationPatterns.pattern: Thickness same unit across both layers (no conversion)
verificationPatterns.example: InstalledSubstrateEntity->Substrate.Thickness=110 | OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.Ctrl.SubStrateThickness.Value=110

verificationPatterns.pattern: IBL InstalledSubstrateEntity reflects installed substrate name
verificationPatterns.example: Press.IBL.PaperHandling.Substrates.InstalledSubstrateEntity -> Substrate.Name = Film

verificationPatterns.pattern: Three-layer tension propagation: IBL entity value → OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.Ctrl.<TensionField>.Value → gInterface.Web.Comp.<Component>.Par.Local path; all three layers must match
verificationPatterns.example: InstalledSubstrateEntity -> Substrate.Tension.UnwinderTension = 3 / OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.Ctrl.UnwinderTension.Value = 3 / gInterface.Web.Comp.UW.In.Par.Local.Tension.PrintTention = 3

verificationPatterns.pattern: Substrate type in IBL matches installed substrate name
verificationPatterns.example: Press.IBL.PaperHandling.Substrates.InstalledSubstrateEntity -> Substrate.SubstrateType = Film

verificationPatterns.pattern: Width unit scaling: IBL stores micrometers, OPCUAInterface stores millimeters (factor 1000)
verificationPatterns.example: InstalledSubstrateEntity -> Substrate.Width = 336000 / OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.Ctrl.SubStrateWidth.Value = 336

verificationPatterns.pattern: Thickness direct match: same numeric value in IBL and OPCUAInterface
verificationPatterns.example: InstalledSubstrateEntity -> Substrate.Thickness = 50 / OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.Ctrl.SubStrateThickness.Value = 50

verificationPatterns.pattern: Rewinder taper and lay-on-roller fields use value 10 (not 3); verify these fields separately from standard tension fields
verificationPatterns.example: Substrate.Tension.RewinderTaperTension = 10 / Substrate.Tension.LayOnRollerForce = 10 / Substrate.Tension.LayOnRollerForceTaper = 10

verificationPatterns.pattern: NIP pressure propagates only to OPCUAInterface (no gInterface path listed)
verificationPatterns.example: Substrate.Tension.NipsPressure = 4 / OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.Ctrl.PWSNipsPressure.Value = 4

verificationPatterns.pattern: Three-layer signal parity check: IBL entity property == OPCUAInterface imported value == PLC gInterface parameter
verificationPatterns.example: InstalledSubstrateEntity->Substrate.Tension.UnwinderTension=7, OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.Ctrl.UnwinderTension.Value=7, gInterface.Web.Comp.UW.In.Par.Local.Tension.PrintTention=7

verificationPatterns.pattern: Two-layer signal parity check: IBL entity property == OPCUAInterface imported value (no PLC gInterface path present)
verificationPatterns.example: InstalledSubstrateEntity->Substrate.Tension.NipsPressure=4, OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.Ctrl.PWSNipsPressure.Value=4

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unit scaling check: IBL stores value in micro-units while OPCUAInterface stores in base units
verificationPatterns.example: InstalledSubstrateEntity->Substrate.Width=336000, OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.Ctrl.SubStrateWidth.Value=336

verificationPatterns.pattern: Enum/string property propagation: IBL entity string property matches expected substrate type literal
verificationPatterns.example: InstalledSubstrateEntity->Substrate.SubstrateType=Paper

verificationPatterns.pattern: DC disconnect on Feed-group PS (LPH 1-3): set PS_DC_OK=9000 + set Main_Enable_Feed_Feedback=TRUE → error, press OFF, Feed disabled, Exit stays, LPH 1-3 voltage off, LPH 4-6 voltage on
verificationPatterns.example: Set LPH_1_PS_DC_OK=9000, Set LPH_Main_Enable_Feed_Feedback=TRUE → PE_FEED_POWER_SUPPLY_DISCONNECTED; LPH_Main_Enable_Feed=FALSE, LPH_Main_Enable_Exit=TRUE, LPH_1/2/3_Enable_Voltage=FALSE, LPH_4/5/6_Enable_Voltage=TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: DC release on Feed-group PS at OFF (PS_DC_OK=12500) → all 6 Enable_Voltage go FALSE, Feed stays FALSE, Exit stays TRUE
verificationPatterns.example: Release LPH_1_PS_DC_OK (12500 at OFF) → LPH_Main_Enable_Feed=FALSE, LPH_Main_Enable_Exit=TRUE, LPH_1..6_Enable_Voltage=FALSE

verificationPatterns.pattern: DC disconnect on Exit-group PS (LPH 4-6): set PS_DC_OK=9000 + set Main_Enable_Exit_Feedback=TRUE → error, press OFF, Exit disabled, Feed stays, LPH 1-3 voltage on, LPH 4-6 voltage off
verificationPatterns.example: Set LPH_4_PS_DC_OK=9000, Set LPH_Main_Enable_Exit_Feedback=TRUE → PE_FEED_POWER_SUPPLY_DISCONNECTED; LPH_Main_Enable_Feed=TRUE, LPH_Main_Enable_Exit=FALSE, LPH_1/2/3_Enable_Voltage=TRUE, LPH_4/5/6_Enable_Voltage=FALSE

verificationPatterns.pattern: DC release on Exit-group PS at OFF → all 6 Enable_Voltage FALSE, Feed stays TRUE, Exit stays FALSE
verificationPatterns.example: Release LPH_4_PS_DC_OK (12500 at OFF) → LPH_Main_Enable_Feed=TRUE, LPH_Main_Enable_Exit=FALSE, LPH_1..6_Enable_Voltage=FALSE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Recovery after OFF: bring press back to Standby → all 6 Enable_Voltage TRUE, both Main enables TRUE
verificationPatterns.example: Bring press to Standby after release → LPH_Main_Enable_Feed=TRUE, LPH_Main_Enable_Exit=TRUE, LPH_1..6_Enable_Voltage=TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cooling failure at Ready state disables all voltage enables while both Main enables remain TRUE
verificationPatterns.example: Set gIos.LPHCooling.Input.LPH_Tank_Temperature_Sens.Value=500 → press OFF, LPH_Main_Enable_Feed=TRUE, LPH_Main_Enable_Exit=TRUE, LPH_1..6_Enable_Voltage=FALSE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Standby→OFF with cooling at OFF (AtOFF=TRUE) keeps all voltage enables FALSE and both Main enables TRUE
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.LphCooling.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOFF=TRUE → LPH_Main_Enable_Feed=TRUE, LPH_Main_Enable_Exit=TRUE, LPH_1..6_Enable_Voltage=FALSE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error message must include power supply number and location, not just error code
verificationPatterns.example: PE_FEED_POWER_SUPPLY_DISCONNECTED error should be displayed, including the power supply number and location

verificationPatterns.pattern: Main enable signals (Exit, Feed) stay TRUE regardless of which ME station is disabled
verificationPatterns.example: LPH_Main_Enable_Exit = TRUE, LPH_Main_Enable_Feed = TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Only the LPH_N_Enable_Voltage signal mapped to the disabled ME station goes FALSE
verificationPatterns.example: ME station 1 disabled → LPH_1_Enable_Voltage = FALSE; ME station 4 disabled → LPH_3_Enable_Voltage = FALSE

verificationPatterns.pattern: All non-mapped LPH voltage enable signals remain TRUE
verificationPatterns.example: LPH_2 through LPH_6 all TRUE when ME station 1 disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: AC contactor failed-to-turn-off: set feedback TRUE while enable FALSE, verify error + transition block
verificationPatterns.example: Set LPH_Main_Enable_Feed_Feedback = TRUE while LPH_Main_Enable_Feed = FALSE → PE_FEED_EC_CONTACTOR_FAILED_TO_TURN_OFF displayed; transition to OFF state disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: AC contactor failed-to-turn-on: set feedback FALSE while enable TRUE, verify error + transition block
verificationPatterns.example: Set LPH_Main_Enable_Feed_Feedback = FALSE while LPH_Main_Enable_Feed = TRUE → PE_FEED_EC_CONTACTOR_FAILED_TO_TURN_ON displayed; transition to Standby disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: DC power supply failed-to-turn-off: set PS_DC_OK above threshold while Enable_Voltage FALSE, verify error + transition block
verificationPatterns.example: Set LPH_1_PS_DC_OK = 13500 while LPH_1_Enable_Voltage = FALSE → PE_FEED_POWER_SUPPLY_FAILED_TO_TURN_OFF displayed; transition to OFF state disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: DC power supply failed-to-turn-on: set PS_DC_OK below threshold while Enable_Voltage TRUE, verify error + press falls to OFF
verificationPatterns.example: Set LPH_1_PS_DC_OK = 12500 while LPH_1_Enable_Voltage = TRUE → PE_FEED_POWER_SUPPLY_FAILED_TO_TURN_ON displayed; press falls to OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error includes identifying metadata: contactor name/location or power supply number/location
verificationPatterns.example: PE_FEED_EC_CONTACTOR_FAILED_TO_TURN_OFF error should be displayed, including the contactor name and location

verificationPatterns.pattern: After clearing fault signal, restore valid state and re-attempt transition to verify recovery
verificationPatterns.example: Set LPH_Main_Enable_Feed_Feedback = TRUE → Bring press to Standby state (MechInit should pass)

verificationPatterns.pattern: After PS turn-on failure falls to OFF, restore DC_OK to valid level then re-bring to Standby before testing next PS
verificationPatterns.example: Set LPH_1_PS_DC_OK = 13500 → Bring press to Standby state → Set LPH_2_PS_DC_OK = 12500

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify full enable signal state snapshot after each fault injection
verificationPatterns.example: LPH_Main_Enable_Feed = FALSE, LPH_Main_Enable_Exit = TRUE, LPH_1_Enable_Voltage = FALSE … LPH_6_Enable_Voltage = FALSE

verificationPatterns.pattern: PS_DC_OK threshold: 13500 = voltage present (ON), 12500 = voltage absent (OFF)
verificationPatterns.example: Set LPH_1_PS_DC_OK = 13500 while LPH_1_Enable_Voltage = FALSE (should-be-off but is on)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Feed PSUs (1–3) map to PE_FEED errors; Exit PSUs (4–6) map to PE_EXIT errors
verificationPatterns.example: LPH_3_PS_DC_OK fault → PE_FEED_POWER_SUPPLY_FAILED_TO_TURN_OFF; LPH_4_PS_DC_OK fault → PE_EXIT_POWER_SUPPLY_FAILED_TO_TURN_OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: All LPH_N_Enable_Voltage signals OFF when press below Standby or activation conditions unmet
verificationPatterns.example: Power disable state: LPH_1_Enable_Voltage = Off ... LPH_6_Enable_Voltage = Off

verificationPatterns.pattern: LPH_Main_Enable_Exit and LPH_Main_Enable_Feed turn ON at OFF state and remain ON through all subsequent states
verificationPatterns.example: OFF state: LPH_Main_Enable_Exit = On, LPH_Main_Enable_Feed = On

verificationPatterns.pattern: All LPH_N_Enable_Voltage signals turn ON only when press is in Standby+ AND pump is on AND tank temperature above minimum
verificationPatterns.example: Standby with pump on and temp above min: LPH_1..6_Enable_Voltage = On

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump off disables all LPH_N_Enable_Voltage regardless of press state
verificationPatterns.example: Pump turned off in Standby: LPH_1_Enable_Voltage = Off ... LPH_6_Enable_Voltage = Off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tank temperature below minimum disables all LPH_N_Enable_Voltage even when pump is on
verificationPatterns.example: Pump on, temp below min: LPH_1_Enable_Voltage = Off ... LPH_6_Enable_Voltage = Off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Restoring tank temperature above minimum re-enables all LPH_N_Enable_Voltage
verificationPatterns.example: Temp raised above min: LPH_1_Enable_Voltage = On ... LPH_6_Enable_Voltage = On

verificationPatterns.pattern: LPH_N_Enable_Voltage signals remain ON through Ready and Print states when conditions met
verificationPatterns.example: Print state: LPH_1_Enable_Voltage = On ... LPH_6_Enable_Voltage = On

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert boolean flag is false across multiple inactive/low-power machine states in a single step
verificationPatterns.example: /// Verify asid at temp is false for stanBy, Off, power disable and Init

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify multiple temperature-related signals across valid and invalid GR and print sequence states
verificationPatterns.example: Verify CS, CR, LPH and asid at atemp sequences for valid and invalid GR and print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal is false in non-operational states
verificationPatterns.example: verify asid at temp is false in off and power disable state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal reflects temperature validity in operational states
verificationPatterns.example: verify asid at temp is true with valid temp and false with invalid temp in standBy state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat temperature validity check per press state
verificationPatterns.example: same true/false check applied to standBy, GR, and print states independently

verificationPatterns.pattern: Invalid state triggers fault + press-state transition
verificationPatterns.example: During MechInit with invalid temp: verify press falls to Off AND event is sent

verificationPatterns.pattern: Valid state suppresses fault + allows normal press-state transition
verificationPatterns.example: With valid temp: verify press goes to StandBy AND no event is sent

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-branch verification (invalid path / valid path) in same case
verificationPatterns.example: Step covers both the fault branch and the recovery/normal branch sequentially

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault-state transition on invalid sensor reading during MechInit
verificationPatterns.example: verify press falls to off and event is sent during mechinit with invalid temp

verificationPatterns.pattern: Normal-state transition with no event on valid sensor reading
verificationPatterns.example: verify press goes to standBy and no event is sent with valid temp

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press falls to standBy on invalid sensor reading when safety control active
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press falls to standBy during GR when setting melexis to invalid temp

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press does NOT fall to standBy on invalid sensor reading when safety control bypassed
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press doesn't fall during GR with invalid temp (after bypass asid control)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press falls to standby during GR when safety control is active and sensor reports invalid value
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press falls to standBy during GR when setting melexis to invalid temp

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press does NOT fall during GR when same safety control is bypassed, even with identical invalid sensor value
verificationPatterns.example: Bypass asid control / Verify press doesn't fall during GR with invalid temp

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass-guard check: assert feature bypass signal is false before any stimulus
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStations.MEStation1.ImportedData.Asid.Config.Bypass.TemperatureMonitoryByPass.Value = false

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault severity depends on press state: communication loss in OFF publishes 'error'; in any other state publishes 'failure'
verificationPatterns.example: OFF state → ASID_IR_MLX_COMM_FAILURE ... error; Print state → ASID_IR_MLX_COMM_FAILURE ... failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state response: fault in OFF keeps press in OFF; fault in non-OFF drives press to OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Start EA service mode for a WEB subsystem → status flag sets True
verificationPatterns.example: Call NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.ServiceMode.WEB.Dryer.EA.Start → Verify NS4|String|gInterface.Web.Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.Dryer.Ea= True

verificationPatterns.pattern: End service operation clears ALL active EA flags across all WEB subsystems simultaneously
verificationPatterns.example: Call NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.EndService.Start → Verify Dryer.Ea=False, ILP.Ea=False, RW.Ea=False, SPM.Ea=False, UW.Ea=False, WHS.Ea=False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Start SEQ service mode for a WEB subsystem → status flag sets True
verificationPatterns.example: Call NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.ServiceMode.WEB.Dryer.SEQ.Start → Verify NS4|String|gInterface.Web.Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.Dryer.Seq= True

verificationPatterns.pattern: End service operation clears ALL active SEQ flags across all WEB subsystems simultaneously
verificationPatterns.example: Call NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.EndService.Start → Verify Dryer.Seq=False, ILP.Seq=False, RW.Seq=False, SPM.Seq=False, WHS.Seq=False

verificationPatterns.pattern: EA phase fully tested and terminated before SEQ phase begins
verificationPatterns.example: EndService.Start called after all EA starts (Step 7), then SEQ starts begin from Step 8

verificationPatterns.pattern: RW subsystem uses OperationData call path instead of Start for both EA and SEQ modes
verificationPatterns.example: Call NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.ServiceMode.WEB.RW.EA.OperationData (Steps 3 and 10) vs .Start used by all other subsystems

verificationPatterns.pattern: EA mode activation: call Start operation, verify corresponding EA status signal goes True
verificationPatterns.example: Call OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.ServiceMode.IMO.Recycling.EA.Start → Verify gInterface.ImoSystem.Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.Recycle.Ea= True

verificationPatterns.pattern: EndService clears all EA status signals to False atomically
verificationPatterns.example: Call OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.EndService.Start → Verify Recycle.Ea=False, Reservoir.Ea=False, TempCtrl.Ea=False, Waste.Ea=False

verificationPatterns.pattern: SEQ mode activation: call Start operation, verify corresponding SEQ status signal goes True
verificationPatterns.example: Call OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.ServiceMode.IMO.Recycling.SEQ.Start → Verify gInterface.ImoSystem.Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.Recycle.SEQ= True

verificationPatterns.pattern: EndService clears all SEQ status signals to False atomically
verificationPatterns.example: Call OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.EndService.Start → Verify Recycle.SEQ=False, Reservoir.Seq=False, TempCtrl.SEQ=False, Waste.Seq=False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Each sub-system has parallel EA and SEQ variants tested independently in sequence
verificationPatterns.example: Recycling EA → Reservoir EA → TempCtrl EA → Waste EA, then same pattern for SEQ

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sub-component EA activation: call EA.Start → status flag becomes True
verificationPatterns.example: Call NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.ServiceMode.MEStation[X].Asid.EA.Start → Verify NS4|String|gInterface.Station[X].Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.Asid.Ea= True

verificationPatterns.pattern: EndService clears all EA flags to False for all stations
verificationPatterns.example: Call NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.EndService.Start → Verify NS4|String|gInterface.Station[X].Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.Asid.Ea= False (and same for Bid[1/2], Cs, Chrg, LPH)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sub-component SEQ activation: call SEQ.Start → status flag becomes True
verificationPatterns.example: Call NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.ServiceMode.MEStation[X].Asid.SEQ.Start → Verify NS4|String|gInterface.Station[X].Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.Asid.Seq= True

verificationPatterns.pattern: EndService clears all SEQ flags to False for all stations
verificationPatterns.example: Call NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.EndService.Start → Verify NS4|String|gInterface.Station[X].Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.Asid.Seq= False (and same for Bid[1/2], Cs, Chrg, LPH)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parametric station sweep: repeat each sub-component activation check for X=1 through 6
verificationPatterns.example: X=1-6 repeated on every step for MEStation[X] calls and gInterface.Station[X] verifications

verificationPatterns.pattern: Zone lock status via Safety signal
verificationPatterns.example: Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.Safety.arrSafetyZone[3].Out.Status.Zone_Status.ZoneLocked = False (unlock) / True (lock)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-zone maintenance flag on single component (Web only)
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.MntZone3 = True when unlocked, False when locked

verificationPatterns.pattern: Broadcast AtService flag across all subsystem components
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT/CVC/CWA/ImoSystem/LphCooling/MgmtCtrl/Web.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtService = True (unlock) / False (lock)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameterised station index assertion (X=1-6)
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Ctrl.Out.Status.AtService = True for X=1 through 6

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state restoration after EndService
verificationPatterns.example: Verify machine returns to the state it held before entering Service in Step 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: EA start sets component Ea flag True
verificationPatterns.example: Call …ServiceMode.CVC.Sys.EA.Start → gInterface.CVC.Ctrl.Out.Status.service.CVC_Main.Ea= True

verificationPatterns.pattern: EndService clears all active Ea flags to False
verificationPatterns.example: Call …EndService.Start → gInterface.LphCooling…LPH_Cooling_Main.Ea= False AND gInterface.CVC…CVC_Main.Ea= False

verificationPatterns.pattern: SEQ start sets component Seq flag True
verificationPatterns.example: Call …ServiceMode.CVC.Sys.SEQ.Start → gInterface.CVC.Ctrl.Out.Status.service.CVC_Main.Seq= True

verificationPatterns.pattern: EndService clears all active Seq flags to False
verificationPatterns.example: Call …EndService.Start → gInterface.LphCooling…LPH_Cooling_Main.Seq= False AND gInterface.CVC…CVC_Main.Seq= False

verificationPatterns.pattern: EA and Seq flags are independent; ending one mode does not affect the other mode's flags
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 1-3 exercise Ea; steps 4-6 exercise Seq with separate EndService calls

verificationPatterns.pattern: Zone lock status assertion — read arrSafetyZone[N].ZoneLocked and assert expected boolean
verificationPatterns.example: Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.Safety.arrSafetyZone[2].Out.Status.Zone_Status.ZoneLocked = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Web component maintenance-zone flag reflects zone lock/unlock state
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.Web.Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.MntZone2 = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: All subsystem components broadcast AtService=True on zone unlock, AtService=False on zone lock
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.BKT.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtService = True (and CVC, CWA, ImoSystem, LphCooling, MgmtCtrl, Web, Station[1-6])

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state restoration — after EndService + lock, verify state matches pre-test state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify machine state returned to state before step 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Zone lock status via safety zone array signal
verificationPatterns.example: Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.Safety.arrSafetyZone[1].Out.Status.Zone_Status.ZoneLocked = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Broadcast MntZone1 flag across all components toggles together on zone unlock/lock
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.MntZone1 = True ... gInterface.Station[X].Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.MntZone1 = True // X=1-6

verificationPatterns.pattern: Broadcast AtService flag across all components toggles together on zone unlock/lock
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtService = True ... gInterface.MgmtCtrl.Out.Status.AtService = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: EndService operation + lock reverses maintenance mode — all MntZone1 and AtService flags flip to False
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.MntZone1 = False, gInterface.BKT.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtService = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state restoration — verify state matches pre-unlock state after EndService + lock
verificationPatterns.example: Verify machine state returned to state before step 1.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify all per-station components reach expected service state by reading AtStdBy/AtOFF status signals across X=1-6
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.AsiD.Out.Status.AtStdBy= True  (X=1-6)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify array-indexed subcomponents (arrBid[1] and arrBid[2]) independently for each station
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.arrBid[1].Main.Out.Status.AtStdBy = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify LPH uses a distinct state signal (AtDisEngage) rather than AtStdBy when in Stdby/Ready
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[X].Comp.LPH.Out.Status.AtDisEngage = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Same operation from different precondition states (Stdby vs OFF) produces different component status outcomes — test both entry paths
verificationPatterns.example: From OFF: all components AtOFF=True; From Stdby: all components AtStdBy=True (LPH: AtDisEngage)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify component AtStandBy after Service Start from Stdby/Ready (components with Ctrl layer)
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.Web.Comp.DRYER.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtStandBy = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify component AtReady after Service Start from Stdby/Ready (components without Ctrl layer)
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.Web.Comp.RW.Out.Status.AtReady = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify all Web subsystems AtOFF after Service Start from OFF state
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.Web.Comp.DRYER.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOFF = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-component AtStandby status check after Service.Start from Stdby/Ready
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.BKT.Comp.BktV.Out.Status.AtStandby = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-conditional signal check: different signal path depending on whether system is in Stdby vs Ready
verificationPatterns.example: Stdby: Tension.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtBldStandbyTen = True; Ready: Tension.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtBldPrcssTen = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Array element sweep: verify signal across indexed array of components
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.BKT.Comp.arrBr[X].Ctrl.Out.Status.AtDisengage = True, where X = 1-6

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-component AtOFF status check after Service.Start from OFF state
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.BKT.Comp.BktV.Out.Status.AtOFF = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-conditional signal check: same operation produces different signal values depending on source state (Stdby/Ready vs OFF)
verificationPatterns.example: BlowersAtLowSpeed=True from Stdby/Ready; BlowersAtOffSpeed=True from OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Monitor active/inactive pattern: monitoring flags remain True from Stdby/Ready, go False from OFF
verificationPatterns.example: CWS Monitor_Active=True (Stdby/Ready) vs Monitor_Active=False (OFF); LphCooling TankLevelMonitorActive follows same pattern

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-component parallel verification after single operation call
verificationPatterns.example: After Service.Start, assert CVC + CWS + LphCooling + ImoSystem + InkCommon signals in one pass

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-invariant signal: component signal holds same value regardless of source state
verificationPatterns.example: InkCommon.InkWaterCtrlTutko.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtStdBy=True in both Stdby/Ready and OFF scenarios

verificationPatterns.pattern: EA operation start sets corresponding .Ea status flag True
verificationPatterns.example: Call ...ServiceMode.BKT.Handling.EA.Start → gInterface.BKT.Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.BktHndl.Ea = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: EndService resets all active .Ea flags to False
verificationPatterns.example: Call ...EndService.Start → BktTemp.Ea=False, BktStir.Ea=False, BktHndl.Ea=False

verificationPatterns.pattern: SEQ operation start sets corresponding .Seq status flag True
verificationPatterns.example: Call ...ServiceMode.BKT.Handling.SEQ.Start → gInterface.BKT.Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.BktHndl.Seq = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: EndService resets all active .Seq flags to False
verificationPatterns.example: Call ...EndService.Start → BktTemp.Seq=False, BktStir.Seq=False, BktHndl.Seq=False

verificationPatterns.pattern: EA and SEQ sub-functions tested independently with separate EndService calls
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 1-4 cover EA cycle; Steps 5-8 cover SEQ cycle, each terminated by EndService.Start

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter compliance check
verificationPatterns.example: ink file parameters for standard white ink are matching requirements

verificationPatterns.pattern: All subsystem managers report AtServiceOperational=True after Service.Start
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.BKT.Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.AtServiceOperational= True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Station array signals verified across all indices (X=1-6)
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.Station[X].Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.AtOperational= True //X=1-6 (all stations)

verificationPatterns.pattern: All subsystem managers report AtReady=False after Service.Stop
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.BKT.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtReady= False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state restored to pre-service state after Stop
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Machine state got back to the state before calling Service operation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Data-driven property comparison against CSV reference table
verificationPatterns.example: Compare each property to requirements; data saved in standardWhiteParameters.csv — expected: data from table matches DB.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Compare expected vs actual calibration results across multiple sub-components
verificationPatterns.example: Verify expected results are matching color calibration results for Electrode, Developer and machine LUT

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify active calibration values are applied during print job via PQ metric check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify PQ values during printed job are using the color calibration values

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calculate expected scan position from DB file and assert equality
verificationPatterns.example: Get scan position from the DB file, calculate the expected scan position and check they equal

verificationPatterns.pattern: Load DB sampling results and expected voltage changes for post-run comparison
verificationPatterns.example: Load the expected voltage changes; load DB sampling results

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fail test on any warning via boolean guard
verificationPatterns.example: If warning found in test, the bool failTestIfWarningFound will be set to True and test will fail

verificationPatterns.pattern: DB results match CSV-driven expected values
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Electrode, Developer, MachineLut CalibrationResultsEntity values match ccExpectedResultsTable.csv

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC sampling voltage-change count per calibration step
verificationPatterns.example: Electrode step: 10 spreads, voltage changed 9 times, developer max 600V; Developer step: 10 spreads, voltage changed 9 times; MachineLut step: 1 spread printed; null/power-off voltages ignored

verificationPatterns.pattern: User-job BID voltages match calibrated absolute values in DB
verificationPatterns.example: Print job 100 copies YMCKOV, capture BID voltages, compare to absolute calculated BID values saved in DB from this calibration run

verificationPatterns.pattern: Revolver rotation response to tube-empty event during print
verificationPatterns.example: verifying that revolvers are reacting and rotating during print

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-triggered rotation check
verificationPatterns.example: With tube empty, verify revolvers are rotating during Get Ready process

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert no rotation occurs during MechInit when saved params present
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that when revolver saved parameters are exist, revolver is not rotating during mechinit

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event generated on invalid hardware state during state transition
verificationPatterns.example: Since the tube is not in place, 'INK_TUBE_NOT_IN_PLACE' event should be generated

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event generated on failed sensor confirmation during mech init
verificationPatterns.example: revolver rotation will not be indicated by revolver home sensor and will generate 'INK_RDU_REVOLVER_ROTATION_FAILURE'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify piston is up
verificationPatterns.example: VerifyPistonUp

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify revolver rotation occurs
verificationPatterns.example: VerifyRevolverRotation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify revolver is de-energized
verificationPatterns.example: VerifyRvlrDeenergized

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify revolver position is saved in PEX after MechInit
verificationPatterns.example: VerifyRevolverPositionSavedInPEX

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify piston is up before revolver rotation begins
verificationPatterns.example: VerifyPistonUpBeforeRvlrRotate

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify revolver rotation is synchronized
verificationPatterns.example: VerifyRvlrRotationSynchronization

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mutual exclusion of concurrent revolver rotations
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that neighbor revolvers of rotating revolver not rotating in the same time — check AtRotation status signal on adjacent stations

verificationPatterns.pattern: OFF state precondition verification
verificationPatterns.example: Extractor is Up (Ext_Piston_Up.Value), Ink Tube is not in place (Tube.In.Place.Sens.Value), Ink Tube replaced=true (TubeReplaced), In-position sensor OFF (Rvlvr_Home.Sns>Value)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Revolver rotation confirmed on standby entry
verificationPatterns.example: Expected: Revolver Rotate — AxesList.gStationAxes[index].arrRevolverDC[index].Out.Status.Moving_Positive

verificationPatterns.pattern: Rotation failure event generated when inpos remains OFF during activation
verificationPatterns.example: Expected: Generate Event: INK_RDU_REVOLVER_ROTATION_FAILURE; Press Falling to OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: State fall-back to OFF after rotation failure
verificationPatterns.example: After INK_RDU_REVOLVER_ROTATION_FAILURE event, press falls to OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat rotation + failure on subsequent standby attempt with inpos OFF
verificationPatterns.example: Step 8 Expected: Rotate revolver (Moving_Positive) AND Generate Event: INK_RDU_REVOLVER_ROTATION_FAILURE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Unload tube sequence starts without tube replacement sequence when TubeReplaced=false
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that UnLoad Tube started without tube replacement sequence — gInterface.Station[1].Comp.arrBid[1].Ink.Rdu.Ctrl.Out.Exported.Statuses.AtUnLoadTube

verificationPatterns.pattern: Extractor reaches upper sensor during tube unload
verificationPatterns.example: Extractor reaching upper sensor — OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[index].HW_Inputs.INK[index].Rdu.Ext_Piston_Up_Sens.Value

verificationPatterns.pattern: RDU pump disengages during tube swap sequence
verificationPatterns.example: RDU Pump Disengage — gIos.Station[1].INK[1].Rdu.Engage.Output.RduDisengage.Value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press does NOT fault to OFF with INK_TUBE_NOT_IN_PLACE when tube empty but not replaced
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that after print finished, press did not fall to OFF with event: "INK_TUBE_NOT_IN_PLACE"

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press faults to OFF with INK_PREPARATION_FAILED_TUBE_EMPTY after 2-minute timeout when replaced but tube not in place
verificationPatterns.example: Verify after 2 minutes event: INK_PREPARATION_FAILED_TUBE_EMPTY and press fall to OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Revolver rotates to load new tube position
verificationPatterns.example: Revolver Rotation — AxesList.gStationAxes[index].arrRevolverDC[index].Out.Status.Moving_Positive

verificationPatterns.pattern: RDU pump re-engages after successful tube load (tube in place + replaced)
verificationPatterns.example: RDU Pump engage — gIos.Station[1].INK[1].Rdu.Engage.Output.RduDisengage.Value

verificationPatterns.pattern: 2-minute timeout fires fault event and press falls to OFF
verificationPatterns.example: After 2 minutes event: INK_PREPARATION_FAILED_TUBE_EMPTY and press fall to OFF / INK_TUBE_IS_NOT_IN_PLACE and press fall to OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: RDU pump disengages during tube-empty or not-in-place condition
verificationPatterns.example: RDU Pump Disengage — gIos.Station[1].INK[1].Rdu.Engage.Output.RduDisengage.Value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Extractor piston reaches upper sensor
verificationPatterns.example: Extractor reaching upper sensor — OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[index].HW_Inputs.INK[index].Rdu.Ext_Piston_Up_Sens.Value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Revolver rotation asserted when tube replace triggers standby flow
verificationPatterns.example: Revolver Rotation — AxesList.gStationAxes[index].arrRevolverDC[index].Out.Status.Moving_Positive

verificationPatterns.pattern: Composite tube-state check: TubeInPlace + TubeEmpty + TubeReplaced flags consistent with simulated inputs
verificationPatterns.example: Tube In Place: gInterface.Station[1].Comp.arrBid[1].Ink.Rdu.Ctrl.Out.Status.TubeInPlace / Tube Empty: gInterface.Station[index].Comp.ArrBid[index].Ink.Rdu.Ctrl.Out.Status.TubeEmpty / Tube Replaced: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStations[index].ImportedData.Ink[index].Rdu.Main.TubeReplaced

verificationPatterns.pattern: AtLoadTube status asserted when tube-empty replace flow reaches load position
verificationPatterns.example: Load Tube — gInterface.Station[1].Comp.arrBid[1].Ink.Rdu.Ctrl.Out.Exported.Statuses.AtLoadTube

verificationPatterns.pattern: MechInit completion — confirm revolver reached Standby status
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[1].Comp.arrBid[1].Ink.Rdu.Comp.Revolver.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtStdBy (expected true after Off→Standby transition)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Revolver rotation triggered — confirm axis moving in positive direction when rotation is required
verificationPatterns.example: AxesList.gStationAxes[index].arrRevolverDC[index].Out.Status.Moving_Positive (expected true when tube not in place and TubeReplaced=true)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Saved side params preserved when revolver is in home position
verificationPatterns.example: ginterface.Station[index].Comp.arrBid[index].Ink.Rdu.Comp.Revolver.Ctrl.In.Par.Save.WorkSideA = true, WorkSideB = false when Rvlvr_Home.Sns.Value = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Saved side params cleared (both false) when revolver is NOT in home position
verificationPatterns.example: ginterface.Station[index].Comp.arrBid[index].Ink.Rdu.Comp.Revolver.Ctrl.In.Par.Save.WorkSideA = false, WorkSideB = false when Rvlvr_Home.Sns.Value = false

verificationPatterns.pattern: PEX saved-data navigation to cross-check persisted revolver side values
verificationPatterns.example: In PEX: PlcSavedDataPrivateEntity >> MEStation[index].SavedData >> Ink >> {} >> RDU >> Revolver >> WorkSideA/WorkSideB

verificationPatterns.pattern: Monitor revolver rotation status signal during Off→Standby to detect unwanted or expected rotation
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[index].Comp.arrBid[index].Ink.Rdu.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtRvlvrRotation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error state verification per component
verificationPatterns.example: Change each component to error state; check ICON status, Label Status, label clickable or not

verificationPatterns.pattern: Warning state verification for applicable components
verificationPatterns.example: Change components that support warning state to warning; check ICON status, Label Status, label clickable or not

verificationPatterns.pattern: Idle state restore and verify
verificationPatterns.example: Return all components to idle state and check ICON status, Label Status, label clickable or not

verificationPatterns.pattern: Revolver motor rotates CCW confirmed via ActPosition and Moving_Positive flag
verificationPatterns.example: AxesList.gStationAxes[index].arrRevolver[index].Crtl.Basic_axis.Output.monitor.ActPosition shows movement; AxesList.gStationAxes[index].arrRevolverDC[index].Out.Status.Moving_Positive = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Home sensor detects revolver within 5-second window; MOTOR_HOMING_FAILED error event generated on timeout
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[1].Comp.arrBid[1].Ink.Rdu.Comp.Revolver.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.HomeSensor asserted within 5s; if not, error event MOTOR_HOMING_FAILED is generated

verificationPatterns.pattern: Motor de-energized 0.5s after reaching InPosition
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[1].Comp.arrBid[1].Ink.Rdu.Comp.Revolver.Ctrl.Out.Status.MotorDeEnergized = true after 0.5s hold at InPosition

verificationPatterns.pattern: WorkSideA flagged true in both OPC-UA status and PEX PlcSavedDataPrivateEntity after successful calibration
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[1].Comp.arrBid[1].Ink.Rdu.Comp.Revolver.Ctrl.Out.Status.RevPosA = true; PEX: PlcSavedDataPrivateEntity >> MEStation[x].SavedData >> Ink >> { } >> RDU >> Revolver >> WorkSideA = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tube unload and extractor-up status verified via exported status signals
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[1].Comp.arrBid[1].Ink.Rdu.Ctrl.Out.Exported.Statuses.AtUnLoadTube and gInterface.Station[1].Comp.arrBid[1].Ink.Rdu.Comp.Extractor.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtUpPos

verificationPatterns.pattern: Revolver AtRotation and RevPosA/B status flags monitored during and after rotation
verificationPatterns.example: ginterface.Station[1].Comp.arrBid[1].Ink.Rdu.Comp.Revolver.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtRotation; RevPosA and RevPosB

verificationPatterns.pattern: All-idle baseline: after known-good IO state, all subsystem icons and labels = idle
