verificationPatterns.pattern: UI label text verification: confirm each panel button/label string matches specification exactly
verificationPatterns.example: rioText = "RIO"; ChargeDirectorText = "Charge Director"; wasteBottleText = "Waste"; filtersText = "Filters"

verificationPatterns.pattern: Single-IO fault injection: set one signal to fault value, verify icon+label = error and label is clickable
verificationPatterns.example: FilterPumpPressure.SimValue = 3000 → Filter icon and label = error, label status is clickable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Absence-of-presence error: set in-place signal to 0, verify icon shows not-in-place error and label is clickable
verificationPatterns.example: Waste.BottleInPlace.SimValue = 0 → icon and label = error (icon is not in place), label status is clickable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Full-state error: set full-indicator signal to 1, verify icon shows full-state error and label is clickable
verificationPatterns.example: Waste.BottleFull.SimValue = 1 → icon and label = error (icon is waste full), label status is clickable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-signal full-error: both high and low signals = 0, verify icon+label = error and label is clickable
verificationPatterns.example: ChDirTank.HW_Inputs.BottleHigh.SimValue = 0 AND BottleLow.SimValue = 0 → Charge Director icon and label = error

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cancel all IO overrides and verify full return to idle across all subsystems
verificationPatterns.example: After cancel: Rio = idle, Charge Director = idle, Waste = idle, Filter = idle

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-signal warning: high = 0, low = 1 (partial fill), verify icon+label = warning and label is clickable
verificationPatterns.example: ChDirTank.HW_Inputs.BottleHigh.SimValue = 0 AND BottleLow.SimValue = 1 → Charge Director icon and label = warning

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-signal malfunction: high = 1, low = 0 (inverted/impossible state), verify icon+label = error with malfunction status and label is clickable
verificationPatterns.example: ChDirTank.HW_Inputs.BottleHigh.SimValue = 1 AND BottleLow.SimValue = 0 → icon and label = error (status is malfunction)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter-to-requirement alignment check

verificationPatterns.pattern: Correct fault event raised with expected event code

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press drops to safe state on motor fault

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault injection uses active-low (0) for presence sensors and active-high (1) for level/warning sensors

verificationPatterns.pattern: STIR reaches AtStandBy without entering clean state when end-print issued before pre-clean

verificationPatterns.pattern: STIR receives end-clean command and reaches AtStandBy when end-print issued during pre-clean

verificationPatterns.pattern: STIR engages, blanket rotates for StirCleanColdBlanketRotations, then reaches AtStandBy when end-print issued during clean

verificationPatterns.pattern: Named error event appears after threshold violation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event contains actual and expected (threshold) values

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press performs safety state drop after error

verificationPatterns.pattern: Hardware sensor disconnection triggers communication failure event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Compare tension properties per substrate type/material
verificationPatterns.example: Compare tension properties per substrate type material

verificationPatterns.pattern: DB entity value check — verify PEX entity reflects expected per-substrate values
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in PEX::SubstrateEntity the tensions are correct

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC propagation check — verify each OPC-UA signal receives the value written to the PEX entity
verificationPatterns.example: Verify tensions moved to PLC web component: UW: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.WEB.ImportedData.Ctrl.UnwinderTension.Value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tank level bypass verification
verificationPatterns.example: checking LPH Tank level bypass

verificationPatterns.pattern: Level event assertion (LOW/INVALID)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tank temp bypass verification
verificationPatterns.example: The test verifies LPH Tank Temp bypass

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic event verification
verificationPatterns.example: The test verifies ... Panic ... events

verificationPatterns.pattern: Invalid event verification
verificationPatterns.example: The test verifies ... Invalid events

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify power supply and bypass status
verificationPatterns.example: Verify LPH power supplies and bypasses

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert monitors not started during mechinit under fault precondition
verificationPatterns.example: LPH cooling monitors (expect level monitor) not started at mechinit while tank level is low

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert failure event fires during mechinit when precondition is violated

verificationPatterns.pattern: No event issued when monitored value below Min while bypass active
verificationPatterns.example: Set LPH cooling value below Min and verify event not issued

verificationPatterns.pattern: No event issued when monitored value above Max while bypass active
verificationPatterns.example: Set LPH cooling value above Max and verify event not issued

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition on emergency stop
verificationPatterns.example: LPH Cooling subsystem changes its state to POWER_DISABLE when emergency stop button is pressed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timed stop of all monitors and components
verificationPatterns.example: All monitors and components stop within 3 seconds when the emergency stop button is pressed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass active + value pushed above ValidHigh threshold → state unchanged
verificationPatterns.example: Bypass 'LPH main line pressure monitoring', change Main Line pressure to above LPHMainLinePressureValidHigh, verify LPH Cooling remains in Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass active + value pushed below ValidLow/PanicLow threshold → state unchanged
verificationPatterns.example: Bypass 'LPH main line pressure monitoring', change Main Line pressure to below LPHMainLinePressureValidLow, verify LPH Cooling remains in Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Each distinct monitoring bypass tested independently from Standby
verificationPatterns.example: Steps repeat Reach Standby → activate bypass → violate bounds for: main line pressure, tank level, tank temperature

verificationPatterns.pattern: All subsystem monitors and controls report inactive when a blocking fault is present at mechinit start
verificationPatterns.example: Tank level monitor OFF, Heating control OFF, Pump OFF, Pressure Monitor OFF when tank level below panic (3.9)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic-level fault during mechinit produces a named error event with actual and expected values
verificationPatterns.example: Error event 'LEVEL_PANIC_LOW' with actual/expected values issued when LPH_Tank_Level_Sens.Value = 3.9

verificationPatterns.pattern: Correctable fault activates relevant monitor and control during mechinit, with heater output observable via HW_Outputs signal
verificationPatterns.example: Tank level monitoring ON, Heating control ON, Tank heater turned ON when LPH_Tank_Temperature_Sens.Value = 23.9

verificationPatterns.pattern: Heating timeout during mechinit causes LPH to fall back to OFF state and emit a timeout error after a defined timeout (ms)
verificationPatterns.example: LPH falls to OFF after LPHTankTempMITimeoutMs (60000ms); error '_LPH_COOLING_TANK_TEMP_HEATING_TIMED_OUT_' issued

verificationPatterns.pattern: Successful mechinit with no faults activates all monitors and pump, and transitions LPH Cooling to Standby
verificationPatterns.example: Tank level monitor ON, Heating control ON, Pump ON, Pressure monitor ON; LPH Cooling reaches Standby state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Activate bypass → verify enable signal drops to 0
verificationPatterns.example: Bypass LPH power supply → verify OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.LPHCooling.HW_Outputs.LPH_1_Enable_Voltage.Value == 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Remove bypass → verify enable signal returns to 1
verificationPatterns.example: Remove LPH power supply bypass → verify OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.LPHCooling.HW_Outputs.LPH_1_Enable_Voltage.Value == 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timed sequence verification — assert all shutdown actions complete within a deadline
verificationPatterns.example: Issue EMStop command and verify the following actions happened within 2.8 seconds: Turn off LPH power supplies, Close heater control, Close water pump, Temperature control turned off, All monitors turned off, LPH cooling changed to power off state (last)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ordering constraint — assert a specific action is last in a shutdown sequence
verificationPatterns.example: LPH cooling changed to power off state (Should be last)

verificationPatterns.pattern: State persistence under competing command — verify subsystem state is unaffected by an unrelated command issued while locked
verificationPatterns.example: Perform MechInit while in EmergencyStop and verify the LPH cooling remains in Power Disabled state

verificationPatterns.pattern: State recovery on fault release — verify subsystem transitions to correct nominal state after E-Stop is cleared
verificationPatterns.example: Release Emergency stop and verify the LPH cooling returns to OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event raised on threshold breach
verificationPatterns.example: Verify an event raised - TEMP_PANIC_LOW

verificationPatterns.pattern: Heater and pump OFF on fault
verificationPatterns.example: Verify LPH heater/pump is OFF.

verificationPatterns.pattern: LPH/press state transitions to OFF on fault
verificationPatterns.example: Verify LPH/press state is OFF.

verificationPatterns.pattern: No error and actuators ON on boundary-inclusive (non-breaching) value
verificationPatterns.example: Verify no error event raised. Verify LPH heater/pump is ON.

verificationPatterns.pattern: State regression to Standby on exact panic-low boundary with MechInit
verificationPatterns.example: Verify LPH reach Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary value test: exclusive breach (e.g. 19.9 triggers fault, 20.0 does not)
verificationPatterns.example: LPHTankTempPanicLow (19.9°) triggers TEMP_PANIC_LOW; exactly 20° raises no error

verificationPatterns.pattern: At-setpoint boundary: valve command and feedback equal nominal minimum, flow is zero
verificationPatterns.example: Tank temp = LPHTankTempSetPoint (29.7°) → CWS valve command = 23°, feedback = 23°, flow required = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Just-above-setpoint: valve command and feedback exceed nominal minimum, flow becomes positive
verificationPatterns.example: Tank temp = LPHTankTempSetPoint (30.3°) → CWS valve command > 23°, feedback > 23°, flow required > 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Monotonic increase: incrementing temperature produces strictly increasing valve command, feedback, and flow
verificationPatterns.example: Tank temp stepped 30.4°→30.5°→30.6°→30.7°→30.8° → each of valve command, feedback, flow required increases with each step

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic-high saturation: valve command and feedback clamp to maximum, flow clamps to defined max
verificationPatterns.example: Tank temp = 50° (PanicHigh) → CWS valve command = 65.45, feedback = 65.45, flow required = 3000 (Max)

verificationPatterns.pattern: For each subsystem, verify LOCAL parameters match expected name/unit/value table
verificationPatterns.example: Local mainline pressure: LPHMainLinePressureMonitorErrorDelay=10 Sec, LPHMainLinePressureAvgWindow=20 NoOfSamples

verificationPatterns.pattern: For each subsystem, verify IMPORTED parameters match expected name/unit/value table
verificationPatterns.example: Imported mainline pressure: LPHMainLinePressureMonStartDelay=5 Sec, LPHMainLinePressureHigh=1600 mBar, LPHMainLinePressureLow=800 mBar

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat local+imported parameter table verification per logical subsystem group (pressure, temperature, level)
verificationPatterns.example: Step 1=mainline pressure, Step 2=tank temperature, Step 3=tank level — each step owns its own local+imported table

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pressure threshold event raised with current/expected values
verificationPatterns.example: Verify event raised _PRESSURE_HIGH_ with current/expected values.

verificationPatterns.pattern: State regression to Standby on pressure fault
verificationPatterns.example: Verify LPH reached the Standby state.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump remains active during pressure fault
verificationPatterns.example: Verify LPH pump active.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Monitor subsystem active after fault
verificationPatterns.example: Verify LinePressureMonitor is active.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press falls to OFF with specific error event on sensor disconnect
verificationPatterns.example: The press fall to 'OFF' state with error event 'LPH_COOLING_MAINLINE_PRESSURE_SENSOR_DISCONNECTED'.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pressure monitoring starts only after configured delay post-MechInit
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the LPH Pressure monitoring starts after 'LPHMainLinePressureMonitorStartDelay' (5 sec).

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event raised with actual/expected values
verificationPatterns.example: Verify error event "LPH_COOLING_TANK_LEVEL_INVALID" raised with actual/expected values

verificationPatterns.pattern: HW output actuator de-energized (value = 0) on fault
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.LPHCooling.HW_Outputs.LPH_Pump.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: State machine falls to OFF on fault
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|gInterface.LphCooling.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOFF = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: OPCUA status signal assertion per state
verificationPatterns.example: After each state command, read gInterface.LphCooling.Ctrl.Out.Status.* and assert expected bool values (e.g. AtOFF=true in OFF, AtOFF=false in cold-start)

verificationPatterns.pattern: All-monitors-active bulk check
verificationPatterns.example: Assert all seven LPH_Cooling_*_Monitor_Active signals = true whenever system is at Standby or above (Steps 2, 3, 4, 6)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor simulation override for boundary testing
verificationPatterns.example: Override OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.LPHCooling.HW_Inputs.LPH_Tank_Temperature_Sens.Simulation.Value to 23.9° (below LPHTankTempOperatingLow) to force cold-start path

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout/fallback verification
verificationPatterns.example: With tank temp below setpoint and no removal of override, wait 60 s and verify PLC falls back to OFF state automatically

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mutually exclusive control-mode toggle (CoolingCtrl vs HeatCtrl)
verificationPatterns.example: In Print: CoolingCtrlActive=TRUE and HeatCtrlActive=FALSE; in Ready after print: CoolingCtrlActive=FALSE and HeatCtrlActive=TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Conditional heater-state check against temperature threshold
verificationPatterns.example: If tank temperature < 30°C verify HeaterOn=true; if ≥ 30°C verify HeaterOn=false (checked in GetReady/Ready and Standby steps)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mechinit (GoToStandby) as state-reset action
verificationPatterns.example: After removing sensor override (Step 3), perform Mechinit and verify system reaches Standby with PumpOn=true and all monitors active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Conditional actuator gate — component active only when inhibit condition absent
verificationPatterns.example: verify pump works only when bottle isn't full

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout assertion during active process state
verificationPatterns.example: verify Normal level timeout during print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify pump is inhibited when waste bottle full condition is active
verificationPatterns.example: /// Verify pump doesn't work if bottle is full

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-condition gate check: pump enabled only when both bottle and barrel are below full threshold
verificationPatterns.example: Verify pump works only when bottle isn't full when barrel isn't full

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify event emission after timeout condition
verificationPatterns.example: Verify event is sent after Empty level timeout for UC and PE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump activation on CT up
verificationPatterns.example: Verify pump starts working when CT is up

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump sustain during drain time
verificationPatterns.example: Verify pump continues working during drain time

verificationPatterns.pattern: Actuator activates when preconditions met
verificationPatterns.example: Waste pump starts to work

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error raised on invalid signal value; press state unchanged
verificationPatterns.example: Error will be raised 'PRESSURE_INVALID'. Press state-no change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error raised on panic-threshold breach; press state unchanged
verificationPatterns.example: Error will be raised 'PRESSURE_Panic_High/Low'. Press state-no change

verificationPatterns.pattern: First-raised CT wins valve direction
verificationPatterns.example: UC CT raised first → Valve 3/2 opens to UC direction; PE CT raised first → Valve 3/2 opens to PE direction

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump does not interrupt when second CT rises while first is active
verificationPatterns.example: Valve does not change direction; waste pump continues to work

verificationPatterns.pattern: Valve switches to surviving CT when first CT drops
verificationPatterns.example: UC low CT = Down (0) after PE was also Up → Valve changes direction to PE; pump continues to work

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump is inhibited while BottleFull = 1, regardless of CT state
verificationPatterns.example: Set bottle = full, Set UC low CT Up → Waste pump doesn't start; Set UC high CT Up → Waste pump doesn't start

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump starts only after BottleFull clears even if CT was already raised
verificationPatterns.example: Set bottle not full → Waste pump starts to work; Valve 3/2 opens to UC direction

verificationPatterns.pattern: Drain failure event fires and valve switches after UcWasteNormalLevelTimeout with level still at normal
verificationPatterns.example: Wait for UcWasteNormalLevelTimeout → Pump stops; event UC_Waste_Drain_Failure appears; Valve changes direction to PE; pump continues during PeWasteAddDrain time

verificationPatterns.pattern: Symmetric test: repeat scenario swapping UC and PE roles
verificationPatterns.example: Step 4: Repeat step 3 but start from PE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Output activates on CT rising edge during Off→SB transition
verificationPatterns.example: Waste pump starts work after UC_CT_Low goes Up and state changes to SB

verificationPatterns.pattern: Output sustains for configured drain time after CT falling edge
verificationPatterns.example: Waste pump continues to work during UcWasteAddDrain / PeWasteAddDrain time after CT_Low goes to Down

verificationPatterns.pattern: Same behavioral contract verified per-subsystem (UC then PE) with subsystem-specific CT signal and drain timer
verificationPatterns.example: Step 1 uses UC_CT_Low + UcWasteAddDrain; Step 2 uses PE_CT_Low + PeWasteAddDrain; same pump output observed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump inhibited until all enable conditions met

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump starts when CT sensor goes Up with bottle full and barrel full
verificationPatterns.example: 2. Waste pump starts to work [after UC low CT set to Up(1)]

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump stops when bottle transitions not-full then returns to full
verificationPatterns.example: Set bottle = not full → pump stops; set bottle = full → pump stops to work

verificationPatterns.pattern: CT sensor permutation: repeat base scenario substituting PE_CT_Low Up for UC_CT_Low Up
verificationPatterns.example: Step 2: Repeat 1 but Set PE low CT to UP (1), UC low CT to Down (0) — Same as 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bottle state permutation: substitute 'not in place' for 'full' across all CT variants
verificationPatterns.example: Step 3: Repeat 1 and 2 but set bottle = not in place instead bottle = full — Same as 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Barrel state permutation: set barrel = not full with bottle in valid states
verificationPatterns.example: Step 4: barrel=not full, bottle=full, bottle=in place — Same as 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Combined negative state: barrel not full + bottle not full + bottle not in place
verificationPatterns.example: Step 5: Repeat 4 but barrel=not full, bottle=not full, bottle=not in place — Same as 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: No-destination pump inhibit + timeout error: pump stays off when both destinations (bottle, barrel) are full; after UcWasteFullNoDestTimeout fires error IMO_UC_WASTE_NO_DESTINATION
verificationPatterns.example: Waste pump doesn't start. After WasteFullNoDestTimeout appears error: IMO_UC_WASTE_NO_DESTINATION

verificationPatterns.pattern: Low-CT-only inhibit: pump does not start when only the low CT sensor is Up; pump starts only after high CT also transitions Up
verificationPatterns.example: 1.Waste pump doesn't start. 2.Waste pump doesn't start. 3.Waste pump starts to work.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump-start on available destination: after bottle (or barrel) transitions to not-full while high CT is active, pump starts immediately
verificationPatterns.example: 3.Set bottle not full → 3. Waste pump starts to work.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Add-drain continuation: after high CT clears (Down) and low CT clears, pump continues running for the full UcWasteAddDrain / PeWasteAddDrain duration before stopping
verificationPatterns.example: 5.Waste pump continue to work during UcWasteAddDrain time.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Normal-level timeout failure: if pump runs but level does not reach normal within UcWasteNormalLevelTimeout, pump stops and drain-failure event is raised
verificationPatterns.example: 4. Waste pump stop and appear event: UC_Waste_Drain_Failure - level is still normal after UcWasteNormalLevelTimeout

verificationPatterns.pattern: UC/PE symmetry: all UC-sensor scenarios repeat identically with PE sensors; only sensor signals and timeout/drain parameters differ
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat 3 Use PE low and high CT instead UC … 1-4 Same. 5. Waste pump continue to work during PeWasteAddDrain time.

verificationPatterns.pattern: State reversion on failure: drain failure in GR state reverts to SB; drain failure in Print state reverts to Ready
verificationPatterns.example: After Failure State change from GR to SB, From Print to Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump-start on low-CT trigger
verificationPatterns.example: Waste pump starts work after UC/PE low CT is set to Up (1)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump-stop + failure event after timeout expiry
verificationPatterns.example: Waste pump stops and event UC_Waste_Drain_Failure / Pe_Waste_Drain_Failure appears: 'level is still normal after UcWasteEmptyLevelTimeout / PeWasteEmptyLevelTimeout'

verificationPatterns.pattern: GR button disabled in SB after drain-failure event
verificationPatterns.example: Press in SB, GR button is disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state rollback on drain-failure during active run
verificationPatterns.example: For GR: press stops GR and returns to SB, GR button disabled. For Print: press stops Print and returns to Ready, Print button disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cross-fluid-type repeatability (UC → PE → GR → Print)
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat test 1 and 2 for GR, and Print — same results expected

verificationPatterns.pattern: CT-low rising edge triggers valve direction
verificationPatterns.example: Set PE low CT to Up (1) → Valve 3/2 open to PE direction; Set UC low CT to Up (1) → Valve 3/2 open to UC direction (default)

verificationPatterns.pattern: CT-low falling edge (pulse complete) starts waste pump
verificationPatterns.example: Set PE low CT to Down (0) → Waste pump starts work; Set UC low CT to Down (0) → Waste pump starts work

verificationPatterns.pattern: Waste pump runs for subsystem-specific drain time after pulse
verificationPatterns.example: Waste pump continues to work during PeWasteAddDrain time (PE path) / UcWasteAddDrain time (UC path)

verificationPatterns.pattern: System status polled via gInterface after each stimulus
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.ImoSystem.Ctrl.Out.Status checked alongside HW output signals after CT transition

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert availability reason equals specific enum value
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[i].ElementsActivation.BID[j].BidHV.HvActivation.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0] = ZONE_DISABLED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert availability reason does NOT equal specific enum value (condition cleared)
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[i].ElementsActivation.BID[j].BidHV.HvActivation.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0] != ZONE_DISABLED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal equals specific enum value after deactivation
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[i].ElementsActivation.BID[j].BidHV.HvActivation.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0] = COMPONENT_INACTIVE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal no longer equals enum value after reactivation
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[i].ElementsActivation.BID[j].BidHV.HvActivation.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0] != COMPONENT_INACTIVE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert availability reason equals specific fault enum when device physically removed
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[i].ElementsActivation.BID[j].BidHV.HvActivation.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0] = DEVICE_NOT_IN_PLACE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert availability reason no longer equals fault enum after device reinserted
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[i].ElementsActivation.BID[j].BidHV.HvActivation.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0] != DEVICE_NOT_IN_PLACE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Disengage component → availability reason reflects blocking condition

verificationPatterns.pattern: Engage component → availability reason clears to AVAILABLE
verificationPatterns.example: Engage BID → AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0] = AVAILABLE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stopping BID rotation sets reason to INK_NOT_DELIVERED_TO_BID
verificationPatterns.example: Stop the BID rotation → Reason[0] = INK_NOT_DELIVERED_TO_BID

verificationPatterns.pattern: BID rotation at process speed restores reason to AVAILABLE
verificationPatterns.example: BID rotation to process speed → Reason[0] = AVAILABLE

verificationPatterns.pattern: INK in StandBy state sets reason to INK_NOT_DELIVERED_TO_BID
verificationPatterns.example: Change INK state to StandBy → Reason[0] = INK_NOT_DELIVERED_TO_BID

verificationPatterns.pattern: INK transitioning to Print (via GetReady) restores reason to AVAILABLE
verificationPatterns.example: Change INK state to Print (GetReady -> Print) → Reason[0] = AVAILABLE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0] equals named enum value while feature is active
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[i].ElementsActivation.BID[j].BidHV.HvActivation.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0] = BID_HV_ON

verificationPatterns.pattern: Confirming close restores previous valid state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Backup relocation on calibration start
verificationPatterns.example: Verify old save parameters is moving in: s:\ILS_saved_images\Scanner_Calibration_Files_Backup

verificationPatterns.pattern: Progressive per-iteration save to working folder
verificationPatterns.example: Verify during calibration new results appears after each calibration state in folder s:\Press\bin\iVision\Saved

verificationPatterns.pattern: Partial results persist after mid-run stop
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the results for four iterations continue to be in: s:\Press\bin\iVision\Saved

verificationPatterns.pattern: Backup folder unchanged on re-run
verificationPatterns.example: Old Saved data continue to be in: s:\ILS_saved_images\Scanner_Calibration_Files_Backup Verify calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Rollback to pre-calibration state on Cancel+OK
verificationPatterns.example: Rollback should be done, and previous results will be recovered. Verify correct files in s:\Press\bin\iVision\Saved

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault mid-run produces same backup/persist behavior as clean stop
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat steps 1-3 but cause to fault in step 2. Same results.

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI control enabled before action
verificationPatterns.example: Verify 'Play' button is enabled before starting calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Special job sheet sequence during operation
verificationPatterns.example: Press prints 6-sheet job: Offset, 300dpi led, 200dpi led, 600dpi led, 600dpi uniformity, alignment calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-step parameter verification during execution
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Speed at each calibration step

verificationPatterns.pattern: All-or-nothing success gate
verificationPatterns.example: Successful calibration achieved only when all calibrations succeeded

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI control enabled after completion
verificationPatterns.example: Verify 'OK' button is enabled after all calibrations complete

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dialog dismissal verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify window closes after clicking OK

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-sink result persistence
verificationPatterns.example: Results saved to s:\Press\bin\iVision\Saved and to PEX according to installed substrate

verificationPatterns.pattern: Precondition signal state check — assert each subsystem is at expected baseline state before operation
verificationPatterns.example: OCB.gInterface.Station.Station[1-6 !=i].Comp.AsiD.Out.Status.AtOFF = TRUE; OCB.gInterface.Station.Station[i].Comp.Chrg.CrEng.Out.Status.AtDisEngage = TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability check — assert Reason[0] = 0 (AVAILABLE) before calling operation
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[i].ElementsActivation.ASID.fbInchingRotation.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0] = 0 (AVAILABLE)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation-in-progress check — assert DoneFlag = TRUE, status transitions, and COMPONENT_BUSY reason while running
verificationPatterns.example: OCB.gInterface.Station.Station[i].Comp.AsiD.Element.InchingRotationDone = TRUE; Reason[0] = 12 (COMPONENT_BUSY); Out.Status.Rotated = TRUE; Out.Monitor.AxisActSpeed = 2402558

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-deactivation state check — assert DoneFlag = TRUE, motion signals cleared, availability restored to 0
verificationPatterns.example: Element.DeactiveDone = TRUE; Out.Status.Rotated = FALSE; Out.Status.AtProcessSpeed = FALSE; Out.Monitor.AxisActSpeed = 0; Reason[0] = 0 (AVAILABLE)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error simulation and recovery — inject SimMotionError, re-run preparations, verify system recovers to AVAILABLE with cleared motion signals
verificationPatterns.example: Set OCB.gInterface.Station[i].Comp.AsiD.In.Par.Local.SimMotionError = TRUE; ReRun preparations; verify DeactiveDone = TRUE, Rotated = FALSE, AxisActSpeed = 0, Reason[0] = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blocking-dependency reason code pair — engage dependent subsystem → assert Reason[0] = 23 (MOTOR_NOT_FREE_TO_ROTATE); disengage → assert Reason[0] = 0 (AVAILABLE)
verificationPatterns.example: Engage BID → Reason[0] = 23; DisEngage BID → Reason[0] = 0. Same pattern repeated for CR, CS, BR[i], T1 (blanket GoToOff/StandBy)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service-state reason code — change station to Maintenance or Sequence-service → assert Reason[0] = 63 (SERVICE_REQUIRED); restore Service-EA → assert Reason[0] = 0 (AVAILABLE)
verificationPatterns.example: Change station to Maintenance (Zone 1) → Reason[0] = 63; change aSID to Sequence-service → Reason[0] = 63; return to Service-EA → Reason[0] = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine-state end check — perform Service-End operation, verify availability reason reflects loss of service mode
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[2].ElementsActivation.ASID.fbInchingRotation.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0] = 63 (SERVICE_REQUIRED)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pre-call availability check: Reason[0] = 0 (AVAILABLE)
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[i].ElementsActivation.ASID.fbProcessRotation.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0] = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation done flag set TRUE after call
verificationPatterns.example: OCB.gInterface.Station.Station[i].Comp.AsiD.Element.ProcessRotationDone = TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: COMPONENT_BUSY (12) reported while operation is running
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[i].ElementsActivation.ASID.fbProcessRotation.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0] = 12

verificationPatterns.pattern: Status flags TRUE after successful operation; FALSE after deactivation
verificationPatterns.example: OCB.gInterface.Station.Station[i].Comp.AsiD.Out.Status.Rotated = TRUE / FALSE; AtProcessSpeed = TRUE / FALSE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Motor speed monitor matches expected RPM after operation; returns to 0 after deactivation
verificationPatterns.example: OCB.gInterface.Station.Station[i].Comp.AsiD.Out.Monitor.AxisActSpeed = 10331000 (running) / 0 (deactivated)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error simulation via SimMotionError yields SERVICE_REQUIRED (63); restored to AVAILABLE (0) after re-running preparations
verificationPatterns.example: Set OCB.gInterface.Station[i].Comp.AsiD.In.Par.Local.SimMotionError = TRUE → Reason[0] = 63; ReRun prep → Reason[0] = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blocking sub-component (BID/CR/CS/BR/T1) engaged → MOTOR_NOT_FREE_TO_ROTATE (23); disengaged → AVAILABLE (0)
verificationPatterns.example: Engage BID → Reason[0] = 23; DisEngage BID → Reason[0] = 0 (same pattern repeated for CR, CS, BR, T1)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Concurrent aSID rotation operation → COMPONENT_BUSY (12); deactivate → AVAILABLE (0)
verificationPatterns.example: Start aSID[i] rotation → Reason[0] = 12; Deactivate → Reason[0] = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Station service-state change to Maintenance or Sequence-service yields SERVICE_REQUIRED (63); return to Service-EA restores AVAILABLE (0)
verificationPatterns.example: Change station to Maintenance (Zone 1) → Reason[0] = 63; return to Service-EA → Reason[0] = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine-state Service-End operation makes all ASID operations SERVICE_REQUIRED (63)
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[2].ElementsActivation.ASID.fbMechInit.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0] = 63

verificationPatterns.pattern: Confirm precondition signals before operating
verificationPatterns.example: OCB.gInterface.Station.Station[i].Comp.Chrg.CrEng.Out.Status.AtDisEngage = TRUE; OCB.gInterface.Station.Station[i].Comp.CS.Comps.Engage.Out.Status.AtDisEngage = TRUE; OCB.gInterface.Station.Station[1-6].Comp.arrBid.arrBid[1-2].Engage.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtDisEng = TRUE; OCB.gInterface.BKT.Comp.Tension.Ctrl.Out.Status.TenMonStat_AtTen = TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0] = 0 (AVAILABLE) before calling operation
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[i].ElementsActivation.ASID.fbMechInit.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0] = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify operation completion flag after calling MechInit
verificationPatterns.example: OCB.gInterface.Station.Station[i].Comp.AsiD.Element.MechInitDone = TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify operation completion flag after calling Deactive
verificationPatterns.example: OCB.gInterface.Station.Station[i].Comp.AsiD.Element.DeactiveDone = TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Engage a motor-driven component, verify MOTOR_NOT_FREE_TO_ROTATE reason, then disengage and verify AVAILABLE
verificationPatterns.example: Engage BID/CR/CS/BR → Reason[0] = 23 (MOTOR_NOT_FREE_TO_ROTATE); Disengage → Reason[0] = 0 (AVAILABLE)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Start a concurrent operation on aSID, verify COMPONENT_BUSY reason, then deactivate and verify AVAILABLE
verificationPatterns.example: Start rotate on ASID[i] → Reason[0] = 12 (COMPONENT_BUSY); Deactivate → Reason[0] = 0 (AVAILABLE)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Set Blanket to OFF state, verify MOTOR_NOT_FREE_TO_ROTATE reason, return to Standby/MechInit and verify AVAILABLE
verificationPatterns.example: Blanket GoToOff → Reason[0] = 23 (MOTOR_NOT_FREE_TO_ROTATE); Return to Standby/MechInit → Reason[0] = 0 (AVAILABLE)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Change station to Maintenance or Sequence-service state, verify SERVICE_REQUIRED reason, restore to Service-EA and verify AVAILABLE
verificationPatterns.example: Station → Maintenance (Zone 1) → Reason[0] = 63 (SERVICE_REQUIRED); ASID → Sequence-service → Reason[0] = 63 (SERVICE_REQUIRED); ASID → Service-EA → Reason[0] = 0 (AVAILABLE)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Execute Service-End operation and confirm availability is lost (SERVICE_REQUIRED remains)
verificationPatterns.example: After Service-End: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[2].ElementsActivation.ASID.fbMechInit.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0] = 63 (SERVICE_REQUIRED)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service activation signal asserted on element activation
verificationPatterns.example: OCB.gInterface.Station.Station[!i].Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.Asid.EA = TRUE after clicking Asid button in element activation box for station[i]

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service signal cleared and station returns to idle state on Service End
verificationPatterns.example: OCB.gInterface.Station.Station[!i].Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.Asid.EA = FALSE AND (AtOFF = TRUE OR AtStdBy = TRUE) after clicking Service End

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify tensioner values at each machine state
verificationPatterns.example: Check tensioner values in Mech-init, GR and print state

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-transition coverage: verify component values across multiple ordered states in a single test
verificationPatterns.example: Mech-init → GR → print state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify brake release outputs are True/False per state
verificationPatterns.example: OCB_saPLC.OCB.gIos.BKT.BktTen.Output.BrakeReleaseFront.Value = True / False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify tension sensor value is within window of target tension (lower bound: target - window, upper bound: target + window) for both Front and Rear sensors
verificationPatterns.example: TensionSensFront.Value > StandbyTension - Win_AtTension AND TensionSensFront.Value < StandbyTension + Win_AtTension

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify tension status flag matches current state (Standby, Process, Print, Off)
verificationPatterns.example: OCB_saPLC.OCB.gInterface.BKT.Comp.Tension.Out.Status.AtBldStandbyTen = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Use NS4|String| prefix for OPC UA sensor reads compared against PLC parameters
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.BKT.HW_Inputs.Tension.TensionSensFront.Value > OCB_saPLC.OCB.gInterface.BKT.Comp.Tension.In.Par.Local_V01.BuildTension.StandbyTension - OCB_saPLC.OCB.gInterface.BKT.Comp.Tension.In.Par.Local_V01.BuildTension.Win_AtTension

verificationPatterns.pattern: Test same GoToOFF command from two different source states (Standby and Print) in one step
verificationPatterns.example: 1. Be in Standby state, send GoToOFF command. 2. Be in Print state, send GoToOFF command.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Toolbar visibility gated by print state + pipeline membership
verificationPatterns.example: Non-print state: toolbar shown. Print state + job in pipeline: toolbar hidden. Print state + job not in pipeline: toolbar shown.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-select toolbar reflects worst-case control state
verificationPatterns.example: Multiple jobs selected in print state where some are in pipeline: toolbar visible but all controls disabled; quick edit disabled.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Job thumbnail shows first sheet only
verificationPatterns.example: Upload job with multiple sheets; verify thumbnail displays first sheet.

verificationPatterns.pattern: DFE-side change propagates to UI job metadata
verificationPatterns.example: Update copies on DFE; verify job copies count and estimated print time update accordingly in UI.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Job transfer integrity
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the job added to held/retained queue and removed from print queue

verificationPatterns.pattern: Thumbnail presence in queue entry
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in held/retained queue the job includes its thumbnail

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dynamic count badge in queue title
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the held/retained queue title includes the number of the jobs in the queue - "Held(X)"/"Retained(X)"

verificationPatterns.pattern: Filter by text field with sortable results
verificationPatterns.example: Verify filter by name/substrate option is working. Verify the results can be sorted.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Filter dismissal via clear or X button
verificationPatterns.example: Verify when deleting the filter string or clicking X - causing the filter to exit

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-parameter sort with persistence across SW restart
verificationPatterns.example: Sort by job name, substrate, length, copies, est. time, job availability; restart press SW and verify sorting criteria saved

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default collapsed state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify by default the held/retained queue is folded

verificationPatterns.pattern: Drawer button triggers full-open state
verificationPatterns.example: Click the drawer button. Verify the held/retained queue is fully opened.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Swipe gesture to narrow view
verificationPatterns.example: Swipe the drawer button to the right. Verify the held/retained queue is opened in narrow view.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Swipe gesture to mid view
verificationPatterns.example: Swipe to the drawer button to the most right. Verify the held/retained queue is opened in mid view.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pipeline frame visibility in Print state
verificationPatterns.example: In Print state verify frame exists showing which job is in pipeline (PrintProgressEntity or PrintQueueEntity in PEX)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dynamic queue count in title
verificationPatterns.example: After moving several jobs to print queue in DFE, verify title reads 'print queue(X)' where X equals number of queued jobs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ripped job appears in queue
verificationPatterns.example: Rip a job in DFE and verify it has been added to the print queue

verificationPatterns.pattern: PEX entity state correlation
verificationPatterns.example: Verify job printing status in PEX via PrintProgressEntity or PrintQueueEntity matches UI state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Check operation Available flag is False
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Check Reason[0].Reason matches expected fault code string
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].Reason = DEVICE_NOT_IN_PLACE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Check Reason[0].SubsystemID is populated correctly (TBD pending spec)
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].SubsystemID = TBD

verificationPatterns.pattern: Check Reason[0].SensorID is populated correctly (TBD pending spec)
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].SensorID = TBD

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-state steps: verify correct operation blocked per press state (GetReady when Standby, Print when Ready)
verificationPatterns.example: Standby: GetReady.AvailabilityStatus.Available = False / Ready: Print.AvailabilityStatus.Available = False, both with same Reason code

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert operation availability is False
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert first reason code matches expected fault enum
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].Reason = TANK_LEVEL_PANIC_LOW

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert SubsystemID and SensorID on Reason[0] identify the faulting component
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].SubsystemID = TBD

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability flag is False when fault condition is active
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Reason[0].Reason matches the expected fault reason code for the triggered condition
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.GetReady.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].Reason = TANK_LEVEL_PANIC_LOW

verificationPatterns.pattern: Reason[0].SubsystemID is populated with the correct subsystem identifier
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].SubsystemID = TBD

verificationPatterns.pattern: Reason[0].SensorID is populated with the correct sensor identifier
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].SensorID = TBD

verificationPatterns.pattern: When multiple IO signals can trigger the same operation block, verify the Reason code reflects which specific signal was changed (branch verification)
verificationPatterns.example: Print.Reason[0].Reason = RW_ROLL_ALMOST_FULL when RW IO changed; = UW_ROLL_ALMOST_EMPTY when UW IO changed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation unavailability reported as OPERATION_NOT_STARTED when attempting to stop an operation that was never initiated
verificationPatterns.example: SWF/ILP wash stop operation unavailable due to OPERATION_NOT_STARTED reason in Standby/Ready state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability blocked — check Available = False on the target operation
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Reason code matches expected string constant for the faulted sensor group
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].Reason = CVC_INLET_AIR_TEMP_INVALID

verificationPatterns.pattern: SubsystemID and SensorID present in Reason[0] (values TBD at time of writing)
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].SubsystemID = TBD

verificationPatterns.pattern: For panic-low conditions, block applies to GetReady operation instead of PowerEnable
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.GetReady.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].Reason = TANK_LEVEL_PANIC_LOW

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert operation becomes unavailable
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert specific reason code at Reason[0].Reason
verificationPatterns.example: Reason[0].Reason = WATER_TEMPERATURE_INVALID | WATER_TEMPERATURE_TOO_LOW | WATER_TEMPERATURE_TOO_HIGH

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert subsystem and sensor identity fields on the reason entry
verificationPatterns.example: Reason[0].SubsystemID = TBD, Reason[0].SensorID = TBD

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button enabled in permissive state
verificationPatterns.example: Be in Print/Pre print state → Verify end print button enabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button disabled with explanatory tooltip in non-permissive states
verificationPatterns.example: Be in Power disable/Off/Mechinit/Standby/Go to service/GR/Ready/Post Print/Go to Standby state → Verify end print button disabled with tooltip: "Print state is required"

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button enabled/disabled based on machine state group
verificationPatterns.example: Be in Power disable/Off/Standby/Go to service → Service button enabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Disabled button shows specific tooltip reason
verificationPatterns.example: Be in Mechinit/GR/Ready/Print/Pre Print/Post Print/Go to Standby → Service button disabled with tooltip: STANDBY_REQUIRED

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-to-operation mapping: blocked operation depends on current press state
verificationPatterns.example: OFF → PowerEnable; Standby → GetReady; Ready → Print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operation availability check: AvailabilityStatus.Available must equal False
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Available = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Reason code check: Reason[0].Reason must equal the expected fault enum string
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].Reason = BLANKET_UPPER_AK_PRESSURE_INVALID

verificationPatterns.pattern: SubsystemID and SensorID presence check: both fields must be populated in Reason[0]
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.PowerEnable.OperationData.AvailabilityStatus.Reason[0].SubsystemID = TBD

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold boundary injection: set SimValue strictly above ValidHigh OR strictly below ValidLow to trigger the invalid-sensor fault
verificationPatterns.example: Change AK_Upper_Blower_Pressure_Sens.SimValue to be above AirKnifePressureValidHigh or below AirKnifePressureValidLow

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-state coverage: same fault injected while cycling through OFF, Standby, Ready to confirm correct operation is blocked in each state
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 5 and 6 each verify PowerEnable (OFF), GetReady (Standby), and Print (Ready) for the same fault reason

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button disabled with explanatory tooltip in all non-prerequisite states
verificationPatterns.example: Verify GR button disabled with tooltip - 'off state is required'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button enabled when machine reaches required prerequisite state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify restart button enabled [when in Off state]

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button disabled with tooltip in non-Ready states
verificationPatterns.example: Verify GR button disabled with tooltip - "Ready state is required"

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button enabled in Ready state
verificationPatterns.example: Be in Ready state → Verify Print button enabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button enabled only in required prerequisite state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify GR button enabled (in Standby state)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button absent in non-operational states
verificationPatterns.example: In Power disable/Off/Mechinit/Standby/Go to Standby/Go to Service states: verify no Go to Standby button in UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button enabled in qualifying states
verificationPatterns.example: In GR/Ready states: verify Go to Standby button enabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button disabled with prerequisite tooltip in blocking states
verificationPatterns.example: In Pre Print/Print/Post Print states: verify Go to Standby button disabled with tooltip 'Ready is required'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button enabled in active states
verificationPatterns.example: Be in Mechinit/Standby/GR/Ready/PrePrint/Print/Go to Standby/Go to Service/Post Print → Verify go to off button enabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button disabled with specific tooltip in blocking state
verificationPatterns.example: Be in OFF/power disable state → Verify go to off button disabled with tooltip - STANDBY_REQUIRED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tooltip content assertion on disabled button
verificationPatterns.example: Disabled button tooltip text must equal STANDBY_REQUIRED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button enabled in baseline safe state
verificationPatterns.example: Be in power disable/service/OFF state → Verify power enable button enabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button disabled with specific tooltip when hardware safety input is active
verificationPatterns.example: EMS button signal set True → button disabled with tooltip EMS_IS_ACTIVE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button disabled with specific tooltip when zone interlock is opened
verificationPatterns.example: Zone interlock signal set True → button disabled with tooltip ZONE_DISABLED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button disabled with specific tooltip when machine is in non-OFF operational states
verificationPatterns.example: Mechinit/Standby/GR/Ready/PrePrint/Print/Go to Standby/Go to Service/Post Print → button disabled with tooltip Off state is required

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify BR[X] parameters against linked SW requirements document
verificationPatterns.example: Verify BR[X] parameters are according SW requirements: <confluence link>

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify Br[X] status flag matches issued command (AtEngage / AtDisengage / AtService = True)
verificationPatterns.example: Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.BKT.Comp.arrBr[X].Out.Status.AtEngage = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify PositionPistonA output per command: True on Engage, False on Disengage and Service (all Br[1-6])
verificationPatterns.example: Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gIos.BKT.arrBr[X].Output.PositionPistonA.Value = True (Engage) / False (Disengage, Service)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify PositionPistonB output for Br[1] only (5/3 valve): False on Engage/Disengage, True on Service
verificationPatterns.example: Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gIos.BKT.arrBr[1].Output.PositionPistonB.Value = False (Engage/Disengage), True (Service)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify position piston pilot valve (check valve) is True after Engage or Disengage commands
verificationPatterns.example: Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gIos.BKT.arrBr[X].Output.PositionPistonPilot.Value = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify PressureReg output matches formula-derived value on Engage/Disengage; equals 0 on Service
verificationPatterns.example: Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gIos.BKT.arrBr[1].Output.PressureReg.Value = 1.68 (T1 nip pressure 300); 0 (Service)

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC/T1 falls to OFF on sensor fault
verificationPatterns.example: Verify PLC fell to OFF state. / Verify T1 Fell to OFF state.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Named error event emitted with correct side and BR id
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Error event - BLANKET_T1_ENGAGE_FAILURE with correct side/BR id

verificationPatterns.pattern: Distinct error code per failure mode (engage / disengage / service)
verificationPatterns.example: BLANKET_T1_ENGAGE_FAILURE (sensors false at Mechinit), BLANKET_T1_DISENGAGE_FAILURE (sensors true at Mechinit), BLANKET_T1_SERVICE_FAILURE (sensors true at Service command)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal is True at event then lowers to False
verificationPatterns.example: Verify BR[X] AtMechInit is True at Mechinit, then lowers to False: Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.BKT.Comp.arrBr[X].Out.Status.AtMechInit

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal is True in target machine state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify BR[X] AtDisengage is True in Standby state: Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.BKT.Comp.arrBr[X].Out.Status.AtDisengage

verificationPatterns.pattern: EMS cuts all engage motors
verificationPatterns.example: All Engage motors should be turned off

verificationPatterns.pattern: EMS cuts roll motor
verificationPatterns.example: Roll motor should be turned off

verificationPatterns.pattern: EMS cuts heater
verificationPatterns.example: Heater should be turned off

verificationPatterns.pattern: EMS dismisses engage piston air pressure
verificationPatterns.example: Engage piston will be dismissed of air pressure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service piston moves to service position on Service CMD
verificationPatterns.example: When StiR is in service position the service piston should go to service position

verificationPatterns.pattern: Engage servo motors move to disengage position on Service CMD
verificationPatterns.example: Engage servo motors should go to disengage position

verificationPatterns.pattern: Piston travel completes within timeout
