verificationPatterns.pattern: Valid level returned before recovery timeout allows priming system to resume get-ready
verificationPatterns.example: Return valid level before recovery timeout → Perform get ready → Verify priming system starts get ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault detection in get-ready state with event logging
verificationPatterns.example: Verify liquid state is ready after fault and event exists

verificationPatterns.pattern: Recovery timeout resets monitoring state to wash-required
verificationPatterns.example: Return valid level after recovery timeout; verify wash is required

verificationPatterns.pattern: Over-high-limit triggers standby + failure event
verificationPatterns.example: Set Dryer temp over high limit → Verify press falls to standby and failure event occurs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Below-low-limit triggers standby + failure event
verificationPatterns.example: Set Dryer temp below low limit → Verify press falls to standby and failure event occurs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor differential over diff-limit triggers standby + failure event
verificationPatterns.example: Set sensor A and sensor B in diff of over diff limit → Verify press falls to standby and failure event occurs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Re-setup to ready state before each fault injection
verificationPatterns.example: Set Dryer sensors to 50 in order to Perform Get ready (repeated before each violation scenario)

verificationPatterns.pattern: High-limit bypass in ready state
verificationPatterns.example: Set Dryer temp over high limit → verify press stays in ready and no event occurs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Low-limit bypass in ready state
verificationPatterns.example: Set Dryer temp below low limit → verify press stays in ready and no event occurs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor differential bypass in ready state
verificationPatterns.example: Set sensor A and sensor B diff over diff limit → verify press stays in ready and no event occurs

verificationPatterns.pattern: High-limit breach does not affect press in bypass state
verificationPatterns.example: Set Dryer temp over high limit → Verify press stays in print and no event occurs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Low-limit breach does not affect press in bypass state
verificationPatterns.example: Set Dryer temp below low limit → Verify press stays in print and no event occurs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor differential breach does not affect press in bypass state
verificationPatterns.example: Set sensor A and sensor B to diff > diff limit → Verify press stays in print and no event occurs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state assertion after fault injection
verificationPatterns.example: After each fault condition: confirm press remains in print state

verificationPatterns.pattern: No event assertion after fault injection
verificationPatterns.example: After each fault condition: confirm no monitoring event is raised

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold breach (high limit) causes standby + failure event
verificationPatterns.example: Set Dryer temp over high limit → Verify press falls to standby and failure event occurs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold breach (low limit) causes standby + failure event
verificationPatterns.example: Set Dryer temp below low limit → Verify press falls to standby and failure event occurs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor differential breach causes standby + failure event
verificationPatterns.example: Set sensor A and sensor B to diff over diff limit → Verify press falls to standby and failure event occurs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Reset to valid state between sub-scenarios
verificationPatterns.example: After each failure, set Dryer sensors to 50, perform Get Ready, and start print before next condition

verificationPatterns.pattern: Over-limit bypass — assert no event and no state change
verificationPatterns.example: Set Dryer temp over high limit → Verify press stays in get ready and no event occurs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Under-limit bypass — assert no event and no state change
verificationPatterns.example: Set Dryer temp below low limit → Verify press stays in get ready and no event occurs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor differential bypass — assert no event and no state change
verificationPatterns.example: Set sensor A and sensor B diff over diff limit → Verify press stays in get ready and no event occurs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Under-low-limit triggers standby + failure event
verificationPatterns.example: Set Dryer temp below low limit → verify press falls to standby and failure event occurs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor A/B differential over limit triggers standby + failure event
verificationPatterns.example: Set sensor A and sensor B diff over diff limit → verify press falls to standby and failure event occurs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error code raised on boundary breach
verificationPatterns.example: Error is raised "ILP_PRIMER_TANK_LEVEL_INVALID" / "ILP_PRIMER_TANK_LEVEL_OVERFLOW" / "ILP_PRIMER_TANK_LEVEL_EMPTY"

verificationPatterns.pattern: ILP stops circulating and press enters AfterFault
verificationPatterns.example: ILP stops circulating. Press going to "AfterFault" state.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Motor/mechanical state after fault: motors PowerOff, rollers and chamber remain engaged
verificationPatterns.example: Verify motors in PowerOff, Rollers and chamber are kept engaged.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Recovery within MaxTimeForRecovery restores normal operation
verificationPatterns.example: Fix level in time less than MaxTimeForRecovery. Start GR or SWF → Liquid system should return to milling / Ready for prime

verificationPatterns.pattern: Recovery beyond MaxTimeForRecovery locks out GR and wet SWF via availability flag
verificationPatterns.example: ILP Manager goes to SB. GR and wet SWF are blocked (Availability: ILP_WASH_IS_REQUIRED). Wash and Drain should be available.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass overrides level fault — system continues working
verificationPatterns.example: Set bypass → Continue to work properly.

verificationPatterns.pattern: GetReady state: recovery triggers motor power-on and GoToPrimerCirculation
verificationPatterns.example: Fix level and start GR or SWF with Prime in time less than MaxTimeForRecovery → PLC will power-on motors and start GoToPrimerCirculation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic threshold breach → GR stop + press to SB + event raised
verificationPatterns.example: Set Dryer temp >PanicHigh → GR stopped, Press back to SB, ILP dryer go to SB and raise correct event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Named event raised on specific fault condition
verificationPatterns.example: Set delta (TC2-TC1) > DryerTempMaxDiff → raise 'ILP_DRYER_TEMP_DIFF_TOO_HIGH'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass allows continued operation despite active fault
verificationPatterns.example: With bypass continue to work

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor off → GR stop + press to SB + event raised
verificationPatterns.example: Set pressure sensor is off → GR stopped, Press back to SB, Dryer go to SB and raise correct event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault verified symmetrically in both ready and printing states
verificationPatterns.example: Same in ready and printing state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Drive error triggers fault-state transition and ILP Manager standby
verificationPatterns.example: Liquid system goes through 'fault' state to 'AfterFault'. ILP Manager goes to SB

verificationPatterns.pattern: GR restart within MaxTimeForRecovery causes PLC motor power-on and GoToPrimerCirculation
verificationPatterns.example: Start GR again in less than MaxTimeForRecovery → PLC will power-on motors and start GoToPrimerCirculation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wet SWF start within MaxTimeForRecovery causes PLC motor power-on, GoToPrimerCirculation, then SWF start
verificationPatterns.example: Start SWF in Wet Mode in time less than MaxTimeForRecovery → Before SWF PLC will power-on motors and start GoToPrimerCirculation and then start SWF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat full fault/recovery/timeout sequence for alternate drive (Supply pump) expecting identical behavior
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat test 1-4 for Supply pump → Same results

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault raised on required-tank removal
verificationPatterns.example: Error is raised 'ILP_PRIMER_TANK_NOT_IN_PLACE' — ILP stops circulating, Press goes to AfterFault state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Motor/roller state preserved on fault
verificationPatterns.example: Verify motors in PowerOff, Rollers and chamber are kept engaged

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fast recovery (< MaxTimeForRecovery) resumes prior operation
verificationPatterns.example: Set primer tank in place in time less than MaxTimeForRecovery → Liquid system should return to milling

verificationPatterns.pattern: Slow recovery (> MaxTimeForRecovery) escalates to standby with blocked operations
verificationPatterns.example: ILP Manager goes to SB. GR and wet SWF are blocked (Availability: ILP_WASH_IS_REQUIRED). Wash and Drain should be available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass tank exempts system from tank-in-place check
verificationPatterns.example: Set bypass → Continue to work properly

verificationPatterns.pattern: Non-active-state tanks do not trigger fault
verificationPatterns.example: Set clean and waste tank not in place (during Circulation state) → Continue to work properly

verificationPatterns.pattern: Monitor suppression during start delay
verificationPatterns.example: While FlowMonitorStartDelayMs is active, state does not change and no events are issued

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter default restoration check
verificationPatterns.example: After reset: FlowMonitorStartDelayMs == 6000, FlowMonitorStartDelayMs.ParMetaData.UpperLimit == 15000

verificationPatterns.pattern: Moving average on sensor input
verificationPatterns.example: Flow value change is not reflected immediately; moving average is implemented and can also be verified on press

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic-low event and state
verificationPatterns.example: Flow below CwsFlowPanicLow.Value triggers event CWS_FLOW_PANIC_LOW with params SensorID, ActualValue, LimitValue; state does not change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic-high event and state transition to service
verificationPatterns.example: Flow above CwsFlowPanicHigh.Value triggers event CWS_FLOW_PANIC_HIGH with params SensorID, ActualValue, LimitValue; press state goes to service

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass suppresses all monitoring
verificationPatterns.example: With CwsFlowMonitorBypass active, repeating panic-range conditions yields no state change and no event

verificationPatterns.pattern: State unchanged during monitoring start delay
verificationPatterns.example: verify state does not change (Step 1, while delay=99)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Restore parameter to default and assert known value
verificationPatterns.example: change delay and upper limit back to default; delay should be 5, upper limit should be 8

verificationPatterns.pattern: Moving average applied to sensor input — change not immediate
verificationPatterns.example: verify change is not done immediately and moving average is implemented

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic range breach: state→off, single error event issued, no other events
verificationPatterns.example: set temp above/below CwsTempPanicHigh/Low; verify state changes to off, verify error event CWS_WATER_TEMP_PANIC_LOW/HIGH issued with params SensorID, ActualTemperature, PanicLimit

verificationPatterns.pattern: Valid range breach: state→off, single TEMP_INVALID event issued, no other events
verificationPatterns.example: set temp above/below CwsTempValidHigh/Low; verify state changes to off, verify TEMP_INVALID event issued with params SensorID, TemperatureValue, LimitValue

verificationPatterns.pattern: Working range breach (within panic bounds): print continues, warning events issued
verificationPatterns.example: set temp above/below CwsTempWorkingHigh/Low during print; verify print continues; events CWS_WATER_TEMP_HIGH / CWS_WATER_TEMP_LOW

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass flag suppresses all state changes and events
verificationPatterns.example: set CwsTempMonitorBypass, repeat panic/valid/working tests; state does not change and no event is issued

verificationPatterns.pattern: Valve sequencing: verify dependent valve closes after upstream valve
verificationPatterns.example: verify CWS valve closes after CVC valve

verificationPatterns.pattern: State persistence: verify valve remains in expected position after state change to standby
verificationPatterns.example: verify CWS valve remains closed

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-driven valve open: verify bypass valve opens on transition to off
verificationPatterns.example: bypass valve is opened

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timed IO response: set upstream signal to 0, wait 1 second, verify downstream valve opens with delay
verificationPatterns.example: perform mech init, unset CVC HX water supply to 0, wait 1 second, bypass valve opens after about

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert single status flag is TRUE after triggering condition
verificationPatterns.example: verify Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.CWS.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtPowerDisable is at state TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert previously active status flag clears to FALSE after condition removed
verificationPatterns.example: verify Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.CWS.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtPowerDisable is at state FALSE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert new status flag becomes TRUE after state transition completes
verificationPatterns.example: verify Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.CWS.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff is at state TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default config flag is false
verificationPatterns.example: verify flag of isChillerInstalled is set to default → Value should be false

verificationPatterns.pattern: Config flag TRUE + mech init activates IO output
verificationPatterns.example: set isChillerInstalled to TRUE and perform mech init → verify ON IO signal is sent to chiller

verificationPatterns.pattern: IO output persists across full state cycle
verificationPatterns.example: perform transition ready->print->ready->standby->off → verify chiller ON signal remains ON

verificationPatterns.pattern: Config flag FALSE + mech init suppresses IO output
verificationPatterns.example: set isChillerInstalled to False and perform mech init → verify chiller IO is not turned ON

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timed deactivation: IO stays ON during delay then turns off
verificationPatterns.example: set DeactivateChillerOnOffState TRUE, CwsChillerOffDelay=10, go to off → chiller IO remains ON for 10s then turns off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic condition triggers immediate IO deactivation
verificationPatterns.example: override pressure above panic high → press goes to off, chiller turned off immediately

verificationPatterns.pattern: After calling an operation, verify availability operation flags reflect allowed/blocked transitions
verificationPatterns.example: After MI started: start inching speed, MI and start process speed = False; Deactivation = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify inching speed value after inching is triggered from any source (SB or Off)
verificationPatterns.example: Call inching from SB → Inching started, verify inching speed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify state progression from Off through MI→SB→Inching when process or inching speed is called from Off or SB
verificationPatterns.example: Call process speed from Off → MI-Sb-Inching started, verify inching speed

verificationPatterns.pattern: After deactivation from any active state, verify ASID returns to Off and all availability operations become True
verificationPatterns.example: Call deactivate from SB/inching/process speed → Asid state = Off; start inching speed, MI, start process speed, Deactivation = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: State does not change during start-delay window
verificationPatterns.example: increase CwsPressureMonitorStartDelay to 99, create high pressure at both sensors → verify state does not change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic-high pressure triggers state-off and issues exactly one named error event
verificationPatterns.example: set inlet/outlet above CwsPressurePanicHigh → verify state changes to off, PRESSURE_PANIC_HIGH issued, verify other events are not issued

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event carries mandatory parameters: SensorID, ActualPressure, HighLimit
verificationPatterns.example: PRESSURE_PANIC_HIGH event params: SensorID, ActualPressure, HighLimit

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pressure monitor bypass suppresses both state change and event
verificationPatterns.example: set CwsPressureMonitorBypass, repeat panic tests 4 and 5 → state does not change and no event is issued

verificationPatterns.pattern: Moving average delays effect of pressure change (not immediate)
verificationPatterns.example: change water inline pressure → verify change is not done immediately and moving average is implemented

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor disconnect issues SENSOR_DISCONNECTED event and drives press to off
verificationPatterns.example: trigger inlet/outlet sensor disconnected IO → SENSOR_DISCONNECTED event issued and press goes to off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Working-range violation issues event but does not change state
verificationPatterns.example: set inlet/outlet above/below CwsPressureWorkingHigh/Low → verify events are issued, state should not change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Component state check after operation trigger
verificationPatterns.example: Verify PLC mgr & station component are in Service state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal boolean TRUE after entering operational service state
verificationPatterns.example: OCB.gInterface.Station[1].Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.AtServiceOperational = TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal boolean TRUE after entering service ready state
verificationPatterns.example: OCB.gInterface.Station[1].Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.AtServiceReady = TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: State restoration check after End Service
verificationPatterns.example: Verify PLC mgr & station components are back to previous state

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-gated availability: verify all ASID ops report flag=false with state-specific reason
verificationPatterns.example: OFF state → flag false, reason SERVICE_REQUIRED; after Call Service → flag false, reason EA_MODE_REQUIRED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Motor-free check: engaging an axis (CS/CR/Bids/T1) sets availability false with 'Motor not free to rotate'
verificationPatterns.example: Set CS to engage → flag false, reason Motor not free to rotate

verificationPatterns.pattern: Motor-free recovery: disengaging axis restores availability true
verificationPatterns.example: Set CS to disengage → flag true

verificationPatterns.pattern: MI-to-Blanket check: performing MI while blanket is Off sets availability false with 'Motor not free to rotate'
verificationPatterns.example: Do MI to Blanket (Off state) → flag false, reason Motor not free to rotate; blanket reaches SB → flag true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Axis symmetry: repeat same engage/disengage verification for each axis (CS, CR, Bids, T1)
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat test for CR, Bids and T1 — same result expected

verificationPatterns.pattern: Component inactive check: deactivating aSID component sets availability false with 'Component inactive'
verificationPatterns.example: Set aSID component not active → flag false, reason Component inactive

verificationPatterns.pattern: Drive disabled check: disabling aSID drive sets availability false with 'Zone Disabled'
verificationPatterns.example: Set aSID drive disabled → flag false, reason Zone Disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: All PS enables OFF when LPH in OFF state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all LPH PS enables are OFF (Digital Output): LPH_1_PS_ENB … LPH_6_PS_ENB

verificationPatterns.pattern: All PS enables ON when LPH in Standby or above
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all LPH PS enables are ON (Digital Output): LPH_1_PS_ENB … LPH_6_PS_ENB

verificationPatterns.pattern: Partial-install: only installed units get enable=1; uninstalled units stay 0
verificationPatterns.example: When LPH in Standby state, verify enable signals set to '1' for only installed LPH units

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify specific pressure-fault error event is raised
verificationPatterns.example: Verify an error event about PRESSURE_PANIC_LOW / PRESSURE_PANIC_HIGH / PRESSURE_INVALID

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify LPH state transitions to OFF after pressure fault
verificationPatterns.example: Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.LphCooling.Out.Status.AtOFF = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event raised for specific fault code
verificationPatterns.example: Verify an error event about TEMP_PANIC_LOW / TEMP_PANIC_HIGH / TEMP_INVALID

verificationPatterns.pattern: State output signal confirms machine reached OFF
verificationPatterns.example: Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.LphCooling.Out.Status.AtOFF = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary crossing tested in both directions (low and high) for each threshold pair
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 1+2 cover PanicLow/PanicHigh; Steps 3+4 cover ValidLow/ValidHigh

verificationPatterns.pattern: Both initial states (OFF and Stdby) exercised per threshold pair
verificationPatterns.example: Step 1 starts OFF, Step 2 starts Stdby for panic thresholds

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event raised with fault code, sensor ID, and actual/expected values
verificationPatterns.example: Verify an error event about TEMP_PANIC_LOW with sensor ID and actual/expected value

verificationPatterns.pattern: LPH state transitions to OFF regardless of prior state after threshold violation
verificationPatterns.example: Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.LphCooling.Out.Status.AtOFF = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert heater output ON when tank temp below threshold after Mechinit
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.LPHCooling.HW_Outputs.LPH_Tank_Heater.Value = 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert timeout event fires after heating delay elapses
verificationPatterns.example: Verify after heating timeout reached, an event appeared: LPH_COOLING_TANK_TEMP_HEATING_TIMED_OUT

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert press state drops to OFF and LPH reports AtOFF after timeout
verificationPatterns.example: Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.LphCooling.Out.Status.AtOFF = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert heater output OFF after timeout-induced shutdown
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.LPHCooling.HW_Outputs.LPH_Tank_Heater.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert heater output OFF when tank temp raised to above-threshold value mid-heating
verificationPatterns.example: Set NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.LPHCooling.HW_Inputs.LPH_Tank_Temperature_Sens.Value=310, then verify LPH_Tank_Heater.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: State machine status check — assert exactly one AtXxx boolean True after each transition
verificationPatterns.example: Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.LphCooling.Out.Status.AtMechInit = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Monitor activation gate — all four cooling monitors become True on MechInit entry and False on OFF entry
verificationPatterns.example: LPH_Cooling_Temp_Monitor_Active = True / LPH_Cooling_Pressure_Monitor_Active = True / LPH_Cooling_TankTemp_Monitor_Active = True / LPH_Cooling_TankLevel_Monitor_Active = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: HW output value check — verify pump and heater digital outputs via OPCUAInterface HW_Outputs path using NS4|String namespace
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.LPHCooling.HW_Outputs.LPH_Pump.Value = 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Heater OFF invariant — heater must be 0 in GetReady, Standby, and OFF states
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.LPHCooling.HW_Outputs.LPH_Tank_Heater.Value=0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump OFF on OFF state — pump output drops to 0 when system transitions to OFF
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.LPHCooling.HW_Outputs.LPH_Pump.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event raised with correct code and actual/expected values
verificationPatterns.example: Verify error event raised - LEVEL_PANIC_LOW with actual/expected values

verificationPatterns.pattern: LPH pump output driven to 0 after threshold violation
verificationPatterns.example: NS4|String|OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.LPHCooling.HW_Outputs.LPH_Pump.Value = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: LPH subsystem status reaches OFF state
verificationPatterns.example: Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.LphCooling.Out.Status.AtOFF = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-Mechinit position equals hardcoded home value
verificationPatterns.example: ActPosition = 1000 after SPM Z Mechinit

verificationPatterns.pattern: Named operation drives ActPosition to matching parameter signal
verificationPatterns.example: After OFF: ActPosition = spmZOffPos; after Ready: ActPosition = spmZReadyPos

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stop during motion halts before target — verify position is below target, not equal
verificationPatterns.example: Change spmZReadyPos to 100000, call Ready then Stop; verify ActPosition not reached 100000

verificationPatterns.pattern: Modify parameter signal before operation to test dynamic target tracking
verificationPatterns.example: Set spmZReadyPos = 100000, then call Ready to confirm axis targets updated value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Named operation moves axis to fixed literal position
verificationPatterns.example: Call SPM X - Mechinit → ActPosition = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Named operation moves axis to parameter-defined position signal
verificationPatterns.example: Call SPM X - Tile → ActPosition = spmXcalibTilePosition; Call SPM X - Calib → ActPosition = spmX_ZcalibrationPos; Call SPM X - OFF → ActPosition = spmXOffPos; Call SPM X - Ready → ActPosition = spmXReadyPos

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stop operation interrupts in-progress movement before target reached
verificationPatterns.example: Set spmXReadyPos=100000, call Ready then Stop → ActPosition did not reach 100000 and stopped during movement

verificationPatterns.pattern: Exit service restores component to previous state
verificationPatterns.example: Click Exit service button → SPM returned to previous state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert boolean signal TRUE after UI action
verificationPatterns.example: OCB.gInterface.Web.Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.AtServiceOperational = TRUE after clicking Service

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert component-ready signal TRUE after element activation button press
verificationPatterns.example: OCB.gInterface.Web.Ctrl.Out.Status.Service.AtServiceReady = TRUE after clicking SPM button in element activation box

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert component returns to previous state after exit action
verificationPatterns.example: Verify web component is back to previous state after clicking Exit service button

verificationPatterns.pattern: Baseline unavailability in OFF/Stdby: all operations blocked with SERVICE_REQUIRED
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in all SPM X/Z operations, that the availability flag is false and the reason is - SERVICE_REQUIRED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service mode shifts block reason to EA_MODE_REQUIRED for all operations
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in all SPM X/Z operations, that the availability flag is false and the reason is - EA_MODE_REQUIRED

verificationPatterns.pattern: EA activation unlocks only the first prerequisite operation (MechInit on X); all others remain blocked with axis-specific reasons
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the availability flag of SPM X - Mechinit operation is True. Verify in all other SPM X/Z operations that the availability flag is False. Verify the SPM Z - Mechinit availability reason is SPM_X_MOTOR_NOT_IN_POSITION. Verify all other operations availability reason is - MOTOR_NOT_READY

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-MechInit on X: Stdby/Ready unlocks all X ops; OFF state blocks X MechInit with tension reason; Z remains blocked with position dependency reason
verificationPatterns.example: In Stdby/Ready states, verify in all SPM X operations, that the availability flag is True. In OFF state, verify SPM X Mechinit operation availability status is False and the reason is - PWS_ZONE_WEB_TENSION_REQUIRED. Verify SPM Z - Mechinit operation availability reason is SPM_X_MOTOR_NOT_IN_POSITION. Verify other SPM Z operations reason is - MOTOR_NOT_IN_POSITION

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tension bypass checkbox overrides web-tension interlock on a specific operation
verificationPatterns.example: Mark check box - Tension bypass in SPM EA screen. Verify SPM X - Mechinit operation availability status is True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Safety door unlock disables zone and blocks operation with ZONE_DISABLED reason
verificationPatterns.example: Unlock PWS door. Verify SPM X - Mechinit operation availability status is false and the reason is - ZONE_DISABLED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequential axis dependency: Z MechInit available only after X MechInit and Calib complete
verificationPatterns.example: Lock PWS door. Enter Service EA mode. Call SPM X - Mechinit operation. Call SPM X - Calib operation. Verify SPM Z - Mechinit availability flag is True. Verify all rest SPM Z operations availability flag is False with reason - MOTOR_NOT_READY

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-Z MechInit all Z operations become available
verificationPatterns.example: Call SPM Z - Mechinit operation. Verify all SPM Z availability flag is True

verificationPatterns.pattern: In-progress operation blocks all sibling operations with OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS reason
verificationPatterns.example: Call SPM X - Ready operation. Verify all other operations availability status is False with reason - OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button state at Ready with no jobs
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Print, Stop and Ready button is disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button state at Ready with job loaded
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Print button is active, Stop and Ready buttons disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button state at PrePrint
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Print and States buttons is disabled, Stop button is active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button state at PostPrint
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Print and Stop buttons disabled, States button enabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button state at Print after second Print press
verificationPatterns.example: Press on Stop button and verify Print and States button disabled, Stop button active

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC state transition wait before assertion
verificationPatterns.example: Press on Print button and wait to PLC reach PrePrint state; Press on Stop button and wait to PLC reach PostPrint state

verificationPatterns.pattern: OPC UA subscribe before action, capture timestamped state transitions, unsubscribe after
verificationPatterns.example: Subscribe to buzzerStatus parameter in PLC: OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.EndService.OperationData.BuzzerStatus ... Unsubscribe from Buzzer status parameter

verificationPatterns.pattern: Record timestamps at each state boundary, assert delta between consecutive timestamps against threshold

verificationPatterns.pattern: End-to-end print sanity check
verificationPatterns.example: Print and verify press is printing without issues

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout trigger on missing local print metadata
verificationPatterns.example: Application side Print session timeouts in case stripe from Application is late

verificationPatterns.pattern: Network disconnect halts active print job
verificationPatterns.example: Disconnect datalan during printing → Printing will stop

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout error surfaced in UI after fixed delay
verificationPatterns.example: After 30 sec will appear Red error in UI side

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout triggers visible error in UI after fixed delay
verificationPatterns.example: After 30 second, need be red Exception in UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault clears and operation succeeds after resetting fault condition and retrying
verificationPatterns.example: Set PEX entity to false, restart calibration — calibration succeed, no errors

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout surfaces as visible error in UI within expected window
verificationPatterns.example: After 10 second, need be red Exception in UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print End event carries specific error constant
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Print End with Error: PRINTING_INSTRUCTIONS_WERE_NOT_RECEIVED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Clear simulation fault, reprint, verify full recovery
verificationPatterns.example: Set ErrorBehaviotType None → Print local job → Verify job printed successfully

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition after OPC UA operation call
verificationPatterns.example: Calling OPCUAInterface.Global.Operations.Print Start moves PLC from Ready to Pre Print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout-triggered fault state after inactivity
verificationPatterns.example: After 120 seconds without printing instructions, system reports PRINTING_INSTRUCTIONS_WERE_NOT_RECEIVED

verificationPatterns.pattern: OPC UA variable write to simulate data unavailability
verificationPatterns.example: Set OPCUAInterface.Global.PrintingData.SendStripeDataAvailable = False via UaExpert

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout threshold boundary check (120 sec)
verificationPatterns.example: After 120 sec (below time out) event will appear and print is stop

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault/event code assertion on session abort
verificationPatterns.example: Expected event: PRINTING_INSTRUCTIONS_WERE_NOT_RECEIVED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Monitor stripe receipt log signals for diagnostic context
verificationPatterns.example: G_PrintCtrl.printDataControl.out.monitor.logStripeReceivedPrint and logStripeReceivedNull fields inspected during timeout

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button absence check — verify a button does not appear in UI for the current state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify no GoToStandby button in UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Disabled button with required-state tooltip — verify button is disabled and tooltip text follows pattern '<StateName> state is required'
verificationPatterns.example: Verify GR button disabled with tooltip - "Standby state is required"

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat disabled-button check per action button (GR, Print, EndPrint, Service) each requiring its own prerequisite state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Service button disabled with tooltip - "Off state is required"

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert button absent in current state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify no GoToStandby button in UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert button disabled with tooltip stating required state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify GR button disabled with tooltip - "Standby state is required"

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert action button disabled when press not in prerequisite state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Print button disabled with tooltip - "Ready state is required"; End Print disabled with "Print state is required"; Restart/Service disabled with "Off state is required"

verificationPatterns.pattern: One tooltip per button reflects the single prerequisite state needed
verificationPatterns.example: GR button → "Standby state is required"; Restart button → "Off state is required"

verificationPatterns.pattern: All action buttons checked individually while machine state is held constant
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 1-6 each repeat the same state precondition, then target a different button

verificationPatterns.pattern: Enabled button visibility check in current state
verificationPatterns.example: GoToStandby button appears in UI and is enabled while in Ready state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tooltip text format: "<RequiredState> state is required"
verificationPatterns.example: GR button tooltip = "Standby state is required"; Service button tooltip = "Standby state is required"; Restart button tooltip = "Off state is required"; End Print button tooltip = "Print state is required"

verificationPatterns.pattern: Disabled button shows required-state tooltip
verificationPatterns.example: PowerEnable button disabled with tooltip - 'PowerDisable state is required'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tooltip text format: '<StateName> state is required'
verificationPatterns.example: Print button disabled with tooltip - 'Ready state is required'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button disabled with state-requirement tooltip
verificationPatterns.example: PowerEnable button disabled with tooltip - 'PowerDisable state is required'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button absent from UI when action is irrelevant to current state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify there is no GoToStandby button in UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Each action button tooltip names the exact required state
verificationPatterns.example: Print button disabled with tooltip - 'Ready state is required'; End Print button disabled with tooltip - 'Print state is required'; Restart button disabled with tooltip - 'Off state is required'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button absent in wrong state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify there is no GoToStandby button in UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button absent from UI in given state
verificationPatterns.example: In Init state → GoToStandby button does not appear in UI at all

verificationPatterns.pattern: Each action button names its prerequisite state in its tooltip
verificationPatterns.example: Print button: 'Ready state is required'; End Print button: 'Print state is required'; Restart button: 'Off state is required'; Service button: 'Off state is required'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Snapshot full SPM status bitmap at named state boundary
verificationPatterns.example: Step 6: verify all SPM.Device.Out.Status.*, SPM.Main.Out.Status.*, SPM_X.Out.Status.*, SPM_Z.Out.Status.*, SPM.Device.Out.Export.SPMReady, MachineState together as a named checkpoint (e.g. 'AtStandby after data-server stop')

verificationPatterns.pattern: Track axis position against parameter expression at each motion sub-step
verificationPatterns.example: SPM_X_Act_Position = SPM.Main.In.Par.Local.spmXReadyPos + SPM.Main.In.Par.Import.spmXoffset; SPM_Z_Act_Position = SPM.Main.In.Par.Local.spmZworkingDistance + SPM.Main.In.Par.Import.spmZoffset + SPM.Main.In.Par.Local.WebThickness = 1490

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify individual axis sub-state transitions in order: AtOFF→moving→AtStandBy for each axis separately
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 8-11: SPM_Z.Out.Status.AtStandBy toggles False then back True as Z moves to OFF position; SPM_Z_Act_Position = SPM.Main.In.Par.Local.spmZOffPos = 1500

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify X waits at spmX_ZcalibrationPos until Z activation completes before proceeding to tile position
verificationPatterns.example: Step 18: SPM_X_Act_Position = SPM.Main.In.Par.Local.spmX_ZcalibrationPos while SPM_Z remains AtOFF/Disabled; Z activation (steps 19-21) must complete before X moves to spmXcalibTilePosition

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify CalibrationPassed transitions False→True exactly at self-calibration completion, not before
verificationPatterns.example: Step 26: CalibrationPassed = False during calibration; Step 27: CalibrationPassed = True after calibration finish

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify SPM.Main.Out.Status.AtMechinit True throughout mech-init sequence and False only at completion, with AtReady flipping simultaneously
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 12-33: AtMechinit = True; Step 34: AtMechinit = False AND AtReady = True simultaneously

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify SPM.Device.Out.Export.SPMReady goes False at mech-init start and True only when mech-init finishes and AtReady is set
verificationPatterns.example: Step 12: SPMReady = False; Step 34: SPMReady = True coincident with AtMechinit = False and AtReady = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify MachineState transitions at sequence phase boundaries
verificationPatterns.example: Step 6: MachineState = 6 (Standby); Step 9-11: MachineState = 14 (OFF sequence); Step 11: MachineState = 3 (pre-mechinit); Step 35: MachineState = 6 (Standby restored)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Offset parameter write-back
verificationPatterns.example: Change SPM X offset to 100 → verify SPM X offset = 100

verificationPatterns.pattern: Axis status after power-on transition
verificationPatterns.example: Press power On, wait for standby → verify SPM Axis status = ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Absolute position = base + offset
verificationPatterns.example: X move to = 220100 (base 220000 + offset 100); Z move to = -1400 (base -1300 + offset -100)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Full axis status matrix snapshot at each state transition
verificationPatterns.example: At standby: SPM.Device.Out.Status.AtStandBy=True, SPM.Main.Out.Status.AtOff=True, SPM_X.Out.Status.AtOFF=True, SPM_X.Out.Status.Disabled=True, SPM_Z.Out.Status.AtOFF=True, SPM_Z.Out.Status.Disabled=True, SPM.Device.Out.Export.SPMReady=False

verificationPatterns.pattern: X-axis motor activation sub-state sequence (AtOFF→AxisOn→Disabled=False→AtStandBy) verified incrementally step-by-step
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 11–14: SPM_X.Out.Status.AtOFF: True→False; then AxisOn: False→True; then Disabled: True→False; then AtStandBy: False→True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Z-axis motor activation sub-state sequence mirrors X pattern and begins only after X reaches calibration position
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 17–19: SPM_z.Out.Status.AtOFF=False, AxisON=True; then Disabled=False; then AtStandBy=True — only starts when SPM_X_Act_Position = SPM.Main.In.Par.Local.spmX_ZcalibrationPos

verificationPatterns.pattern: X-Z sequential position dependency: Z axis activation gated on X reaching parameter position
verificationPatterns.example: Step 16: SPM_X_Act_Position = SPM.Main.In.Par.Local.spmX_ZcalibrationPos, PM_Z_Act_Position = 0 — Z remains AtOFF=True until this condition

verificationPatterns.pattern: Self-calibration state: AtCalibrate=True and CalibrationPassed=False during calibration; CalibrationPassed flips True on completion
verificationPatterns.example: Step 24: AtCalibrate=True, CalibrationPassed=False. Step 25: AtCalibrate=False, CalibrationPassed=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: SPMReady export flag stays False throughout entire mech-init sequence; flips True only when AtMechinit transitions False→SPM.Main.Out.Status.AtReady=True
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 10–31: SPM.Device.Out.Export.SPMReady=False. Step 32: AtMechinit=False, AtReady=True, SPMReady=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ready positions verified as parameter expressions, not hardcoded values
verificationPatterns.example: Step 29: SPM_X_Act_Position = SPM.Main.In.Par.Local.spmXReadyPos + SPM.Main.In.Par.Import.spmXoffset; Step 31: SPM_Z_Act_Position = SPM.Main.In.Par.Local.spmZworkingDistance + SPM.Main.In.Par.Import.spmZoffset + SPM.Main.In.Par.Local.WebThickness = 1490

verificationPatterns.pattern: MachineState progression checked at press-level milestones
verificationPatterns.example: Step 7: MachineState=3 (standby after DB stop); Step 33: MachineState=6 (standby post mech-init); Step 35: MachineState=7 (ready)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ele connected status verified when simulator includes ELC
verificationPatterns.example: Step 9: Ele Connected = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Velocity-zero injection triggers SPM error and Not Active status
verificationPatterns.example: In the middle of mech init change the SPM X velocity to 0 → SPM will send error and SPM axis status = Not Active.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Same fault pattern repeats for orthogonal axis
verificationPatterns.example: In the middle of mech init change the SPM z velocity to 0 → SPM will send error and SPM axis status = Not Active.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Manual reactivation of SPM resets status to Off (not Active)
verificationPatterns.example: Change the SPM to active → SPM status = Off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Power-on re-triggers mech init and SPM init after fault recovery
verificationPatterns.example: Press on power on button → Press start mech init and also SPM

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state assertion
verificationPatterns.example: Press state = standby / Press state = Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: SPM axis and device state assertion
verificationPatterns.example: SPM AXIS = Ready, SPM Device = At Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration initiation position check
verificationPatterns.example: X move to = 40000, Z move to = -100

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration status transition assertion
verificationPatterns.example: SPM status will change to calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration completion assertion
verificationPatterns.example: SPM calibration status passed = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-calibration ready position return check
verificationPatterns.example: X move to = 220000, Z move to = -1500

verificationPatterns.pattern: Off-sequence order: Z moves before X
verificationPatterns.example: SPM X motor and SPM Z motor moves to their off position. First Z and then X. z=3000, X=1000

verificationPatterns.pattern: Off positions match parameters spmXOffPos / spmZOffPos
verificationPatterns.example: Off position is specified by parameters spmXOffPos spmZOffPos.

verificationPatterns.pattern: OffMotorDelay wait after motion completes before state change
verificationPatterns.example: When the motion ended wait OffMotorDelay second and change to OFF. After position x and Z wait 1 second and continue

verificationPatterns.pattern: AtOff status signal asserted after sequence completes
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.SPM.Comp.SPM_Device.Out.Status.AtOff = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state transitions: GO to OFF → Off
verificationPatterns.example: Press state = GO to OFF ... Press state = Off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Power-on restores SPM to Ready with expected axis positions
verificationPatterns.example: SPM AXIS = Ready, X position = 220000, Z position = -1500, gInterface.Web.Comp.SPM.Ctrl.Out.Status.SPMReady = TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Off sequence valid when triggered mid-transition (interrupt during GetReady)
verificationPatterns.example: In the middle of get ready press on the power off button → Verify SPM OFF sequence is matching expected result

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mech init sequence step-by-step verification
verificationPatterns.example: X moves to 51200 → Z moves to 3000 → self-calibration (X=40000, Z=-100) → SPM status = calibration → calibration status passed = true → SPM moves to ready position → SPMReady = True → press state = standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Axis position assertion at known state
verificationPatterns.example: At Get Ready and Ready states: X position = 220000, Z position = -1500, SPM AXIS status = Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Position stability across press-state transitions
verificationPatterns.example: During Pre-Print, Print, Post-Print: X=220000, Z=-1500, SPM AXIS=Ready — positions must not change across these states

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state transition sequencing
verificationPatterns.example: power-disable → (power on) → standby → (get ready) → At Get Ready → Ready → Pre-Print/Print/Post-Print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass blocks operation start
verificationPatterns.example: Set Bypass at true, cause to BackWash operation True → Verify the BackWash doesn't start

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify sequence completes successfully
verificationPatterns.example: Verify sequence finished successfully

verificationPatterns.pattern: Image count matches duration÷frequency formula
verificationPatterns.example: 1-minute job at 1s refresh → 60 images; at 10s refresh → 6 images

verificationPatterns.pattern: Images persisted to expected file-system location
verificationPatterns.example: 60 images were saved in s:\Images

verificationPatterns.pattern: Images start from leading edge without offset
verificationPatterns.example: image is shown every N seconds and start correctly from the leading edge

verificationPatterns.pattern: Images are uncropped and render without visual defects
verificationPatterns.example: Images appear correctly in the print out viewer

verificationPatterns.pattern: Full media width visible in viewer (no clipping)
verificationPatterns.example: all width is shown

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat matrix over multiple IVision configs and job sources (DFE vs local)
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 1-8 (DFE, 0.8m/1s), Steps 9-14 (DFE, 1.2m/10s), Steps 15-19 (local job, 1.2m/10s)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Image count in viewer matches expected total
verificationPatterns.example: The printout viewer will show 15 images

verificationPatterns.pattern: Saved image count and storage path match expected values
verificationPatterns.example: 15 images were saved in s:\Images

verificationPatterns.pattern: Images are visually complete and uncropped
verificationPatterns.example: Images appear correctly in the print out viewer.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Status reflects machine print state
verificationPatterns.example: In OFF/Standby/GR/Ready: all ink stations show not-printing; during job/internal wizard: relevant stations show printing, others show not-printing

verificationPatterns.pattern: Gauge actual values sourced from OPCUA under Ink stations; limits from OPCUA work window Min/Max
verificationPatterns.example: Density, Level, Conductivity & Temperature actual value read from OPCUA tree under Ink stations; limits read from work window Min and Max

verificationPatterns.pattern: Out-of-limit value triggers red gauge
verificationPatterns.example: Change density/level/conductivity/temperature to out-of-limit → gauge changes color to red

verificationPatterns.pattern: Station color change reflects in UI
verificationPatterns.example: Change some ink station color → UI shows correct station color

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inactive station marked visually in UI
verificationPatterns.example: Mark station as not active → UI shows station as not active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Count constraint assertion for specific deployment context
verificationPatterns.example: Verify only 2 screen sets will be sent to IDo (only for Drupa).

verificationPatterns.pattern: Component activation on RDU Active
verificationPatterns.example: Configure RDU Active at station 2 → verify Lift, Revolver, Slider components are active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Component deactivation on RDU Inactive
verificationPatterns.example: Configure RDU InActive at station 2 → verify Lift, Revolver, Slider components are Not Active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Configuration persistence across SW restart
verificationPatterns.example: Configure RDU Active at station 2, restart SW → verify station 2 revolver components are still active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Automatic recovery on power restore
verificationPatterns.example: RDU & Revolver that weren't in the middle of rotation will recover automatically once power is enabled - continue solid add where needed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mid-sequence completion after recovery
verificationPatterns.example: Revolver is during replacement sequence: Revolver will complete the replacement procedure

verificationPatterns.pattern: SLC blocks revolver rotation during safety operation
verificationPatterns.example: Verify SLC block the revolver ability to rotate during Tube replacement / Color change / Revolver maintenance

verificationPatterns.pattern: SLC blocks RDU solid-add capability during safety operation
verificationPatterns.example: Verify SLC block the RDU solid add capability during Tube replacement / Color change / Revolver maintenance

verificationPatterns.pattern: Safety interlock applies consistently across all relevant maintenance modes
verificationPatterns.example: Same dual-block assertion repeated for Tube replacement, Color change, Revolver maintenance

verificationPatterns.pattern: Persisted state after restart
verificationPatterns.example: Verify last position saved after restart

verificationPatterns.pattern: Enumerate valid positions per hardware config
verificationPatterns.example: RevolverConfig=DualRevolver → position ∈ {0°, 180°}

verificationPatterns.pattern: Single dependency: station waits for predecessor to complete before rotating
verificationPatterns.example: Send Rotate CMD to stations 1 & 2 → verify station 2 waits for station 1 completion

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fan-out dependency: multiple stations wait on one station, then execute in parallel after it completes
verificationPatterns.example: Send Rotate CMD to stations 2 & 1 & 3 → station 1 and 3 wait for station 2; after 2 completes, stations 1 and 3 work together

verificationPatterns.pattern: Chained dependency with parallel groups: cascading wait with mid-chain parallelism
verificationPatterns.example: Send Rotate CMD to stations 3 & 2 & 4 & 1 → stations 2 and 4 wait for 3; after 3 completes, 2 and 4 work together; station 1 waits for station 2

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequential chain: each station waits for the next higher station to complete
verificationPatterns.example: Send Rotate CMD to stations 4 & 3 & 2 → station 3 waits for 4; station 2 waits for 3

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert failure event fires on rotation fault
verificationPatterns.example: Verify INK_RDU_REVOLVER_ROTATION_FAILURE event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert system resilience — print continues despite rotation failure
verificationPatterns.example: Verify print continue, Verify event: INK_RDU_REVOLVER_ROTATION_FAILURE event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state unchanged after command with sensor mismatch
verificationPatterns.example: Press remain at Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout failure event fires after configured lift duration
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Timeout event after RaiseLiftDuration (INK_RDU_RELEASE_LIFT_FAILURE)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure event enqueued with source, FlowID, and actual sensor states as IntParam1/IntParam2
verificationPatterns.example: Enqueue event INK_RDU_RAISE_LIFT_FAILURE from INK_1_Stn_3, FlowID 0, IntParam1 LiftUpSensorValue 0, IntParam2 LiftDownSensorValue 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout event enqueued with correct event ID, source, FlowID, and sensor IntParams
verificationPatterns.example: Enqueue event INK_RDU_SLIDER_CLOSE_FAILURE from INK_1_Stn_3, FlowID 0, IntParam1 SliderCloseSensorValue 0, IntParam2 SliderOpenSensorValue 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press remains at Ready state while timeout condition is pending
verificationPatterns.example: Press remain at Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout fires after configured duration constant (not hardcoded ms) for each direction
verificationPatterns.example: verify Timeout event after OpenSliderDuration=500ms (INK_RDU_SLIDER_CLOSE_FAILURE)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Paired sensor mutual-exclusion check: assert active sensor = True, inactive sensor = False after command
verificationPatterns.example: verify SliderOpenSensor=True & SliderCloseSensor=False and revolver status is Open

verificationPatterns.pattern: Revolver status string matches command direction (Open/Close/Up/Down)
verificationPatterns.example: revolver status is Open

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify valve operation comment after each sensor assertion
verificationPatterns.example: Verify valve operation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Guard condition: monitoring suppressed when prerequisite component not installed
verificationPatterns.example: Set revolver to not installed, override both sensors to False, send Close & Open CMD -> Verify monitoring is not active (No Error)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Illegal sensor state (both True) during print triggers event after timer elapses
verificationPatterns.example: Set LiftUpSensor & LiftDownSensor both to 1 for LiftSensorIllegalTimer seconds during print -> Verify Event: INK_RDU_LIFT_SENSOR_ILLEGAL_STATE, print continues

verificationPatterns.pattern: Illegal sensor state (both False) during print triggers event after timer elapses
verificationPatterns.example: Set LiftUpSensor & LiftDownSensor both to 0 for LiftSensorIllegalTimer seconds during print -> Verify Event: INK_RDU_LIFT_SENSOR_ILLEGAL_STATE, print continues

verificationPatterns.pattern: Illegal sensor state at off/idle state produces no event (monitoring inactive outside print)
verificationPatterns.example: At off state, set both sensors to 1 (or both to 0) for LiftSensorIllegalTimer seconds -> Verify no event appears

verificationPatterns.pattern: Guard: monitoring suppressed when revolver not installed
verificationPatterns.example: Set revolver to not installed; override both sensors to False during print + ReplaceTube CMD → verify no error

verificationPatterns.pattern: Illegal state detection: both sensors simultaneously True during print+replace triggers event
verificationPatterns.example: Set SliderOpenSensor=1 and SliderCloseSensor=1 for SlideSensorIllegalTimer seconds → print continues; verify event INK_RDU_SLIDER_SENSOR_ILLEGAL_STATE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Illegal state detection: both sensors simultaneously False during print+replace triggers event
verificationPatterns.example: Set SliderOpenSensor=0 and SliderCloseSensor=0 for SlideSensorIllegalTimer seconds → print continues; verify event INK_RDU_SLIDER_SENSOR_ILLEGAL_STATE

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-gate: no event fired when both sensors True at Ready state
verificationPatterns.example: At Ready state set both sensors to 1 for SlideSensorIllegalTimer seconds → verify no event

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-gate: no event fired when both sensors False at Off state
verificationPatterns.example: At Off state set both sensors to 0 for SlideSensorIllegalTimer seconds → verify no event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Conditional branch on sensor state during MechInit
verificationPatterns.example: If lift is down → Finish MI; if lift is not down → lift up, rotate until InPositionSensor=True, then Lift Down, go to last working position

verificationPatterns.pattern: Active responsiveness check in Run state
verificationPatterns.example: Revolver is active and responds to ink manager commands

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press continues printing despite fault signal until density threshold is crossed
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press continue to print until density drop to Exit Low

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence ordering check: assert earlier event occurs before later event within a command sequence
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Slide open before Tube Engage

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blocking-condition guard: verify motion does not start while inhibit flag is active
verificationPatterns.example: With TubeEmpty=True during Print, verify rotation doesn't start

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence trigger: verify multi-step sequence activates after replace flag set
verificationPatterns.example: Set Tube Replaced Flag to True; verify rotation sequence activated

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence order: verify each sub-step fires in declared order
verificationPatterns.example: PumpDisengage → CloseSlider → ExtractorUP → LiftValve(on) → EnableMotor → RevolverAtRotation → DisableMotor → LiftValve(off) → OpenSlider → TubeEngage → ExtractorDown

verificationPatterns.pattern: State cleanup: verify flag auto-clears to False after operation completes
verificationPatterns.example: After tube replace completion, TubeEmpty=False

verificationPatterns.pattern: BID station odd/even selection: odd-indexed BIDStations enabled, even disabled
verificationPatterns.example: BIDStation 1=True, BIDStation 2=False, BIDStation 3=True, BIDStation 4=False ... BIDStation 11=True, BIDStation 12=False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard status passes after print trigger
verificationPatterns.example: Wizard status = Passed

verificationPatterns.pattern: No DB results exist before commit
verificationPatterns.example: Press.IBL.Calibrations.ConcreteCalibrations.MachineLut.MachineLutCalibrationResultsEntity (empty before commit button pressed)

verificationPatterns.pattern: After commit, MachineLutCalibrationResultsEntity contains 20-point LUT per ink with DotAreaOutput[0]=0.0 and DotAreaOutput[19]=100.0
verificationPatterns.example: Result for Cyan: DotAreaOutput[0]=0.0 ... DotAreaOutput[19]=100.0 with non-linear intermediate values

verificationPatterns.pattern: Developer voltage during print = DeveloperCalibrationResultsEntity[ink].VDeveloper + ChargingEntity[station].DefaultT1Bias
verificationPatterns.example: MEStation[1].HW_Outputs.BID[1].BidHv.DeveloperVoltSet_v = DeveloperCalibrationResultsEntity[Black]->VDeveloper + ChargingEntity[1]->DefaultT1Bias

verificationPatterns.pattern: Electrode voltage during print = VElectrode * NomPartialInkDevelopment/100 + VElectrode + DeveloperVoltSet_v
verificationPatterns.example: MEStation[3].HW_Outputs.BID[1].BidHv.ElectrodeVoltSet_v = (ElectrodeCalibrationResultsEntity->VElectrode * InkEntity[Cyan]->NomPartialInkDevelopment/100) + ElectrodeCalibrationResultsEntity->VElectrode + DeveloperVoltSet_v

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dataserver formula cross-check: developerAbs and ElectrodeAbs match expected absolute values (e.g. 300/300, 100/200) for specific test points
verificationPatterns.example: 1. developerAbs=300; ElectrodeAbs=300  3. developerAbs=100; ElectrodeAbs=200

verificationPatterns.pattern: BID station odd/even selection check
verificationPatterns.example: BIDStation 1=True, BIDStation 2=False, BIDStation 3=True ... BIDStation 12=False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard status = Passed after print completes
verificationPatterns.example: Wizard status = Passed

verificationPatterns.pattern: No calibration results in DB before commit button pressed
