verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-step algorithm flow verification
verificationPatterns.example: Run calibration and verify algorithm flow matches expected: 1st step – rotate aSiD at printing speed, engage cleaning station and charge roller, enable PTE, enable CR transition bias and aSiD bias, LPH print solid 100% coverage (no T1/T2/BID), calculate Vlight from raw data averaged over at least 10 aSiD cycles

verificationPatterns.pattern: Transfer function acquisition with configurable sweep values
verificationPatterns.example: 2nd step – LPH off, BID engage with clear wet null voltages, T1 engage, operate CR at 4 predefined voltages (800, 900, 1000, 1100 V — configurable), measure Vbg per CR voltage over at least 10 aSiD cycles, calculate linear fit of Vbg vs Vcr

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration status + press message check
verificationPatterns.example: Calibration status = pass. Press message = calibration pass successfully.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard dismissal on finish
verificationPatterns.example: Press finish button; Auto bias wizard is closed.

verificationPatterns.pattern: DB persistence of calibration values
verificationPatterns.example: Auto bias calibration values were saved to DB.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Completion event with named parameter list
verificationPatterns.example: Event appears: auto bias calibration pass successfully. Parameters present: Vlight, VBg, station name, intercept, slope, ASID age, residual.

verificationPatterns.pattern: State regression on fault — PLC falls to Off after MI attempt
verificationPatterns.example: Go to Mech init in PLC and verify PLC fall to off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event persisted in DB after fault
verificationPatterns.example: Verify error event created in DB

verificationPatterns.pattern: Step sequence completeness and consistency check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify if all steps created as expected consistently

verificationPatterns.pattern: Out-of-range value triggers event and log
verificationPatterns.example: Override position value outside Engage range → Verify event + log

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC mode regression after failed mech init
verificationPatterns.example: Go to Mech init in PLC and verify PLC fall to off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event persisted in DB
verificationPatterns.example: Verify error event created in DB

verificationPatterns.pattern: Step sequence consistency check in DB
verificationPatterns.example: Verify if all steps created as expected consistently

verificationPatterns.pattern: EMS press triggers subsystem disengage
verificationPatterns.example: Press EMS while T1 at engage → Verify T1 disengage

verificationPatterns.pattern: Status unchanged while out-of-range override is active
verificationPatterns.example: verify AtEngage status doesn't change until override is not removed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout event raised when command cannot complete due to blocked sensor
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Timeout event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Disengage status unchanged while out-of-range override is active
verificationPatterns.example: verify AtDisEngage status doesn't change until override is not removed

verificationPatterns.pattern: MI sequence gate — assert MI passes before issuing operational commands
verificationPatterns.example: Step 1: MI → Verify MI sequence passed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequential multi-step MI order verification against SFR
verificationPatterns.example: Run MI CMD and verify sequence: 1. T1 service, 2. T1 engage, 3. T1 service, 4. T1 disengage, 5. MI completion + log (per SFR sec 2.3)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor override to inject failure and verify named error signal
verificationPatterns.example: Override T1 service sensor to cause failure; verify failure Blanket_service_position_error

verificationPatterns.pattern: Engage sensor override failure verification
verificationPatterns.example: Override T1 engage sensor to cause failure; verify failure Blanket_Engage_position_error

verificationPatterns.pattern: MI completion and log entry verification
verificationPatterns.example: After full sequence, verify MI completion event and log are recorded

verificationPatterns.pattern: Table-driven default value assertion — for each ink, verify both OD Target and Conductivity match the specified defaults
verificationPatterns.example: Cyan: OD Target=2, Conductivity=110 | Magenta: OD Target=2, Conductivity=110 | Yellow: OD Target=2, Conductivity=110 | Black: OD Target=2, Conductivity=110 | Premium White: OD Target=8.5, Conductivity=170 | Orange: OD Target=2, Conductivity=110

verificationPatterns.pattern: Differentiated defaults check — assert that specialty inks (Premium White) carry different baseline values than standard CMYK/Orange inks
verificationPatterns.example: Standard inks default to OD Target=2 and Conductivity=110; Premium White defaults to OD Target=8.5 and Conductivity=170

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary condition: value exactly at valid-low/valid-high limit triggers panic-low/panic-high event (not merely a valid-range event)
verificationPatterns.example: Change the value to be exactly valid low/valid high limit — verify panic low/high error event raised.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press/CVC transitions to OFF state on any error event
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press/CVC state changed to OFF (AtOFF signal = TRUE).

verificationPatterns.pattern: Output values match expected values from reference sheet after error
verificationPatterns.example: Verify outputs values are according to the excel sheet.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Info events do not change press/CVC state or outputs (non-disruptive path)
verificationPatterns.example: Verify info event raised; verify press/CVC state didn't change; verify outputs values didn't change.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blower speed value per press state
verificationPatterns.example: Off→not working; Standby→4915 (15%); GR→32767 (100%); Ready→16383 (50%); Print→32767 (100%); Post Print→16383 (50%); Service→0

verificationPatterns.pattern: CVC water pump on/off per press state
verificationPatterns.example: Off→not working; Standby/GR/Ready/Print/Post Print→5v; Service→not working (0v)

verificationPatterns.pattern: HX valve open/close per press state
verificationPatterns.example: Off (PLC restart)→closed (false); Standby→opened (true); GR/Ready/Print/Post Print→closed (false); Off (transition from Standby)→opened (true); Service→opened (true)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Exclusive state-status signal TRUE for active state
verificationPatterns.example: AtOFF=TRUE in Off; AtStandby=TRUE in Standby; AtReady=TRUE in Ready and Post Print; AtPrint=TRUE in Print; AtService=TRUE in Service

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration fails with correct event on invalid motor position
verificationPatterns.example: Set lph front motor engage position to 140000. Start focus calibration. Expected: Calibration failed with correct event.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Motor reverts to previous engage position after calibration failure
verificationPatterns.example: LPH motor back to previous engage position

verificationPatterns.pattern: Visual printout inspection for spatial centering
verificationPatterns.example: Check on the printout that the Focus is in the center of the job.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor value below valid range aborts calibration
verificationPatterns.example: Overwrite sensor value to 1000 during calibration → calibration failed with correct event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor value above valid range aborts calibration
verificationPatterns.example: Overwrite sensor value to 32000 during calibration → calibration failed with correct event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor disconnect during calibration aborts calibration
verificationPatterns.example: Disconnect sensor during Focus calibration → calibration failed with correct event

verificationPatterns.pattern: On calibration abort due to sensor fault, LPH recovers to pre-calibration engage position
verificationPatterns.example: All three fault conditions result in LPH back to previous engage position

verificationPatterns.pattern: Simultaneity check — two subsystem events must occur at the same time
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Trigger from ELC and LPH movement start in same time

verificationPatterns.pattern: Subset-only execution check — confirm only the defined (active) stations participate in the operation, not the full possible set
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that only defined stations performing calibration procedure.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Engage position changes after calibration value is applied
verificationPatterns.example: Verify engage position changed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Engage position and sensor value are approximately equal across different aSID angles (use trace to confirm)
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat test when focus calibration started on different asid angles. (Use trace) — Verify engage position and sensor value should be ~same

verificationPatterns.pattern: Changing calibration set position yields different best-focus value but same engage position and sensor value
verificationPatterns.example: On print out job the best value should be different from previous test. But engage position and sensor value should be ~same

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify signal value matches DB value via both DB and OPC UA channels
verificationPatterns.example: verify for two motors engage value (DB, OPC UA). Verify two motors engage position changed according to db value.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify all station motor positions match last calibration value after print job initiated from DFE
verificationPatterns.example: verify motor positions of all stations are in the correct focus position(according to last calibration)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Preprint sensor position check before learning runout
verificationPatterns.example: In preprint start learning runout procedure. Verify correct sensor position before start.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-learning calibration parameter verification (sensor position, amplitude, duty cycle)
verificationPatterns.example: After learning done start calibration procedure. Verify correct (or default or previous calibration) sensor position, correct amplitude and correct duty cycle.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-print motor return to previous engage position
verificationPatterns.example: In post print LPH motors back to previous engage position.

verificationPatterns.pattern: All phase state transitions verified via traces and logs
verificationPatterns.example: All states check with traces and logs.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Confirm learning initiated on all stations via trace and log
verificationPatterns.example: Verify learning started on all stations. Check it via trace and log.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Validate output data counts: samples, polynomes, and LUTs
verificationPatterns.example: Verify correct number of samples, polynomes and luts.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeatability check: re-run procedure and compare polynome values to previous run
verificationPatterns.example: Value of polynome should be near to previous value.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter propagation to PLC
verificationPatterns.example: Verify PLC get new params

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration executes with updated values
verificationPatterns.example: calibration doing according new value

verificationPatterns.pattern: LPH learning procedure activates during print and adjusts position
verificationPatterns.example: Verify during print LPH start learning procedure and then changing position according to default or last calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Visual focus quality difference observable on first printout
verificationPatterns.example: Verify different focus on print out job

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-station best value entered in UI, re-print confirms correct focus
verificationPatterns.example: On print out job choose best value for each station and put it to UI. Print again the job. Verify correct (good) focus on print out job.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary-reached error during calibration motion
verificationPatterns.example: Event error if during calibration motors reach to min/max cam not linear engage position

verificationPatterns.pattern: Out-of-threshold sensor alert during active operation
verificationPatterns.example: Info event if during print sensor value is not in threshold window

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event payload includes diagnostic triple: measured value, threshold, and actuator position
verificationPatterns.example: Info event should include sensor value, threshold value and motors position

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tracking active: sensor stable, engage position varies per runout
verificationPatterns.example: Verify sensor value should be ~ same / But engage position should be different.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tracking bypassed: engage position fixed, sensor value varies
verificationPatterns.example: Engage position should be same. / Sensor value should be different.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print quality degrades or stays same when tracking bypassed
verificationPatterns.example: Verify focus on printout is the same or worse than before.

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-transition disengage (Ready → SB)
verificationPatterns.example: LPH going from engage to disengage

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-motor sensor override via DB/OPC UA affects both motors
verificationPatterns.example: For two motors change engage sensor value (DB, OPC UA) to another value — verify two motors engage position changed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Single-motor sensor override is isolated to that motor only
verificationPatterns.example: Change only for one motor — only one motor engage position changed

verificationPatterns.pattern: New sensor value takes effect after disengage/engage or Off/MI-engage cycle
verificationPatterns.example: Perform disengage/engage, Off/MI-engage — motors engaging to new position

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibrated sensor position restored on print start (pre-print override is not persistent)
verificationPatterns.example: Before print change engage motor position. Start normal print — motor back to position according to calibrated sensor position

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify calibration executes with correct parameters at nominal engage
verificationPatterns.example: Asid at stand still. 15 engage positions around nominal focus. Correct sensor calibration step, time, delay after engage step before samples, number samples. Verify correct numbers of polynome and LUT.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify calibration fails with correct event when engage position is outside calibration window
verificationPatterns.example: During calibration sensor should reach to over calibration window. Calibration failed with correct event.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify calibration stops with fault when sensor reaches minimum distance safety threshold
verificationPatterns.example: Stop calibration with fault when sensor reach to min distance to Asid.

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition to SB after MI sequence completes
verificationPatterns.example: LPH state change to SB

verificationPatterns.pattern: Homing procedure executes and reaches disengage position via home sensor
verificationPatterns.example: Find home by home sensor and go to disengage position

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor calibration runs only on active sensors, skipped entirely when none active
verificationPatterns.example: Run sensor calibration procedure only on active sensors. After calibration done LPH going to disengage position

verificationPatterns.pattern: No calibration branch: MI completes to SB without calibration when all sensors inactive
verificationPatterns.example: after homing procedure LPH change state to SB wo calibration procedure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault during homing triggers correct event
verificationPatterns.example: Cause to fault on home during MI — Verify correct event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify named parameters equal expected scalar values
verificationPatterns.example: CsEngagePressureSampTime = 50, CsEngagePressureSampNum = 5, CsEngageMinPressure = 200, CsEngageMaxPressure = 900, CsEngagePressureSetpoint = 700, CsDisengagePressure = 50, CsEngageDuration = 50, CsDisengageDuration = 50, CsEngageSensorsOverlap = 100

verificationPatterns.pattern: After engage CMD: verify position reached, sensor ON, status At Engage, engage valves TRUE and disengage valves FALSE
verificationPatterns.example: Verify relevant CS reached engage position. Verify relevant engage sensor turned ON. Verify relevant CS status is At engage. OutEngageFrontValve=TRUE, OutEngageRearValve=TRUE, OutDisengageFrontValve=FALSE, OutDisengageRearValve=FALSE

verificationPatterns.pattern: After disengage CMD: verify position reached, sensor OFF, status At Disengage, disengage valves TRUE and engage valves FALSE
verificationPatterns.example: Verify relevant CS reached dis-engage position. Verify relevant CS engage sensor turned Off. Verify relevant CS status is At Disengage. OutEngageFrontValve=FALSE, OutEngageRearValve=FALSE, OutDisengageFrontValve=TRUE, OutDisengageRearValve=TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timed engage/disengage: send command, wait named duration constant, then verify sensor state
verificationPatterns.example: Do CS engage. Wait CsEngageDuration time. Verify CS engage sensor turned ON. Do CS disengage. Wait CsDisengageDuration time. Verify disengage sensor turned ON.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print state implies CS at engage
verificationPatterns.example: Be in Print state. Verify CS is at engage.

verificationPatterns.pattern: End print command triggers CS disengage
verificationPatterns.example: Send end print command. Verify CS is at disengage.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout-triggered failure event after sensor stays in wrong state
verificationPatterns.example: After CsEngageDuration time, event raised about CS_ENGAGE_FAILURE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout-triggered failure event for disengage sensor stuck false
verificationPatterns.example: After CsDisengageDuration time, an event raised about CS_DISENGAGE_FAILURE

verificationPatterns.pattern: CS status transitions to AT_OFF on any failure path
verificationPatterns.example: CS status changed to At OFF (all three steps share this expected outcome)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Hardware fault triggers event
verificationPatterns.example: Unplug motor encoder cable → verify event appeared

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify press is actively printing after setup
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press is printing

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify blanket stops at parking position after end-of-print
verificationPatterns.example: At the end of print Blanket Stops on parking position (AtParking = True)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify fault event raised on bad index sensor signal
verificationPatterns.example: Verify event raised - BLANKET_MISS_INDEX

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify PLC transitions to Ready state on fault
verificationPatterns.example: Verify PLC fell to Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Time-bounded stop verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify ITM stopped within 2.3 seconds.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Invalid pulse count triggers miss-index fault
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate 1/2 pulses of index reading → Verify event BLANKET_MISS_INDEX

verificationPatterns.pattern: Invalid pulse width (setpoint ± delta) triggers miss-index fault
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate 3 pulses each with width = setpoint width - 5 → Verify event BLANKET_MISS_INDEX

verificationPatterns.pattern: Over-wide single pulse (multi-pulse width) triggers miss-index fault
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate 1 pulse with width of 3 pulses → Verify event BLANKET_MISS_INDEX

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mixed invalid pulse widths trigger miss-index fault
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate 2 pulses: first width=1 pulse, second width=2 pulses → Verify event BLANKET_MISS_INDEX

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC transitions to Ready state after miss-index fault
verificationPatterns.example: Verify PLC changed to Ready state (all invalid-pulse steps)

verificationPatterns.pattern: AtParking signal asserts true after miss-index fault
verificationPatterns.example: Verify blanket AtParking signal is true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Relative position resets to 0 after AtParking de-asserts
verificationPatterns.example: Verify blanket relative position is 0 after AtParking = False

verificationPatterns.pattern: Index sensor noise is filtered — no spurious event
verificationPatterns.example: Randomly toggle index sensor false/true → Verify noise filtered and no event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Temperature stability across separations
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the Blanket temperature is not jump between separations

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify temperature set points track external lookup table during continuous print
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the blanket temperature set points and real blanket temperature Changes according to the external table

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify actual measured temperature follows set points derived from coverage-based table
verificationPatterns.example: real blanket temperature Changes according to the external table

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass activation verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify feature bypass works correct

verificationPatterns.pattern: Set point tracks external table per sensor
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the blanket temperature set point changes according to the external table for each IR blanket sensor

verificationPatterns.pattern: Actual temperature converges to new set point
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the Blanket temperature is according to new set point

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log and Event verification for torque boundary conditions (MIN and MAX)
verificationPatterns.example: Test MIN Torque during Calibration — Expected: Verify Log & Event; Test Max Torque during Calibration — Expected: Verify Log & Event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Override asid torque at non-process speed during GR to exercise off-nominal calibration path
verificationPatterns.example: Run calibration and override asid torque not at process speed (during GR)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequential resource arbitration: first BID reaching a shared state executes while the second waits for its completion
verificationPatterns.example: Test two BID needs to do pos optimization. The first BID that reach this state should start while the other BID wait for his complition.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Negative-path: assert calibration is blocked when precondition not met
verificationPatterns.example: try to run Mechanical Calib while BID is installed → Should fail to run the calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary torque check: verify MIN torque limit raises Log & Event
verificationPatterns.example: Test MIN Torque during Mech Calibration → Verify Log & Event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary torque check: verify MAX torque limit raises Log & Event
verificationPatterns.example: Test Max Torque during Mech Calibration → Verify Log & Event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Precondition gate: assert ink flow stabilized before proceeding
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Ink flow to BID is stabilized before starting the calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Override test during active motion phase: run calibration with asid torque overridden at non-process speed during GR
verificationPatterns.example: Run Semi engage calibration and override asid torque not at process speed (during GR)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Expected failure verification
verificationPatterns.example: Try to run Mechanical Calib while BID is installed — should fail to run the calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event and Log verification after action
verificationPatterns.example: verify Event & Log after calibration attempt fails

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary value verification — MIN
verificationPatterns.example: Test MIN Torque during Mech Calibration — Verify Log & Event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary value verification — MAX
verificationPatterns.example: Test Max Torque during Mech Calibration — Verify Log & Event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Motor failure triggers report to BID manager and logs
verificationPatterns.example: Verify failure report to BID manager+Logs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press and BID manager transition to OFF state on motor failure
verificationPatterns.example: press and BID manager fall to OFF (might be changed)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure reported to BID manager and captured in logs on timeout
verificationPatterns.example: Verify failure report to BID manager+Logs

verificationPatterns.pattern: System falls to Standby on motor timeout regardless of originating state
verificationPatterns.example: press and BID manager fall to Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout behavior is consistent across all three engagement transitions (SemiEngage, Engage, Disengage)
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 1-3 each repeat the same expected outcome for a different CMD

verificationPatterns.pattern: Motor state verification at each command transition
verificationPatterns.example: Verify motor at off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-motor position confirmation after engage commands
verificationPatterns.example: Verify both motor reached position

verificationPatterns.pattern: Full engage cycle coverage: Off → MI → Semi-Engage → Engage → Dis-Engage
verificationPatterns.example: Semi engage CMD → Engage CMD → Dis-Engage, each verified with position check

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify motor acceleration profile shape/values
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the acceleration profile of the BID engage motors

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event raised on dancer position threshold breach during UW Ready state
verificationPatterns.example: change dancer position to <10 during UW Ready state → An event about web wrap in UW raised.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event raised on dancer position threshold breach during RW Ready state
verificationPatterns.example: change dancer position to <10 during RW Ready state → An event about web wrap in RW raised.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-axis status enumeration after state transition
verificationPatterns.example: After Mechinit done: PLC manager=AtStandby, UW=AtReady, FP/PTR=AtStandby, FI/FE=AtGearInMultiMaster, WHS=AtStandby, buffer=AtStandby, IPE=AtStandby, RW=AtReady

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mechinit success check under boundary dancer position
verificationPatterns.example: Change UW dancer position to maximum/minimum, do Mechinit — Mechinit passed, PLC manager status is AtStandby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mechinit success check under boundary roll diameter
verificationPatterns.example: Change UW/RW diameter to minimum/maximum, do Mechinit — Mechinit passed, PLC manager status is AtStandby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Axis state isolation — changing one axis to OFF must not affect other axes
verificationPatterns.example: Only UW/RW axis changed to OFF state.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Roll jog in OFF state — jog direction and speed match button input
verificationPatterns.example: UW/RW roll jogged in proper speed/direction according to roll jog button.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Arm movement in OFF state — arm direction matches button input
verificationPatterns.example: UW/RW arms lowered/raised according to the button.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Motor power-on failure triggers named error event
verificationPatterns.example: fail 'power on' of FI motor (unplug power/communication cable) in OFF state and do Mechinit → An event about FI motor error should appear

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor-forced failure triggers subsystem error event
verificationPatterns.example: fail the trolley unit Mechinit by forcing the edge sensors → An event about buffer motor error should appear

verificationPatterns.pattern: Homing failure includes motor ID and side (front/rear) in error event
verificationPatterns.example: fail homing of impressions engage motors during Mechinit by moving the hard stop → An event about impression engage motors lag error should appear with correct motor ID and side (front/rear)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-axis status check after print start
verificationPatterns.example: PLC manager status is AtPrint; UW axis status is AtReady; PTR axis status is AtStandby; FI/FE/FP axes status are AtGearInMultiMaster; WHS axis is at AtPrint; buffer axis status is AtPrint; IPE axis status is AtPrint; RW status is AtReady.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-axis status check after stop print
verificationPatterns.example: PLC manager status is AtReady; UW axis status is AtReady; FP/PTR axes status are AtStandby; FE/FI axes status are AtGearInMultiMaster; WHS axis is at AtStandby; buffer axis status is AtReady; IPE axis status is AtStandby; RW status is AtReady.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequential axis status verification after error-induced stop
verificationPatterns.example: Verify FP and buffer axes are AtStandby; verify IPE transitions through AtDisEngage then reaches AtStandby.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stop-during-mid-command verification
verificationPatterns.example: Click stop print button during impression engage command/status; verify press stopped correctly and all axes are AtStandby status.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dancer-position threshold triggers web break event
verificationPatterns.example: Change dancer position to >90 during Ready state → event raised with dancer position value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Load-cell percentage threshold triggers web break event
verificationPatterns.example: Change FI/FE load cell value to <20% of set tension value → event raised with load cell value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Web break drives all axes to AtOFF
verificationPatterns.example: After any web break event (UW, RW, FI nip, FE nip) → all axes AtOFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event carries the triggering sensor value as payload
verificationPatterns.example: Web break event raised with dancer position value / load cell value (not just a boolean flag)

verificationPatterns.pattern: All major axes/subsystems reach AtOFF after state transition
verificationPatterns.example: PLC manager status is AtOFF; UW axis status is AtOFF; FI/FE/FP/PTR axes status are AtOFF; WHS axis is at AtOFF; buffer axis status is AtOFF; IPE axis status is AtOFF; RW status is AtOFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Enumerate each axis individually to confirm no axis is left in a non-OFF state
verificationPatterns.example: a. PLC manager b. UW c. FI/FE/FP/PTR d. WHS e. buffer f. IPE g. RW — each checked separately

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-axis status sweep after state transition
verificationPatterns.example: PLC manager status is AtStandby; UW axis status is AtReady; FI/FE axis status is AtGearInMultiMaster; FP/PTR axis status is AtStandby; WHS axis is AtStandby; buffer axis status is AtStandby; IPE axis status is AtStandby; RW status is AtReady.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dynamic speed change verification during SWF run
verificationPatterns.example: Change SWF speed during SWF run — expected: SWF speed should be changed on the fly.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Paper motion and line speed verification at SWF start and stop
verificationPatterns.example: Do SWF — paper should move, line speed updated. Stop SWF — paper should stop, line speed should be 0.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Click-and-hold a slow unwind button and verify the roll rotates slowly in the clockwise direction
verificationPatterns.example: Click and hold UW slow unwind button. Verify UW roll rotates slowly, and in clock wise direction.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Click-and-hold a slow rewind button and verify the roll rotates slowly in the counter-clockwise direction
verificationPatterns.example: Click and hold UW slow rewind button. Verify UW roll rotates slowly and in counterclock wise direction.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat the slow unwind/rewind direction checks symmetrically for both UW and RW units
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 3–4 mirror steps 1–2 exactly for the RW roll, confirming the same speed and direction contract on both web units.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Safety HW disables critical actuators on interlock open
verificationPatterns.example: Safety HW shall disable electrode voltage and drum motor.

verificationPatterns.pattern: State machine falls to SERVICE from any operational state
verificationPatterns.example: PRINTING state: stop printing on sheet and fall to SERVICE. In GR: stop GR and fall to SERVICE. In READY or STB states: fall to SERVICE.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dependent subsystem is disabled on interlock open
verificationPatterns.example: Filter pump shall be disabled.

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI reflects interlock open condition
verificationPatterns.example: UI shall display that interlock is open.

verificationPatterns.pattern: User is notified via event on interlock open
verificationPatterns.example: Issue event to the user.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Both-drum symmetry: two-drum results must match single-drum baseline
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat all tests to both drums; result should be as for one drum

verificationPatterns.pattern: EFS failure propagation: any EFS failure must shut off both drums including rotation and HV
verificationPatterns.example: For each test perform and require EFS failure, verify that both EFS drums turned off (including rotation & HV)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Delayed error event on physical fault — wait configured delay then raise named IMO event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cooling case verification — after confirming fault-triggered state transition, verify corresponding cooling behavior
verificationPatterns.example: Verify cooling cases for 1-3.

verificationPatterns.pattern: State matrix repetition — repeat the full threshold × cooling matrix for each press operating state
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat 1-4 for Pre-print. Repeat 1-4 for Print.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timed deactivation after dependency off — verify a subsystem deactivates after a configured delay once its dependency is turned off
verificationPatterns.example: Verify AK turns off AkDeactivateTimeDelay after EH (blanket heating) turns off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-unit set point assignment — set a distinct set point on each unit and verify each unit adopts its own value
verificationPatterns.example: Set different set point to each AK; verify each AK receives its assigned set point

verificationPatterns.pattern: Runtime parameter change reflected in output — change a set point mid-operation and verify the corresponding physical output responds
verificationPatterns.example: During print, change AK set point; verify voltage changed accordingly

verificationPatterns.pattern: Safety interlock blocks activation — attempt to activate a subsystem while a safety condition is violated and verify both rejection and a log entry identifying the source
verificationPatterns.example: Try to activate AK with hood open; verify AK doesn't work and log contains the hood number

verificationPatterns.pattern: Subsystem transitions to standby/ready state conditioned on previous state
verificationPatterns.example: drying subsystem (and press) will go to standby/ready according to previous state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-unit health metrics enumeration
verificationPatterns.example: Verify each blower has Current/Torque monitoring, RPM monitoring, and Internal errors

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault simulation triggers subsystem stop and produces event + log entry
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate AK blower overheat → Blanket heating stop + event+log

verificationPatterns.pattern: Out-of-valid-range value raises named failure and transitions subsystem to OFF
verificationPatterns.example: Set pressure value out of valid range → failure BLANKET_AK_PRESSURE_INVALID raised, drying system goes to OFF + logs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Out-of-panic-range value raises directional panic failure codes (HIGH / LOW pair)
verificationPatterns.example: Set pressure value out of panic range → BLANKET_AK_PRESSURE_PANIC_HIGH / BLANKET_AK_PRESSURE_PANIC_LOW raised

verificationPatterns.pattern: Monitor bypass suppresses out-of-range failures when enabled
verificationPatterns.example: Set value outside valid range with bypass ON → verify no failure appears

verificationPatterns.pattern: All preconditions met → feature activates
verificationPatterns.example: Blanket at process speed + suction pressure in panic range + upper hood closed → blanket heating is active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Single precondition violation → timeout event + log generated
verificationPatterns.example: Blanket not reached process speed → verify timeout event + log

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event and log must include hardware identifier of failing component
verificationPatterns.example: Upper hood not closed → verify event/log includes hood's number; pressure sensor outside panic range → verify event/log includes sensor's number

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ordered sub-step execution
verificationPatterns.example: Verify steps fire in exact order: activate CS drive → open IMO line valve → wait flow stabilization → check flow threshold → engage CS & activate ImoTempControl

verificationPatterns.pattern: Flow threshold gate
verificationPatterns.example: Verify ImoFlow>MinFlowForTempControl before proceeding to engage CS & ImoTempControl

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition gating — state changes only after full sequence completion
verificationPatterns.example: Verify only when sequence finished - state changed to AtFreeWetting

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event assertion on safety/status signal false transition
verificationPatterns.example: Verify event - CS_NOT_IN_PLACE.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state regression to OFF on critical input loss
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press fell to OFF state.

verificationPatterns.pattern: IO override mid-state to test runtime signal change (not just startup)
verificationPatterns.example: During Ready/Standby/GR, override CS in place IO and change it to false.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify AT OFF status propagates to CS Manager and all sub-components
verificationPatterns.example: Verify CS manager and all components below status At OFF is TRUE.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify ordered shutdown sequence from GR-Wetting state
verificationPatterns.example: 1. Close IMO valve  2. Disengage CS  3. Stop CS rotation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify ordered shutdown sequence from GR-Free Wetting state (no CS disengage step)
verificationPatterns.example: 1. Close IMO valve  2. Stop CS rotation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cover multiple initial states to confirm transition-to-OFF behavior is state-dependent
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat OFF command from Ready/Standby (no sequence), GR-Wetting (3-step), GR-Free Wetting (2-step)

verificationPatterns.pattern: AtOFF status check on manager and all sub-components
verificationPatterns.example: Verify CS manager and all components below status At OFF is TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mechinit command propagation — verify manager forwards command to every sub-component
verificationPatterns.example: Verify CS Manager sends Mechinit command to all components

verificationPatterns.pattern: AtStandby status transition after CS engage and rotation finishes MI
verificationPatterns.example: Verify after CS engage, CS rotation finished MI, the CS manager AtStandby status changed to TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter table assertion — verify each parameter's name, unit, default value, and Local/Imported source against a reference table
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the rotation parameters for PP are same as the table below: |CsWrSetSpeed|RPM|160|Imported|

verificationPatterns.pattern: Import-source classification check — confirm which parameters are marked Imported vs Local
verificationPatterns.example: CsRollerTorqueAvg|msec|50|Local vs CsWrSetSpeed|RPM|160|Imported

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-transition-on-fault: out-of-range sensor value during active state forces subsystem to Standby
verificationPatterns.example: Set CS imo flow below CsImoMinFlow → Verify CS changed to Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault-event with current/expected values: each range violation raises a named event carrying both the actual value and the threshold
verificationPatterns.example: Verify an event raised about CS_IMO_LOW_FLOW with current/expected values; Verify an event raised about CS_IMO_HIGH_FLOW with current/expected values

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-gated suppression: same out-of-range condition in a non-active state (Ready) must produce no transition and no event
verificationPatterns.example: Be in Ready state and set CS imo flow above/below min/max → Verify press stayed at Ready state and no event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ordered action sequence after command
verificationPatterns.example: 1. Activate CS drive  2. Open IMO line valve

verificationPatterns.pattern: Component disengagement on state transition
verificationPatterns.example: When moving from wetting to freewetting status CS is disengaged

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-dependent sequence branching
verificationPatterns.example: Wetting includes Disengage CS step; FreeWetting omits it — verify correct subset per source state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Final state assertion after transition
verificationPatterns.example: Verify CS Manager at Standby state after sequence completes

verificationPatterns.pattern: DB event creation on panic IO trigger
verificationPatterns.example: Set IO to the panic value → Verify event created in DB

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC state recovery after IO reset
verificationPatterns.example: Set IO to default value → Verify PLC fall to ready state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Enumerate multiple panic fault codes under a single test flow
verificationPatterns.example: INK_TEMPERATURE_OVERHEAT, INK_LEVEL_TOO_HIGH_DURING_INK_SUPPLY, INK_DENSITY_TOO_LOW_FOR_PRINT, INK_CONDUCTIVITY_TOO_LOW each exercised via the same inject-verify-restore loop

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC state regression on failure
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Plc fall to standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure event persisted in DB
verificationPatterns.example: Verify conductivityTimeoutEventName created in DB

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC fallback to standby on failure
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Plc fall to standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: DB event creation at correct timing
verificationPatterns.example: Verify levelFirstPrepEventName created in DB

verificationPatterns.pattern: Component status all-off after PLC off-state transition
verificationPatterns.example: Verify ink statuses at off state after PLC falls to off state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wait for system to reach target state
verificationPatterns.example: Wait for ready state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert all Ink sub-component AtOFF/AtOff flags are True after BID manager failure
verificationPatterns.example: Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.Station[2].Comp.arrBid[1].Ink.Main.Out.Status.AtOFF=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify failure propagates across every Ink functional layer (Main, Rdu, Cond, Temp, Level)
verificationPatterns.example: arrBid[1].Ink.Main ... Ink.Rdu ... Ink.Cond ... Ink.Temp ... Ink.Level all AtOFF=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wait for failure event enqueue after Get Ready
verificationPatterns.example: Enqueue event INK_FAILED_TO_ADD_CD from INK_2_Stn_1, FlowID 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Return press to stable state after fault verification
verificationPatterns.example: Press go to Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inject out-of-range SimValue to breach a panic threshold
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[2].HW_Inputs.INK[1].Temp.Tank_Temperature.SimValue=3600 (above panic high)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify named fault event is raised after threshold breach
verificationPatterns.example: Verify event: INK_TEMPERATURE_OVERHEAT

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify press state transitions to Ready following a panic fault
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Press go to Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Step sim value above threshold, wait, verify system transitions state
verificationPatterns.example: Level=11000 (above levelGRStartSetpoint) → wait 10s → system progresses toward Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequential multi-parameter injection with fixed inter-step delay
verificationPatterns.example: Between each step wait 10 seconds; inject Level, Temperature, Conductivity, Density in ordered sequence

verificationPatterns.pattern: Extended wait after critical threshold crossing
verificationPatterns.example: After Level=16000, wait 25 seconds before next step (Conductivity=11000)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Release sim override at end of sequence to confirm final state
verificationPatterns.example: After all sim steps, release level override; expected: Press goes to Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold awareness: set value above a named setpoint signal to trigger state gate
verificationPatterns.example: Level=11000 should be above Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.Station[2].Comp.arrBid[1].Ink.Level.In.Par.Local.levelGRStartSetpoint

verificationPatterns.pattern: Speed command transitions to atProcessSpeed on printFree
verificationPatterns.example: Bid rotation gets process_speed cmd moves to atProcessSpeed

verificationPatterns.pattern: HV subsystem stays at prior state (no change on printFree)
verificationPatterns.example: bid HV remains at standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ink subsystem stays at prior state (no change on printFree)
verificationPatterns.example: ink remains at ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Rotation responds to speed command and transitions to atProcessSpeed
verificationPatterns.example: Bid rotation gets process_speed cmd and moves to atProcessSpeed status

verificationPatterns.pattern: Engage sub-component remains unchanged (disengage) during free run
verificationPatterns.example: bid engage remains at disengage

verificationPatterns.pattern: HV sub-component remains unchanged (standby) during free run
verificationPatterns.example: bid HV remains at standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ink sub-component remains unchanged (ready) during free run
verificationPatterns.example: ink remains at ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Only targeted subsystem receives command; status transitions accordingly
verificationPatterns.example: only ink gets cmd getReady and status changes to atGetReady

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ink manager enters expected operational state
verificationPatterns.example: ink manager enters print

verificationPatterns.pattern: BID rotation receives process speed value
verificationPatterns.example: bid rotation receives process speed

verificationPatterns.pattern: BID engage sequences through semi-engage-calib phase
verificationPatterns.example: bid engage get semi engage calib

verificationPatterns.pattern: Uninvolved subcomponent receives null (no command)
verificationPatterns.example: bid HV gets null

verificationPatterns.pattern: BID engage advances to engage optimization phase
verificationPatterns.example: bid engage gets engage optimization

verificationPatterns.pattern: Manager status gates on dependent subsystem readiness
verificationPatterns.example: manager at status atGetReady; once ink is ready status of manager changes to atReady

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sub-component AtMI then MIPassed sequence
verificationPatterns.example: Verify engage goes to status atMI and then MIpassed for both BIDs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ink three-state MI sequence: AtMechInit → MechInitDone → AtStdBy
verificationPatterns.example: Verify ink goes to atMechinit, then to mechInitDone and then AtStdBy

verificationPatterns.pattern: Manager waits for all sub-components before transitioning: MIPassed then AtStdBy
verificationPatterns.example: Once all above BID components finished MI, verify BID mgr status is MIPassed and then AtStdBy

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault injection via IOS input forced to False triggers PLC OFF and system event with correct ID
verificationPatterns.example: Change BidFiInPlace.Value to False and perform MI; verify PLC fell to OFF state and event appeared about BID[X] not in place with correct station/BID ID

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-transition check on Main status after command
verificationPatterns.example: After get ready: Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.Station[X].Comp.arrBid[1].Main.Out.Status.AtGetReady == true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parallel sub-component check — verify both Main and HV reach same state
verificationPatterns.example: After print: check arrBid[1].HV.Out.Status.AtPrint AND arrBid[1].Main.Out.Status.AtPrint

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameterized station sweep — repeat all signal checks with Station[X] for X in 1..6
verificationPatterns.example: Replace X with 1-6 in all signal paths for full station coverage

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-instance array check — verify both arrBid[1] and arrBid[2] at each step
verificationPatterns.example: arrBid[1].Main.Out.Status.AtGetReady and arrBid[2].Main.Out.Status.AtGetReady both verified

verificationPatterns.pattern: Command triggers state transition — verify status field reflects new state
verificationPatterns.example: bid HV gets dryBid cmd → status changes to atDryBid

verificationPatterns.pattern: Command triggers downstream sub-system action — verify sub-system reaches expected state
verificationPatterns.example: ink manager gets postPrintDrain cmd → ink eventually moves to ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timed delay before next command — verify state transitions after delay written in requirements
verificationPatterns.example: HV gets stdby cmd after delay written in req → status changes to atStdby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stop command halts rotation — verify status reflects stopped state
verificationPatterns.example: bid rotation gets stop cmd → status changes to atStdby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault injection via import parameter override — verify sequence continues despite error
verificationPatterns.example: Set gInterface.Station[1].arrBid[1].Engage.In.Par.Import.PosTargetTimeOut to T#0.001s to prevent BID reaching disengage; sequence must continue

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-signal AtOFF sweep: after state command, verify every sub-component's AtOFF/AtOff signal across all station and BID index combinations
verificationPatterns.example: Kedem_Sim_QA.OCB.gInterface.Station[X].Comp.arrBid[Y].Main.Out.Status.AtOFF = True, ...Engage.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = True, etc. for X=1-6, Y=1,2

verificationPatterns.pattern: Hierarchical sub-component coverage: assert OFF state on Main, Engage, Rotation, HV, and Ink control layers independently
verificationPatterns.example: arrBid[Y].Engage.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff, arrBid[Y].Rotation.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOFF, arrBid[Y].HV.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff, arrBid[Y].Ink.Main.Out.Status.AtOFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify availability table in baseline state
verificationPatterns.example: verify availability table is correct

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify availability after state transition sequence
verificationPatterns.example: change state to get ready and then printSync; verify availability is correct

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify availability degraded by ink tank fault
verificationPatterns.example: perform ink tank not in place; verify availability is affected due to this

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify availability degraded by BID hardware fault
verificationPatterns.example: perform bid not in place; verify availability is affected due to this

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify DFE disconnected state
verificationPatterns.example: dfe disconnected

verificationPatterns.pattern: Perform DFE-side operations (e.g. substrate editing) after disconnect to confirm they are isolated
verificationPatterns.example: Make some operations in DFE side such as substrate editing — editing done

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify no notifications appear in console after disconnect (unsubscribe succeeded)
verificationPatterns.example: Verify notification regarding this changes NOT appeared in the console Console — UnSubscribe to notifications succeeded

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify UI label reflecting DFE connection is absent
verificationPatterns.example: Verify dfe connected label not exists in UI — label not exist

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify dependent operations fail gracefully when DFE is disconnected
verificationPatterns.example: import job failed - no press connected

verificationPatterns.pattern: Communication loss with BIM causes all components to deactivate
verificationPatterns.example: create no communication with BIM → verify components go to deactivate state

verificationPatterns.pattern: BID engage error during pre-print moves components to standby and starts dry BID sequence
verificationPatterns.example: during pre print create bid engage error → verify components move to standby, verify dry bid sequence is started

verificationPatterns.pattern: High temperature fault during ready state moves components to standby
verificationPatterns.example: create during ready high temperature → verify components move to standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: BID motor error during print triggers post-print completion before dry BID sequence
verificationPatterns.example: create during print bid motor error → verify post print is done and then dry bid

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify UI label presence after DFE connection
verificationPatterns.example: 'Connected.' label appeared in press UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify UI label absence after DFE disconnection
verificationPatterns.example: Label not exists after press unmapped from DFE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state after connectivity loss
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press fall to ready — Expected: Press fall to ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event log entry for connectivity change
verificationPatterns.example: Verify DFE disconnected event existence — Expected: event exists

verificationPatterns.pattern: Connectivity restore confirmation
verificationPatterns.example: Connect DFE — Expected: DFE connected

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI label presence check for connectivity state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify dfe connected label exists in UI — Expected: Label exists

verificationPatterns.pattern: Job end-to-end flow verification via Kedem UI
verificationPatterns.example: Import job, then verify job appeared in Kedem UI — Expected: job appeared

verificationPatterns.pattern: WebSocket creation check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Web Socket created to the connected DFE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Console notification subscription check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify notification appeared in the console such as dfe connection and substrate editing Web Console — Subscribe to notifications succeeded

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-instance addition verification
verificationPatterns.example: Add several DFE's to the same press → All press were added

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bidirectional mapping verification — confirm mapping from both sides (press side and DFE side)
verificationPatterns.example: Map DFE to press PEX → verify from DFE side that DFE is mapped

verificationPatterns.pattern: Source routing verification — confirm job originates from the expected source after mapping
verificationPatterns.example: Import job and verify job imported from the correct DFE

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI error on state transition timeout
verificationPatterns.example: error in UI about state transition timeout with the postprint state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Subsystem leader-first ordering
verificationPatterns.example: Main Manager changes state to post-print before other subsystems

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dependent subsystem ordering within group
verificationPatterns.example: T2 Manager changes state to post-print before Blanket Manager

verificationPatterns.pattern: Phase exit transition
verificationPatterns.example: When Main Manager finishes post-print it changes state to ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-component command receipt and immediate status check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify CVC, IMO, Web got post print command and their out status are AtPostPrint

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition gated on upstream disengage notification (T2)
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Blanket moved to AtPostPrint only after T2 disengage notification has been raised

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition gated on upstream disengage notification (T1)
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Station manager moved to AtPostPrint only after T1 disengage notification has been raised

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parent component state advances only after all children complete
verificationPatterns.example: After Station, blanket, web, CVC, IMO finished post print, PLC manager state changed to Ready state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event presence in Press UI
verificationPatterns.example: event exist

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event content validation — check Event_ID, UI description (from attached excel), 'What to do' field, and Timestamp; extra params in DB or log
verificationPatterns.example: event appeared with it's relevant content

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event persistence on main screen bottom bar
verificationPatterns.example: event exist [at bottom of main screen]

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ignore/dismiss event action closes event window
verificationPatterns.example: event ignored- event window closed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Single simulated event appears in grid
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate some error event and remember his id and description — event simulated and exists in UI grid

verificationPatterns.pattern: Grid enforces per-page maximum (20)
verificationPatterns.example: 20 events appeares in the first grid page

verificationPatterns.pattern: Overflow paginates to next page
verificationPatterns.example: 2nd page exists with 1 event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Capture PC timestamp before simulation as expected arrival time anchor
verificationPatterns.example: Step 1/3/5: Get PC time → Current time saved

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify event severity label matches event type (warning / info / error)
verificationPatterns.example: CS_NOT_IN_PLACE → warning event; INK_TEMPERATURE_TOO_HIGH → Info event; INK_CONDUCTIVITY_TOO_LOW → Error event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify event message body matches SE Document spec including SubsystemID placeholder
verificationPatterns.example: Info: 'The temperature in [SubsystemID] is too high to enable print'; Error: '[SubsystemID] conductivity is too low'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify event list order is newest-on-top (descending arrival time)
verificationPatterns.example: Step 7: Events order will be by their arrival time - upper event is the newest one

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event fields verification on press UI
verificationPatterns.example: Description = 'DFE [DFE_ID] controller has disconnected'; Parameters = 'Subsystem: XX'; What To Do = As defines in the SE Events Definitions; Timestamp taken from SE Solution (events)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state change after fault
verificationPatterns.example: Press stopped printing and fell to ready after DFE disconnect

verificationPatterns.pattern: Recovery verification after reconnect
verificationPatterns.example: Connect DFE; verify DFE connected

verificationPatterns.pattern: Motor homing failure → PLC falls to OFF + named error event
verificationPatterns.example: Fail front home motor → 'PLC fell to OFF state' + 'error about tension front motor homing failed'

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition sets correct tension setpoint
verificationPatterns.example: Standby: tension equals StandbyTensionSetPoint; after GR: tensioner builds PrintTensionSetPoint and activates tension control

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tension control algorithm convergence: actual tension moves toward set tension
verificationPatterns.example: Change BktSetTension by ±10N → verify actual tension changed and got closer to set tension

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tension control delayed until N blanket revolutions in print
verificationPatterns.example: Ready/Print at 500N → tension control algorithm fixes tension only after 3 blanket revolutions

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tension panic (low or high) → PLC OFF + named event with actual/expected values
verificationPatterns.example: Set Win_TensionErr=30, force actual=269 → BLANKET_TENSION_PANIC_LOW; force actual=331 → BLANKET_TENSION_PANIC_HIGH

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tension convergence timeout → PLC OFF + event with actual tension and elapsed time
verificationPatterns.example: Force tension outside working window for BlanketTensionConvergeTime → BLANKET_TENSION_CONTROL_FAILURE with actual tension and time

verificationPatterns.pattern: Front/rear tension variance exceeds threshold → PLC OFF + named event with actual/expected
verificationPatterns.example: Change only front actual tension outside FrntRearTensionVar → BLANKET_TENSION_HIGH_VARIANCE with actual/expected values

verificationPatterns.pattern: High tension at Mechinit → PLC OFF + named event with actual and expected tension values
verificationPatterns.example: Tension above MaxTensionAtMechinit before Mechinit → BLANKET_HIGH_TENSION_AT_MECHINIT with actual and expected tension

verificationPatterns.pattern: EM stop from active state → tensioner returns to OFF status
verificationPatterns.example: Send EM stop from Ready state → tensioner at OFF status

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service state → tensioner motors move to service position
verificationPatterns.example: Change to Service state → tensioner front/rear go to service position (-15000)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal boolean check per press state transition
verificationPatterns.example: Verify prg_BktLat_EdgeController.fbBktLat_EdgeController.Enable = FALSE in Standby/Service/OFF, TRUE in GR/Ready/Print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Homing completion + post-home position check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify homing in lateral axes is done; verify lateral axes go to zero position after homing

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sensor unplug → event raised with correct component/sensor ID
verificationPatterns.example: Unplug front/rear home sensor, do Mechinit, verify event raised with correct motor/sensor ID (real press only)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Motion parameter corruption → fail-path event check
verificationPatterns.example: Change acceleration/deceleration to 10 to force Mechinit failure; verify event raised with correct component

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault injection → event raised + state change to OFF
verificationPatterns.example: Force edge sensor to FALSE → verify BLANKET_EDGE_NOT_DETECTED event and state changed to OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Out-of-limit position → event with current/expected values + state change to OFF
verificationPatterns.example: Set EdgeCtrlPar_ref.EdgePosMon.LimitMin to 20000; verify BLANKET_LATERAL_OUT_OF_LIMIT event with current/expected position and state changed to OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cyclic sensor behavior in print state (requires attachment reference)
verificationPatterns.example: In print state, verify edge sensor is changing in cyclic way (see attachment)

verificationPatterns.pattern: State propagates to all child components — when manager enters a state, every component beneath it must reflect that same state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify blanket manager state is At Standby. Verify all components below blanket manager also At Standby.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ordered sub-step sequence (a, b, c…) verifies correct orchestration order within a single transition
verificationPatterns.example: a. Tensioner got Mechinit command. b. T1 got Mechinit command. c. ITM got Mechinit command.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parallel execution block — verify multiple actions happen simultaneously rather than in sequence
verificationPatterns.example: Verify the following happens in parallel: 1. Turn off lateral movement control (status = AtService). 2. Turn off blanket temperature control and air knifes. 3. Verify T1 disengaging to service position.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Safety-gate engage/disengage — engaging element only when a safety flag is TRUE, disengaging when FALSE
verificationPatterns.example: Verify when AtGetReady_T1_AtEngage = TRUE, ArrBr[1...6] status is AtEngage = TRUE; when AtGetReady_T1_AtEngage = FALSE, ArrBr[1...6] status is AtDisengage = TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tension component state triplet — correct pair of tension status booleans is asserted per press state
verificationPatterns.example: Standby: AtBldStandbyTen = TRUE, TenMonActive = TRUE. GetReady/Ready: AtBldPrcssTen = TRUE, TenMonActive = TRUE. Print: AtPrntTen = TRUE, TenMonActive = TRUE.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Lateral velocity factor gate — BktVelFact value encodes lateral control mode (0 = standstill, 1 = active)
verificationPatterns.example: Verify lateral component is at Standstill (prg_BktLat_EdgeController.fbBktLat_EdgeController.BktVelFact = 0)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Drying-off delay guard — blanket rotation must not stop until the drying-off delay has elapsed
verificationPatterns.example: Wait blanket drying off delay. Verify blanket rotation is off.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Air knife activation paired with print temperature control — both must be active together during print, both deactivated together on exit
verificationPatterns.example: Activate blanket temperature control. Activate both air knifes: gInterface.BKT.Comp.Temperature.AK_Comp[1&2].Out.Status.Activated = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: ITM sync-to-blanket-velocity assertion during run states — AtRun alone is insufficient; AtRun_AtSyncToBktV must also be TRUE
verificationPatterns.example: Verify ITM statuses: AtRun = TRUE, AtRun_AtSyncToBktV = TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-off verification: all outputs inactive
verificationPatterns.example: OFF → Expected: All is off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Proportional valve hold on state switch: valve retains last value across any state transition
verificationPatterns.example: MI → Expected: The proportional valve stay at the same value. this suppose to happen on every state switch

verificationPatterns.pattern: State sequence cycling back to OFF: traverse Standby→OFF→service→Ready→Post Print→Standby and expect OFF behavior
verificationPatterns.example: Standby, Go to OFF, service, Ready, Post Print, Go to standby → Expected: Off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Active state verification during print sequence: temp control activates through Get Ready→Pre-print→Print
verificationPatterns.example: Get Ready, Pre-print, print → Expected: Active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Valid-range press-operation check
