verificationPatterns.pattern: PID output tracks temperature change
verificationPatterns.example: After changing IMO temperature, verify PID result changes

verificationPatterns.pattern: Valve state follows PID output
verificationPatterns.example: After PID result changes, verify valve opens or closes accordingly

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic threshold breach → named event + log + press goes to standby
verificationPatterns.example: Set IMO above CsImoTempWorkingPanicHigh and below CsImoTempWorkingValidHigh → verify IMO_MAINLINE_TEMP_PANIC_HIGH + log; press should go to standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Valid-range threshold breach → named event + log (no standby required)
verificationPatterns.example: Set IMO above CsImoTempWorkingValidHigh → verify IMO_MAINLINE_TEMP_INVALID_LOW + log

verificationPatterns.pattern: Formula verification: assert computed value matches formula (lowest ASID set point − constant)
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Set point calculation (lowest Asid's set point-const)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dynamic recalculation: mutate one input below current minimum, assert output updates accordingly
verificationPatterns.example: Change one of the asid set point to lower then was before → Verify set point changed accordingly

verificationPatterns.pattern: EM console error message on node failure
verificationPatterns.example: Verify an error appeared in EM console - ping to element 'Bls' failed. Process should be restarted.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Auto-restart attempt within 120-second window
verificationPatterns.example: Verify EM tries to restart the process for 120 seconds.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Manual restart escalation after 120-second timeout
verificationPatterns.example: If it fails after this time - an error should be raised to the user to restart the process manually.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print job continuity unaffected during process restart
verificationPatterns.example: Verify press is printing and didn't affected from the process restart.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Hardware disconnect causes state transition to OFF
verificationPatterns.example: Unplug PLC communication cable or disable internal network adapter in Standby state — Verify PLC fell to OFF state.

verificationPatterns.pattern: @ signal emitted in EM console on board communication loss
verificationPatterns.example: Verify an error appeared in EM console. Verify @ sent in console.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event visibility under resource stress
verificationPatterns.example: Verify an error event appears in EM console when CPU is at 100%

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault injection during startup — disconnect CAN, verify error raised
verificationPatterns.example: During press start up disconnect the CAN → Verify error

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault injection during active run — disconnect CAN, verify press transitions to Off and EH turns off
verificationPatterns.example: During GR disconnect the CAN → Verify press go to Off, EH should turn off

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-dependent fault response — same fault produces different outcome based on press state (startup vs GR)
verificationPatterns.example: Step 1 expects error; Step 2 expects full press shutdown + EH off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Record signal and verify stability (no large oscillations)
verificationPatterns.example: Record the Blanket temperature, verify the Temperature is stable, not causing big SIN waves

verificationPatterns.pattern: Record actuator output power and verify it is stable
verificationPatterns.example: Record the EH power, verify the power given to the EH is stable

verificationPatterns.pattern: Circuit breaker stability check after sustained thermal load
verificationPatterns.example: verify no CB "Jumped"

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cross-phase temperature verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify blanket temperature works properly. Both for Get Ready, Pre-Print & Print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error visibility on connection loss
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Correct error appear to the User

verificationPatterns.pattern: Clean exit after error
verificationPatterns.example: When exit verify exit process works good

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI availability question for maintenance mode on vital component failure
verificationPatterns.example: Does UI load in this case? to make maintenance for example

verificationPatterns.pattern: Watchdog behavior during mid-startup disconnection
verificationPatterns.example: Run SW StartUp Watch dog test — disconnect board during startup

verificationPatterns.pattern: Coverage matrix: vital vs non-vital, before vs during startup
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat 1&2 for non vital components

verificationPatterns.pattern: Board network reachability check
verificationPatterns.example: Connect to boards and verify the have their addresses (IP)

verificationPatterns.pattern: SW returns to normal after component restart
verificationPatterns.example: verify after PLC is up SW back to normal

verificationPatterns.pattern: User-visible event emitted on board restart, followed by SW recovery
verificationPatterns.example: event should appear to user, Init State?, after restart finish SW should back to normal

verificationPatterns.pattern: SW startup succeeds after PC restart
verificationPatterns.example: Verify after PC is up that SW can be StarUp correctly after

verificationPatterns.pattern: SW load + UI presence check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify SW Loaded, UI browser opened.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Clean exit verification — UI and all apps close, PC stays on
verificationPatterns.example: Verify browser closed, all applications closed and PC is On.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Restart cycle — SW exits then re-enters startup
verificationPatterns.example: Verify SW exit and than start StartUp again.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Shutdown cycle — SW exits then PC powers off
verificationPatterns.example: Verify SW exit and than PC turn OFF.

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC health check after shutdown sequence
verificationPatterns.example: Verify PLC computer is On and in good status

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeatability check — multiple startups after installation
verificationPatterns.example: Start SW few times after installation (can be different after first start up)

verificationPatterns.pattern: FW layer boot verification
verificationPatterns.example: FWlayer - electric boards boot

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC & SPLC layer init verification
verificationPatterns.example: PLC&SPLC Layer - Load internal params and init (=communication verification with all Ether-cat devices)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter persistence across SW load
verificationPatterns.example: verify the parameter changed after the SW is up

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert imported timing profile parameter equals expected numeric value
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[x].Comp.arrBid[x].Rotation.In.Par.Import.TimingProfileData.LoadSpeed = 984

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert local mechanical gear ratio parameter equals expected ratio value
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[x].Comp.arrBid[x].Rotation.In.Par.Local.MechanicalData.GearRatio = 0.7469512

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert imported timing profile time durations equal expected seconds/jerk values
verificationPatterns.example: AccTime = 0.5, DccTime = 0.8, JerkTime = 0.2

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert gear profile deviation parameter equals expected value
verificationPatterns.example: Kedem_Sim.OCB.gInterface.Station[1].Comp.arrBid[1].Rotation.In.Par.Import.GearProfileData.GearDeviation = 96

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert imported torque limit parameters (panic and working, high and low) equal expected NM values
verificationPatterns.example: BidTorquePanicHigh = 2.3 NM, BidTorquePanicLow = 0.5 NM, BidTorqueWorkingHigh = 1.8 NM, BidTorqueWorkingLow = 0.3 NM

verificationPatterns.pattern: Assert saved torque-in-place parameter equals expected value
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[1].Comp.arrBid[1].Rotation.In.Par.Save.TorqueInPlace.Value = 0.3

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify AtProcessSpeed flag is TRUE after GR
verificationPatterns.example: Verify BID rotates at process speed (AtProcessSpeed=TRUE)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify rotation reaches AtSync on entering print state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify BID rotation is AtSync

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify rotation transitions from AtSync to AtProcessSpeed within print state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify BID rotation changed to At process speed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify all BIDs rotation falls to OFF state after deactivate
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all BIDs rotation fell to OFF state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify numeric parameter equals expected constant value
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Station[1].Comp.arrBid[1].Rotation.In.Par.Import.TimingProfileData.LoadSpeed should be 984

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify parameter exists/readable for all stations (implies loop over station index)
verificationPatterns.example: Verify correct BidAsidGearRatio value for all stations: gInterface.Station[1].Comp.arrBid[1].Rotation.In.Par.Import.GearProfileData.GearDeviation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Torque monitoring activates at process speed
verificationPatterns.example: Bid developer torque monitoring should start when Bid on process speed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault threshold breach raises named event AND transitions all BIDs to OFF
verificationPatterns.example: TorqueInPlace=0 → event BID_DR_NOT_IN_PLACE raised + all BIDs state changed to OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic-low threshold breach raises under-torque event AND transitions all BIDs to OFF
verificationPatterns.example: TorquePanicLow=1 → event BID_ROT_UNDER_TORQUE raised + all BIDs state changed to OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic-high threshold breach raises over-torque event AND transitions all BIDs to OFF
verificationPatterns.example: TorquePanicHigh=1 → event BID_ROT_OVER_TORQUE raised + all BIDs state changed to OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Warning threshold breach raises warning event WITHOUT changing BID state
verificationPatterns.example: TorqueWorkingHigh=1 → warning event BID_ROT_HIGH_TORQUE raised, BIDs state unchanged

verificationPatterns.pattern: Working-low threshold breach raises low-torque warning WITHOUT changing BID state
verificationPatterns.example: TorqueWorkingLow=1 → warning event BID_ROT_LOW_TORQUE raised, BIDs state unchanged

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify all four electrodes reach target voltages simultaneously at specified slew on instantaneous state transition
verificationPatterns.example: Off→Clear-Wet at Match slew: DR=vDark-WetNullDrOffset, SQ=Vdr+WetNullSqOffset, CL=Vdr+WetNullClOffset, EL=Vdr+WetNullElOffset

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify fast-slew immediate change followed by timed match-slew correction on a single electrode
verificationPatterns.example: Off→Print: DR=Vdr, SQ=VSq, CL=Vdr-15, EL=Vel on Fast slew; after 71ms CL transitions to Vcl at Match slew

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify multi-phase timed ramp-down with per-phase slew and no-change constraints on non-active electrodes
verificationPatterns.example: Print→Off Phase 1: EL=DR+15 Fast slew (DR/SQ/CL no change); Phase 2 +15ms: SQ=DR+15 Fast slew (DR/CL/EL no change); Phase 3 +100ms: DR=SQ=CL=EL=0 Match slew

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify Print→Clear-Wet multi-phase sequence ends at Clear-Wet operating voltages rather than zero
verificationPatterns.example: Phase 3 after 100ms: DR=v(250 below vDark), SQ=Vdr+15, CL=Vdr-15, EL=Vdr+15 at Match slew

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify hardcoded default voltage constant
verificationPatterns.example: VDark default = 900V

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify calculated voltage sent to PLC on SW startup and again after successful calibration
verificationPatterns.example: After Auto Bias: calculated VDark sent to PLC; after successful calibration: updated VDark sent to PLC

verificationPatterns.pattern: Voltage/current error → state reduction to Ready and Standby
verificationPatterns.example: BID_VOLTAGE_FAILURE / BID_CURRENT_FAILURE: Print & Ready to Ready; GR & Standby To Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold breach → delivery failure signal raises + logs + HV off
verificationPatterns.example: INK_TO_BID_DELIVERY_FAILURE should raise+logs; BID HV turned off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Download file corruption → error signal raises + logs
verificationPatterns.example: BIMHV_DOWNLOAD_ERROR_IN_FILE should raise+logs (corrupt file transfer)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Auto-download failure → error signal raises + logs; state depends on prior version availability
verificationPatterns.example: BIMHV_DOWNLOAD_FAILED_ERROR should raise+logs; if previous version exists: no press state change; if previous version cannot function: press goes to Init

verificationPatterns.pattern: Info/success-level event → no mode change
verificationPatterns.example: BIMHV_DOWNLOAD_SUCCESS: No mode Change; BID_DSP_CALIBRATION_ERROR: no mode change; BID_DSP_OVERRIDES: No change; BID_DSP_AT_TIME_OF_FAULT: No change; BID_HV_FAIL_INFO: No change; BID_DSP_INTERNAL_FAULT: no mode change; BID_DSP_VOLTAGE_NOT_REACHED: No change

verificationPatterns.pattern: DSP communication error → Init
verificationPatterns.example: BIMHV_DSP_COMMUNICATION_ERROR: init

verificationPatterns.pattern: HV not enabled → Off from all states
verificationPatterns.example: BIMHV_HV_NOT_ENABLED: Off state from all states

verificationPatterns.pattern: Communication timeout → Standby from all states
verificationPatterns.example: BIMHV_COMMUNICATION_ERROR: Standby from all states

verificationPatterns.pattern: Current leakage / overcurrent / DSP reset → Off
verificationPatterns.example: BID_DSP_CURRENT_LEAKAGE: Off; BID_DSP_OVERCURRENT_FAULT: Off; BID_DSP_RESET: Off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Voltage not reached error (HV set target unmet) → state reduction to Ready and Standby
verificationPatterns.example: BID_DSP_VOLTAGE_NOT_REACHED_ERROR: Print and Ready to Ready; Get ready and standby to Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Phase-transition voltage check
verificationPatterns.example: Verify wet voltages present during Preprint, then confirm values change to print voltages on transition to Print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Startup abort on critical communication loss
verificationPatterns.example: During SW start up disconnect the BIM communication → Verify SW load stopped + relevant error showed including Index

verificationPatterns.pattern: Runtime fault recovery with subsystem restart and state transition
verificationPatterns.example: During print disconnect the BIM communication → Verify failure, BIM should be restarted. press go to init.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error message includes Index field
verificationPatterns.example: relevant error showed including Index

verificationPatterns.pattern: Monitoring start delay — verify failure event fires after configured delay, not immediately
verificationPatterns.example: Verify failure appear BidHvMonitorStartDelay msec after the HV command

verificationPatterns.pattern: Monitoring deactivation on HV off — verify monitoring is disabled before HV is turned off
verificationPatterns.example: BID HV monitoring will be turned off right before BID HV is set to off — Verify monitoring parameter change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass/override suppresses failure — overriding current and voltage IOs should produce no failure event
verificationPatterns.example: Bypass the monitor, override Current and Voltage IOs — Verify no failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Set slew mode + direction, verify per-component HV PS slew rate (V/msec)
verificationPatterns.example: Fast rise → DR=21.5, SQ=32.3, CL=21.5, EL=64.5

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fast fall slew: verify asymmetric rates differ from fast rise
verificationPatterns.example: Fast fall → DR=98, SQ=30, CL=98, EL=30

verificationPatterns.pattern: Match rise slew: verify near-symmetric rates across components
verificationPatterns.example: Match rise → DR=24.6, SQ=25.1, CL=24.6, EL=25.1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Match fall slew: verify lower rates than match rise
verificationPatterns.example: Match fall → DR=9.6, SQ=6.4, CL=9.6, EL=9.4

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass suppresses monitoring and triggers completion status
verificationPatterns.example: component is not monitored and send completion status to ink manager

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat pattern per sensor type (Conductivity, Temperature, Level, Density) with same bypass+sim setup and same expected outcome
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 1-2, 3-4, 5-6, 7-8 each follow identical setup/verify structure for one sensor

verificationPatterns.pattern: Status signal active at setpoint
verificationPatterns.example: During SolidAdd with Temp at setpoint → verify Ink.Temp.Out.Status.AtTempMonitoring

verificationPatterns.pattern: Status signal active in standby state
verificationPatterns.example: During Standby → verify Ink.Temp.Out.Status.AtStdBy

verificationPatterns.pattern: Status signal + actuator state when heating required
verificationPatterns.example: During SolidAdd with Temp below setpoint-offset → verify Ink.Temp.Out.Status.AtHeating AND heating valves open

verificationPatterns.pattern: Status signal + actuator state when cooling required
verificationPatterns.example: During SolidAdd with Temp above setpoint+offset → verify Ink.Temp.Out.Status.AtCooling AND cooling valves open

verificationPatterns.pattern: Enqueued event assertion — verify named event fires from specific ink source
verificationPatterns.example: Enqueue event INK_FAILED_TO_ADD_CD from INK_1_Stn_2

verificationPatterns.pattern: Timeout event routing — verify timeout event sent to Ink Manager plus associated event/log
verificationPatterns.example: Verify Temp Timeout event sent to Ink Manager +relevant event/log

verificationPatterns.pattern: Critical failure at Ready drives press to Standby
verificationPatterns.example: Press go to standby with this event: Enqueue event INK_LEVEL_TOO_LOW from INK_1_Stn_2, FlowID 0, RealParam1 LevelValue 5000.000, RealParam2 LowLimit 8000.000

verificationPatterns.pattern: Critical failure during Print drives press to Ready (degraded, not full stop)
verificationPatterns.example: Press go to Ready with this event: Enqueue event INK_LEVEL_TOO_LOW_DURING_INK_SUPPLY from INK_1_Stn_2, FlowID 0, RealParam1 LevelValue 7996.000, RealParam2 LowLimit 8000.000

verificationPatterns.pattern: Warning-level failure fires event but press remains in current state
verificationPatterns.example: Press remain at Ready. Verify event: Enqueue event INK_TEMPERATURE_TOO_HIGH from INK_1_Stn_2, FlowID 0, RealParam1 MeasuredTemperature 3251.000

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic/overheat threshold always stops the press regardless of current state (Standby at Ready, Post Print during Print)
verificationPatterns.example: Press go to Standby. / Press go to standart Post print. Verify event: Enqueue event INK_TEMPERATURE_OVERHEAT from INK_1_Stn_2, FlowID 0, RealParam1 MeasuredTemperature 3506.000

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event payload carries measured value as RealParam1 and the violated limit as RealParam2; integer targets use IntParam1
verificationPatterns.example: Enqueue event INK_CONDUCTIVITY_TOO_LOW from INK_1_Stn_2, FlowID 0, RealParam1 MeasuredConductivity 9400.000, IntParam1 TargetConductivity 11000, RealParam2 MeasuredTemperature 3000.000

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event source is formatted as INK_<tank>_Stn_<station> with FlowID always 0
verificationPatterns.example: Enqueue event INK_DENSITY_TOO_LOW_FOR_PRINT from NoSubsystem, FlowID 0, RealParam1 DensityValue 1500.000, RealParam2 TankVolume 12000.000, IntParam1 IsTubeEmpty 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Status check at standby/init via StepMessage
verificationPatterns.example: At standby and init verify status accordingly (through StepMessage)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify component enters AtCondActive state and pump activates when precondition check exhausts retries
verificationPatterns.example: PRE_CONDITIONS_CHECK -> too many retries: Verify status AtCondActive and Conductivity pump is active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify Running state when measured value reaches SetPoint or working range
verificationPatterns.example: Set Conduct to SetPoint (or in the working range) -> Verify status Running

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify fault state closes all valves and disables heating/cooling
verificationPatterns.example: Send fault CMD from Ink manager -> Verify status fault, all valves are close (no heating or cooling)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Status verification via StepMessage
verificationPatterns.example: At standby and init verify status accordingly (through StepMessage)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Drive temp below SetPoint to trigger Heating state; assert heating valve open
verificationPatterns.example: Set temp to SetPoint-offset → Verify status at Heating, Heating valve should open

verificationPatterns.pattern: Drive temp above SetPoint to trigger Cooling state; assert cooling valve open
verificationPatterns.example: Set temp to SetPoint+offset → Verify status at Cooling, Cooling valve should open

verificationPatterns.pattern: Drive temp to SetPoint (working range) and assert AtTempMonitoring state
verificationPatterns.example: Set temp to SetPoint (or in the working range) → Verify Status at AtTempMonitoring

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inject fault and assert all valves close (no heating or cooling active)
verificationPatterns.example: Enter a fault status → Verify status fault, all valves are close (no heating or cooling)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify availability state table for a named ink tank control type
verificationPatterns.example: For temperature control verify availability state table

verificationPatterns.pattern: Apply the same availability-state-table check across all ink tank control types (temperature, level, conductivity, density)
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 1-4 repeat the identical verification pattern, one step per control type

verificationPatterns.pattern: Write OPC-UA output signal and assert pump Off (value=0)
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStation[2].HW_Outputs.INK[1].Conductivity.cdDirectPump.Value=0 → pump is Off

verificationPatterns.pattern: Write OPC-UA output signal and assert pump On (value=1) plus status flag active
verificationPatterns.example: cdDirectPump.Value=1 → Verify Ink.Cond.Out.Status.AtCondActive + Cond pump is On

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-gated pump assertion — same signal, different expected result per press state
verificationPatterns.example: SolidAdd: pump Off; Standby: pump Off; Print (cond < 10,000): pump On

verificationPatterns.pattern: Above-threshold voltage injection during print
verificationPatterns.example: During Print set CR voltage to above ChargingThreshold

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat threshold-breach pattern per charging channel (CR, ASID)
verificationPatterns.example: During Print set ASID voltage to above ChargingThreshold

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold breach during active state
verificationPatterns.example: During Print set CR voltage to above ChargingThreshold

verificationPatterns.pattern: Per-component voltage threshold check
verificationPatterns.example: During Print set ASID voltage to above ChargingThreshold

verificationPatterns.pattern: HV inhibit when drum not at speed
verificationPatterns.example: run ASID&CR charging CMD while asid no at speed → Verify HV doesn't turn on; check event CRG_ASID_NOT_IN_FULL_SPEED in log

verificationPatterns.pattern: IoSensor override blocks HV sequence continuation
verificationPatterns.example: override CR DisEngage IoSensor '1' to simulate disengage → verify HV sequence doesn't continue

verificationPatterns.pattern: Electrometer out-of-range handling (TBD)
verificationPatterns.example: set electrometer reading to above valid → TBD if necessary, may be tested under another feature

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ordered-sequence verification: assert each activation sub-step fires in prescribed order before checking the final outcome
verificationPatterns.example: Set CR VDC and aSID VDC → (conditional BR) → Set CR VDC to print default → Wait ChargingStabTime → Set CR VAC; Expected: HV turn on at the correct sequence

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ordered-sequence verification: assert each deactivation sub-step fires in prescribed order (mirror of activation)
verificationPatterns.example: Turn off CR VAC → Set CR VDC to AsidBiasVoltage → Turn off CR VDC → Wait DischargingStabTime → Turn off aSID VDC → (conditional BR off)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Conditional hardware-type branch: gate a sub-step on installed component type (CrType) within the sequence
verificationPatterns.example: If CrType=Hydrin is installed, activate balancing roller current control

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stabilisation wait inside sequence: insert a timed wait between voltage/current changes to allow electrical stabilisation before the next step
verificationPatterns.example: Wait ChargingStabTime msec for current stabilization and charging uniformity

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ordered deactivation sequence check
verificationPatterns.example: 1. deactivation sequence (as in sanity) 2. 2 asid rotation 3. PTE off 4. disengage CR

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault injection via IoSensor override blocks state transition
verificationPatterns.example: override CR DisEngage IoSensor '0' to simulate engage → verify charge manager didn't reach Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Open/exploratory HV protection check (incomplete step)
verificationPatterns.example: is there protection to HV stayed On?

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-state entry check — verify several subsystem states simultaneously on sequence start
verificationPatterns.example: 1. ASID at process speed 2. CR engage 3. PTE on

verificationPatterns.pattern: Flag toggle + event/log verification — turn off a boolean flag and assert event and log entry generated
verificationPatterns.example: Turn off ASID at process speed flag → Verify event+log

verificationPatterns.pattern: IoSensor override to simulate hardware state — force sensor value to trigger disengage path and assert event and log entry
verificationPatterns.example: override CR DisEngage IoSensor '1' to simulate disengage → Verify event+log

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inject limit-boundary IO value then assert error event raised
verificationPatterns.example: Set IO to panicLow value → verify LEVEL_PANIC_LOW event created

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inject limit-boundary IO value then assert subsystem stops
verificationPatterns.example: Set IO to panicHigh value → verify PLC is in off state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Repeat verification for each boundary state (panicHigh, panicLow)
verificationPatterns.example: For each value verify the expected event created and PLC in off state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic-threshold event creation
verificationPatterns.example: Set IO to panicLow/panic value; verify the correct event (PRESSURE_PANIC_LOW or PRESSURE_PANIC_HIGH) is created

verificationPatterns.pattern: Subsystem stop on panic
verificationPatterns.example: After threshold breach, verify PLC is in off state and IMO subsystem has stopped

verificationPatterns.pattern: Iterate both panic limits
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat test flow for each limit (panicHigh, panicLow) and assert the matching named error per case

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic value check per machine state
verificationPatterns.example: Verify for GR and print states the panic values.

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic-high threshold breach stops subsystem and raises error event
verificationPatterns.example: If averaged pressure exceeds FilterPressurePanicHigh → IMO subsystem stops + PRESSURE_PANIC_HIGH event raised

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic-low threshold breach stops subsystem and raises error event
verificationPatterns.example: If averaged pressure drops below FilterPressurePanicLow → IMO subsystem stops + PRESSURE_PANIC_LOW event raised

verificationPatterns.pattern: Filter pump follows CS-IMO pump activation state
verificationPatterns.example: While CS-IMO pump is activated, the filter pump will be active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event creation on boolean sensor signal activation
verificationPatterns.example: when Reservoir Cover is true, error event created

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC state transition to on/off on sensor fault
verificationPatterns.example: when Reservoir Cover is true, PLC on off state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Invalid sensor value → PLC response check
verificationPatterns.example: PLC when Clean Reservoir Temp is get not valid values

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold-range pump activation
verificationPatterns.example: When dirtiness > DirtinessThreshold AND < DirtinessPanicHigh → IMO filter pump activates and runs until dirtiness reaches DirtinessTarget

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic-high timer arm-and-expire
verificationPatterns.example: When dirtiness > DirtinessPanicHigh → DirtinessPanicHighTimer starts; if timer expires before dirtiness drops below DirtinessPanicHigh → IMO subsystem stops and transitions to Off state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic-high event raised on timer expiry
verificationPatterns.example: On DirtinessPanicHighTimer expiry event 'IMO_DIRTINESS_PANIC_HIGH' must be raised

verificationPatterns.pattern: Invalid sensor value handling
verificationPatterns.example: PLC must handle not-valid dirtiness readings from Clean Reservoir without undefined behavior (exact expected PLC reaction is the test objective)

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC behavior under invalid sensor input

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event fires on IO override before action

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event fires on IO override during active print

verificationPatterns.pattern: HV shuts off on not-in-place condition during print

verificationPatterns.pattern: New command preempts in-progress sequence

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bidirectional preemption: later command wins regardless of direction

verificationPatterns.pattern: Distinct fault signal raised per operation type (supply vs. drain) under low-pressure condition

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pump-state preservation on drain
verificationPatterns.example: Set DrainToStandby once with pump On and once with pump Off → InkPump stays at its last state in both cases

verificationPatterns.pattern: Forced pump-off on drain command
verificationPatterns.example: Set DrainToOff → InkPump is turned off regardless of prior state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Drain sequence execution
verificationPatterns.example: Each drain command (DrainToStandby, DrainToOff, DrainToCirculation) must trigger the drain sequence

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual pump-state coverage

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass status propagates to all sub-components of the targeted tank

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ink manager reports ready to bid manager once the single active tank completes Get Ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: Removing bypass restores all sub-components to active state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Iterative operation cycles with counter verification

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard completion status

verificationPatterns.pattern: Calibration completion status

verificationPatterns.pattern: HTTP health endpoint verification
verificationPatterns.example: GET http://192.168.200.11:30161/health/ping responds with pong

verificationPatterns.pattern: Web UI navigation and page load verification
verificationPatterns.example: Navigate to https://pressqa.printopt.org/start/#/signin and verify Print OS Sign In page displays

verificationPatterns.pattern: Modal/popup confirmation verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify confirmation pop-up message with text 'Press logs request' displayed after action

verificationPatterns.pattern: HTTP job queue verification
verificationPatterns.example: GET http://192.168.200.11:30161/jobs and verify JobID present with Status=In Progress and matching time range/filename

verificationPatterns.pattern: Job cleanup verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify JobID deleted from http://192.168.200.11:30161/jobs queue after download completes

verificationPatterns.pattern: Service process recovery verification
verificationPatterns.example: Kill PressTools.PressCollector.exe from Task Manager, then verify service restarts and endpoints respond after Press PC restart

verificationPatterns.pattern: Continue button disabled until selection made
verificationPatterns.example: Verify 'Continue' button is disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Tooltip prompts selection when continuing without choice
verificationPatterns.example: Verify tooltip 'Select an issue to continue'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Enlarge/close cycle for defect image inspection
verificationPatterns.example: Tap Enlarge icon → Verify enlarged view → Tap Close button

verificationPatterns.pattern: Selection updates title confirmation
verificationPatterns.example: Tap 'Streaks - All Colors' → Verify title 'Streaks - All Colors'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Technical Details icon reveals affected component list
verificationPatterns.example: Tap Technical Details info icon → Verify tooltip: Blanket, Printing, BCR, WHS Rollers

verificationPatterns.pattern: Back button returns to prior wizard screen
verificationPatterns.example: Tap Back → Verify 'PRINT QUALITY (PQ) ASSIST' wizard displayed

verificationPatterns.pattern: OPC signal state verification
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Method execution verification via Log4View filtering
verificationPatterns.example: Filter PressTools→presscollector→jobs, search for 'IsDiskSpaceAvailable' method, verify on Message is false

verificationPatterns.pattern: Job substatus verification in logs
verificationPatterns.example: Verify PressTools.PressCollector.Jobs.LogIotCollectionManager subStatus = 'Job received' in UpdateJobProgressAsync

verificationPatterns.pattern: Async operation completion verification
verificationPatterns.example: Search for 'UpdateJobDoneAsync' method, verify job status = 'Succeeded'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Email delivery and link activation verification
verificationPatterns.example: Check inbox for email with subject 'Logs - Data Oger', click download link, verify redirect to Print OS

verificationPatterns.pattern: Voltage calculation verification during print mode
verificationPatterns.example: Capture ElectrodeVoltSet_v, DeveloperVoltSet_v, SqueegeeVoltSet_v while BidHvMode=2 (Print). Calculate V_electrode=(ElectrodeVoltSet_v-DeveloperVoltSet_v)/(NominalPID/100+1). Verify result equals PEX.IBL.InkEntity.Yellow.NomBidElectrodeVoltage. Example: (1458-480)/(15/100+1)=850

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print-only voltage consistency across job types
verificationPatterns.example: Verify identical BID voltages are used during Print phase across user job, cleaner, ATP job, and calibration wizard. Confirm voltages appear only during Print, not PrePrint

verificationPatterns.pattern: Button tap opens expected wizard
verificationPatterns.example: Tap on 'CPR Calibration' button → Verify 'CPR CALIBRATION' wizard was opened

verificationPatterns.pattern: Source wizard persists after navigation
verificationPatterns.example: After opening CPR CALIBRATION → Verify 'PRINT QUALITY (PQ) ASSIST' is still open

verificationPatterns.pattern: Config file modification verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify UploadTarget changed to LRS in PressCollectorConfig.json

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI page load verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that the Print OS Sign In page is displayed successfully

verificationPatterns.pattern: Logs on Demand feature access
verificationPatterns.example: Verify logs on demand screen opened after navigation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine identification by serial number
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that the selected machine or simulator is identified correctly

verificationPatterns.pattern: Date range and timeframe selection
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that the selected date range and time frame are applied correctly

verificationPatterns.pattern: Request confirmation dialog verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that a confirmation pop-up message with the text 'Press logs request' is displayed

verificationPatterns.pattern: File system log collection verification
verificationPatterns.example: Search for sim folder and verify logs file located in \\iifs2\logrepository$\Press Data

verificationPatterns.pattern: Email notification delivery
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that an email is received with a link to Print OS for downloading the logs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Download link functionality
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that the link opens successfully and redirects to Print OS

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log download completion
verificationPatterns.example: Verify that the logs are downloaded automatically without errors

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-download folder cleanup verification
verificationPatterns.example: Ensure R:\HP\PressCollector folder is empty and logs were deleted from folder

verificationPatterns.pattern: Configuration reset verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify UploadTarget changed back from LRS to S3 in PressCollectorConfig.json

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log request triggers IN_PROGRESS status for UpdateJobProgressAsync method
verificationPatterns.example: After Execute button clicked, search for method 'UpdateJobProgressAsync' and verify status is 'IN_PROGRESS'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log saver is blocked while log request is in progress with proper user message
verificationPatterns.example: While status is 'IN_PROGRESS', attempt to open log saver on press and verify proper error message is displayed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log request completion triggers email notification with download link
verificationPatterns.example: Wait for email inbox to receive message with subject containing 'Logs - Data' and download link

verificationPatterns.pattern: Job completion marked by UpdateJobDoneAsync with Succeeded status
verificationPatterns.example: Search for 'UpdateJobDoneAsync' in logs and verify job status is 'Succeeded'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log saver becomes available after job completion
verificationPatterns.example: After job completes, verify log saver on press can be opened successfully

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state verification via OPC-UA machine state signal
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = OFF, MECH_INIT, Standby, GET_READY, DYNAMIC_READY

verificationPatterns.pattern: Logs on Demand UI request workflow
verificationPatterns.example: Navigate to https://pressqa.printopt.org/start/#/signin, enter serial number, select date range, enter filename, click Execute, confirm dialog shown

verificationPatterns.pattern: Email delivery verification for log download
verificationPatterns.example: Verify email received with subject 'Logs - Data Oger' containing Print OS download link

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log4View logger filtering for bypass validation
verificationPatterns.example: Filter loggers: PressTools->presscollector->jobs and S3->Uploaders->LogsOnDemandUploader

verificationPatterns.pattern: Async collection condition verification in logs
verificationPatterns.example: Search AwaitCollectionConditionsAsync, verify IsLogSaverRunning: False, IsPressStateValid: True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Job completion status verification in logs
verificationPatterns.example: Search UpdateJobDoneAsync, open JSON viewer, verify job status is Succeeded

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI window/page display verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify log4View application is opened; Verify Log4View Configuration window is opened

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state signal verification
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Method execution status in logs via Log4View search
verificationPatterns.example: Search UpdateJobProgressAsync verify status IN_PROGRESS; Search UpdateJobDoneAsync verify job status Succeeded

verificationPatterns.pattern: Method property state verification
verificationPatterns.example: IsDisSpaceAvailable returns true; AwaitCollectionConditionsAsync shows IsLogSaverRunning: False, IsPressStateValid: True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Job substatus progression in logs
verificationPatterns.example: Under UpdateJobProgressAsync verify subStatus sequence: Job received, Uploading to S3, Collecting Logs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Email delivery with downloadable link
verificationPatterns.example: Verify email received with Print OS download link in subject line

verificationPatterns.pattern: Process failure and retry cycle via task manager
verificationPatterns.example: Stop log saver process, verify not running, wait FailureRetryIntervalSec, verify process restarts; repeat until FailureRetries (3) exceeded, verify job status changes to failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI state transitions occur correctly after each user action
verificationPatterns.example: Sign In page → authenticated home screen → Data Oger page → Logs on Demand screen

verificationPatterns.pattern: System generates correct confirmation messages at request submission
verificationPatterns.example: Pop-up with text 'Press logs request' appears after Execute button clicked

verificationPatterns.pattern: Downloaded file naming includes all requested metadata
verificationPatterns.example: ZIP file name includes machine serial number, log collection date, and user-defined file name

verificationPatterns.pattern: Statistics report data matches across Print OS and Elasticsearch
verificationPatterns.example: Verify timestamps, ZIP name, status, sub-status, and size match between POS and Elasticsearch Discover

verificationPatterns.pattern: Offset initialization depends on calibration mode
verificationPatterns.example: from default: delete all CprYOffsets and set zero values for all revolutions; from previous: no offset values change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Only participating stations have offset values updated
verificationPatterns.example: CPR YOffset for single rotation is updated for all stations except ref station #3. Other rotations get same values as in single rotation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypassed and reference stations preserve offsets
verificationPatterns.example: Offset stations 4 and #6 are not changing. Ref station #3 also has zero values

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cancel action reverts all changes
verificationPatterns.example: Click Cancel → All values back to values before calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Save action persists offset changes for participating stations
verificationPatterns.example: Click Save button after finishing calibration → Verify new offset values saved for Stations #1, #2 #5

verificationPatterns.pattern: All selected values change during printing cycle
verificationPatterns.example: Verify all 3 values change while printing

verificationPatterns.pattern: Request and Report ID offset tolerance
verificationPatterns.example: RequestID and ReportID should be = +-2

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pre-iteration zero initialization for participating stations only
verificationPatterns.example: delete all CprYOffsets and set zero values for all revolutions only for stations participating in calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Offset value updates across rotations with reference station constraints
verificationPatterns.example: CPR YOffset for all rotations are updated except ref station #3 singe rotation =0 and first of many=0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Non-participating station isolation
verificationPatterns.example: Offset stations 4 and #6 are not changing

verificationPatterns.pattern: Reference station special rules: single/first-of-many fixed to zero, last-of-many may change
verificationPatterns.example: Ref station #3: singe rotation =0, first of many=0, but last of many can be changed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cancellation rollback to pre-calibration state
verificationPatterns.example: All values back to values before calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Save persistence for participating stations only
verificationPatterns.example: Verify new offset values saved for Stations #1, #2 #5 and last of many ref station #3

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pre-iteration offset reset
verificationPatterns.example: Before first iteration: delete all CprXOffsets and set zero values for all revolutions in participating stations only

verificationPatterns.pattern: Reference station invariant
verificationPatterns.example: Station #3 (ref): single rotation = 0, first of many = 0, but last of many can change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Non-participating station preservation
verificationPatterns.example: Stations in bypass or white-only mode retain existing offset values; do not participate in calibration updates

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-iteration offset update
verificationPatterns.example: After iteration complete: CprXOffset values updated for participating stations; may vary per rotation; values may or may not differ

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cancellation rollback
verificationPatterns.example: Click Cancel button: all offset values revert to pre-calibration state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Save persistence
verificationPatterns.example: Click Save button: new offset values persisted for participating stations and reference station last-of-many

verificationPatterns.pattern: Pre-calibration offset verification
verificationPatterns.example: Verify In Pex before starting calibration: Stations has LeftOffset value for all revolutions. Different stations may have different values

verificationPatterns.pattern: CPR initialization clears offsets
verificationPatterns.example: After starting but before first iteration: delete all CprXOffsets and set zero values for all revolutions in Press.IBL.Calibrations.ConcreteCalibrations.Cpr.CprIlsAlgorithmBlanketAxisXResultEntity

verificationPatterns.pattern: X offset updates during iteration
verificationPatterns.example: CPR XOffset for single rotation is updated for all stations except ref station #3. Other rotations get same values as in single rotation. Values per station

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cancellation restores baseline state
verificationPatterns.example: Click Cancel and verify all values back to values before calibration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass stations excluded from calibration
verificationPatterns.example: When Station #4 in bypass: set zero values only for participating stations #1, #2, #3, #5. Bypass stations #4 and #6 offsets are not changing. Ref station #3 also has zero values

verificationPatterns.pattern: Resume from previous calibration state
verificationPatterns.example: Start CPR wizard from previous: No offset values change before first iteration. After first iteration XOffset values change only for participating stations

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state enters GET READY
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = 7

verificationPatterns.pattern: TEMP_PANIC_LOW event appears with sensor reading and limit
verificationPatterns.example: Temperature is below working window, sensor id: eh temperature sensor 10, actual temperature value, temperature limit value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine transitions to STANDBY after error event
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = 6

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket drying component powers off
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Comp.Drying.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: TEMP_PANIC_LOW event fires with correct sensor metadata
verificationPatterns.example: Event includes sensor_id, actual_temperature from target BktTemp_EH<X>_MelexisSens, temperature_limit calculated as DefaultValue + ExitLow

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transitions follow sensor type (EH10 only vs EH5/EH1)
verificationPatterns.example: EH10: GR/DYNAMIC_READY/PRE_PRINT/POST_PRINT→READY; GR→STBY; STBY/OFF/INITIALIZE→no change. EH5/EH1: behavior TBD per SFR

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket drying component offline during event
verificationPatterns.example: Drying.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true maintained

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event is generated with sensor identification
verificationPatterns.example: IR_SENSOR_COMM_FAILURE appears with event parameter: eh temperature sensor 10

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket drying component disables in response to sensor failure
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Comp.Drying.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state transition depends on initial state
verificationPatterns.example: From READY/PRE_PRINT/POST_PRINT/DYNAMIC_READY: move to STBY. From STBY and below: no change

verificationPatterns.pattern: TEMP_PANIC_HIGH event generation
verificationPatterns.example: TEMP_PANIC_HIGH event appears with correct SensorID and temperature parameters

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-dependent machine transitions on error
verificationPatterns.example: From GET_READY: move to STANDBY (State=6); from DYNAMIC_READY/PRE_PRINT: move to READY; from STANDBY/OFF: no state change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Component shutdown on thermal violation
verificationPatterns.example: BKT.Comp.Drying.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true in all machine states

verificationPatterns.pattern: TEMP_CONTROL_TIMEOUT event appears with correct sensor and temperature parameters
verificationPatterns.example: Event appears after 400 sec with SensorID=EH5, ActualTemp=80, SetpointTemp=105

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state transition after timeout depends on source state
verificationPatterns.example: From STANDBY/OFF/INITIALIZE: remains STANDBY; from READY/PRE_PRINT/POST_PRINT/DYNAMIC_READY: transitions to READY

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket drying component enters OFF state when timeout occurs during heating
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Comp.Drying.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event is suppressed when heating monitor is not active
verificationPatterns.example: From STANDBY and below, event does not appear when goToHeating is not initiated (AtHeatingMonitor = false)

verificationPatterns.pattern: THERMISTOR_INVALID error event is raised
verificationPatterns.example: error event THERMISTOR_INVALID

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event contains correct sensor identification
verificationPatterns.example: SensorID : air knife thermistor

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event reports actual resistance value from simulation
verificationPatterns.example: Actual Resistance : -1 (OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.BKT.HW_Inputs.Temperature.AK_Blower_Thermistor_Temperature.Simulation.Value)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event reports the violated limit threshold
verificationPatterns.example: Limit Resistance : AkBlowerValidLow

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error persists across machine state transitions
verificationPatterns.example: Verify in states: READY, PRE_PRINT, POST_PRINT, DYNAMIC_READY, STBY, OFF, INITIALIZE

verificationPatterns.pattern: High RPM threshold detection
verificationPatterns.example: When AK_Upper_Blower_RPM_Speed > AirKnifeBlowerSetPoint + AirKnifeBlowerMaxRpmDelta (6900 + 500), BLANKET_AK_BLOWER_HIGH_RPM event appears with Actual Value and Limit Value (7400)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Low RPM threshold detection
verificationPatterns.example: When AK_Upper_Blower_RPM_Speed < AirKnifeBlowerSetPoint - AirKnifeBlowerMinRpmDelta (6900 - 500), BLANKET_AK_BLOWER_LOW_RPM event appears with Actual Value and Limit Value (6400)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Component shutdown on threshold violation
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Comp.Drying.Comp.AirKnifeUpper.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true AND gInterface.BKT.Comp.Drying.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state on error
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState = 6 (standby)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-state repeatability
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat error injection across READY, PRE PRINT, POST PRINT, DYNAMIC READY, STBY, OFF, INITIALIZE; verify component remains off in stby and below, transitions to Ready in Dynamic Ready/Pre-print/Print

verificationPatterns.pattern: Recovery from error
verificationPatterns.example: Remove simulation changes and verify press transitions from Ready to PRE PRINT (9) or PRINT (10), and from STBY to GR (7)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event conditional on heating state
verificationPatterns.example: BLANKET_AK_INVERTER_AT_FAULT appears only when gInterface.BKT.Comp.Drying.Ctrl.Out.Status.Atheating = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition and component shutdown on fault during heating
verificationPatterns.example: When fault detected during heating: press transitions to stand by (State = 6), blanket drying component enters OFF (AtOff = true)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event includes standardized error ID parameter
verificationPatterns.example: BLANKET_AK_INVERTER_AT_FAULT event with error ID = 3

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault behavior repeatable across all machine states
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat fault injection in READY/PRE_PRINT/PRINT/DYNAMIC_READY/STBY/OFF/INITIALIZE—event and state changes consistent when Atheating = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event emission on panic condition
verificationPatterns.example: TEMP_PANIC_LOW event appears with description 'Temperature is below working window', sensor id 'eh temperature sensor 10', actual temperature from BktTemp_EH10_MelexisSens, limit from BktTempGetReadySetPoint.ParMetaData.DefaultValue + BlanektTemperatureExitLow

verificationPatterns.pattern: State retention after event
verificationPatterns.example: MachineState.State remains at 8 (READY) after TEMP_PANIC_LOW; transitions to STBY only from GR state

verificationPatterns.pattern: Component shutdown on panic
verificationPatterns.example: Blanket drying component goes OFF: BKT.Comp.Drying.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: PRESSURE_INVALID event triggered when pressure below minimum limit
verificationPatterns.example: Set BKT.HW_Inputs.Temperature.AK_Upper_Blower_Pressure_Sens = 0 (below AkPressureValidLow 0.1), verify PRESSURE_INVALID event with sensor ID 10

verificationPatterns.pattern: PRESSURE_INVALID event triggered when pressure above maximum limit
verificationPatterns.example: Set BKT.HW_Inputs.Temperature.AK_Upper_Blower_Pressure_Sens = 61 (above AkPressureValidHigh 60), verify PRESSURE_INVALID event with limit value 60

verificationPatterns.pattern: Events triggered consistently across all machine states
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat pressure violations in READY/PRE_PRINT/POST_PRINT/DYNAMIC_READY/STBY/OFF/INITIALIZE states; for READY verify state transitions to STBY, others remain unchanged

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state is GET_READY when error condition exists
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = 7

verificationPatterns.pattern: TEMP_PANIC_LOW event generated with temperature details
verificationPatterns.example: Event description: 'Temperature is below working window', Sensor ID: 'eh temperature sensor 05', Actual temp: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.BKT.HW_Inputs.Temperature.BktTemp_EH10_MelexisSens, Limit: DefaultValue + BlanektTemperatureExitLow

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket Drying Component disables on error
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Comp.Drying.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event emission and parameters
verificationPatterns.example: TEMP_PANIC_HIGH event appears with SensorID, actual temperature from BktTemp_EH10_MelexisSens, and temperature limit

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-dependent machine transition
verificationPatterns.example: GET READY→STANDBY (State=6); DYNAMIC_READY/PRE_PRINT/PRINT→READY; STBY/OFF→no change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Component shutdown
verificationPatterns.example: Blanket Drying Component goes OFF (Drying.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true)

verificationPatterns.pattern: No error event appears until timeout period elapses
verificationPatterns.example: In OFF and STANDBY states with temperature below setpoint: NO EVENT APPEARS until TemperatureTimeout (400 sec) expires

verificationPatterns.pattern: TEMP_CONTROL_TIMEOUT event includes complete diagnostic parameters
verificationPatterns.example: Event parameters: SensorID (eh), Actual temperature (BktTemp_EH5_MelexisSens = 80), Set point (BlanketTemperatueGetReadySetPoint = 105), Time Limit (400 sec)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state behavior depends on which state initiated temperature control
verificationPatterns.example: From STANDBY→READY: timeout causes return to STANDBY; from READY/PRE_PRINT/POST_PRINT/DYNAMIC_READY: timeout causes transition to STANDBY; from STBY and below: no state change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket drying component enters OFF when timeout occurs
verificationPatterns.example: Verify gInterface.BKT.Comp.Drying.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true when TEMP_CONTROL_TIMEOUT event appears

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event only appears when heating is actively monitored
verificationPatterns.example: From STBY and below: event not shown since goToHeating is NOT initiated (gInterface.BKT.Comp.Drying.Comp.Hood[5].Comp.Heater[1].Ctrl.Out.Status.AtHeatingMonitor = false)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Behavior is consistent across different blanket temperature sensors
verificationPatterns.example: Test repeats identically with EH1, EH5, and EH10 sensors; same event and state transitions occur for each sensor

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event triggered with correct sensor and resistance details
verificationPatterns.example: Verify THERMISTOR_INVALID event includes SensorID='air knife thermistor', Actual Resistance=-1, Limit Resistance=AkBlowerValidLow

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event IR_SENSOR_COMM_FAILURE appears with sensor parameter
verificationPatterns.example: error event IR_SENSOR_COMM_FAILURE appears, event parameter: eh temperature sensor 10

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket drying component transitions to OFF state
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Comp.Drying.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state behavior varies by initial state
verificationPatterns.example: From READY/PRE_PRINT/POST_PRINT/DYNAMIC_READY transitions to stby; from STBY/OFF/INITIALIZE remains unchanged

verificationPatterns.pattern: Low pressure boundary violation
verificationPatterns.example: Set BKT.HW_Inputs.Temperature.AK_Upper_Blower_Pressure_Sens < 0.1 (e.g., 0); verify PRESSURE_INVALID event with sensor ID 10, actual value and limit 0.1

verificationPatterns.pattern: High pressure boundary violation
verificationPatterns.example: Set BKT.HW_Inputs.Temperature.AK_Upper_Blower_Pressure_Sens > 60 (e.g., 61); verify PRESSURE_INVALID event with sensor ID 'AK pressure sensor', actual value 61 and limit 60

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event appearance across all machine states
verificationPatterns.example: Repeat boundary violations in READY, PRE PRINT, POST PRINT, DYNAMIC READY, STBY, OFF, INITIALIZE; PRESSURE_INVALID event must appear in each state

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition behavior during event
verificationPatterns.example: For DYNAMIC READY/PRE PRINT/PRINT: maintain or transition to READY state; for STBY and below: no state change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault during heating triggers error event with ID 3
verificationPatterns.example: When blanket manager in go to heating status and inverter STATUS=TRUE → BLANKET_AK_INVERTER_AT_FAULT event appears with error ID 3

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fault at OFF state does not trigger event
verificationPatterns.example: Press at OFF state, set inverter STATUS=TRUE → BLANKET_AK_INVERTER_AT_FAULT doesn't appear

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event forces component OFF and system to STBY
verificationPatterns.example: After error event → gInterface.BKT.Comp.Drying.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true AND OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = 6 (stby)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event only appears when heating is active
verificationPatterns.example: Same fault stimulus in READY/PRE_PRINT/POST_PRINT/DYNAMIC_READY/STBY states → event only appears when gInterface.BKT.Comp.Drying.Ctrl.Out.Status.Atheating = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event appears with correct actual and limit values
verificationPatterns.example: BLANKET_AK_BLOWER_HIGH_RPM event with Actual Value = OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.BKT.HW_Outputs.Ak_Upper_Blower.Simulation.Value and Limit Value = SetPoint + MaxRpmDelta

verificationPatterns.pattern: Air knife component transitions to OFF state
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Comp.Drying.Comp.AirKnifeUpper.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOff = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state behavior differs by current state
verificationPatterns.example: In DYNAMIC_READY/PRE_PRINT/PRINT: move to READY; in GR: move to STBY; in STBY and below: no state change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Recovery from error restores normal state transitions
verificationPatterns.example: After removing simulation changes: from READY → PRE_PRINT (state 9) → PRINT (state 10); from STBY → GR (state 7)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Separation order warning icon and tooltip appear on job when auto mode conflicts with original order
verificationPatterns.example: Error availability appears; tooltip: 'Separation Order Warning. Order mode is set to Auto. Ignoring warning will print the job not according to the original separation order.'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error icon in job properties jumps UI to separation tab on click
verificationPatterns.example: Click error icon in job properties → UI navigates to separation tab

verificationPatterns.pattern: White position dropdown initial state reflects current separation order
verificationPatterns.example: White position last is initially selected in dropdown

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print order tab displays auto mode with yellow-colored text
verificationPatterns.example: order mode = Auto displayed with Yellow color text in Print Order tab

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket rotation order updates when white position selection changes
verificationPatterns.example: Select white first → 1st blanket: White, 2nd blanket: Yellow/Black, 3rd blanket: Cyan/Magenta/White

verificationPatterns.pattern: Toggle separation order error to warning state enables print button
verificationPatterns.example: Icon turns gray after toggle; print button becomes available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stripe descriptor in PLC logs captures blanket rotation mapping with ink IDs and HV targets

verificationPatterns.pattern: PLC log verification - stripe descriptor structure and ink routing
verificationPatterns.example: stripeDescriptor.stripeId=1; dataTransferControl=IMG_TO_SUBSTRATE; sliceGroups with hvTargetType (HV_TO_PRINT, HV_TO_NULL) and inkId values

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print history verification - PrintOrder array and separation order type
verificationPatterns.example: PrintOrder entries with Yellow/Black/Cyan inks at stations 1/2/1 with separation indices 1/2/3 and rotation indices 1/1/2; PrintInfo.SeparationOrderType=Auto

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI configuration verification - Job properties, separations tab, white position dropdown, print order display
verificationPatterns.example: Open job properties > separation tab > verify White position dropdown appears > verify print order shows 1st blanket Rotation - Yellow, Magenta, Cyan, Black, White

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log verification for stripe descriptor with separation order
verificationPatterns.example: In Press.Host.AppDev.Log > Press.BL.Printing.PLC.PrintControlManager, search stripeDescriptor.stripeId=1, verify dataTransferControl=IMG_TO_SUBSTRATE, firstInBlanketLoop=True, sliceGroups hvTargetType and inkId match expected

verificationPatterns.pattern: History verification for print order parameters and separation indices
verificationPatterns.example: Verify print-attempt-end-history PrintOrder array contains InkName, MEStation, Bid, SeparationIndex, RotationIndex, RepeatType, AverageInkCoverage with correct values, plus PrintInfo.SeparationOrderType and WhiteSeparationOrderOnSubstrate

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error and warning handling for blanket rotation mismatch
verificationPatterns.example: When white position changed and rotations exceed limit, verify error message 'Print order cannot be displayed because at least one ink is deactivated or not installed' and warning icon with tooltip 'Blanket Rotations mismatch - Job number of separations exceeds allowed number of blanket rotations'

verificationPatterns.pattern: Configuration constraint adjustment and revalidation
verificationPatterns.example: Modify Press.IBL.Printing.IPC.UserJobPrintOrderConfigEntity > MaximumNumberOfRotationsForUserJobs = 2, reopen job properties, verify separation order updates to 1st blanket Rotation = White, 2nd blanket Rotation = Yellow, Magenta, Cyan, Black

verificationPatterns.pattern: Manual mode error state and override
verificationPatterns.example: Print button unavailable with error icon; tooltip shows 'Separation order warning' header; toggle error to enable mode grays out error and enables print button

verificationPatterns.pattern: Manual mode label visibility
verificationPatterns.example: Job properties → Print Order tab shows order mode = Manual with yellow text; White position dropdown absent in separation tab

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket rotation order verification
verificationPatterns.example: 1st Blanket Rotation: Yellow, Magenta, Cyan, Black, Violet, Orange; 2nd Blanket Rotation: Green, Premium White

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log stripe descriptor structure
verificationPatterns.example: Press.BL.Printing.PLC.PrintControlManager log: stripeDescriptor.stripeId=1 with 6 HV_TO_PRINT slices in first group, 4 HV_TO_NULL and 2 HV_TO_PRINT in second group

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print history metadata
verificationPatterns.example: PrintOrder array: 8 entries with MEStation/SeparationIndex/RotationIndex progression; PrintInfo.SeparationOrderType=Manual, WhiteSeparationOrderOnSubstrate=Surface

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error state and button availability match separation order mode
verificationPatterns.example: Auto: no error icon, print button available. Manual: error icon red until toggled grayed out, then print button becomes available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Order mode label text color indicates active mode
verificationPatterns.example: Auto mode: 'Auto' text in white. Manual mode: 'Manual' text in yellow

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket rotation grouping matches separation order
verificationPatterns.example: Auto: 1st blanket=YMCK, 2nd=M. Manual: 1st blanket=YM, 2nd=MCK

verificationPatterns.pattern: stripeDescriptor slice configuration in logs reflects print order
verificationPatterns.example: Search Press.BL.Printing.PLC.PrintControlManager logs for stripeId=1, verify sliceGroups[].slices[].hvTargetType and inkId match expected ink routing

verificationPatterns.pattern: PrintOrder array in print-attempt-end-history contains all separations with correct RotationIndex and RepeatType
verificationPatterns.example: Auto: 5 entries (YMCK rotation 1 + M double-hit rotation 2). Manual: 5 entries (YM rotation 1 + MCK rotation 2)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Order mode label displayed as Auto with white font color
verificationPatterns.example: order mode = Auto; The font text color = "Auto" appears with white color

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket rotation sequence matches ink separation
verificationPatterns.example: YMCK: Yellow, Magenta, Cyan, Black; YMCKOVG with green disabled: Yellow, Magenta, Cyan, Black, Violet, Orange

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log signature: stripe descriptor structure with slice groups
verificationPatterns.example: In Press.BL.Printing.PLC.PrintControlManager logs, stripeDescriptor with stripeId=1, dataTransferControl=IMG_TO_SUBSTRATE, firstInBlanketLoop=True, lastInBlanketLoop=False, slices[0-5] with hvTargetType=HV_TO_PRINT

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print history: PrintOrder array with ink station mappings
verificationPatterns.example: print-attempt-end-history contains PrintOrder array with InkName, MEStation (1-4 or 1-6), SeparationIndex, RotationIndex=1, RepeatType=Source, AverageInkCoverage=0.5

verificationPatterns.pattern: Separation order type recorded as Auto

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blanket rotation order UI verification

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stripe descriptor log verification

verificationPatterns.example: Validate PrintOrder array with InkName, MEStation, Bid, SeparationIndex, RotationIndex, RepeatType, AverageInkCoverage; verify PrintInfo.SeparationOrderType and PrintInfo.WhiteSeparationOrderOnSubstrate

Counter values match across three independent sources

verificationPatterns.pattern: Mechinit sequence completes despite error

verificationPatterns.pattern: Temperature spike rejection when delta exceeds threshold
verificationPatterns.example: Inject 116 when baseline is 105 (delta=11 > max=10): reading rejected, AbnormalTempChangeCount increments by 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Last valid reading retention during spike
verificationPatterns.example: After spike to 116 is rejected, BcrLastTemperatureReading remains 105 for control logic

verificationPatterns.pattern: No immediate error state on single spike
verificationPatterns.example: TEMP_UNEXPECTED_READING stays false despite spike, press state unchanged at GetReady

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter persistence across recovery
verificationPatterns.example: After returning to normal (105), AbnormalTempChanges counter persists at value 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Duration accumulation during anomaly window
verificationPatterns.example: AbnormalTempChangesDurationMs accumulates > 0 during and after the spike period

verificationPatterns.pattern: Abnormal counter unchanged when delta is within BcrMaxTempDelta
verificationPatterns.example: delta = 5 (105→110), BcrMaxTempDelta = 10, Counters.AbnormalTempChanges = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Current and last temperature readings updated after valid delta
verificationPatterns.example: RollerTemp = 110, BcrLastTemperatureReading = 110

verificationPatterns.pattern: No error flags raised on valid temperature change
verificationPatterns.example: TEMP_UNEXPECTED_READING = false

verificationPatterns.pattern: Temperature baseline validation
verificationPatterns.example: Inject BKT.HW_Inputs.Stir.STIR_RollerTemp = 68, verify reads in gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Comp.Heating.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.RollerTemp, BcrTempInvalid = false, BcrLastTemperatureReading = 68

verificationPatterns.pattern: Spike detection with threshold comparison
verificationPatterns.example: Inject STIR_RollerTemp = 116 (delta 11 > BcrMaxTempDelta 10) for 1 sec, verify AbnormalTempChanges incremented to 1, last valid reading unchanged at 105, no error raised

verificationPatterns.pattern: Isolated anomaly without state change
verificationPatterns.example: After spike injection, verify MachineState remains 7 (GetReady), TEMP_UNEXPECTED_READING = false, abnormal counter persists across temperature recovery

verificationPatterns.pattern: Report generation on state transition
verificationPatterns.example: Move press from Ready to Standby, verify BcrUnexpectedTemperatureReport generated, AbnormalTempChangesDurationMs accumulated (> 0), counter history retained

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inspect bypass configuration state
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Ctrl.In.Par.Config.Bypass.StirRollerInPlaceBypass = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify temperature validity and heating status
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Comp.Heating.Ctrl.Out.Status.BcrTempInvalid = false; AtHeatingOn = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify machine state via OPC UA: expected state and fallback state on error
verificationPatterns.example: State = 7 (GetReady) during operation; State = 6 (Standby) after TEMP_UNEXPECTED_READING error

verificationPatterns.pattern: Monitor baseline temperature reading to establish reference point
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Comp.Heating.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.BcrLastTemperatureReading = 105

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify error raised when spike delta exceeds threshold (>BcrMaxTempDelta=10) and persists beyond duration limit (>BcrUnexpectedTemperatureDurationLimit=5sec)
verificationPatterns.example: TEMP_UNEXPECTED_READING = true; AbnormalTempChangesDurationMs >= 5000

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter increment on each abnormal temperature spike
verificationPatterns.example: After each spike (delta > 10°C), verify AbnormalTempChanges counter increments: spike 1 → counter=1, spike 2 → counter=2

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error suppression when duration below threshold
verificationPatterns.example: Spikes lasting < 5 sec (BcrUnexpectedTemperatureDurationLimit) do not set TEMP_UNEXPECTED_READING = true, even with multiple spikes

verificationPatterns.pattern: Last valid temperature preservation during anomalies
verificationPatterns.example: BcrLastTemperatureReading preserves last stable value (105) while abnormal readings occur; only updates on stable return

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press state stability during brief anomalies
verificationPatterns.example: MachineState.State remains unchanged (State = 7) while spikes occur below duration limit

verificationPatterns.pattern: Duration accumulation tracking
verificationPatterns.example: AbnormalTempChangesDurationMs accumulates > 0 upon return to normal, capturing total abnormal time even if error not triggered

verificationPatterns.pattern: Temperature injection verification - monitor signal reflects injected value
verificationPatterns.example: Inject BKT.HW_Inputs.Stir.STIR_RollerTemp = 105, verify gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Comp.Heating.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.RollerTemp = 105

verificationPatterns.pattern: Low temperature boundary detection - TEMP_LOW error and state regression
verificationPatterns.example: Inject STIR_RollerTemp = 50 (below StirTempWorkingExitLow) for StirTempExitDelay duration; expect TEMP_LOW error and MachineState.State regression from 8 to 7

verificationPatterns.pattern: High temperature boundary detection - TEMP_HIGH error and state regression
verificationPatterns.example: Inject STIR_RollerTemp = 150 (above StirTempWorkingExitHigh) for StirTempExitDelay duration; expect TEMP_HIGH error and MachineState.State regression from 8 to 7

verificationPatterns.pattern: Temperature recovery cycle - restore valid temp to return to Ready
verificationPatterns.example: After boundary violation triggers state regression, inject valid temperature (105°C) and move press back to Ready state (MachineState.State = 8)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Invalid temperature detection (below valid range)
verificationPatterns.example: Inject STIR_RollerTemp = -50 (below BcrTempValidLow), verify BcrTempInvalid = TRUE and UnavailabilityReason = TEMP_INVALID

verificationPatterns.pattern: System state lockout on invalid temperature
verificationPatterns.example: While BcrTempInvalid = TRUE, attempt GR start and verify machine remains in Standby (State = 6) with Print disabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: Recovery from invalid temperature
verificationPatterns.example: Inject valid temperature (105) and verify BcrTempInvalid transitions to FALSE

verificationPatterns.pattern: High temperature detection (above working range)
verificationPatterns.example: Inject STIR_RollerTemp = 200 (above StirTempWorkingExitHigh) for StirTempExitDelay, verify BcrTempTooHigh = TRUE and UnavailabilityReason = TEMP_TOO_HIGH

verificationPatterns.pattern: Out-of-range temperature below BcrTempValidLow triggers BcrTempInvalid error
verificationPatterns.example: Inject STIR_RollerTemp = -50; verify BcrTempInvalid = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Out-of-range temperature above BcrTempValidHigh triggers BcrTempInvalid error
verificationPatterns.example: Inject STIR_RollerTemp = 500; verify BcrTempInvalid = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press drops to Off (3) when temperature becomes invalid from Ready (8)
verificationPatterns.example: At state 8, inject invalid temp; verify MachineState.State = 3

verificationPatterns.pattern: Press drops to Off (3) when temperature becomes invalid from Print (10) or above
verificationPatterns.example: At state 10, inject invalid temp; verify MachineState.State = 3

verificationPatterns.pattern: BcrTempInvalid clears when temperature returns to valid range
verificationPatterns.example: After invalid injection, inject STIR_RollerTemp = 105; verify BcrTempInvalid = false

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify default parameter values for temperature anomaly detection
verificationPatterns.example: Read gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Comp.Heating.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.Monitoring.Temp.AbnormalTempChange_AllowedTempDiff and verify = 10

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify timeout/duration parameter defaults
verificationPatterns.example: Read gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Comp.Heating.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.Monitoring.Temp.AbnormalTempChange_Timeout and verify = 5

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify counter initial values are zero
verificationPatterns.example: Read gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Comp.Heating.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.Counters.AbnormalTempChanges and verify = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify monitor duration initial values are zero
verificationPatterns.example: Read gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Comp.Heating.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.AbnormalTempChangesDurationMs and verify = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify last temperature reading initial state
verificationPatterns.example: Read gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Comp.Heating.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.BcrLastTemperatureReading and verify initial value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Temperature spike counter increments when delta exceeds threshold
verificationPatterns.example: Inject temp spike from 105 to 116 (delta=11 > 10), verify AbnormalTempChanges counter = 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary value acceptance - temperature delta equals exactly BcrMaxTempDelta
