verificationPatterns.pattern: Temperature spike rejection - abnormal reading exceeding threshold is ignored
verificationPatterns.example: Inject STIR_RollerTemp = 116 (exceeds BcrMaxTempDelta by 1°C), verify no TEMP_UNEXPECTED_READING event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter increment - AbnormalTempChanges increments on detected anomaly
verificationPatterns.example: After spike, Counters.AbnormalTempChanges = 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Last valid temperature recovery - system uses last valid reading for control
verificationPatterns.example: RollerTemp = 105, AbnormalTempChange_LastValidTemp = 105

verificationPatterns.pattern: State stability - no state transition on temperature anomaly
verificationPatterns.example: MachineState.State remains 7 (GetReady) after temperature spike

verificationPatterns.pattern: Temperature threshold violation triggers event
verificationPatterns.example: Inject STIR_RollerTemp = 116 (delta 11 > BcrMaxTempDelta 10) for > 5 sec (BcrUnexpectedTemperatureDurationLimit), verify TEMP_UNEXPECTED_READING event with SensorID, actual temp 116, last valid temp 105

verificationPatterns.pattern: State rollback on thermal error
verificationPatterns.example: When TEMP_UNEXPECTED_READING raised, verify MachineState.State transitions from GetReady (7) back to Standby (6)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Component off-state on error
verificationPatterns.example: When temperature error detected, verify Stir.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOFF = true per Events Table #7

verificationPatterns.pattern: Recovery capability post-error
verificationPatterns.example: Restore RollerTemp to 105, restart GetReady, verify MachineState.State = 7 and Stir heating resumes (AtHeatingOn = true)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Below threshold: spike not flagged, raw reading accepted
verificationPatterns.example: Delta=9 (105→114): AbnormalTempChanges=0, RollerTemp=114

verificationPatterns.pattern: At threshold: boundary condition behavior check
verificationPatterns.example: Delta=10 (105→115): Verify AbnormalTempChange_AllowedTempDiff=10, check counter increment

verificationPatterns.pattern: Above threshold: spike flagged, counter incremented, last valid temp retained
verificationPatterns.example: Delta=11 (105→116): AbnormalTempChanges incremented, RollerTemp filtered to 105, LastValidTemp=105

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify component mirrors injected hardware temperature
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Comp.Heating.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.RollerTemp = 105

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify temperature threshold event fires when anomaly sustained beyond duration limit
verificationPatterns.example: TEMP_UNEXPECTED_READING event raised and visible in SW UI event log when BKT.HW_Inputs.Stir.STIR_RollerTemp = 116 for >5 seconds

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify component shutdown on anomaly detection
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOFF = true when temperature anomaly detected

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify machine state regression on component fault
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State < 10 (reverts from Print state)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify full recovery after fault resolution
verificationPatterns.example: GetReady + move to Print restores State = 10 and AtHeatingOn = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Phase 3 abnormal temperature change counter resets to zero
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Comp.Heating.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.Counters.AbnormalTempChanges = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Phase 3 abnormal temperature change duration resets to zero
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.BKT.ExportedData.Stir.Monitor.AbnormalTempChangesDurationMs = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default temperature delta threshold parameter matches SWR specification
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Comp.Heating.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.Monitoring.Temp.AbnormalTempChange_AllowedTempDiff = 10 (deg Celsius)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Default temperature monitoring timeout parameter matches SWR specification
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Comp.Heating.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.Monitoring.Temp.AbnormalTempChange_Timeout = 5000 (msec)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary testing: below-threshold spike behavior
verificationPatterns.example: Inject spike (delta > 10) for 4 sec (below 5-sec limit), verify no TEMP_UNEXPECTED_READING event, counter AbnormalTempChanges incremented, state remains 7 (GetReady)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Boundary testing: at-threshold spike behavior
verificationPatterns.example: Inject same spike for exactly 5 sec (at limit), verify TEMP_UNEXPECTED_READING event raised in SW UI, state transitions to 6 (Standby)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Temperature injection via PEX Systab
verificationPatterns.example: BKT.HW_Inputs.Stir.STIR_RollerTemp = <value> injected and monitored via gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Comp.Heating.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.RollerTemp

verificationPatterns.pattern: State machine verification on event threshold
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State: 7 (GetReady) below threshold, 6 (Standby) at threshold

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter validation matches timeout configuration
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Comp.Heating.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.Monitoring.Temp.AbnormalTempChange_Timeout = 5000 msec

verificationPatterns.pattern: Temperature spike detection increments counter
verificationPatterns.example: Inject STIR_RollerTemp = 116 (delta > 10) for 1 second; verify AbnormalTempChanges counter = 1

verificationPatterns.pattern: Report generation requires concurrent triggers

verificationPatterns.pattern: Report content includes counter deltas and hardware metrics

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal injection via HW_Inputs, verify at Monitor level

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state verification via OPCUAInterface

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal injection propagation from HW_Inputs to Monitor

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold-based event triggering with duration gate

verificationPatterns.pattern: Event metadata and remediation guidance

verificationPatterns.pattern: Recovery verification - no spurious events on restoration

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify heating activated after GetReady

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inject temperature noise and verify counter/duration increment

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify counter and duration reset upon PLC reset

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify normal operation restores without counter increment
verificationPatterns.example: GetReady started again, AtHeatingOn = true, AbnormalTempChanges stays = 0

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transitions are reflected in MachineState signal

verificationPatterns.pattern: Counter remains unchanged when no anomalies detected

verificationPatterns.pattern: Component isolation - affected component transitions to Off per Events Table
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.BKT.Comp.Stir.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOFF = true

verificationPatterns.pattern: Recovery verification - restore nominal condition and confirm normal restart

verificationPatterns.pattern: Duration cumulative across spikes

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify wizard success indication
verificationPatterns.example: Wizard indicates substrate reached T2 successfully

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify no unintended advance after wizard close
verificationPatterns.example: Substrate remains at T2 position, no further advance occurs toward RW

verificationPatterns.pattern: Configuration applied
verificationPatterns.example: verify configuration applied (Step 1)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state via OPCUA
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = 6

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal inspection via PEX

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard blocking on insufficient resources

verificationPatterns.pattern: Signal inspection via UA Expert

verificationPatterns.pattern: Cancellation during advance stops substrate motion and maintains safe state
verificationPatterns.example: Click Cancel/Stop before substrate reaches T2 → substrate stops → Press remains Standby (State=6), no faults

verificationPatterns.pattern: Wizard restart after cancellation completes full advance cycle
verificationPatterns.example: Re-open wizard, select RW, restart advance → substrate advances full distance to 28000 mm

verificationPatterns.pattern: Stepping overlap distance reaches configured limit after successful advance
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.WHS.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.WebFeed.SteppingOverLapDist = 28000 mm when substrate reaches RW

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state tracking
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = 6 for Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Web break simulation via tension injection
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.WHS.Ctrl.Out.Monitor.FiTension = 0 for break, = 6000 for recovery

verificationPatterns.pattern: Axis fault response verification
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtOFF = True when fault active

verificationPatterns.pattern: Advance halt on fault
verificationPatterns.example: Substrate advance stops when web break event raised in UI event log

verificationPatterns.pattern: Post-fault recovery cycle
verificationPatterns.example: Clear fault, re-open wizard, verify advance resumes to RW (28000 mm) and completes

verificationPatterns.pattern: Advance to intermediate position with distance verification
verificationPatterns.example: Select T2 destination, substrate advances 14000 mm from UW, verify SteppingT2Dist = 14000 via gInterface.Web.Comp.WHS.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.WebFeed.SteppingT2Dist

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequential advance from intermediate to final with cumulative distance check
verificationPatterns.example: Select RW from T2, substrate advances 14000 mm, verify total UW→RW distance SteppingOverLapDist = 28000 mm

verificationPatterns.pattern: Configuration acceptance
verificationPatterns.example: Configuration accepted when UW_CONFIG_TYPE set to Narrow_UW_60m_PerMin_max_speed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Lift arm monitoring active detection
verificationPatterns.example: Lift arm position monitoring is ACTIVE for this config

verificationPatterns.pattern: Blocking on precondition failure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Normal operation on precondition met
verificationPatterns.example: MechInit proceeds normally and Press reaches Standby when LiftArmTopPosition = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: State transition verification
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = 6 (Standby)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sustained monitoring without interference
verificationPatterns.example: Lift arm monitoring active throughout — no unavailability reason displayed

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify substrate advances exactly a specified distance via OPC UA parameter
verificationPatterns.example: Substrate advances exactly SteppingT2Dist = 14000 mm via UA Expert: gInterface.Web.Comp.WHS.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.WebFeed.SteppingT2Dist = 14000

verificationPatterns.pattern: Verify total cumulative distance equals sum of sequential advances
verificationPatterns.example: Total distance traveled from UW to RW = 28000 mm via UA Expert: gInterface.Web.Comp.WHS.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.WebFeed.SteppingOverLapDist = 28000

verificationPatterns.pattern: Confirm mathematical consistency between derived and component values
verificationPatterns.example: SteppingRwDist = SteppingT2Dist + SteppingT2RwDist (28000 = 14000 + 14000)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Machine state reaches Standby after MechInit
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Global.ExportedData.MachineState.State = 6

verificationPatterns.pattern: SteppingT2Dist parameter matches engine configuration

verificationPatterns.pattern: SteppingT2RwDist parameter matches engine configuration
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.WHS.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.WebFeed.SteppingT2RwDist = 14000 for Engine_3ME_Narrow/RW

verificationPatterns.pattern: SteppingRwDist equals sum of component distances
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Web.Comp.WHS.Ctrl.In.Par.Local.WebFeed.SteppingOverLapDist = 28000 (14000 + 14000)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error signal triggers event after configurable delay when prerequisites met
verificationPatterns.example: Set EF201_ERR=1 → EF201 Event appears after EfuseErrOnTimeDelay (default 1s)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Missing prerequisite suppresses monitoring despite error signal
verificationPatterns.example: PS201_DC_OK=0 + EF201_ERR=1 → No EF201 Event, press goes OFF

verificationPatterns.pattern: Monitoring resumes when prerequisites restored
verificationPatterns.example: Restore PS201_DC_OK=1 while EF201_ERR=1 → FUSE_GENERAL_ERROR event appears

verificationPatterns.pattern: Delay configurable via parameter, verified across press states
verificationPatterns.example: Change EfuseErrOnTimeDelay to 10s, verify event appears after 10s in Standby, GR, dynamic ready, print states

verificationPatterns.pattern: Prerequisite-gated monitoring
verificationPatterns.example: EF501 monitoring starts only when PS501_DC_OK=1 AND SW500_Monitor.Out.Status.Enabled=TRUE

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event with configurable delay
verificationPatterns.example: Setting EF501_ERR=1 triggers FUSE_GENERAL_ERROR event after EfuseErrOnTimeDelay (1s or 10s)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Prerequisite failure disables monitoring
verificationPatterns.example: When PS501_DC_OK=0, press goes to Off, PS501 Failure event fires, EF501 monitoring stops

verificationPatterns.pattern: Error event triggered after configurable delay
verificationPatterns.example: set EF400_ERR Value = 1, wait 1s, verify EF400 Event with parameters (fuse name, channel, cabinet)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Monitoring prerequisites gate event generation
verificationPatterns.example: set PS201_DC_OK=0, set EF400_ERR=1, verify no EF400 Event since monitoring prerequisites not met

verificationPatterns.pattern: Delay parameter drives event timing
verificationPatterns.example: Change EfuseErrOnTimeDelay to 10s, set EF400_ERR=1, verify event after 10s

verificationPatterns.pattern: Behavior consistent across press states
verificationPatterns.example: repeat steps 3–6 in GR, dynamic ready, print states; verify same behaviour, no press state change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Fetch documents from each source and compare
verificationPatterns.example: Fetch Elastic search docs for the index and store them in a list; Fetch S3 docs for the index and store them in a list; Compare both lists and store results in a table

verificationPatterns.pattern: Export comparison results to file
verificationPatterns.example: Write table to csv file

verificationPatterns.pattern: Log summary of test results
verificationPatterns.example: Summarize tests results and write them in the logs

verificationPatterns.pattern: Extract and compare data from two sources using column whitelist
verificationPatterns.example: Send whitelist of columns and only these columns get compared between S3 and PrintOS files

verificationPatterns.pattern: Map comparison status per row
verificationPatterns.example: Compare csv files from S3 and PrintOS (defined columns) and map comparison status in Results file

verificationPatterns.pattern: Aggregate results across resource set
verificationPatterns.example: Summarize comparison results for all the presses in the list

verificationPatterns.pattern: No error when pressure in valid range, blowers not high speed
verificationPatterns.example: ValidHigh (2000) > VALUE > PanicHigh (1229), blowers off → no errors in UI

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic high failure: stop operation, return to stable state, send failure event
verificationPatterns.example: VALUE between PanicHigh (1229) and ValidHigh (2000) while BlowersAtHighSpeed=true → Get Ready stopped, return to Standby, FLOW_PANIC_HIGH event, Status=7

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic low failure: stop operation, return to stable state, send failure event
verificationPatterns.example: VALUE between ValidLow (0) and PanicLow (291) while BlowersAtHighSpeed=true → Get Ready stopped, return to Standby, FLOW_PANIC_LOW event, Status=6

verificationPatterns.pattern: Multi-state failure: return to Ready (not origin state), remain operational
verificationPatterns.example: Panic failures from Dynamic Ready/Pre-Print/Print/Post-Print → press returns to Ready state, Print available

verificationPatterns.pattern: No error in low-speed operation
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate violation with blowers not at high speed → no errors in UI after 5 seconds

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic high violation stops operation and returns to stable state
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate CVC_MIDDLE_BLOWER_DELTA_AIR_PRESSURE between PanicHigh (1229) and ValidHigh (2000) during high-speed → operation stops, press returns to closest stable state, FLOW_PANIC_HIGH event sent, status = 7

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic low violation stops operation and returns to stable state
verificationPatterns.example: Simulate CVC_MIDDLE_BLOWER_DELTA_AIR_PRESSURE between PanicLow (360) and ValidLow (0) during high-speed → operation stops, press returns to closest stable state, FLOW_PANIC_LOW event sent, status = 6

verificationPatterns.pattern: Failure message structure with subsystem, sensor, event, limit
verificationPatterns.example: Subsystem: CVC, Sensor ID: CVC_BLOWER_MIDDLE_PRESSURE_SNS, Event ID: FLOW_PANIC_HIGH/FLOW_PANIC_LOW, Limit value: 700 (high) or 360 (low)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Return state determined by origin—closest stable state available
verificationPatterns.example: From Get Ready → return to Standby with GR available. From Dynamic Ready/Pre-Print/Print/Post-Print → return to Ready with Print available

verificationPatterns.pattern: Flag value verification via OPCUA signals
verificationPatterns.example: OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.LPHCooling.ImportedData.Config.LPHCoolingProportionalVlvConfigType.Value = 1 (Rotary_Actuator) or 2 (Rotary_Actuator_IP54)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Configuration change confirmation

verificationPatterns.pattern: UI appearance against reference image

verificationPatterns.pattern: Part number tracking
verificationPatterns.example: Part number changes to correct P/N for selected valve type (Rotary_Actuator or Rotary_Actuator_IP54)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Configuration persistence across system reset

verificationPatterns.pattern: Invalid low pressure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Invalid high pressure

verificationPatterns.pattern: State-dependent response to invalid pressure

verificationPatterns.pattern: Air shaft command controls inflate/deflate transitions
verificationPatterns.example: Cmd.AirShaft=true (inflate), Cmd.AirShaft=false (deflate), Cmd.AirShaft=true (re-inflate)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Motor energize on operation start

verificationPatterns.pattern: Motor de-energize on operation stop
verificationPatterns.example: Call EnergizeMotor#Stop → MotorEnergized becomes false

verificationPatterns.pattern: Availability status progression through valve control

verificationPatterns.pattern: Shaft operation state transitions

verificationPatterns.pattern: Sequence start/stop output status

verificationPatterns.pattern: Availability status transitions based on operation mode

verificationPatterns.pattern: Operations unavailable until service mode and EA mode initiated

verificationPatterns.pattern: Availability status progression through precondition validation

verificationPatterns.pattern: Motor energized state lifecycle matches operation calls

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inactive BID state at blanket rotation start (BktPosRel = loopStartAbsPosUnits)

verificationPatterns.pattern: ASID voltages during blanket revolution

verificationPatterns.pattern: Inactive BID remains disengaged at rotation boundary

verificationPatterns.pattern: Data mismatch: LPHC NONE (press stops) → PC aborts, falls to ready

verificationPatterns.pattern: FSM/internal error requiring reset: LPHC LPHC_RESET → PC aborts, ready, resets host and LPHC

verificationPatterns.pattern: Startup/initialization failure: LPHC wait_setup → PC issues error
verificationPatterns.example: ALARM_TYPE_LPH_STARTUP_FAILURE: LPHC wait_setup. PC issues error, generates LPH_STARTUP_FAILED

verificationPatterns.pattern: Warning-level threshold: LPHC NONE → PC no state change

verificationPatterns.pattern: Non-critical hot-folder failure: LPHC NONE → PC no action

verificationPatterns.pattern: Dual-layer parameter verification across stations: check OPCUA ImportedData values, then verify matching PLC gInterface values
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 2-3, 4-5, 6-7, etc: Check OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStations.MEStation[N].ImportedData.Bids.Bid[N].Rot.Param values, then verify gInterface.Stations.Station[N].Comp.Bid[N].Comp.Rot.Ctrl.In.Par.Import values match

verificationPatterns.pattern: Parameter pair verification: always test both BidToAsidRelativeVelocityLow and BidToAsidRelativeVelocityPanicLow in same step for same bid/station
verificationPatterns.example: Verify BidToAsidRelativeVelocityLow = 90 AND BidToAsidRelativeVelocityPanicLow = 50 in same assertion

verificationPatterns.pattern: Color change wizard triggers parameter update: apply wizard to change ink, verify ink field updated, then re-verify both OPCUA and PLC parameters reflect new values
verificationPatterns.example: Steps 18-20: Open color change wizard, replace Ink #7 to Yellow, verify Ink #7 updated to Yellow, then check parameters now show Yellow values (90/50 instead of prior 93/90)

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic-high threshold violation causes state change to Ready and failure event
verificationPatterns.example: Set BidToAsidRelativeVelocityPanicHigh to 125, expect MOTOR_VELOCITY_PANIC_HIGH event with MotorID, ActualVelocity, Velocitylimit

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic-low threshold violation causes state change to Ready and failure event
verificationPatterns.example: Set BidToAsidRelativeVelocityPanicLow below threshold, expect MOTOR_VELOCITY_PANIC_LOW event with MotorID, ActualVelocity, Velocitylimit

verificationPatterns.pattern: Threshold violation < delay tolerance is suppressed
verificationPatterns.example: Violate panic threshold for <2sec (BidDevMonitorVelocityDelay), no failure event published, press continues printing

verificationPatterns.pattern: Velocity low (non-panic) threshold publishes event but press continues
verificationPatterns.example: Set BidToAsidRelativeVelocityLow below threshold, expect MOTOR_VELOCITY_LOW event with no state change, press continues printing

verificationPatterns.pattern: State machine transitions
verificationPatterns.example: MachineState.State: OFF → Standby → GET_READY → DYNAMIC_READY

verificationPatterns.pattern: BID engagement sync across stations during print
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.Stations.StationX.Comp.BidX.Main.Out.Status.AtPrintSync = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Ink pump stability during operation
verificationPatterns.example: gInterface.arrInk[1].Pump.Ctrl.Out.Status.AtStableDelivery = True AND AtEngage = True

verificationPatterns.pattern: High torque threshold triggers event but press continues
verificationPatterns.example: ActualTorque > BidDevTorqueWorkingHigh → MOTOR_TORQUE_HIGH event published, state unchanged

verificationPatterns.pattern: Panic low torque triggers failsafe state change
verificationPatterns.example: ActualTorque < BidDevTorquePanicLow → MOTOR_TORQUE_PANIC_LOW event published, press → Standby

verificationPatterns.pattern: Transient threshold violation (1 sec) tolerates without failure
verificationPatterns.example: Brief torque excursion for 1 sec → press continues printing without errors

verificationPatterns.pattern: Override restore verifies signal recovery
verificationPatterns.example: Cancel override → ActualTorque returns to previous value

verificationPatterns.pattern: Bypass state toggle verification
verificationPatterns.example: Set BypassStateRequested=True, verify OPCUAInterface.Subsystems.MEStations.MEStation1.ImportedData.Bids.Bid2.Config.Bypass.RotVelocityMonitorBypass.Value=True

verificationPatterns.pattern: Print sync status check across BID stations
verificationPatterns.example: Verify gInterface.Stations.Station1.Comp.Bid2.Main.Out.Status.AtPrintSync=True, gInterface.Stations.Station2.Comp.Bid2.Main.Out.Status.AtPrintSync=True during print

verificationPatterns.pattern: GearDevation panic threshold boundary testing
verificationPatterns.example: Set GearDevation > BidToAsidRelativeVelocityPanicHigh, verify MOTOR_VELOCITY_PANIC_HIGH event NOT published when bypass enabled

verificationPatterns.pattern: GearDevation low threshold with delay monitoring
verificationPatterns.example: Set GearDevation < BidToAsidRelativeVelocityPanicLow for less than BidDevMonitorVelocityDelay (2sec), verify no MOTOR_VELOCITY_PANIC_LOW event

verificationPatterns.pattern: BID presence simulation with calibration state

verificationPatterns.pattern: BID engagement readiness after GET_READY transition

verificationPatterns.pattern: Transient torque spike (1 sec) above working high - no interruption

verificationPatterns.pattern: Torque below panic low threshold - triggers state transition and MOTOR_TORQUE_PANIC_LOW event

verificationPatterns.pattern: Transient torque dip (1 sec) below panic low - no interruption
